dkar chag1 gleng brjod/ 72 rig 'dzin rgod ljem gyi gter ma/ ma 'ongs lung bstan sbas yul gyi them byang bzhugs// 10kro3 rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyi gter ma/ lha sras mu tig btsan po la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis lung bstan sbas yul bdun gyi spyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan bzhugs so// sgrusprote4 rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyi gter ma/ srus pul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig le'u drus pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor bdog go: spro317 sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma/bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: ma 'ongs lung bstan gsang ba'i dkar chag bkod pa zhes pa las 'bras ljongs gnas yig zur phyung / sprorkyo'ocu pad+ma gling pa'i gter ma/ klong gsal gyi skor las/oṃ: sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas yi ga bzhubs so: 23 77 srus yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me lo/nga bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ha77

mkha' spyo da 'bras mo lji+o ngas kyi gnas yig byogs bsngebs bzhugs/rngu gter ston rdo rje bde chen gling pas mdzad pa/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs 'og mi na rnam dag pad+ma dru ba can gyi gnas yig lung bstan gsol 'debs smon lam gter srung gsol mchod bcas bzhugs/ 211lnga lha btsun 'gyur med 'jigs bral bstan 'dzin dpa' bos mdzad pa/ slas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// 3spro0

sngon gleng /sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi rgyal sa sgang tog tu rnam rgyal bod kyi shes rig nyams zhib khang (kho3①2〉mi/1ba5(1(5(༷06116khurdu0/0yusko)kro phyag btab nas mi 'o/ོ 7༷ 'khor ba'i rjes dun srung brtsi'i slad rnam rgyal bod kyi shes rig nyams zhib khang dang / a myes rma chen bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug khang gnyis zung 'brel thog hi ma la ya'i rig gnas lo rgyus deb preng mirnyaṣāmiji0kha1ghu(0‘1khum3bskusbyi1(khu( 2gyo1khu5(5 6(0① (skukhu 51la3/makaumib ṣākhudzi10ba zhes pa'i mu 'brel deb 'phreng 'don 'char gyi 11na 'gror ‘ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdusri zhes pa spar skrun 'grems slel zhu gi yod lags/1 bod sa khyi phyi lo 1'a7rngu lor 'bras ljongs bod kyi shes rig nyams zhib khang (5:khri'i1ba1ṣākhurdukhu3ngangu'i /ba5(1rdu5(ḍū06ka16dzi(0/027) zhes 'bod pa dang / 1rtse76na1lnga77bar rnam rgyal bod kyi shes rig nyams zhib khang (smo1lapyismomi/ 11rdu(1(5(khu 0/ dzhakha/)0(0/0mo) zhes 'bod/ 1rtse 7ca—1khyaji1 bar 'bras ljongs bod kyi shes rig nyams zhib la/ nga (5 khri 6k+ṣe/kurdurirdumi7khu'i1ba8((5(༷061 nedzi(0/0pyikro)zhes par ming bsgyur gnang /1chuji2lo gcig ring (5 khri61ba1 ṣā05dzi37khu'i /ba5( (5(khu 061 khyiX(0/0yusko mib7 0('iX725skusku/15( 5(rdzu sku1dzi3) zhes dang / de rjes 1lngaji3wa1lngalngaji bar 'bras ljongs bod kyi shes rig nyams zhib khang (5 khrikhri1111 ṣādzi5j-i37dzu'i /r+sā8(1((/(0 0/ci /160(0/067) dang /mthar 10rtse⑩ nas bzung slar yang na ma rgyal bod kyai shes rig nyams zhib khang (kho3bkyipyi kā rka /1ba5(1( /(khu06/ /)ji (()/)mo)zhes pa rang 'jags bed spyod gnang /)smu

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rnam rgyal bod kyi shes rig nyams zhib khang 'di ni 'bras ljongs chos rgyal sku rabs bcu gcig pa bkra shis rnam rgyal mchog (spro893—1963) dang rgyal sras bla ma dpal lngan don grub rnam rgyal (1923—1982) phyis 1lngatsu7nas bzung 'bras ljongs chos rgyal sku rabs bcu gnyis par mnga' gsol zung gis thugs bskyed smon lam dang dgongs dkyel rlabs chen zab bzhes las gsar bzhengs thub pa byung /phyi lo 1⑩77phyi blo 2tshes 1༷nyin 7gong sa skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sku dreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog nas brtsigs pa'i rmang rdo 'jog gnang mdzod/phyi lo 1rtse7rnguphyi zla 1༷ tshes 1nyin rgya gar gyi srid blon paṇ+ḍi ta niha ru nas dbu 'byed mdzad sgo bskyangs/de yang 1rtse7ca lor bdag cag gi ston pa bcom lngan 'das sku mya ngan las 'das nas lo 27༷༷ 'khor ba'i rjes dran srung brtsi'i dus chen nyin 'bras ljongs sgang tog rgya gar gzhung gi gsar deb spel 'grems las khungs nas/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du nang pa'i mchod rten dang gnas mchog byin can rnams kyi bshad pa mthong thos kun grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zhes pa'i phyag deb kyi mjug bsdoms lta bur/ gong 'khod zin pa'i gnas chen khag tsam ma yin/ da dung rgya gar du theg pa chen po'i gnas mtsho pad+ma dang / na gar dzun koṣ+ṭa gnyis dang ༈/ 'bras mo ljongs/ lho 'brug khul du 8

sngon gleng /yod pa rnams kyi skor zur du par 'debs bya rtsis bcas/ 2 zhes gsal yang da bar mi lo 72 la nye bar song na'ang 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig gi phyag deb spar 'grems byas rigs mthong thos ma byung / des na da thengs de bas kyang sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdus zhes pa 'di'ang 'bad rtsol chen pos spar 'grems zhu bar bya'o//'o skol gyi 'dzam bu gling gi lho gling dbus ma de yang dbus su ma ga dha rdo rje gdan dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba'i gnas/ shar phyogs rgya nag na 'jam dbyangs gtso 'khor lnga dngos su bzhugs pa'i ri bo rtse lnga rtsis kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa'i sa/ lho phyogs na gnyis med dus 'khor gsungs pa'i dpal lngan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten na ye shes sems dpa' ma bsdus shing dngos su bzhugs pa sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / de'i lho rgya mtsho'i gling na rtse mor lag na pad+ma'i pho brang ri bo gru 'dzin dang rtsa bar rje btsun sgrol ma'i bzhugs gnas yod pa/ hūṃb phyogs na rgyud thams cad kyi gsang mdzod mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du pa'i o rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i pho brang he ru ka rang byung gi gtsug lag khang zhes bya 2 rgya gar gzhungagigasar gnas rgya khyab sreṅge 'grems las khungs kyi ched du/ rgya gar gzhung gi gsar deb rig gnas spel 'grems las khungs sgang tog nas par du bkod pa'o+o/ /ka lhug bod yig par khang du khu zhu mthar phyin gyis par 'debs zhus pa'o//1ṭha7cashag grangs 112nang gsal/9

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ba rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi gnas/ byang phyogs na gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi smin grol rnams chos rgyal rigs lngan rim par byon te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas 4 bha la/rdo rje gdan nas ri rgyud dgu 'das pa na gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa ste 'dzam gling dbus ma'i nang tshan ri bo gangs can nam/ bod yul gangs can gyi ljongs zhes ngo mtshar khyad du 'phags pa bzhugs/ de'i 'dabs 'brel ma hā gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha ba'i dpal gyi mgul nas gter chen dang gter phran du mas thengs gcig ma yin par lan brgyar bsngags pa sbas yul mang po'i nang nas ches khyad du 'phags pa sprus yul thams cad kyi rgyal po mkha' spyod dpal gyi 'bras mo ljongs yang ga la ba der gnas so//de yang rang re nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs kyi rgyud sde las gsungs pa'i gnas dang / nye ba'i gnas sogs mang bar bgrang 'dren brtsi srol yod cing rma bya chen mo 3 sogs nas bzhad pa'i yul 'khor brgya dang / ljongs chen po 3 rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rma bya chen mo'i mdo'i 'bum 'grel zhes bya ba/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍita mkhas pa chen po a mo gha badz+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'o/ /sde dge par khang chos mdzod bkra zhis sgo mang gi bstan 'gyur/7rgyal dbang karma pa bcu drug rig pa'i rdo rje'i ldi li'i spar ma'i rgyud pod du pa'i shog web/ rtse3ba1—241na7 bar dang / lhag par du sgo+og ldeb/ 13jib7—172na3 bcas la sa/zigs 'tshal/kro0

sngon gleng /bcu drug/yul phran snyong sogs yod pa'i khongs nas rgyun du rang re'i mig sngar 'char ba'i gnas chen po brgyad/4ces dang /gnas nyer bzhi/ gnas bcu gnyis/6he ru ka'i gnas bcu/7 yul chen bcu drag8/yul nyi sgo rtsa bzhi/9yal dbas 'es pa la sa tshigs bi ngabang nga thu~X pa ngang chos tshisgos rang ring / / sangami/ ra /ra tsho / 4 dung dkar li mdzod chen mo/krung go'i ngod mig pa dpe skran khang /2༷༷2'di rjes ban+tu sa mi nga / dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo zhes༄ 'god rgyu/ zhog grangs/1222hwa224bar bgrang 'dren 'grel bzhad gsal/dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/zhog grangs/1224—1227bar bgrang 'dren 'grel bzhad gsal/6 dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/zhog grangs/122༷nang bgrang 'dren 'grel bshad gsal/7 dung ngakar tshig mdzod chen mo/zhog grangs/2137nang bgrang 'dren 'grel bzhad gsal/8 dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/zhog grangs/1rnguca1nang bgrang 'dren 'grel bzhad gsal/dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/zhog grangs/1jica1—1rnguca3bar bgrang 'dren 'grel bzhad gsal/thams cad mkhyen pa chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i bkod pa'o//yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i bzhad pa'o//mchan 'di rnams nang du lus la sbyar ba'o//karma pa rang byung rdo je gsung 'bum/pod bcu pa'am tha pa/dpal brtsags bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang /lha sa/2༷༷7dbyin zi 'i zhog grangs 72ṭha—733bar la'ang gzigs/bu ston rin chen grub kyis mdzad pa'i bde mchog spyi rnam do na gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 7rme (179 77/66tre )191350 ṣa3 6(pho/ 75 /ba ba 0 /75 /rdubato0b.lo ba /5 khosmo /khri 96zhog ldeb 27ba2—2d+nghab1bar bde mchog yul

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis las/ dang po'i dbang du shar du li kha ra shing 'phel gyi nags/ lho na 'dam bu can chu klung de ba zhes bya ba 'bab pa/ zhub tu grong ka dang nye ba'i ka ba zhes bya ba yod pa/ byang du uzhi ra'i ri bcas kyi dbus te rgya gar gyi yul dbus ma gha dha rdo rje gdan gyi mchod rten yod sa ni bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong byon pa'i gnas yin pas yul dbus la ngos nyer bzhi'i skor gsal/'jam mgon a myes zhabs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis 1cu3rngu lor mdzad pa'i dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi nying khu 'khor lo sdom pa'i dam pa'i chos byung ba'i tshul legs par bsh-id pa bde mchog chos kun gsal ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhug so/ /zhes pa'i nang / gnas nyer bzhi po de dag yul gang dang gang na yod snyam na/ rtsa rgyud las/ bu la sogs par gang bstan pa/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can du gnas//zhes pa ltar spyir yul nyer bzhi la/ phyi'i yul nyer bzhi dang / nang gi yul nyer bzhi gnyis su yod pa las sogs re re'i ngos 'dzin dpal ldan sa skya'i spar ma'i shog ldeb 47ba2d+ngha47ba2 bar gzigs 'tshal/ ye shes rab 'bar las: rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas mchog nyer bzhi'i dbye ba bzhugs so: gter chen rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po'i (spyo625—1692) zab gter skor bzhugs so/ /pod cha pa/ gter snon sdu med 'od zer gyi gdan sa seng ri bdud 'joms gling gi spar mar sa/zhi bzung gzhi chen be ro sku breng gsum pa pad+ma rgyal mtshan gyi gas/ra srur/ rdo rje gling / 1lnga27 dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 314—31ca bar gsal/ ye shes rab 'bar las/ gnas 'dus rdo rje'i sbas bshad snying po bzhugs so/ /gter chen rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po'i zab gter skor bzhugs so/ /pod cha pa/dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 327—327bar gsal lo///12

sngon gleng /'dzin/ gnyis pa'i dbang du dge slong pha ma gnyis dge tshul pha ma gnyis te 'khor rnom bozhi cha tshang bar yod pa la zer/10 yul sum cu so gnyis 11bcas yad da//bod la'ang bod kyi gnas kha gnyis zhes pa ni/ lha sa gtsug lag khang dang ra mo che gnyis/spro2 chos 'khor gsum ste/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ khra 'abhug go13 /da dung yar klungs gnas gsum ni/ gnas bya sa lha khang / gnas khra 'brug lha khang /gnas btsan thang g.yu yi lha khang /yar klungs rten gsum ni/rten mchog rtag spyan 'bum pa/ rten mchog dgon thang 'bum pa/ rten mchog tshe chu 'bum pa/ yar klungs phug gsum ni/ ras chung phug /be+e ro phyag /shel brag phug 14 sogs mang du mchis/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i (1820—1892) gsung / bod yul gyi rdo rje'i gnas chen dag la bsngags pa'i gtam ḍā ki dgyes pa'i rol mo 10 dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/shog grangs/1jica4nang 'grel bshad gsal/1kro dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/shog grangs/1rngu4canang 'grel bshad gsal/12 dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/ shog grangs/ 1212 nang bgrang 'dren 'grel bshad bkathag05//13 dung dkar tshig mdzod chen mo/shog grangs/ji3rngunang bgrang 'dren 'grel bsh-id gsal/4 mkhas grub/ yar klungs rten gsum gnas sa/sum phyag gsum/ lho kha'i lo rgyus rig gnas dbya da gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/ 'don thengs gsum pa/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dbe skrun khang / 2༷༷cazhog grangs ca3—771 rnye

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/zhes bya ba 15 dang / sku yi dben gnas sgrags yang rdzong dus dgra'i dbang po'i pho brang la bsngags pa'i gtam rdo rje sgra ma'i tasbru ra zhes bya ba/16 gsung gi dbe+en gnas dpal gyi bsam yas mchims phu la bsngags pa'i gtam rdo rje sgra ma'i glu dbyangs zhes bya ba/spro7 thugs kyi dben gnas lho brag mkhar chu rdo rje'i pho brang la bsngags pa'i gtam rdo rje sgra ma'i rol mo zhes bya ba/spyo8 yon tan gyi dben gnas bsam 'grub shel gyi brag phyag la bsngags pa'i gtam rdo rje sgra ma'i mchod sgrin ces bya ba/spyo9phrin las kyi dben gnas mon kha ni ring seng ge'i rdzong du bgrod pa'i gtam rdo rje sgra ma'i ngag ces bya ba/20 rdo rje'i cad gtamagyitshogs rig gzhung rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru jing zhes bya ba bzhugs so//'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i bka' 'bum/pod kha pa/ṣā7midzuXs 0ba35rdurngu‘todzumib2(06 spro977shog grangs 42—4416 gtam gyi tshogs rig gzhung rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzing zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shog grangs 72—7417 gtam gyi tshogs rig gzhung rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzing zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shog grangs 74—7tsu18 gtam gyi tshogs rig gzhung rgya mtshor 'jug pa 'i gru rdzing zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shogre/ grangs 7ca—7rngu/9 gtam gyi tshogs rig gzhung rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzing ne+es bya ba bzhugs so/ /shog grad+ku sa 7/—ca120 gtam gyi tshogs rig gzhung rgya mtshor 3jug pa 'i gru rdzing zhes bya ba bzhusas so༈ /si+og grangs ca1—ca414

sngon glong /gnas chen ser ba byang chub zhing gi dga' tshal la bsngags pa'i gtam drang srong grub pa'i rgyan ces bya ba 21 bcas la'ang gzigs 'tshal/kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs (smo290—spro364) kyi gsung las/ bstan 'gyur nang gnas chen du bgrod tshul dang /bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i skor la/po ṭa la kar 'gro ba'i lam yig rje btsun sbyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ 22 zhes gsal/ 'di ni sde dge bstan 'gyur rgyud tsha pa'i nang bzhugs po ta lar 'gro ba'i lam yig bzhugs/ zhes pa dpal lngan po ta la ka'i rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas gsungs pa rdzogs so/ /pho brang skyid kyi byang mkhar du lha bla ma zhi ba'i blo gros kyi lung gis/ rgya gar zhar phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta a bhi yuk+ta de ba shrī dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba ban+dhe dharma yon tan gyis ji ltar rnyed par bsgyar ba'o/ 23/zhes gsal/skabs 'dir rmongs pas 'ol tshod kyi bsam tshul byes na so skye'i ngo skal du gnas dang / 'phags chen tshor zhing khams su bgrod 'dug snyam/ gang zag gi rgyud tshod mtho dman dang bstun ༵da gtamagyitshogasarib nazhung rgyu mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzing zhes bya ba bzhugs/ so/ /zhog grangs ca4—caca22 bu ston gsung 'bum/deb chen 2rngulo kesha tsan+d+ras sru ra ma /ldi li gsar pa/1lnga71nang sases/ bstan bcos 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi dkar chag yid bzhin gyi nor bya rin po che'i za ma tog ces bya ba bzhus/sa so/ ༈dbyin ri 'i thog grangs/ 7༷2ge3 thob/ lngeb 10༷nac-i—1༷cabacabar gsal /)

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/pa'i mthong snang rnam pa mi 'dra ba 'byung ba dber na/ ‘sngon rgyal ba rgod tshang pa ma pham gyi 'gram nas gangs skor la phebs skabs lha mda'i chu 'gram du phebs shing chu tsha'i skyems shig gsol dgongs nas/ thugs dam gyis ngang nas sgyed rdo btsal bas/ rdo thams cad la lha sku dang yig 'bru sogs rang byon kho nar gyur nas sgyed rdo ma rnyed pas thugs ngo mtshar du gyur nas phyag 'bul bar mdzad/ 24ces pa'i rnam thar lta bu'o//gnyis pa/ bod mis 'du shes 'dzin stangs su gnas kyi skor 'di la bsam gzhigs byed dgos pa mang po yod/ de yang dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ lha was dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod kyi snod lngan gyi slob tshogs la zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu bstsal/ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i bstan 'gro'i gsos dang /dam chos la sel slad mi 'jug pa'i phyir chos nor rten gyi gter kha bgrang las 'das pa sbas// bod kyi sa khol bu lag mthil tsam yang ma lus pa rdzu 'phrul gyis 24 'bri gung gdan rabs so bzhi pa chung tshang sku phreng bzhi pa rje dkon mchog bstan 'dzin chos kyi blo gros phrin las na ma par rgyal ba'i sdes mdzad pa'i/ gangs ri chen po ti se dad+ku mtsho chen ma dros pa bcas kyi sngon 'byung lo rgyus mdor bsdus su brjod pa'i rab byed shel dkar me lod+ku bzhugs so// smo56/5'i(pu 6/ ji)2①rdzu'i()༷ 530990 ji)stu 373 1)snye3/2 1983dbyin ji'i shog grangs/ 172—17316

sngon gleng /zhabs kyis bcags shing sgrub gnas mdzad nas 'brel tshad don lngan chen por byin gyis brlabs/ sprul pa yang sprul rnam mang rim dang cig car byon nas snyigs dus kyi rgyud pa sel zhing / gnas gter gyi sgo 'byed par lung bstan/de spong gter ston yar rje o rgyan gling pa'i (1323—spro360) gter ma bka' thang shel brag gam pad+ma bka' thang las bod nang ma hā gu ru pad+ma saṃ bha dang 'brel ba'i sgrub gnas ngos bzung ba ni/ sgrub gnas kun gyi rgyal po khyad 'phags ni: mkha' 'gro ma bsgrubs rang bzhin 'du ba'i gnas: sku yi dben gnas sgrags kyi yang rdzong yin: gsung gi dben gnas bsam yas mchims phu ste: thugs kyi dben gnas lho brag mkhar chu yin: yon tan dben gnas yar klungs shel gyi brag: phrin las dben gnas mon kha seṅge rdzong : khyad par yar klungs shel brag mchims phu gnyis: rgya sa/ra dur khrod bsil ba tshal dang mtshungs:lung lnga gling gcig ljongs gsum gangs nyi shu:de ya nga dbyas na shangs kyi zab bu lung : shar phyogs kong po'i yul na ljon pa lung : lho yi phyogs na mon gyi srib btsan lung : hūṃb kyi phyogs na 'gos kyi nga ga ri 'u/nga : byang gi phyogs na skyid kyi gro ma lung : sgor lho mtshams na sbas yul pad+ma gling : lho rtub mtshams na sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs: hūṃb byang mtshams na sprus yul mkhan pa ljongs: byang thar mtshams na sbas yul lung gsum ljongs: thang lha ti se mang mkhar bya le gangs: star sgo pho ma mkha'

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ri rdo rje gangs: jo mo kha rag gang bzang rtse dum gangs: la phyi tshe ring sna nam te sgro gangs: 'o de gung rgyal sham po gsal rje gangs: ha 'o gangs bzang tsā ri nga la'i gangs: nga yis zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gnas chen du:khyad par 'phags pa'i sgrab gnas de dag kun:mimi25 yin zhes pa 'di rnams ni dus rabs rngu—14dror gyi snga mo'i gnas rnams yin/25 khu/rgyan ghu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi skyes rabs rnam par thar pa rgyas par bkod pa pad+ma bka'i thang yig ces bya ba bzhugs: dga' lngan phyan tshogs gling gi sgrar ma/zhog ldeb/1ji4na3nas gsal/phyogs mtshungs rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru'i gter ma/ sbas yul skyid mo lung gi snying byang dang lam yig/rtse po ta la'i dpe khongs bzhugs pa de'i dbu med bris ma zhog ldeb 2ba7—3na7 las/ rgyal po khyed rang dang sgrub pa re tsam byed pa shin tu gnad che:bsgrub pa byed pa'i gnas ni: ngas zhabs kyis bcags byin gyis brlabs yod pasaca khyad par du mkha' 'gro bsgrub pa'i gnas ni: sku'i dben gnas sgrags kyi yang rdzong yin: gsung gi dben gnas bsam yas 'ching bu yin: thugs kyi dben gnas lho brag mkhar chu yin: yon tan dben gnas ni yar lung shel phyag yin: 'phrin las dbe+en gnas mon kha seng rdzong yin2 khyad par 'phags pa yar lung shel phug yin: rgya gar dur khrod bsil ba tshal dang mnyam: gzhan yang lung lnga gling bzhi gasgo+ongs gsum:gangs nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams yod de: 'di rnams sgrub pa'i gnas kyi them yig yin no: de la lung lnga ni: gtsang na dpal gyi za phya lung : zhar na kong gi ljon zhing lung : lho na mon gyi srid btsan lung : hūṃb na mgon gyi phag ri lung : byang na sbas yul skyid mo lung :sgor lho mtshams na pad+ma gling :gshongs gsum ni:lho nub mtshams na 'bras mo sash-i+ongs:lho na kham pa gshongs:byang la lud+ku gsum gzhongs2gangs nyi shu rtsa gcig 18

sngon gleng /yang sprul yang : dpag tu med 'byon theg chen chos sgra sgrogs: la lar sangs rgyas rnams kyi sbrul pa ni: sa rdo ri brag lam 'phrang la sogs su:sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa rang byung 'byon: de mthong thos reg gang 'brel ngan song med: 28 ces dang / de bzhin gnas dang gnas phran la sogs dang : yul dang yul 'dra sbas pa'i yul rnams su: bsgrub pa byas pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab:phal pa'i gnas su lo gcig bsgrubs pa bas:de dag rnams su zhag gcig 'grub thag nye: 29 zhes dang / dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can las ngan gyis mnar ba rnams dus rtags ngan pa ci shar yang smas pa'i spyi tshig la nyan par mi 'gyur bas: chos byad sgrub pa po rnams dang : skal ldan pho mo rnams: dus rtags ngan pa zhar ba'i tshe: srus pa'i yul chen dang : yul phran dang : rong kha bzhi dang : lung phran dang : ri sul dang : gangs brag dang : nags 'dabs la sogs dben zhing : 'tshe dogs med pa'i sa phyogs su bros la bsgrub pa tshul bzhin spyod cig: yul khrod phal pa bas stong 'gyur gyi bogs che ba'i gnas tsā ri dang : mkhar chu dang : stag tshang dang : brag dkar til sgro dang : zab bu lung dang : rma skung lung la sogs pa rnams su song la rtse gcig si/sa bsgrub pa nyams su 28 gongargeṅge zlodabyinaji'ishog grangs/27mi27429 gong gsal dbyin ji'i shog grangs/2rtseX—22123

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/longs zhig: tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro: 30zhes dang / kye dad pa dang ldan pa'i rjes 'bangs yab yum sras 'khor thams cad nyon cig: de ltar gnas khyad par can rnams sgrod par byed pa'i thabs khyad par can du brjod par bgyid do: zhes gsungs nas: ma 'ongs pa'i sems can sbro ba bskyed pa la dgongs nas kha byang : de dag tu sgrod pa la dgongs nas lam yig: de dag tu gnas shing rtse gcig tu sgrub pa byed pa rnams la dgongs nas zhal gdams bslab bya:de'i dus kyi cha rkyen yo byad la dgongs nas gang la gang dgos kyi gter kha sbas pa: so sor bka' yi nan thag dang bcas pa gnang ba las: spu+o ba bskyed pa'i kha byang rnams snga thog tu dgongs nas gter kha dang por bstsal zhing / 'dir lam yig bslab bya zhal gdams gter byang lde mig rnams bka' stsal pa'i thog mar sbas pa'i yul chen po: bar yul rin chen 'bras mo gshongs kyi lam yig la sogs pa gsung pa ni: 'di ltar kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su phyogs bzhi na sbas pa'i gnas yul chen po bzhi: mtshams bzhir yul phran bzhi la sogs pa yod de: shar phyogs su tsā ri gangs kyi ra ba: lhor bar yul gangs kyi ra ba: hūṃb tu la phyi gangs kyi ra ba: byang du gnod sbyin gangs kyi ra ba:mtshams bzhir yul phran bzhi ni:shar lho rgyal gyi mkhan pa lung :lho zhub tu dpal gyi gra phu lung :zhub byang du dpal gyi 'jag ma lung : byang shar 7warnye+ogasaladabyin ji'i shog gangs 4/1—4ji224

sngon glong /du skyid kyi gro ma lung : gzhan yang spar phug gangs gyi ra ba: gsal rje gangs kyi ra ba: g.yu lung gangs kyi ra ba: 'brong rdza gangs kyi ra ba: bal yul gangs kyi ra ba: jo mo gangs kyi ra ba: ste'o gangs kyi ra ba: rdza yul gangs kyi ra ba: sna nam gangs kyi ra ba: shel bzang gangs kyi ra ba: rong btsan gnas kyi ra ba: shar sgam po gangs kyi ra ba: lho rong gangs kyi ra ba la sogs pa'i gangs yul rnams dang : byang gi se mo do: shar gyi rma kong lung : lho'i 'ba' chags shing ra: zhub kyi sbrang sman lung dang : gzhan yang stod kyi rtsib ri rdzong : bar gyi kha rag rdzong : smad kyi kye ri rdzong: mon gyi kha ri rdzong :kongapo'i bu chu rdzong :spu bo'i bra gad rdzong:cham gyi na bun rdzong :ne+e rings seng ge'i rdzong : g.ya' ri brag dmar rdzong : ka ring srin po rdzong : lha ri g.yung drung rdzong : lngan yul rdo rje rdzong la sogs pa'i rdzong che chung rnams dang : gzhan ya nga dar di dang : rdza'i zom dang : lung pa'i sul dang : lung phub/ 'du so/ོbkatha/ pa'i 'brothe/ ༷/nga ba/ba ba/natra/ bathe/ma /)tra/ mi khyab pa mang po byin gyis brlabs nas yod cing : de rnams kyi nang nas yangs la khrod che zhing btsan pa: bkra shis byin chags: sbas yul rin chen 'bras mo gshongs zhes bya ba: 3spro zhes mdor bsdu na 'i/ 'i/ra sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul pa ni: sa rdo ri brag lam 'phrang la sogs su: sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa rang byung 'byon: zhes dang de bzhin gnas dang gnas phran la 3 gong gsal dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 409 4rngu725

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/sogs dang : yul dang yul 'dra sbas pa'i yul rnams su: bsgrub pa byas pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab: ces dang / skal ldan pho mo rnams: dus rtags ngan pa sh-ir ba'i tshe: sbas pa'i yul chen dang : yul phran dang : rong kha bzhi dang : lung phran dang : ri sul dang : gangs brag dang : nags 'dabs la sogs dben zhing : 'tshe dogs med pa'i sa phyogs su bros la bsgrub pa tshul bzhin sbyod cig: ces dang / rdzong che chung rnams dang :gzhan yang dar di dang : rdza'i zom dang : lung pa'i sul dang : lung phug la sogs pa'i 'bros lung gab gnas bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang po byin gyis brlabs nas yod cing : de rnams kyi nang nas yangs la khrod che zhing btsan pa: bkra shis byin chags: sbas yul rin chen 'bras mo gzhongs su bgrod dgos skor lung bstan gsal bar marāni no//bod kyi bstan srid dgra bo mtha'o mi mi bsrun hor sog kla klo mthar byed kyi dmag dpung dbus su lhags skabs las skal ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams o rgyan sbas lung ngam sbas yul zhes bod kyi lho phyogs yongs dang / lhag par du lho'i nang nas rong dang ljongs/gzhongs dag la sbas yul 'tsho'/ ba'i dus bab rtags su go bar sems3232 sog bzlog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan (155snusku 'khrungs ) gyis 1caXcalor mdzad pa'i/slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa yid kyi mun 26

sngon glong /ji skad du kong sbral karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde'i (18rwa3—spro89༵) gsung las/‘‘mchod yon ub dpon pad+ma saṃbha wa dang /chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan )skog tu bka' bgros te sku dngos mtsho rgyal sogs las can gyi 'khor dang bcas bod yul gyi sa gzhi rta mig tsam spong ma lus pa zhabs kyis bcags/ mnga' ris skor du gangs brag nyi shu/ dbus gtsang du sgrab gnas nyer gcig /mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga/ stod smad bar gsum bgyi sbas yul rgyal po gsum/lung lnga/ljongs gsum/gling gcig/de re re la'ang rtsa ba dang yan lag me tog 'bras bu'i tshul du yod pa la sogs pa gangs brag ri mtsho thams cad sgrub gnas su byin gyis brlabs/33zhes gsal/sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /'di rjes bsdus ming ‘pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa yid kyi mun sel zhes 'god rgyu/ smo3(gyibamisdi sbyi6(lngangakau2tre5(3ba 1smo1①9smo52'i5(3ba1rtserngu4shog grangs 212—213nang / skabs 'dir slob dpon gyis/gter ston tshad ma la zhal gdams so/ /gter rdzus brtag tshul/bsgrub gnas kyi yon tan la sogs pa gsungs/ ma 'ongs lung bstan mang po gnang / dus kyi tha ma la bod la 'bros sa dgos/ma bros na hor dmag gis bod dmyal thag gcod gsungs/'bras mo gshongs la sogs pa'i sbas yul rnams su/ mnga' bdag rje 'bangs rnams slob dpon nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul la brten nas byon te/ yon mchod bka' bgros nas gter kha mang po sbas/ sbas yul na mas su 'gro ba'i lam yig mang po bris te gter ston chen po rnams kyi gter kha'i khrod du sbas/ zhes gsal/33 gter ston brgya rtsa'i rnam thar rin chen beḍūr+ya'i lbeng ba/ dzha/16ḍū(mib kho〉bapyilami93smo0ba33rkudzi7to 7khusnu5 1973 dbyin ji'i sgo+og grangs 47—4rngubar gsal/27

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i dkyil nang gter chen mchog gyur gling pa (spro829—sdu870) dang / 'jam mgon kong sprul/ (spro8spro3—spro899) 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po (spro820—1892) gsum gyi sku dus su mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga yan lag dang bcas pa phyi lo 1rnguca7yan mdo byang gis dngos su zin pa bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis ma zin pa bzhi bcu rtsa gsum bcas khyon dril gnas mchog brgyad cu rtsa lnga tsam sbral pa'i gter ston chen po mchog gyur gling pas ye shes gzigs pa'i byin rlarās kyi bdag po'i rkyen las snang bar mdzad pa'i bko' drin gyis bod chen po'i ljongs sbyi dang bye brag gi bstan 'gro'i rgud pa thams cad zhi zhing / mthong thos dran reg gi yid can thams cad gnas skabs dang mthar thug kun tu phan pa dang bde ba'i dge legs kyi snang ba rgyas par spel bar mdzad pa yin no//34—34 bodakyiganas chen rnams kyi mdo byang dkar chag a rgyan gyi mkhas pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bkod pa bzhugs so: gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pa'i zab gter chos skor/pod/3༷2mi(5'imibapyisbyimib1350ba37dzuto3(5dzib smokhusmo2༷1'i1 1rtse77dbyin ji'i shog grangs/1—4༷bar dang / phyi lo 1rnguca7lor kong sbrul pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa/mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga yan lag dang bcas pa'i mdo byang gi gsal byed zin thun nyung ngu bzhugs so/ /dbyin ji'i shog grangs/41—ca7bar gsal ba la'ang gzigs 'tshal/kong sbrul yon tan rgya mtshos zin bris su btab pa/ gnas chen byin 'bebs zin bris bzhugs so/ /dbyin ji'i shog grangs/3'a7—3rtselnga bar gsal/'jam mgon kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas kyi gsung 'bum 28

sngon gleng /gsum pa/ de yang mkha' spyod spral pa'i pho brang dpal gyi 'bras mo ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji do:ra dar ba'i tshul la'ang /dang po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis bod kha ba4can gyi yul byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus na/gnas dben zhing bzang ba thams cad phyi ma'i don du sbas zhing gab/ chos kyi sgrab gnas su byin gyis brlabs/ las can gyi don du gab pa dkrol/ log pa sdun la sgo srung bzhag nas/ bar yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas byin gyis brlabs so/ /de'i tshe gnas kyi snying por bzhugs pa 'phags pa'i bka' lung rgya chen bka' mdzod/pod ca/ 5khrikhuji'i0ba256/1khu3(’0ba5 smornguspo2rdu/khri 2002gnas 'dus sgo byang dang po/dbyin ji'i shog grangs/1༷rngurtse—1༷rtse2gnas 'dus sgo byang gnyis pa/ dbyin ji'i zhog grangs/ 1༷lnga2—1༷lngaca gnas 'dus sgo byang gsum pa/ dbyin rji'i shog grangs/ 1༷lngaca—11༷༷ bcas la'ang gzigs/brje dkon mchog 'gyur med bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam/ pad+ma kun khyab ye shes rdo rje snying pos 1rtse21lor mdzad pa'i/gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pa'i rnam thar bkra zhis dbyangs kyi yan lag gsal byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// (7stu ṭu02ljurkyoṭu(stu72 70spro560tostustustu0(27ṭu7zloglu650(6(ṇari8—ṭu7stukhrispoṭu706—61lhostu—6 shā(glu6—ṇa( ṣāngaṣ+ṭa70spu5dzurdusku670ba 35j-i(06(smoX‘(51—7jikhu6/0dzu)9(’1(57ba75ba95615'iḍūskub 3r+sā5—ku‘19(5 670ba (6rdu/ne(mibasko0(('irdu/lnga(khu /lokhustu0ཿ—pyi/1bapyi39nga5/—565 95khyi/5khrirduspu 6 ༈22(5'i'ibatha1༅ba mi50ba3ba 6to7(3dzi0 sa/670dzi/'i1 spro976 myo0/5①khu 28(/dz+wa4) dbyin ji'i shog grangs 2ca2—2rngu3bar la'ang gzigs/29

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ mdzad/35 de'i rjes mi lo brgya phrag gsum na dpal 'bras mo gshongs mdzod lnga stag rtse'i steng du/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin byon nas gnas kyi sgo dbye gsal byed lha'i lung bstan mdzad/36 de'i rjes su 'phags pa'i spul pa mi lnga byon/gnas kyi ming btags gab pa rtsis lung mdzad/37 de nazlo mi lo stong phrag gsum dang brgya phrag gsum/lo bzhi nas sdogargyan gyi rgyal po pad+ma 'byung gnas byon/'bras mo gshongs gnas kyi bar chad srung zhing lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor gyi lung mdzad/38 de'i tshe spul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan byon nas gnas kyi byin dbab/rgyal pos garming ba'i gab lung mdzad/39de nas bud med khyad du 'phags pa/ rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ye shes mtsho rgyal dang / las can gyi ma shes bza' sgron me zung nas mkha' 'gro thig le'i lung mdzad/40 chos kyi 35 rig 'dzin rgod kyi ljem phru'i gter ma byang gter gsang ba rmad byung gi cha lag tu gtogs pa/sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor dag goca gzham gsal rtse po ta la'i dpe khongs bzhugs pa de'i shog ldeb dbu med t+pās ma 1ba1—1ba4bar nas gsal/'di rjes bsdus ming sbus yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor zhes 'god rgyu/36 sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor/sh-i+og ldeb 1ba7—3ba237 sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor/shog ldeb 3ba2—4ba438 sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor/zhog ldeb 4ba4d+ngha7ba439 sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor/sgo+og ldeb 7ba4—chubaca40 srus yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor/zhog ldeb rtsebathong1༷ba730

sngon gleng /blon po brgyad kyis 'dren pa gnas kyi lung mdzod/41 de'i tshe bar thang rin chen gzhongs su/ gnas chen 'bras mo gzhongs kyi sgo dbye ba'i thabs/ lung bdun/gces pa'i gdams pa drug /gsang ba'i mdzod gsum/ gab pa'i sting gi lde mig dang bcas pa dkar chag yi ger btab nas/ byang sgo la byon te man ngag thams cad gu ru urgyan gyi gling du gshegs pa'i dus su/byang zang zang gi brag la sbas pa'o/42/zhes dang /41 sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor/sgo+og ldeb 1༷bca—12na742 sbas yul 'bās mo ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor/shog ljeb 12na7—12narngupad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa yid kyi mun sel/shog grangs 172—177nang /de nas slob dpon chen po bod du byon nas lo nyer bdun lon pa chu mo lug gi lo la bsam yas mchims bur rje 'bangs rnams tshogs pa la/ sngon 65ོ rgyan gyis rgyal khams 'dul ba'i skabs der gshed mas tsan dan gyi smre dpung dbus su bsregs pa'i tshe/ slob dpon nyid pad+ma badz+ra rtsal zhes bya ba drang srong khros pa'i he ru ka ru sku bzhengs te yum man rda ra dang 'khril sbyor du bstan nas rgyal po en+d+ra bhu ti 'khor dang bcas pa btul ba'i tshe/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams su chos sku snang ba mtha' yas kyis 'dus pa'i 'khor la bka' bstsal ba'i gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde rtsa rgyud pad sngong brtsegs pa/ sku rgyud shel gyi ri bo/ gsung rgyud/ thugs rgyud/ yon tan gyi rgyud/ phrin las kyi rgyud dang drug gsungs te/ de'i tshe rgyud drug po de dag kyang dus mtshungs su/o rgyan bkod pa'i zhing du pad+ma badz+ra gyis gsungs so/ /de bzhin du pad+ma badz+ra rtsal nyid las sprul pa'i lha tshogs ni/ shar ri bo ta lar bud+ngha thod phreng rtsal/ lho phyogs gyang mkhar brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du mi bskyod rdo rje/ hūṃb phyogs so sa gling 3kro

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/lhag par du ‘sbral pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde btsan sku 'khyungs nas mi lo nyi shu rtsa gcig nasazlo u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs: brag dmar dbus kyi bsam yas bzhengs: bod yul chos kyis gang bar byas: rgyal pos dgung lo sum cu rtsa brgyad (phyi lo 779tsā780) bzhes pa dang : srus pa'i yul 'bras mo gzhongs su byon te: lha srin thams cad gi dur khrod du rta mgrin dang / byang phyogs ma ga rdar dpa' bo rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal/zhar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du gu ru drag po me lce'i dreng ba can dang / lho zhub dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du sangs rgyas thod pa dang / nub byang rab tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod du dbang chen rta mgrin dang / byang shar lcang lo can du phyag na rdo rje/ rang rang gi rigs dang yum dang gtso 'khor du bcas pa'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po dgu ru mngon par 'du mdzad de/ gong du bshad pa'i rgyud sde drug gi sgo nas 'khor grub pa dang /drang srong dang /rig 'dzin dang mi rigs bzhi la sogs pa grangs med dpag tu med pa dag dang / khyad par gyi gdul bya mkha' 'gro ma dang / dpa' bo dang / gnod sbyin dang / 'byung po bye ba phrag brgya la sogs pa mi ma yin gyi gdul bya bgrangs ba las 'das pa'i don rgya cher mdzod pa'i chos bla ma dasongs pa 'dus pa zhes bya ba de'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor te/ smin byed kyi dbang bskur/ grol byed kyi gdams pa bsngan rte/ rgyud dkrug pa sdebs/ lung gcus pa bsra ngas// man ngag gab pa maron du bstan to/ /chos skor rnams kong yul gyi brag spu ri phug mo cher sa/ter du sbas/ sras mu rug btsan pos gter de 'don par lung bstan/ 'dis ni bstan pa ma snong bar du 'gro don rgya chen po 'byung bar gsungs shing /bod kyi bstan rngu stongs nas /'bras mo ljo ras su yang 'gro ba mang po 'di'i sgo nas smin grol la 'god do/ /zhes sogs/ rgya cheru bsgod/ ces gsal/32

sngon gleng /dam la btags:phyi ma'i don du byang bu drug dang :lung bstan sum cu mdzad do:stigs ma'i sems can bsod nams zhan pas:dge ba mi sgrub sdig la spyod:lung bstan thob pa'i gang zag la:bdud kyi spyod pa 'byung :de tshe dpal 'bras mo gshongs 'dir:nga'i bstan pa 'byung bas:de'i don la gces pa'i man ngag:kun rdzob kyi snang ba bshig pas:yang dag pa'i don mthong ba:lha srin gyi rdzu 'phrul 'phrog pas don grub pa:bdud kyi dpung bshig pas log pa'i dgra thul ba 'di: ma 'ongs pa'i don du bzhag par bya'o: 4zhes gsal/lhag par du mdo mang gter chen rdo rje bde chen gling pa'i khu876—928gsung las/ sbas gnas chen po dpal gyi 'bras ljongs 'dir:sngon chad sangs rgyas kyis kyang zhabs ma bcag/ri phyag bsgrod dka' nags tshal ra ba can:spu sgrel gcan gzan rnams kyis bzung ba'i yul:brag srin ri sman btsan dang klu gnyan gnas:mi yi 'gro ba gcig kyang med pa la:o rgyan chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa:bod du phebs nas rgyal po'i bsam pa bsgrub:rje 'bangs grol zhing chos 'khor dpag med bskor:sgrub gnas chen po thams cad zhabs bcags nas: byin gyis brlabs pas sgrub gnas zhes su grags:de gong sgrub gnas zhes bya'i ming yang med:g.yang sa ngam grog gcong rong phug stong rnams:'dre srin tshang byas 'jigs zhing ya nga'i gnas:4 sprus(55'bras d+me+o ljongs kyi lde mig 'phrul gyi dgu skor/zhog ldeb 4ba4—7na1

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/yin phyir sus kyang brten pa'i gnas ma yin: de kun gu rus byin gyis brlabs zin nas: rjes 'jug skal lngan sgrab pa po rnams kyi: bsgrab bstan btsug pas nyams rtogs 'phel zhing rgyaḍā: de dus o rgyan rje jong mkhar chen bza': rgyal sras lha rje mchog grub rgyal po dang : paṇa chen bi ma be ro tsa na dang : nam mkha'i snying po sangs rgyas ye shes sogs: grub chen thams cad rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis byon:brag dkar bkra shis sdings su zhabs bkod de: dgongs pa'i rtsal gyis lha srin dbang med bsdus: bka' nan mdzad pas dam nos bstan bsrung byas: zab mo chos dang nor gyi gter kha gtad:gnas 'di zhar lho zhub byang dbus dang lnga: sku lnga mngon rdzogs zhing khams lnga ru bsgyar: gnas 'brel gang song rig 'dzin go 'phang thob: khyad par 'phabashas pa'i yon tan bsgrang las 'das: 44zhes gsal bar ltar lags/ring por ma thog par gu ru pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rig pa 'dzin pa gter ston nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byon pa'i nang nas mtshan nyi rla ltar yongs su grags pa'i khrod na mchog gi sprul sku rnam gsum/ gter ston rgyal po lnga/gling pa bcu gecig /gter chen brgya rtsa/ gter phran stong rtsa sogs rim par byon pa'i nang tshan/ mchog gi sprul sku rnam gsum gyi ya gyal/ o rgyan pad+ma'i yod— snyamayuṅge'abras—d+me+o—ljosarā+o ṅge —rmerno wa d+me dag pad+ma drwa ba can gyi gnas yig 'u/nga bsdin sasol 'debs smon 'a/ma gter spu/nga gsol mchod ba cas bzhugs// sgang tog dbe+en can dason du bzhus/sa nga'i spa/ra thung rgog lngeb 11ba434

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/gnas che chung rnamaṅge su bgrod thabs kyi kha byang / lam yig /zhal gdams bslab bya sogs dang / mthar sprus yul 'bras mo gshongs zhes pa'i phyi'i snod bcud rnam gzhag gam bkod pa ji sted cig gsal ba rim pa'i sbel ba byung /kaḥthog bzhag bla ye shes 'bum / mon kaḥthog bsod nams rgyal mtshan/rdo brag rig 'dzin chen mo sku phreng gnyis pa mang spru ris rig 'dzin legs lngan rje/ zhar ri mnga' bdag sems dpa' chen po phun tshogs rig 'dzin yab sras/ 'bras ljongs chos rgyal rgyal thog dang po phun tshogs rnam rgyal/de rjes ring por ma thogs par lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med/4646 grub dbang gnas mdo karma chags med (kro6spyo0—1674) kyis mdzad pa/ sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i /gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje (spro645—1667)1 nang gi rnam thar spyi don gsum pa gnam chos dang dgongs gter gyi gter 'byung las/ de la sngon byon gyi grub chen de dag gis rmi lam du byung ba'i gnam chos la yang 'gro don dang khyab rgya chen po byung 'dug kyang /deng sang dus snyigs bstan pa na bab pas/gter ston yin zer ba tsam gyi rmi lam du byung ba'i gnam chos tsam la byin brlabs dang 'gro don cher mi 'ong ngam snyam na/ de la dus phyis rig 'dzin 'ja' mtshon pa dang rtse le sprul sku sogs kyi bya chen/gter ston nam mkha' 'jigs med zhes pa'i rtogs lngan chags lam gtso bor ston ba des/ sa'i gter ni gcig kyang ma ston te/ 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas sgo sngon nas gzhan gyis phyes pa'i nang nas/ brag dkar bkra zhis lding sogs ngos 'dzin dang zhal gzigs kyi gnas yig gsar du bkod pa tsam las/gzhan gnas sno gsar 'byed ma mdzod mod kyi/ rmi lam du thod phreng sde lnga zhal mjal nas dbang bskur/ rdo rje phag mo'i 36

sngon gleng /kaḥthog chos rje kun tu bzang po sogs rnal 'byor mched bzhi/ stod 'brug 'ba' ra bka' ba2/da kyi ba/ba mchog dkon mchog dzo/la mtshan (spro60spro—1687) sogs rim pa'i zhabs kyis bcags nas sbas yul phyi nang phyag na seng ldeng gi ḍa ma ru dkrol ba'i sgra las chos kyi sgra byung ba yi ger bkod pa la/rig 'dzin srog sgrub du grags pa'i rmi lam du byung ba gtso che'i glogs bam che ba zhig byung ba/ sa skya a mi lags/ 'bras spungs thams cad mkhyen pa/ zhabs drung rdo rje brag pa'i sbrul sku/ spu bo sba kha sprul sku sogs kyi thugs dam gtso bor mdzod pa yin zhes thos la/ rmi lam gyi gnam chos de'i gtum mo'i khrid skyong bas/ ras rkyang thub pa stong phrag tsam byung zer yang / ding sang gtsang dbus dag rkong 'bras mo ljongs sogs na ras rkyang thub pa'i rtogs lngan bzang po mang du yod par snang ba/ ras rkyang zub pa phal che ba ni khong gi gtum mo khrid thob nas ras rkyang byas pa kho nar snang zhing / khrid de la brten nas ras rkyang ba lnga brgya tsam nitshunges bar byung gda' 'o/ /zhes/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor/pod da pa/ 25khyi/15'ij-isku 6kromyokhub ṣāj-ib1mismo01khyi5ṣā1ba90khusmokhumiskukausdilnga6599dzimispro983dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 77—77 bar gsal/grub dbang gnas mdo karma chags med (16spro0—spro674) kyis mdzad pa/ sprul sku mi 'gyur rdo rje'i phyi'i rnam thar kun khyab snyan pa'i 'brug sgra zhes bya ba las/ snyede ltar gnam chos gsar du dar ba des/ /nad mug mtshon 'khrug la sogs 'phral du zhi/ /lo legs nad mug nyung sogs kun la phan/ /rang rang so so'i bar chad rkyen zhi nas/ /byang chub mchog gis sa bon theb pa dang / /rtse gcig nyams blang tshe 'dir mchog 'grub ste//'bras mo ljongs su nam mkha' 'jigs ped la/ /mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gnam chos phan yon las/ /'di ni rtsa gsum bla rdo yin/ /bcang bas nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi//mjal bas bag phebs shes rig 'byung / /nyams blang phyir mi lngog pa thob/ /brda' dang 37

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/sogs mang du brtsi 'jog byed srol yong 'dug /de dag so sor yang gnas kyi mdo byang /kha byang /snying byang /gnas kyi them byang /gnas yig/lam yigadakar chag /lde mig /gnas bstod/ gnas rten gyi che bshad rgyas pa bcas yig cha yang mi nyung ba byung myong 'dugades na sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas lag ni gter ston rdo rje bde chen gling pa'am/ mdo mang gter chen (khuspro876—1928) mchog gi bzhed pa ltar na mdo khams smad kyi zar lung ri khrod dam/ zab phu lung bde chen chos gling gi gnas yin par 'dod/ de yang gter chen gyis mdzad pa'i zar lung ri khrod gnas yigamimi50ces pa'i mdzad byang nang / 'og min 'bras ljongs gnas gnyis pa: zab phu lung bde chen chos gling gi gnas 'di: kyi dbu na bris pas thams cad yid ches pa yin no/ /'di mthong tshad thams cad yid ches dad pa skye ba'i gnad yod do/ /zhes/ gnas yig /waṃ/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor pod ta/dbyin ji'i shog grangs carngurtsenang dang /gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha snyan brgyud zab mo'i skor pod ta/dbyin ji'i shog grangs ca⑩༷las grub dbang chags med a rā gas/ de yang bod yul du gnas chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad: gnas phran stong dang rtsa gnyis: de dag re re la yang gnas 'dra dang gnas lag grangs med pa zhig yod par bshad de: 'dul ba lung las bcom lngan 'das shākya thub pas bka' stsal paca dge slong dag byang phyogs gangs ri'i khrod na sa rdo bem pos kyang sems can gyi don byed par yod doca zhes gsungs pa dang : zhes gsal/sto0 pod/3tha'i wan sprar ma/2༷༷7dbyin ji'i shog grangs 727༷ 144

sngon gleng /ces dang / bar chad lam sel gyi dbang gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus las kyang /ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi rnam sbrul rdo rje bde chen gling pa zhes bya bas me pho 'brug gi lo'i ston tha chung gi tshes bdun nyin mdo smad zar lung stag tshang gsang ba'i phug pa nas sbyan drangs pa'i gter zhog gu ru'i phyag bris las zhal bshus pa ste/ gnas de'i lo rgyus mdo tsam zhus na/ grong gser mo 'bum rgyas zhes bya ba'i lung pa'i phya na dpal o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen/ 'og min 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas kyi cha lag zab phu lung bde chen chos gling zhes pa'i gnas de/ 51zhes mdo khams hor khog gam tre+e hor rong 52 gi char yod pa gsal/bskor srol yod pa'i gnas dang gnas phran 'gar skor tshad dang / dgos pa rgyu mtshan phan yon bcas gsal ba'i dkar chag rgyas bsdus mang po zur du'ang yad/gnas khag cig lo khams bcu gnyis re mos kyis bskor srol yod pa dang /de la bskor chen zhes 'bod srol 'dugazlo——gongagasalapod/3dbyin ji'i shog grangs 743ཿ752 rdo rje bde chen gling pa'i byung ba baji+od pa rnam par thar pa'i 'du bshad yod/ pod/ 11tha'i wan spar ma/ 2༷༷7 dbyin ji'i shog grangs 1lnga7 las/ lo me 'abhug ston zla tha chung gi/tshes bdun la hor yul rong gi cha//grong ser mo 'bum rgyas bya ba'i sa//gnas zal lung stag tshang gsang phug nas/ /chos bar chad sel ba'i gter zhal phye/ zhes gas0//45

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ mkhas grub gnas mdo karma chags med zhabs (1610—1674) kyi gsung las/ thog mar gnas bskor ba'i lo ni/byi lor rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i mchod rten bzhengs pa yin/ lo der gnas mjal na phan dang byin rlabs che/ de bzhin glang gi lo la glang chen 'gying ri mjal/ stag lor spa gro stag tshang mjal/ spo+os lor bsam yas bzhengs par lo der mjal na byin rlabs che/'brug lor dgun gyi dus su 'brug ldir ba'i zhing khams rgya gar rdo rje gdan mjal/ rta lo rta mchog kha 'bab kyi gnas gangs ti se dang mtsho ma pham mjal/ lug lor lug tshong pa byang yin pas gnam mtsho mjal/ sprel lor sprel tshob/sa pa tsā ri bskor du 'gro /bya lor ri bo bya rkang mjal/ khyi lor khyi dang mi sogs 'dus che bas chos 'khor lha sa mjal/ phag lor phag la dga' ba'i kong yul bāg gsum mjal ba sogs de ltar so sor gnas rnams ma nor bar mjal na phan yon dang 'gyur che bar sngon gyi bstan rabs rnams kyis zer ro/ 53/zhes gsal/lnga pa/ gnas kyi skor tshad skor la/ a mdo tsong la byang brgyud kyi sum pa mkhan po'am zhabs drung ye shes dpal 'byor (1704—sdu788) gyi gsung las/53 chagresamed po—ts+tshapredhe ge lo rmyetsa'u lor mdzad pa'i/ kun rdzob g.ya 'a sel/ me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /ka spu ga bod yi ga paru khang /1khu34thos grangs 1na4 2ba4bar gsal/46

sngon gleng / rten byin can dang / gnas byin can rnams la skor tshad dang phyag tshad nges pa re yod par grags pa 'di'i skor tshad sogs gang gi sgos bzhag pa yin/bskor lam gyi cha 'am rgyang grags lta bu brtsi ba yin nam rten gyi ngos nas yin tshad lngan gyi khungs yod pa zhig yin nam ji ltar lags/ zhes pa'i lan ni/sku gsung thugs rten kyi skor tshad mdo rgyud las gsungs pa ngos kyis ma mthong yang bod du grags che/ de la khyangs gzhung tshad ma yod dam/ dam pa rnams kyi gsungs rgyun nam/ gang ltar yang gsang sngags kyi lha'i sngags thung ba phal cher gyi las rung tsam gyi bsten tshad rgyud du/ 'bum phrag tu ni bzlas gyur na/ /rnam par dag pa'i bad ga nyid 'gyur/ zhes pa la rigs 'gres sam/ 'bum gsungs ltar phyag 'tshal pa 'grub grangs kyang 'bum yin nam snyam ste/skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam thar na sdig ltung sbyong ched du yig brgya sogs 'bum re blozlas pa dang / tshogs bsags slad du phyag dang maṇ+ḍal 'bum re mdzad zer ba mthong ngo / /de bzhin du skor tshad kyang 'bum yin nam snyam la de yang ji ltar brtsi zhe na/la las lha khang dgon pa sgrub sde sogs kyi nang gi rten gyi gtso bo'i pad gdan nam bzhugs khri'i mtha' skor gyi tshad kyis gzhal zer/ de 'jal byed ni/ mdo las/ lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang / nas/ sor tshad zhes bya gong bdun bsgyur/ /sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ khru bzhi ba la 'dom gang ngo / /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de las rten chung ba la sor dang /'bring la sor mo bcu gnyis la mtho gang du byas pa dang / che tsam la mtho do (7

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/khru byas pa dang / de las kyang che ba la gzhu 'dom gyis gzhal nas ci tsam yod pa'i grangs blang la/ rang rang gi grangs gang yod de dang de gcig tu brtsis nas bskor ba 'bum re 'gro dgos la/ de la skor lam phyi nang bar gsum yod dam gcig yin kyang / de gang la'ang goms pa che chung ran pa do la 'dom gang yod pas des gzhal nas grangs blang ste/ de la bskor ba ci tsam byas na nang gi rten gyi gdan tshad blang pa de 'bum longs na rten de'i skor ba 'grub tshad zer/ de ltar na sku 'bum lta bu la rten gyi gtso bo mchod rten chen po la byed na/ de'i khri'i tshad blangs pa'i 'dom grangs gcig tu brtsis nas de 'bum phyi skor la ci tsam gyis 'gro ba de'i skor tshad yin/ de bzhin du kho bo'i bkra zhis rtse ri khrod 'di'i rten gtso thub dbang li sku zhig bzhugs pa'i pad gdan mtha' skor mtho do yod cing / sgrub sde'i phyi skor la 'dom lnga brgya lnga bcu mchis pas/phyi skor 'dom gang la mtho do bzhi yod de/des lnga brgya lnga bcu bsgyur te grangs des drug gis spel na 'grigs/ zhe drug bskor na rten gtso de la skor ba 'bum 'gro la/ gzhan ri khrod de na yod pa'i rten de las chung ba la 'bum lhag dang / de las che 'bring la 'bum mi long ba lta bu'o//yang kho bos bsams tshod la skor lam ring thung gang la'ang 'bum re dgos pas de'i dod la thar lha khang sogs kyi rten gtso 'bur bzo med pa dang / ri ma thang la bzhengs pa'i mchod rten dang gnas byin rlabs can lta bu dang / gzhan dgon pa sgrub sde sogs gang dang gang gi phyi'i skor lam 'dom 48

sngon gleng /gyis gzhal ba'i grangs des 'bum la bgos pa'i nor grangs de ni gangadang gang de dang de'i skor tshad du bzhag chog gam snyam/ de ltar na bkra shis rtse ri khrod kyi skor grangs 1༷rngu 'di'o/ /yang bod dbus kyi lha sa'i jo bo che ba'i lha khang gi sum stong bdun brgya dang ra mo che'i jo bo chung ba'i bzhi stong nyis brgya zer ba dang / jo bo rnam gnyis dang po ta la bcas pa'i phyi'i skor tshad la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod ces skor lam du bris snang zer ro/ /yang chos skor 'a/ga skor zhethe/ pa'i khungs che ba ma mthong go/nga / bsam yas sogs su bka' 'gyur chos skor snang ltar gzhan du'ang de 'dra mang ngo / /lag skor 'khor lo lcang skya rin po ches gong ma'i bsnams zhes thos zhing 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa gong mas bsnams pa mthong bas/ de bskor bas de'i nang gi sngags sogs bton pa'i phan yon 'byung bar nges la// de bzhin du chu 'khor rlung 'khor kyang rung ste/ 'jigs byed kyi 'khrul 'khor la rlung 'khor bzhad cing / gdugs dkar dang seng gdong ma'i bzlog 'khor rlung la bskor bar snang ngo / 54 /zhes gsal lo//na ga chu karma kun khyab kyis sbrang char dus deb kyi shes rab rgan po'i 'bel zlo sumapad+mekhanapoyeshes dpal 'byor gyi gsung 'bum/a mdo'i srur ma/pod nya pa'i khongs// nang don tha snyad rig gnas kyi gzhung gi dogs gnas 'ga' zhig dris pa'i lan phyogs gcig tu bris pa rab dkar pa sangs zhes pa bzhugs so/ /shog ldeb rngu7na4ma dpe yigo/ 'bru gsal po mi 'dug4()

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/gtam gyi rtsom sgrig par/gangs ti se sogs gnas chen rnams la 'khor chen zer ba'i lo rtags re yod pa ga 'dra zhig yin nam/ zhes pa'i dri ba bton par/bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi zhib 'jug pa nor brang o rgyan lags ('khrungs spyo933) kyis lan bskyon pa gsham gsal ltar/ de ni rta lor gangs ri'i skor r+ṣa/ sprel lor tsā ri'i skor r+ṣa/ lug lor la phyi'i skor mro zhes pa'i gnas gsum po bde mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gsum ste/ gangs ri seng gdong dkar mo sku yi gnas/ la phyi stag gdong khra mo gsung gi gnas/tsā ri phag gdong nag po thugs kyi gnas zhes yongs su grags pa ltar dang /gzhan yang lug lo gnam mtsho'i skor chen dang /rwa sgreng pha bong thang skor sogs rta lug sprel gsum nam 'char la gnas skor dang / chos lugs kyi bya bzhag dmigs bsal can mang po mchis pa so sor khungs lngan gyi rgyu mtshan yod pa smos ma dgos kyang /gnad don 'di'i skor dpyad gzhi la lar gnas sgo phye ba'i lo khams de dag gi skabs su gnas der skor thengs gcig phog na gnas de'i skor tshad kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i phan yon yod par gsungs pa de ltar yin zhag las kha tshon gcod chi/ zhus snyam/ da yod dpyad gzhi khungs la gzhigs na gangs ri'i skor chen nam 'khor chen rta lor byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ni dus 'khor gyi lugs ltar na bdag cag gi ston pa shukya thub pa me rta lor lhums su zhugs pa dang / chu rta lor mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i lo bcas rta lor khel pas gangs ri skor chen yang rta lor byed pa'i srol byung / tsā ri'i rong 50

sngon gleng /skor chen mo sprel lor byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang phug lugs lcags sprel lor ston pa sku balngams pa dang / sprel 'o'i sprel zlar slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dha na ko zha'i mtsho gling du brdzus te 'khrungs pa'i lo yang sgrel lor yin par brten/tsā ri'i rong skor chen mo sprel lor byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de ltar lags so/ 55/zhes gsal/shar ba thogs med kyis/ gnas bshad kyi khyad chos gleng ba/56 de'i nang /gnas bshad kyi go don/ gnas bshad kyi 'byung ba brjod pa/ gnas bshad kyi rigs dgar ba/gnas bzhad kyi 'byung rkyen/gnas bzhad kyi khyad chos/gnas bshad kyi rgyun skyong tshul sogs gleng 'duga'es pa'i dpyad rtsom zhig spel 'dug pa la'ang gzigs mdzod/bod mis bla ma la chos 'brel zhus pa dang gcig mtshungs gnas la'ang gnas 'brel 'jogs par byed/ gnas bskor ba'i skabs la'ang cha tshang ma bskor bar yang bskyar rjes sor bskor rgyus rten 'brel du gnas log ces ma 'ongs par bskor rgyu'i ched du bzhag srol yod/drug pa/gnas bskor mkhan gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi lta spyod la'ang mchog phal 'bring gsum gyi rnam dbye 'am rnam thar yod skor kaḥthog si tu chos kyi rgyamatsho (1280—1925)zhabs kyi gresung las/ chags med zhen med gtad med rtesnye——sbangachar/2༷༷4(1)sgo+og grangs 177 17jito6 krung go'i bod kyi shes rig12khyatsu(4)zhog grangs/rngu7—113stospro

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/nges med gnas/ /rang 'khris med pas gdul bya ris med la/ /phan byed 'gro don rgyal khams cadags med byed/ /gnas bskor rab kyi rnam par thar pa'o//dam pa phyogs med sel med bsten pa dang / /dam chos ris med 'gal med zhu ba dang / /sgrab gnas phyogs med 'dzin med tsho+ogs bsags pa/ /'di yang gnas bskor jib kyi rnam thar ro/ /rten gsum kun la dad pas ngal dub la//mi skyo dben gnas dgon sde thams cad du/ /'gras med sun med dag snang tshogs gsog byed/ /gnas bskor 'bring gi rnam par thar pa'o/ /dang po khas len sa steng bskor na bsam/ /bar du gyen re mthong na gnas re bzhag /tha ma byas lo song lo'i ngang du thal/ /gnas bskor mdo don med pa'i ngang tshul gcig /dge 'dun yon tan mi mthong skyon de mthong / /lha sku gsung rab mi mjal rgyang bltas byas/ /mthong na slong zhing ma mthong rku ba de/ /gnas bskor sdig bskor song ba'i ngang tshul gnyis/ /dka' chad byung dus gnas la log lta byas/ /lha khang da lta mjal ba da lta brjed/ /gnas bskor lam du khong khro dpa' ru brtsi//gnas bskor ngal ba 'bras med ngang tshul dor/ 57zhes gsal/57 wadabusagatsang gnas bskor lam yig/bkra shis ljongs khams pa slar spar gsaru /1rtse72shog grangs/ 737—73ca bar sa/sal/kong po'i gsang chen snga 'gyur ba skyabs mchog ri ga 'dzin mkhyen brtse klong grol (1832—spyo909) gyis mdzad pa'i/ gnas bskor byed tshul nyams mgur bzhugs so/ /rig 'dzin mkhyen brtse klong grol rin po che'i rnam thar dang gsung 'bum bzhugs so// 2565stukhu66tochaXlo17grang1spu85bapyi7mi6khotomi①50so/mibapyi1nye /7/(rdzu /1bapyi 1982myo0kyisdikrodzi 1dbyin ji'i zhog grangs/11tsu—11khyabar gzigs 'tshal/52

sngon gleng /zhor 'phros su kun mkhyen rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i (spro729—spro798)gsung gnas bskor ba la spying ba'i gtam zhes pa'ang 'dir bkod par bya/gnas bskor ba la sgring pa'i gtam//lhag bsam gyi chun po zhes bya ba//srid pa'i zug ju drungs 'byin pa'i/ /mchog gi sman pa thams cad mkhyen/ /des gsungs 'gog lam dam pa'i chos/ /rig grol gnyis lngan tshogs la 'dud/khyed khams sgom gnas skor la gdung ba che/ /yul rkyen dge sbyor bcom ta re/ /las ngan gyi rlung 'tshub langs nas yong / /gnas mthong bas sangs rgyas thob gyur na/ /dus da lta rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ /mu stegs dang kla klos bzung ste mchi/ /de dag la mos pa med zer na/ /jo shāka rnam gnyis kyi sku mdun na//gnas bzhad dang rten bzhad 'don pa rnams/ /yi dwags su skyes pa ma mthong ngam//de bsam pa dang sbyor ba ma mthun pas lan//gnas la sting nas dad pa dang / /ltad mo'i 'du shes kyang nor nyen che/ /'bangs la longs spyod byed rnams ni/ /gnas skor ma yin sdig skor yin/ khyad par a khu khams pa dang //sgom chen sa mtha' 'grim pa rnams/ /shul ring lam du zhugs tsa na/ /rkang 'og tu bsad pas ma chog par//gro ga'i don du sems can gsod/ar jag dang g.yul sbrod zhe snang 'bar/ /bzod pa'i go cha rlung la bskur/ /rku 'phrog dang gzhogs slong ma byin len/ /sbyin pa'i mi mthun phyogs la bsten/ /lam grogs sna tshogs pas srung sdom skyel/ /tshul khrims thal ba bzhin du gtong //lus kyi las gsum pang du blangs/ /phyag dang skor ba'i rgyun lam gcod/to3

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs//rnyed pa 'tshol phyir rdzun tshig smra/ /zho sna snga phyir phra ma 'dzud/ /lam 'phrang yangs dog la tshig rtsub 'phel/ /shul ring gi ngal dub ngag 'khyal gyis bsgrib//ngag gi las lam bzhir bsnyen sgrub byed//bzlas brjod dang chos spyod 'bag 'bug chag /brtson 'grus log lam gyi phyogs la 'khyog /lha khang dang rten gsum mthong tsa na//phra rgyan dang mchod rdzas la brnab sems dang //dkon gnyer gyi tshig rtsub la gnod sems 'phel/ /bgrod lam gyi kha char bu yug dang / /dgra gyod dang nad gdon chom rkun sogs/ /las ngan gyi rlung 'tshub langs tsa na/ /dkon mchog dang chos skyong la yi chad dang / /log lta'i g.yang sar gom pa 'jog /yid kyi las lam rnam pa gsum/ /la sogs rnam rtog gi chom rkun rnams/ bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi 'gal zlar slebs/ /de ltar phyin drug sma 'bebs shing / /mi dge'i las lam rnam pa bcu/ /bltar mi mngon par 'du byed pa//sdom min rgyun ldan gyi rgyal blon dang /khe 'dod kyi tshong pa g.yon can dang / khams pa gnas skor la gdung ba dang / /sgom chen sgrub tshugs ma zin pa/ /thams cad kun gyi 'bug pa yin/ /gnyan sa 'grims pa skad rnams kyang / /sngon 'gros rang rgyud ma sbyangs zhing / /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i gzhung lam la/ /g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin lnga'i/ /drod rtags kyi sne yang ma zin par//bza' 'atung rkang gling dang ḍa rus 'tshol//thogs bcas bdud la skrag cing 'dar/ /thogs me+ed bdud kyis kun nas dkris/ /dga' brod bdud la mngon par rlom/ /snyems byed bdud la 'khyams bzhin du/ /chang 54

sngon sleng /dang lam zan 'tshol bzhin par/ /zha khyer khrag khyer zer ba mtshar/ /zhi gnas kyi myong ba mthar phyin nas//lhag mthong la nyams sad byed pa dang //ro snyoms kyi 'phrang la bsh-ir hūṃs pa'i//gcod mkhan deng sang yod mi 'dra//dur khrod du nyal bas sangs rgya na/ /mi tsher ri stongs su nyal byed pa'i/ /rdzi bo rnams 'ja' lus 'grub la nye/ /de kun glen pa'i brtul zhugs yin/ /gdon bgegs rang gi sems la tshang / /dur khrod mal sa las gnyan pa med//'jig rten chos brgyad kyi ro langs dang / /'du 'bral me+ed pa ma shes sam//'di nyid la gcod na gcod mkhan yin/ /brtul zhugs grub pa'i nang na mchog /de bas gnas skor dang sa skor la/ /rgyu ba rnams bag yod kyis dun pa brtan/ khyad par chos lngan gyi gang zag dang / /sgom chen gnas skor la 'gro ba'i mtshams/ /byang chub sems gnyis la rang dbang thob/ /ro snyoms kyi skyid sdug la 'dam ga bral/ /babrod pa'i go chas yul rkyen thub/ /nyin gcig la brdungs btags brgya byung yang / /'byung bzhi la dbyug pas bsnun pa ltar//ci mi snyam pa'i bahūṃl zhugs kyi//spobs pa gdeng du gyur pa'i tshe//yul chen nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs/ /bgrod par sngags kyi gzhung nas bshad/ /tshogs lam gyi sne yang ma zin cing / /sbre'u las bzod bsran chung ba yi/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /lpu+o spyod la grub thob tu rlom pa yi/ /ngo tsha'i gdong lpags ral ba rnams/ /gnas skor gyis ngan song sgrub nyen che/ ༈/bar dor zung 'jug thob nges pa'i//nag po spyod pa lta bu yang //gnas skor gyis sku srog bskyal gyur na/55

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs//phyogs las rnam rgyal dang kha 'gyangs pas/ khyed cag gi rgyud tshod rig ste mchi/ /zas gos kyi zhen pa ma chod pas/ khal ma dang tshong zog lam yig la gdung //brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas gnas nyul ba//o rgyan pa rang byung dpal sogs yin/ /de dag gis de 'dra e mdzad ltos/ /byis pas nyer spyod kyi bsam gtan la/rlung rkyen dang mngon shes gyal gyol sogs//lha'i bu'i bdud kyi 'phrang dam pas/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa lngar/ /bag yod bsten na mi legs sam/ /de la dag pa lnga yod de/ /gnas dag dgon pa bas mtha' bzung / /log 'tshos ma gos 'tsho ba dag /grogs dag tshangs par mtshungs sbyod ldan//sdom pa dag pa byang sems dang //rig 'dzin zung du sbrel ba bsrung //chos dag sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi/ /gnad don go ba'i bskyed rim dang / /sa bcu'i spangs rtogs la reg pa'i/ /rdzogs rim zung du 'brel gyur na/ /sangs rgyas rang la yod pa'i phyir//byang chub mal gyi nang nas thob//'di ltar mi shes rmongs chen rnams/ /'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras ming gzugs la/ /chags nas gzung 'dzin yul la bgrod/ /yul ni gzugs yin gnas kyang de/ /ming ni rnam shes la sogs bzhi/ /gnas kyi ming thos tshor ba ste/ /'gro bar 'dod pa 'du shes dang / /rgyu 'bras sna tshogs 'du byed de/ /rnam shes las su mi rung ba'i/ /blo lhag gnas skor bdud kyi las/ /cis kyang sngod du ma tshugs na//gnas chen gsum dang mtha' yang 'dul/ /ru gnon gtsug lag khang rnams la//phyag skor smon lam rgya chen mdzod//lam ma zhugs kyi skye bo la'ang bag 56

sngon gleng /yod shugs la bsten dgos pa'i/ /tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong 'di nyid zab//dge ba'i chos rnams sdud pa la/ /yan lag bdun dang phar phyin drug /chos spyod bcu sogs gsungs pa las/ /gcan gzan dang ni chom rkun gyi/ /brtul zhugs bstan pa med pa'i phyir/ /phan pa'i sems kyis smras pa yin/ /zhes kaḥsgom rtswa mchog grong la 'gro zer ba la gdams pa rang byung rdo rjes so/rnya58/zhes gsal na phyi rabs pa'i bod 'bras gnas bskor ba rnams nas sprin dkar tshad la btsugs/ sa nag 'dom la 'jal nas lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyams len mi 'dzo+ol bar tshul mthun dran pa nye bar gnas shing bag yod don lngan yod par bya ba'i phyir du bkod pa ni zhor 'phros su gsol ba'o//deng sang phyi mi bod rig pa zhib 'jug pa tshos kyang gnas kyi skor la'ang gzham gsal deb lta bu thon 'dug 5tsho9ḍodzo752tsho9tsho5 tsho77ṇa07tshotenya7ṇa(79dzo5 77(/ tre9lha77ṭu77tsho7ṇi9 phre907799shātsho0729135tsholha5 bhusku1(khu76kau10ba1556khu(’sbyi16ngapabasko0611 6༷(3ba gta0smoṣā5 8ca sa7khu'i15khu5 1)smo313bge5313 1999 /loshu53kro tshogej-iklo (khu7 )ṇa‘khrirtetsho77motsho /7 (/tre9shā bhu5‘snu0ba sbyi0bsku0ba 1998’ 143020sam/sku sa gta (khusku )77tsho7776tshosku7ṭ+wāṃ7775972tsho 1bsku1lngabastuskye1(10ba 1) stu 2(1babal0‘/sku(2)sbyi11) sa/khusag2rdu/smo1 spro997 1)khuṣā0551 stu1116ḍūkhusmostu/khus3 (70 13ṇ+ḍaṃdzomi77 67ཿ76200hūṃ5shā0 135tshoto8 'jigs med gling pa'i gtam tshogs/gangs can rig mdzod/1rngubod ljongs bod yig dbe rnying dpe skrun khang /1rtsertse1shog grangs 231—23cabar nas zur du phyungs pa'o//57

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/777 ljutsho (ṇ+ḍaṃlhaḥ 140ba5ba1ḍūsardutshi 5ḍū‘1khum 1115(0‘1khu3 2lngabaspu 4 //611ga91 55khub5khu'ilngaṣ+pe55khu(1mthami 2༷bab 1988 ṣākhu1('i 20spo①mab (medzoṇa0lha797—ṇa69tsho5 96ṭutsho77tsha711tredzoshā (metshoṇaḥ67/7tre67’79miṣā05(1khuspupyikhu8shu5khuthalngas2lnga51 1988bdun pa/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig rig 'dzin rgod kyi ljem 'phru can dang / gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa/ bum thang gter ston pad+ma gling pa/ gter ston bde chen rdo rje gling pa'i gter chos bcas nas zur phyung bgyis pa rnams la zhu dag skabs ji skad du/ gter chen nyag bla dri med 'od zer gyi sku gsung thugs kyi sras pad+ma thugs rje'i dbang phyug gi gsung las/spyir yang rang tshod kyi bya ba rgya chen yin stabs 'bru dag daphyis phyin 'ong dka' bar ma zad/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos gter zab mo rnams rgya bod kyi brda dag phyogs re ba dang bstun pa'i dag sbyor mi rung bar grags pa'i phyogs la tshad ma'i shes byed kyang snang bas dpe bsdur lan lnga tsam byas/ don gzhan du drangs ba'i nyes par mi 'gyur zhing ma bcos su mi rung pa'i yig nor du mthong ba rnams ci zhus su bcos pa tsam las/ chigo don gnyis char pho tshod kyis bslad pa ni med par rlom mo/ 59 /zhes gsungs pa ltar gus chung nas 5)—dbaterachenachos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po'i zab gter skor gyi bzhugs byang dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bzhugs so/ /gter chen rig 'dzin klong gsal snying po'i zab gter skor bzhugs so//pod ka pa/ gter ston dri med 'od zer gyi gdan sa snge dge rag chab seng ri bdud 'joms gling gi spar mar gzhi bzung gzhi chen be ro sku preng 58

sngon gleng /kyang de ltar lag bstar bgyis khyal yin lags/brgyad pa/ rang 'dra skal mnyam 'ga' la phan na snyam rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru'i rnam thar gzigs 'dod na/ sprul sku rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyi rnam thar gsal byed nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba bzhugs/dngos slob sur+ya bha dra'am se ston nyi ma bzang pos mdzod pa/ ṣā3‘0 2stu5(3ba spro985 zhog ldeb 42bzhugs pa dang /bstan pa'i snying po gsang chen snga 'gyur nges don zab mo'i chos kyi byung ba gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad mkhas pa dga' byed ngo mtshar gtam gyi rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sde dge 'dzing pa stag sgang chos sde'i mkhas mchog ngag dbang blo gros sam gu ru bkra shis mdzad pa/ 'di rjes bsdus ming gur bkras chos 'byung zhes 'god rgyu/ krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skran khang / 1rtsertse0 shog grangs 4ji3—4rngurtse bar la'ang gzigs 'tshal ༄sprul sku rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyi gter chos skor la/ zab pa dang rgyu che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa'i 60shog ldeb 111na7—174bcabar dang /zab pa dang rgya che ba'i —da gsur nga pad+margyal mtshan gyi gsar spar/rdo rje gling /1rtsertse7 ྅na ji'i shog grangs 7kyi460 thams can mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod ga pa bzhugs so/59

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa'i 61 zhog ldeb 71ba1—73ba4 bar la'ang gzigs mdzod/ lhag par du rgya drug gi nang gi gnam lcags lta bu sbyang pa'i rgya: zhes pa dang / snyan brgyud man ngag bzhi bcu rtsa gcig tu byed pa'i skabs kyi tshar gcod dug po gnam lcags kyi khang bu lngar grags pa snying mdzod nas byon pa'i phag mo gsang ba mad byung gi skor la/ spu+os med don gyi dbang chog gi steng nas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rdzas la brten nas spros med don gyi dbang dang dmigs rim nyams khrid smin rgyas su mnos nas/lung la/gsang ba rmad byung gi brgyud 'debs kun bzang ma rig 'dzin yol mo pa gsum pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'phros las gnyan sa dur khrod du blang ba'i glud ni rdo rje phag mo ma/ snyan brgyud kha byang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdo sngags chos kyi bcud phyung las can la phrad zhog gi smon lam can/ chos 'di'i brgyud pa ston par byed pa'i lo rgyus bka' srung la gtad rgya'i mtha' can/ gleng gzhi la nang gses kyi chos 'di'i mtshan gyi gleng gzhi/ stong thun spyi mthun gyi gleng gzhi/ rtsa ba bogs 'don 'bras bya gsum gyi gleng gzhi/ slob dpon chen por lha sras mu tig btsan pos zhus pa'i gsang ba rmad byung gi lde mig ces pa sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs nas 'phros te gnas chen 'tshol ba'i gang zag la bdud kyi bar gcod 'byung bas de 'dus thabs /'bras spungs dga' lngan pho brang gi spar ma/61 thams can mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nga pa bzhugs so//60

sngon gleng /kyi nyams len dmigs pa ting 'dzin gyi mtha' can/ spru+os med don gyi dbang chog /sa dmigs 'tshol ba bdag nyid rig pa dar dang bcas te dur khrod du 'gro tshul/ dang po spros bcas kyi spyod pa/ gnyis pa spros med kyi sbyod pa/gsum pa shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa/ de'i dus dgos pa'i log btsan mjug tu las can gyi sbas yul bdun gyi sgo 'byed tshul don gyi mdzo+od du sbas pa'i mtha' can/ phyi rabs las can gyi don du log gnon gnad kyi man ngag le'u lnga/ gsang ba rmad byung gi gdams pa nyams su blang ba'i rgyun khyer yol mo sprul pa'i skus phag gru'i rgyal khab tu mdzad pa dpa' bo'i 'gying glu rol pa chen po'i blo+os gar/ des mdzad pa'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang brgyud 'debs 'og min gdal khyab ma/ rgyun gyi nyams len khrigs chags bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsol 'debs nyams len dngos dang bcas pa sbrul sku phyag rdor nor bus mdzod pa/ rang snying rdo rje phag mor bsgom pa'i gdams pa rnams legs par thob/62 ces dang / yang / lung bstan dang srus yul lam yig gi skor la/ ma 'ongs lung bstan pad+ma'i bskul byang chen po lus kyi gzhung shing 'dra ba bod kyi sngags ban rgyal blon 'bangs rnams kyi ngan spyod dar ba dang de la brten nas sdug bsngal 'byung tshul dang thems byang bdun yod tshul sogs bstan pa/ ma 'ongs pa'i lung byang thems byang bdun pa zhes pa bdud 62 thams canamakhyenapa7rgyal dbang snye nga chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nga pa bzhugs so//shog ldeb 127na4d+ngha127bcabar gsal lo//6spro

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/dmag sde dgu g.yo ba'i dus su mi rtag bskul ba'i thems byang /rtsa ba brlag pa'i bdud gsum g.yo ba'i tshe zlog bsgyur bsrung ba'i thems byang / nang 'khrug gaspo+o ba'i tshe btsan sa bsnyeg pa'i thems byang / tshe thung bde skyid me+ed pa'i dus 'khor bar skyug log gi thems byang / bdud kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe chos dang chos min 'byed pa'i thems byang / mtha' dmag dang po gsum gyi dus rong sgo bsnyags nas so mtshams bzung ba'i thems byang /mtha' dmag chu ltar lug pa'i tshe sbas yul du 'gro don bya ba'i thems byang /ma 'ongs lung bstan gu ru pad+ma'i zhal chems brjod don gyi gtso bor mtha' dmag bzlog thabs rgyas par bstan pa re zhig rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ slob dpon chen po la mnga' bdag gis bstan pa/ dam chos/ gtsug lag khang /rgyal khrims rnams kyi gnas tshad zhus pa'i lan du skye 'gro rnams kyi ngan sbyod la brten nas rgyal khrims chos khrims 'jig pa dang / dus dran nyer brgyad 'char ba dang mtha' dmag bzlog tshul sogs kyi zhal chems rnams spa gro brag dmar khrul khur sku gshegs/ khar sbas nas smon lam btab pa/ du ru kha'i rgya thems rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis gu ru pad+ma la bsam yas mchims phur zhus pa/ o rgyan chen pos bod kyi mi rnams mi dga' gsungs nas gshegs par brtsams pa'i dus mnga' bdag gis bzhugs par gsol nas gdams pa brgya rtsa brgyad dang lung bstan che 'bring chung gsum sogs gsungs pa'i dus tshogs mchod brgya rtsa mdzad pa'i tshe mtha' dmag sde 62

sngon gleng /dgus bod 'joms pa'i dus 'bros pa'i yul gyi sbas yul rnams don bsdus te bstan pa leñtsa grangs med kyang mjug tu le'u drug pa zer ba yod/gter chen 'di gdon pa'i dus bod kyi rgyal po dang dge 'dun 'bangs rnams ji ltar 'byung dang bde sdug sogs kyi lung bstan mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis zhus pa/ zab gter 'di nyid kyis bod la phan pa'i rten 'brel dang dus rtags sogs bstan pa'i lung byang brgyad cu par grags pa/ bod rnams sbas yul du 'gro ba'i dus la babs pa'i lung bstan/ sbas yul spyi'i thems byang zhes pa slob dpon chen po mchims phur ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i skabs mnga' bdag gis bsam yas su spyan drangs nas tshogs brgya mdzod pa'i dus gsungs pa'i sbas yul du 'gro ran pa'i phyi nang gi dus rtags bdud kyi dug mda' bsrung ba dang sprus yul nges par rnyed pa'i thabs sogs bstan pa'i mjug tu/ o rgyan rgyal po pad+ma ngas: sa rong btsan pa'i yul phran rnams: sa btul byin brlabs gter chen sbas: sgo ba sgo srung bka' nyan bskos: de phyir sprus pa'i yul kun na: sgrub gnas re dang gnas chen re: bka' rtags yin pas gzhag par bya: nga yis byin rlabs sgrub gnas su: nga yul bu yis 'dzin pa ltar: the tshom med par 'dzin du bzhud:skye ba 'di yi phyi ma la: nga dang phrad par the tshom med: bka' 'di'i dus na bod kyi las ngan gyi: shis ngan gri ru 'chi bas lung 'di nyon: zhes sogs yod pa/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig 'di gsang ba rmad byung gi cha 63

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/lag tu gtogs kyang thob yig tu chos kyi sde tshan du mi 'di 'dugale'u drug pa mjug tu chos kyi blon bo brgyad kyis lung rtags bka' bgros pa 'phags pa zab mo'i lung bdun par yang grags pa/lha sras mu khri btsan pos slob dpon chen po la rin cen ga'u 'di rnams kyi brda'i ngo bo dpe don zhus pa'i lan sbas yul bdun gyi thems byang the tshom med par rnyed par 'gyur ba'i mtha' can/ 'di la yang gsang ba mad byung gi lje mig zer/yul gter du sbas pa skyid mo lung gi kha byang legs par grub pa'i mtha' can/ sbas yul skyid mo lung ngam ku thang skyid du grags pa'i lam byang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ mchims phu brag dmar la rgyal po'i bla gter sbas pa'i tshe gu ru chen por mnga' bdag gis zhus pa'i sbas yul skyid mo lung gi snying byang bstan ma bcu gnyis dang /gnyan chen thang lha la bcol ba'i mtha' can/ skyid kyi yul gyi nang sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig las can la phrad zhog gi mtha' can/ skyid mo lung gi lde mig gsal ba'i sgron me/ 'di'i mjug na kha byang rdzogs zer ba yod kyang brjod don la gong ma dang mi 'dra ba skyid yul dpal gyi lung sgron 'byed ran pa'i dus tshod dang skyid mo lung gi yul gyi gnas tshul ku thang gi yul gyis bskor tshul bzhad/ skyid mo lung gi ming gi rnam grangs bstan pa 'gor slob dpon pad+mas phyi rabs kyi don du zhes yod pa gzhi bdag ma dga' na rnyed dka'o zhes pa'i mtha' can/skyid mo lung gi gnas kyi gegs sel ma 'ongs ba'i dus na sgo 'byed par 'gyur ba'i mtha' can/yol mo gangs kyi ra ba'i lung byang snying bi ti ka mdzod 64

sngon gleng /gsum gyi gab pa bkrol ba dang bcas pa 'gor sbyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal ba dang mjug tu lo sum brgya bsring rtus par 'gyur ba'i mtha' can/pu li'i gangs dang rong la 'bros sa btsal ba las can la phrad shog gi mtha' can/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la mnga' bdag btsan pos zhus pa'i bstan mi dang bod kyi dar rgyud zab gter ji tsam gyi dus la 'don dang 'don pa'i gang zag de'i tshe rgyal brgyud gang du dar bod kyi bde sdug zhus pa'i lan gsungs pa las 'phros te ri kun tu gzigs kyi lung bstan bod kyi sde khol bur dar ba'i thabs bstan pa'i mtha' can/ gtsang gi stod bde bar byed pa'i gnas ri kun tu gzigs zhes bya ba lung bstan pa'i sa'i gnad/sgrub pa'i gnad/ las sbyor gyi gnad gsum gyi zhu ba zhus lan zangs mdzo+od dmar por sbas shing thang lhar bcol ba'i mtha' can/ mnga' bdag gis o rgyan chen por gser gyi pa tre bdun phul nas zhus pa'i ri kun tu gzigs kyis gnas dang gang zag gi gnad tig gi man ngag thams cad rgyas par bstan pa'i lung gi sgron ma rdzogs byang gi mtha' can/sbas yul mkhan pa lung gi thems byang dkar chag yi ger thob las zhog gi mtha' can/ slob dpon chen po la rgyal pos za 'og yug gcig phul nas zhus pa'i rgyal gyi mkhan pa lung gi phyogs mtshams 'gro ba'i dus tshod 'gro ba'i thabs rnams ston pa'i lam byang rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ gter ston rig 'dzin chen pos 'bras gzhongs gnas sgo phye ba'i gnas kyi yon tan yongs su bstan pa rdo rje thod pa 65

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rtsal gyis kha ba can ljongs pa rnams la sgrings yig btang ba/ rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis chu mo glang gi lo 'bras mo ljongs nas btang ba'i sgrings yig rnams thob pa las bskul byang chen mo dang thems byang bdun pa/63zhes sogs gsal/gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i rnam thar sding bsdus shig gzigs 'dod na/gur bkras chos 'byung /zhog grangs 43༷shi43rngubar gzigs mdzod/gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter chos skor la/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa'i 64shog ljeb 24can2—27chun7bar gzigs 'tshal/lhag par du shog ldeb 27༷bakho270bcalas/ ma 'ongs lung bstan bka' rgya'i skor la spyi don dang po mnga' bdag rgyal pos zhus pa'i bstan pa sbyi'i lung bstan/gnyis pa lha sras kyis zhus pa'i gang zag sgos lung / sa/sum pa 'tsho rgyal gyis zhus pa gnas skabs zin tig dang / rje 'bangs kun gyis zhus pa'i 'bras ljongs zab lung gi gnas yig /bzhi pa bar gcod dang 'dra min bdud sprul 'byung tshul thor bu dang bcas pa/ khyad par du lha sras la gal po 63 waṅged+me the lcenamakhyenapa7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nga pa bzhugs so//shog ldeb 1ca4naca—1cacab364 thams can mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod ga pa bzhugs so//66

sngon gleng /che la zhal gdams su gnang ba'i lung byang byin rlabs gnas 'gyur gter gyi sgrab ba'i skor gud du sbas pa thems med/ dkar chag thems byang gi skor nang r+sha thems byang dkar chag pad+ma'i 'phreng ba/ gsang ba don bsdus kyi dkar chag gud du sbas pa rnams so/ thems med/’mi /zhes sogs gsal/65o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pas/ gter ston chen po lnga la bran brgyas bskor:65 zab pa dang rgyu che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa bzhugs/ thams can mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod ga pa bzhugs so/ /shog ldeb 2ji7na2—2rngurtsen1 las/ ‘rgyal ba'i sras po rdo rje gling pas spa gro stag tshang brag nas sbyan drangs pa'i bla ma drag po'i skor ni/ rang gter las/de dus de+o rje drag po rtsal:o rgyan nga yi sgrub thabs 'di:su 'chang 'dzin pa nga rang dngos: de la bar gcod ga la tshugs2rdo rje pha lam ral gri 'dra:dpal ri 'od kyi rtse mo nas: de la g.yeng ba med par skyob: ces thugs sgrub drag po'i chos skor kun gyi nang nas shin tu zab pa byin rlabs hūṃs ldan gyi skor la/ zhes dang / dang po ni/ gu ru'i lo rgyus chen mo zhes pa pad+ma drag po rtsal gyi thugs sgrub la lo rgyus sgrub pa las tshogs gsum gyis phye ba'i a rgyan chen pos bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang 'grub par mdzad nas bod kyi sa/nas chen ri brag rnams byin gyis brlabs tshul dang khyad par dpe har btul ba'i lo rgyus 'bras mo ljongs kyi brag dkar bkra shis sdings su lo tsā ba be ro tsa na dang jo mo la thugs sgrub drag po thugs kyi sgrub pa gnang zhing gter du sbas tshul bcas bstan pa snying stobs can dang phrad par zhog gi mtha' can/ zhes gsal/67

mkha' sbyod 'bras 31 ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/zhes gsungs pa'i lnga ni gter kha gong 'og gnyis te gong ma nyang ral nyi ma 'od zer/'og ma gu ru chos dbang /rdo rje gling pa/pad+ma gling pa/mdo sngags gling pa rnams yin la/ gter ston rgyal po bzhi pa rig 'dzin chen po bum thang gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i (kro450—152kro) rnam thar rgyas pa gzigs 'dod na/rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa'i bka' 'bum yid bzhin gter mdzod las/ marmel lam dag snang gi skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa bzhugs so/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa yi//zab gter chos mdzod rin po che/66pod pa/dbyin ji'i shog grangs 3—77 bar dang / rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa'i bka' 'bum yid bzhin gter mdzod las/ skye ba rim brgyud kyi rnam thar gsol 'debs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa bzhugs so/ /dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 127—1rtsecabar bzhugs/bum thang gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i rnam thar 'od zer kun mdzes nor bu'i phreng ba zhes bya ba skal lngan spu+o ba skye ba'i tshul du bris pa bzhugs so/ /gter ston rang gi zhal gsung ma la rgyal ba don grub kyis kha bskang ba/ rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa yi/ /zab gter chos mdzod rin po che/ pod pha/ dbyin ji'i zhog 66de 7me9studzo907dzoṇi971tsho79ṇ+ḍaṃ ཿ7950(j-iṇ+ḍaṃtsho6ṇirdzo7lhaṇa~X772tsho799tsho khurdu970spu5khung7670la('ikhu0nga pyib11bzhu3ba5byadzu(9(59(dzi30khagarduskumi(5thalngabapyi5(༷bapyi()pyi0sa9lnga062'i5(3bami(rdusmodzi07skurdu70(ji/ same rdzusmo050tomi/6‘lngab7ba 0('irngu‘2'i5brtu50jisngu'i0khusku0sa5bskurdu775ḍū ba5ji —73(0ba061)5sku/0ba stu ba ṣ+ṭa0ji studzi 256 3'ikhuskutsābhu7rdumi(khu76kau55ba3mibaḥ10khyiḥ3〉 1'ib 951975 68

sngon gleng /grangs 3—71༷ bar dang / pad gling 'khrungs rabs kyi rtogs baji+od nyung gsal dad pa'i me tog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /gter chen pad gling rje'i sngags brgyud du skyes shing / skye 'phreng 'dzin pa'i sgro btags can/ rmongs brtul 'du shes gsum pa kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi mar 'bod pas brtsams pa/dbyin ji'i sh-i+og grangs 711—tsuX0bar/pad gling 'khrungs rabs rtogs baji+od dad pa'i me tog gi kha skong mos pa'i ze'u 'bru zhes bya ba bzhugs so//bdud 'joms 'jigs bral ye shes rdo rjes mdzad/ dbyin ji'i shog grangs caX1—ca2rtsebar bzhugs pa bcas la gzigs 'tshal/rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma gling pa'i+o rnam thar sting bsdus zhig gzigs 'dad na/ gur bkras chas 'byung / zhag grangs 43rngu—44ca bar la'ang gzigs mdzod/rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma gling pa'i gter chos skor la/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅga'i chu rgyun las glegs bam gsum pa'i 67 shog ldeb 37rtseb7—3catsun7 bar dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi thob yig gaṅga'i chu rgyun las glegs bam bzhi pa'i 68sh-i+og ldeb 1na1—4rngub2bar gzigs mdzod/lhag par du shog ljeb 1na1—7naca nang / de yang ma ṇi dgon par sprul 67 thams canamakhyenapa7rgyal dbang lnga sbre chen ngo'i gsung 'bum pod ga pa bzhugs so//68 thams can mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nga pa bzhugs so//69

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ sku rma d+ma gling pa la o rgyan chen pos dngos su kha byang stsal bar brten gsol 'debs las/ dus bzang khyad 'phags rla ba nya yi hūṃb/ /zab dgu'i gter gnas sna ring brag logs nas/ /rdzogs chen bla med a ti klong gsal skor//kun bzang thugs bcud gsang ba'i yang bcud rnyed/ /ces pa ltar zab gter gyi thog mar bum thang phyal gyi mda' stang chu rgya mdud 'khyil ba'i sa seng ge sna ring brag gam me 'bar mtshor grags pa'i gter gnas nas sbyan dungs pa'i zab gter kun tu bzang mo klong gsal gsang ba snying bcud kyi rgyud la brten nas slob dpon chen pos phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i klong gsal gyi skor la/ 69 zhes dang / drug pa lung bstan gnas yig gi skor la/ma 'ongs lung bstan gsal ba'i sgron me le'u bcu gcig pa/ sprus yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig lde mig dang bcas pa leñtsa bcu dgu pa/ de'i 'phros sbas yul mkhan pa ljongs kyi lam yig nyi ma'i zer dang bsngoms pas le'u sum cu so gsum pa/ yang mkhan pa ljongs kyi gnas yig zur bkol le'u bcu pa/ 70zhes sogs gsal/slob dpon pad+ma tshe dbang gis brtsams pa/ pad gling lo rgyus drang 69 thams can mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nga pa bzhugs so//zhog ldeb 1na1—70 thams can mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nga pa bzhugs so//shog ldeb 4ba4—70
