mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/'dra sa gcig pu ni sangs rgyas gling pa'i bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las:ma 'ongs lung bstan gsang ba'i dkar chag bkod pa zhes pa'i nang / mū 'ongs pa'i tshe stigs ma lnga bdo ba'i tshe:nga'i sprul pa rnal 'byor mched bzhi 'byung zhing : gcig ni ri dwags lings pa'i tshul du 'byung nas: gsang lam rku thabs su 'byed par 'byung bar 'gyur ro: gcig ni rnal 'byor spyon pa'i tshul du 'byung nas seng ge'i mchong stabs kyis 'byed par 'gyur ro:gcig ni dge sbyong 'gro 'dul gyi tshul du 'byung nas: glang chen stobs lngan tshul du 'byed par 'gyur ro: gcig ni sprul pa ras pa'i tshul sngags 'chang du 'byung bas 'bu srin zhur 'gros kyi tshul du 'byed cing : skal lngan skyes bu rnams kyang rim pas bgrod par 'gyur ro: zhes gsal bar pad gling gi gsungs klong gsal gyi skor las/ sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs kyi gnas yig nang / o rgyan gyis gsungs pa: lha lcam spob sras bdag la gson:sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi ni: shar sgor 'gro na ston kha 'gro bar bya:mon gyi ston thog bsdu ba'i dus su 'gro: glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi yi lo la 'gro:khyad par sa mo lug la ldegro na bzang :byi ba'i zla ba tshes gcig lam la bzhugs: lam lha mchod cing ngang gis 'gro bar bya: rgya la gyi zla bar 'bras mo gshongs su slebaca 'don pa'i gang zag bum thang mthil nas 'byung: lha lcam khyod kyi skye mtha' bum thang yong : rta lo lcags khams pa gcig 'byung ba'o: snang ba 'ur zhing 'dod blo zhig pa dang : tshig rtsub rta skad 72

sngon gleng /cho le smra ba yod: o rgyan nga yi thugs sprul pad+ma'i ming : skyes bu de yis sbas yul 'don par 'gyur: zhes kha bsgyur ram kha gsab byas pa lta bu snang nga //sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rig 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ljem 'phru can gyi gter nas spyan drangs pa'o zhes gsal/ 'di rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyi gsung dngos yin min dpyad/ 'on kyang bdud rtsi'i 'od 'alho'i nang rje lha btsun chen po mkhan sku gzhogs kyi gdung rten ring bsrel bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs/ 73zhes dang / gter ston gling pa brgya dang /dri med lnga/mchog sprul rnam pa gsum de dag gi gter nas byon pa'i bram ze'i sku sha de dag 'phezlo ba'i ring bsrel gsum/ 74zhes dang /‘dgongs 'dus bka' 73 'bras ljongs sgang tog gi rnam rgyal bod kyi shes rig nyams zhib khang gi dpe khongs su bzhugs pa/ ske0khurdu550ba ba0 0239 can la kha shog phyi mar/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dang rgyal rabs mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /zhes dang / kha shog nang mar/ steng phyogs lha nas babs te nang tshan rgya kar shar phyogs brgyud nas 'ong ste khams phyogs mi nyag a'o ldong drug spun gsum gyi byung khungs lo rgyus bzhugs so//'khyug bris shog ldeb 2canarngu 74 gong gsal shog ldeb 2cageca73

mkha' ྅ted 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rgya mas/ 75 zhes gsal ba la bsam tshe 'di ni gter ston rig 'dzin rgod ljem gyi gsung dngos min la phal cher 1rnguca3 gong du do lung rig 'dzin mchog sgrub gling gi dpon slob skal bzang chos dbyings sam kun bzang tshul khrims kyis mdzad dam snyam na da dung dbyad par 'tshal/sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro zhes pa'i nang 'bras ljongs/mdzod lnga stag rtse/brag dkar bkra shis sdings/ glang phyag /lha ri sting phug /mkha' 'gro gsang phugakhrag 'thung rong / phag mo rong / yug sam thang gi mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar/ shar phyogs sbas phug bcas kyi gnas bshad mdor tsam re gsal/lhag par du gnas yig chen po las zhes lung 'dren mdzad 'dug pa sus mdzad sogs ni ma gsal/sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs 'ogo min rnam dag pad+ma drwa ba can gyi gnas yig lung bstan gsol 'debs smon lam gter srung gsol mchod bcas bzhugs zhes pa'i mdzad pa po gter ston rdo rje bde chen gling pa'am/ mdo mang gter chen (kuspro876—1928) gyi rnam thar snying bsdus shig zhu dbang du btang na/ 7rgyal ba dpal yul ba rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab (spro636—1698) kyi bu chen gur dkar mo'i chon chen bzhi'i ya gyal 'bri gung skyu 75 gong gsal zhog ldeb 2jin174

sngon gleng /ra'i gdung rus go la'i sngags brgyud du byon pa 'jang sgang a 'phen dang rigs dbon tshul khrims rdo rje gnyis kyi yongs 'dzin go la'i sngags brgyud rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul sbyin pa rgya mtsho zhes pas thog mar mdo mang dgon phyag btab/ yongs 'dzin spyin pa rgya masnu'i yang srid lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi rnam 'phrul sku chen kun bzang rnam rgyal zhes pa de hor 'dzi brag tu sku 'khrungs/ spyir khong gi mkhas grub du ma'i zhabs dul la bsten kyang /dpal yul rang ngos nas karma chos dpal bzang por gtsug phud phul nas rig bdag tu bsten/ snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos bka' rgya mtsho lta bu man ngag rgyab skyor bcas rdzogs/ rdo rje slob dpon du mnga' gsol nas mdo mang gi grub pa'i khyu tshogs yongs kyi gtsug rgyan du byon/spyi bye brag gi smin grol gyi chos bka' du mas skal lngan rnams bskyangs/lhag par gnam gter dang /rat+na gling pa/'ja' mtshon/kar gling gi zab chos rnams kyi gtsos bka' gter gyi bstan pa bskyangs nas grub brnyes mang du byan/mdo mang bla ma gras/sa pa bstan 'dzin khong gis 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po (rwa820—spro892) dang / dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun ma skal bzang chos kyi dbang mo zung gi mdun du/ mchog sprul kun bzang rnam rgyal gyi yang srid gar bzhugs/ lung bstan zhus te sku bdag mdzad pa de ni gter chen rdo rje bde chen gling pa ste/ gu ru'i gter lung dang skyes chen 75

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ gzhan dag gi lung bstan las thub pa'i drung du dge slong sha na'i gos can/༷/rgyan gyi zhal slob grub chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ de 'og karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa/ lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med/ lha btsun 'jigs med dpa' bo/ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'jam dpal rol pa zhes dang /gzhan yang sog po dpal gyi ye shes dang /'phags yul du grub chen phag tshang pa sogs kyi sprul par gsungs pa'i gter chen khong ni/tre hor brag 'go 'u rdo mkhar du pharmi cher 1rngu7ca76 lor sku 'khrungs/ sku shin tu chung dus nas zhal gzigs dag snang lung bstan dang mkhyen rab nam mkha' ltar rgya che/brag 'go ke'u tshang blo bzang yar rgyas las dge tshul slong sgrab/ yi ge klog sbyong sogs yon tan kun la sbyong ba cher ma mdzad par 'jaswā dpal bstod sgrub kho na la brtson pas lhag lha 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis zhal gzigs/76 pod/11tha'i wan sbar ma/2༷༷7dbyin ji'i shog grangs 17co2༷lngabar/rdo rje bde chen gling pa'i byung ba baji+od pa rnam par thar pa'i 'dra bshad yod/shog ldeb 1rtsebazhugs/gong gsal pod/11dbyin ji'i shog grangs 1rtse7rang lo 21me sprol la/smo896gong gsal pod/ 11 dbyin ji'i shog grangs 1rtse7 lo me 'brug ston blo tha chung gi/tshes bdun la hor yul rong gi cha/ /grong ser mo 'bum rgyas bya ba'i sa/ /gnas zal lung stag tshang gsang phug nas//chos bar chad sel ba'i gter zhal phye/ spro916gong gsal pod/11dbyin ji'i sgo+og grangs 1lngaji 1 me zhing pho byi ba zhar ba'i tshe mi nga rang bgrang bya lnga bcur slebs/ 1924gong gsal pod/11dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 212 rang lo 2rtsezhing 'abhug lo'i 190476

sngon gleng /dgongs pa shugs 'byung du klong rdol/ khong gis spyir bshes gnyen du ma bsten pa las/ thun min gyi bla ma ni 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang / kong sprul yon tan rgya mtsho/ dpal yul mdo sngags chos kyi nyi ma rnams yin/ dgung grangs nyer gcig nas gu ru'i zab gter rgya mtsho lta bu'i zhal phye/sa stod smad kun tu phyogs med kyi 'gro don bskyangs nas khong gi zhal slob tu gyur pa ni stod rgya gar nas smad rgya nag gi bar du bsam las 'das kyang rags bsdus tsam ni/ stod dbus gtsang phyogs nas karma pa mkha' khyab rdo rje/ 'bri gung skyabs mgon rin po che/ mchog sprul bsod nams kun dga'/ stag lung rtse sbrul/ stag lung zhabs drung sogs 'bri stag kar gsum bla grwa yongs la rin chen gter mdzod sogs kyi smin dbang dang / thun min nyams khrid kyi skor mang du bstsal nas kun gyi spyi bo'i mchod gnas su gyur/ khams phyogs nas rdzogs chen rin po che thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje/ mkhan gzhan dga' rin po che/ sku zhabs gzan dkar rin po che pad+ma dngos grub/ mtshams pa bla ma 'jam dbyangs/ a tshab kun mkhyen/bon 'ja' skur gshegs pa zla ba grags pa/ gtsang smad wa shul sku chen/ sgo 'dzi gter chen ye shes 'byung gnas/ lo shul gter ston 'phan lo/ gter ston rang byung / 'jang sgang 'chi me+ed/cha nang bla ma shes rab 'od zer/ra hor rdzogs sprul/ ra la'i bla ma rol pa'i rdo rje sogs brjod las 'das/ lhag par khong dpa' bo rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi sku skye yin rabs gling tshang rgyal pos

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/khong gis sbral sku yin zhes dad mos brtse gdung tshad med gnang nas pho brang gdan ljungs nas zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs/ rgyal po nyid bar chad lam sel gyi chos bdag tu lung gi zin pas chos bka' de'i dbang lung rdzogs par gnang / gter ston rang nyid kyi rdzogs chen gyi chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi gdams khrid ma lus pa chig rdzogs su bstsa'/ ba ni gling tshang rgyal rgan ma'am gsang mtshan pad+ma bde chen rol pa stsal de nyid do/ /'dan khog pad+ma ri mthor gter bzhes sar phebs skabs a thub sras po tshe dbang phun tshogs kyis gzhis len gzab/ mdo mang dgon pa'i bca' yig che mo'ang mdzad/ dus bde zhod 'jags skabs gter chen rdo rje bde chen gling pa'i gter byon gtsor gyur pa'i pod bcu gsum cha tshang mdo mang dgo/na par spar zhing bzhugs kyang rgya dmar gsar brje'i god chags skabs thor zhig tu song /7777 khams phyogs dkar mdzes khul gyi dgon sde so so'i lo rgyus gsal bar bshad pa thub bstan gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs/ deb gsum pa/ krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi chos lugs lo rgyus zhib 'jug so'o dang / krung go bod brgyud nang bstan mtho rim slob gling / zi khron zhing chen dkar mdzes khul chos lugs cud/ dkar mdzes khul yig bsgyur cud bcas las khungs bzhi nas bsdu sgrig byas/(nang khyal yig cha )16d+ngha7nang gses/khams phyogs brag 'bo dngong gi dgon sde so so'i lo rgyus gsal bar bzhad pa thub bstan gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba/ shog grangs 37sa3caca bar nas btus pa'o//gong gsal rnam thar rnams kyang ldo rje bde chen 78

sngon gleng /pa'i 'dra bsgod yod/ces pa ni gter chen mchog dgung lo 7༷shing byi ste phyi lo 1rtse24/1rtse27 bar gyi rang rnam shin tu snying bsdus zhig red 'dug/gter chen mchog sa 'brug ste phyi lo 1rtse2jilor zhing la phebs par mngon/gter chen bde chen rdo rje gling pa ni lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med rtsal gyi rnam 'phrul yin te/ rang gter/ rig 'dzin zhi khro 'dus pa las/'di 'dra rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gsang tshig bcud: 'og min bde ldan pad+ma drwa ba'i gling : mi 'gyur dpal gyi 'bras mo gzhongs zhes par: 'jigs med dpa' bo kun bzang rnam rgyal la: mi shigs rdo rje brda yi chos char 'babs: 'gro don skye ba mang 'gyur bod khams su: sbas pa'i rnal 'byor rdo rje'i ming can gyis: sngon gnas rjes dran thugs kyi klong nas zhar: dag snang bla ma rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi: cha lag 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa 'di:rin chen shog skya'i ngos su legs par bkod: 80ces dang /yang rang gter/ rig 'dzin zhi khro 'dus pa'i dbang bskur ngan song rang grol las/ de ltar rig 'dzin zhi khro 'dus pa yi: dbang bskur brab mo skal lngan smin byed lam: 'dzom gling lte ba gnas chen 'bras mo ljongs: lha ri snying gur rdo rje'i phug pa ru: rig 'dzin bla ma spo+ongs kyi dgongs bcud mchog: nam mkha' 'jigs med sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor pa: rang zhar rdo rje'i brda chig rab bkrol ba'i: dag snang bla ma rig 'dzin srog sgrub kyi: cha lag zlo——ṅge+orked/ ḍāwanasparam/2༷yo da.o lje'i zhog grangs 3༷8kro

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ྅rtongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/'drel tshad rang grol 'di nyid ni: ldan yul dge gnas mthon lding pad+ma ljongs: ye shes rnam bkra mkha' sbyod grub pa'i gnas: 'og min rgyal ba yongs kyis byin rlabs pa'i: gnas mchog dam pa de ru 'dug pa'i tshe:rang slob blo bzang chos grags zhes bya bas: bskul phyir rdo rje'i brda las brjod tshig gi: lam du ri mor spel ba gsang sngags kyi: 'aglo don mu me+ed phyogs mthar dar rgyas zhog: 'jigs med dpa' bo kun bzang rnam rgyal gyi: rnam 'phrul rdo rje bde chen gling pa yis:mi shigs rdo rje'i brda las phab pa dge: 8spro zhes dang / rang gter/ 'pho ba mkha' spyod sgo 'byed las/ lha btsun chen po kun bzang rnam rgyal lam: he ru ka pa nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi: rnam 'phrul rdo rje bde chen gling pa zhes: gzhan phan gter sgo 'byed pa'i bdag po de'i: dgongs klong mi zhigs nam mkha'i mdzod nas phab: 82ces gsal/ phyogs mtshungs gter ston gyi gsung las/ gter ston lha btsun chen po'i sku phreng gsol 'debs bzhugs/ /bi ma'i rnam 'phrul 'bras ljongs rdzogs chen pa/ /he ru ka dpal nam mkha' 'jigs med rtsal/ /yang sprul khrag 'thung 'jigs med dpa' bo'i mtshan/ /skye 'phreng gsum pa rdo rje bde chen gling / /grub brnyes skyes mchog rim par byon rnams la/ /gsol ba 81 gong gsal pod/7dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 1༷rtse82 gong gsal pod/7dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 2cu⑩༷482

sngon gleng /'debs so mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ /zhes rdo rje bde chen gling pas so 83/zhes ba bzhin rgyal ba lha btsun pa sku dreng dang po dang sku phreng gsum pa rnam gnyis kyi 'gro don mdzad 'phro bskyang ched phyi lo 1ci24/1rtse27 nas 1rtse2shābar sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs su chibs bsgyur bka' drin mdzad/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas dgon gang du bzhugs skor cher ma shes kyang / rang gter/ byad grol gyi man ngag khro mo gdugs dkar mo'i sgrub thabs las/ 'di ltar man ngag gi zhus mthu gzhan gyis 'gran zla med pa'i skor rnams bdag gter ston rdo rje bde chen gling pas 'bras ljongs zhes pa mon spyi zlum gyi yul khyad par 'phags pa'i gnas mchog bde chen rnam 'phrul rgyal sras rdo rje gling pa'i bzhugs khang / bhar+ghaṃ zhod kyi sgrub khang zhar ri sbrul 'khyug pa 'dra ba/ lho ri dar dkar kyi yol ba 'dra ba/ hūṃb ri pad+ma kha phye ba 'dra ba/ byang ri mdzod lnga gter gyi bum pa brtsegs pa 'dra/ g.yas su mtsho me long 'dra ba/ g.yon du pha wang rus sbal 'dra ba ste/ ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa dang ldan pa badz+ra tsit+ta ko ṭa'i thub/sa kyi sgrub gnas drag rtsal gzi byin dang lngan pa'i gnas su mchu rla ba'i mar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum dgongs mdzod las phab pas 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung bar zhog 830 sprusayula'abras mo ljongs 'og min rnam dag pad+ma drwa can gyi gnas yig lung bstan gsol 'debs smon lam gter srung gsol mchod bcas bzhugs/ sgang tog dben bcas dgon gyi spar ma/shog ldeb 17na183

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/cig: 84 ces mdzad byang mang po'i nang gsal na gtso bo 'bras ljongs lho rdo gling dgon pa dang nye 'khris su sku bzhugs mdzad par mngon/'bras ljongs khul sku bzhugs gnang ring /1 rig 'dzin zhi khro 'dus pa bzhugs:shog ldeb 12852 sh+lau: rig 'dzin zhi khro 'dus pa'i dbang bskur ngan song rang grol bzhugs so:shog ldeb 7863 baṃ: 'pho ba mkha' spyod sgo 'byed bzhugs so:shog ldeb 2lnga874 byad grol gyi man ngag khro mo gdugs dkar mo'i sgrab thabs bzhugs:zhog ldeb 388 ༄7 shrī: yi dam drag po'i sbyi yi gtor zlog cho 'phrul 'bar ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so:shog ldeb 689ca ṭaṃ: gdugs dkar gyi byad grol mthu stobs ral gri zhes bya ba bzhugs:zhog ljeb rngu90 84 pod/rtsetha'i wan spar ma/dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 277ཿ4 85 gong gsal pod/7dbyin ji'i shog grangs ༅7—1༷lnga86 gong gsal pod/7dbyin ji'i shog grangs 67—1༷lnga87 gong gsal pod/7dbyin ji'i shog grangs 213wa27༷88 gong gsal pod/rtsedabyin ji'i shog grangs 347—3tsu189 gong gsal pod/rtsedabyin ji'i zhog grangs 2rngu1—3༷༷90 gong gsal pod/rtsedabyin ji'i shog grangs 247—2ca184

sngon gleng /7 sh+lau: gza' yi gdon bkrol gnam lcags gur khang zhes bya ba bzhugs:zhog ldeb ca91ji lha: klu yi gdon bkrol ye shes me yi gur khang zhes bya ba bzhugs:shog ldeb ca92 ⑩ gcod kyi bzhus tshogs zha'/ stabs dmigs skor dgu pa bzhugs so//shog ldeb rngu931༷ lha btsun chen po kun bzang rnam par rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul rdo rje bde chen gling pa'i bla sgrab bzhugs:zhog ldeb 29411 bla ma 'jam dpazlo dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs dngos grub myur stsol bzhugs:zhog ldeb 19512 rdo rje bde chen gling pa'i ka kha'i glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /shog ldeb 29613 sngon 'gro bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /shog ldeb 7979spyo gong gsal pod/'dabyin ji'i sh-i+og grangs 373wa3ji392 gong gsal pod/lngadabyin ji'i zhog grangs 3rngu7—37ca93 pod/1༷tha'i wan spar ma/2ཿ7dbyin ji'i shos grangs 3༷1—31794 pod/11tha'i wan spar ma/2༷༷7dbyin ji'i zhog grangs rngu7—lngaX95 gong gsal pod/11dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 12ca—12796 gong gsal pod/11dbyin ji'i shog grangs 377—4༷297 gong gsal pod/11dbyin ji'i shog grangs 4༷ 121385

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/14 brda mdzo+od las byon pa'i gling bzhi sbyi mdos bzhugs:zhog ldeb 19817 lha: ḍā ki'i brda mdzo+od las byon pa'i tshe ring lha mo mched lnga'i gsol mchod bzhugs/shog ldeb 1991ca sbas yul 'bras mo ljong 'og min rnam dag pad+ma drwa can gyi gnas yig lung bstan gsol 'debs smon lam gter srung gsol mchod bcas bzhugs/ shog ldeb 17100 'di gong gsal rgya nag khreng tu dang phyis tha'e wan gnyis ka'i gter chen gyi gter chos phyogs bsdebs spar ma'i nang ma bzhugs/gter chen mchog sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs su sku bzhugs mdzad skabs khams nas/ mnyam phebs/ tha/ma 'bras 'u+o/ོngas pa yin blo bzang chos grags dang pad+ma tshul khrims rnam dag /kun mkhyen/ tshangs dbyangs snyan grags zhu ba'i slob ma bzhi dang / sbyin bdag bstan pa rgya mtsho dang rgyal mtshan zhu ba gnyis byung 'dug /gter chen mchog rgya gar gyi gnas chen khag 'a/ gnas gzigs mchod mjal la'ang phebs myong /gter chen mchog sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs su zhabs bcag skabs 98 pod/12tha'i wan spar ma/2༷༷7dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 2lnga7—2lngarngu99 gong gsal pod/12dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 37rngu—37rtse1ཿ sgang tog dben bcas dgon gyi sbar ma/ldeb thung 17zhog ldeb 14ba4las 'di skor thams cad tshang bar gtan la phab don spyin bdag bstan pa rgya mtsho nas nan cher byas ngor gter ston rdo rje bde chen gling pas sa 'brug lo'i (1928) hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes gnyis nyin rdzogs par phab pa dge zhes gsal/86

sngon gleng /chos rgyal sku rabs bcu gcig pa bkra zhis rnam rgyal dang / btsun mo mdo mkhar kun bzang bde chen mtsho mo/ chos rgyal dang ma yum gcig pa'i sku mched phreng ring rin po che bcas zhal bzhugs pa'i dus skabs dang 'khel/snyigs lnga'i rang mdangs che cher bdo bas thag ring mdo khams smad nas byon pa'i lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi rnam 'phrul sbas yul du 'phrin las 'gro don 'phro mthud par bka' bab dus bab gter chen ngal gron sogs la ma 'dzems par gnas mthil du zhabs pad 'khod na'ang snod lngan gyi chos bdag ma byung ba'am/ 'bras ljongs pa'i che rgyu rnams nas mos gus dag snang blta bzhog ji snyam pa'i gzhis len dang bkur bzos tsam yang ma byung ba 'dra bas gter ston 'dis rten 'drel gzhan dbang du gyur pa ste/ rang gter/'pho ba mkha' sbyod sgo 'byed las/ 'di 'dra dbyangs can mkha' 'gro'i thugs mdzod chos: kun las zab khyad rmad du byung ba ste:'drel tshad thar pa'i gling du 'pho zhus te: dngos rtags 'byung bar the tshom tsam med do: 'on kyang stigre/sa dus log lta can mang bas: khyad 'phags gter ston sprul sku khyi bzhin smad: sgro btags skur btab log sgrub char ltar 'bebs: blun po gdol spyod mkhan rnams bkur ba'i dus: bskal pa'i yang mthar pad+ma'i phrin las kyis: zab gter 'chang ba zol med nyin skar tsam: lha btsun chen po kun bzang rnam rgyal lam: he ru ka pa nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi: rnam 'phrul rdo rje bde chen gling pa zhes: gzhan phan 87

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/gter sgo 'byed pa'i bdag po de'i: dgongs klong mi shigs nam mkha'i mdzod nas phab: yi ge ris byed tshangs dbyangs snyan grags te: dge bas 'gro rnams ma lus 'dren par zhog: spro01ces gsal/des na gdul bya'i chu snod med na 'dul byed kyi zla gzugs kyang mi snang ba bzhin re zhig sku dngos kyis gdul bar 'os pa'ang de tsam du dgongs nas mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du sa 'abhug ste 1rtse2rngulor gshegs so//gter chen mchog gi de ma thag pa'i sku skye sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs su gnyis byon pa ni g.yang thang sprul sku dang rin chen spungs sprul sku rnam gnyis yin/ da lta rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob tu sku 'tsho bzhin mdzad pa phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa 7skyabs rje g.yang thang rin po che kun bzang 'jigs med bde chen 'od gsal rdo rje mchog bod sa sbrul 1rtse2rtse lor 'bras ljongs nang yab sde dge rdzogs chen nas yin pa pad+ma 'gro 'dul dang /yum gtsang 'od yug brag dkar ba'i mi brgyud 'bras blon g.yang thang a thing nam mkha' rgya ma61re sras mo bstan 'dzin chos sgron rnam gnyis kyi sras su sku 'khrungs/ mdo mang sog sprul rin po ches yang srid rtsad gcod thugs 'gan bsnams pa'i zhu ngo ltar rdzogs chen sku phreng lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje dang /stag lung rtse sbrul rnam gnyis kyis mdo mang gter chen gyi yang srid du ngos 'dzin gsal thag mdzad/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs nas phebs 101 gong gsal pod/7dbyin ji'i shog grangs 2cartse 488

sngon gleng /sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med dpa' bo'i gsung yin na lung 'dren de bas mdzad yod dgos/ lha btsun sku dreng gsum pa'i rang rnam rdzogs chen rig 'dzin 'jigs me+ed dpa' bo'i bka' 'bum mthong grol chen mo ni yang yang lung 'dren mdzad yod/ bka' 'bum mthong grol chen mo'i nang la'ang gnas yig de ltar mdzad pa'i skor ci yang ma gsal/'o na/lha btsun 'gyur med 'jigs bral bstan 'dzin dpa' bo zhu ba de su yin zhe na/ 'bras ljongs chos rgyal sku rabs bcu pa srid skyong rnam rgyal gser khri mnga' gsol skabs 'bras blon g.yang thang ka dzi spro03 'am brag 103 'bras mo ljongs sogs ni mi chen dang blon rigs la sde bān kazi sogs kla klo'i cho lo ster ba deng sang gi bar du snang bas yul 'di dag kyang sngar dbang du tshud pa zhig byung bar mngon/ zhes a mdo rdor brag dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis gsung / dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi gsung rtsom/deb dang po/gangs can rig mdzo+od/1༷bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang nas bskrun/ 1rtse60 dbyin ji'i shog grangs 414 nang gsal/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs ni kla klo kha che dang mtha' mi mi bsrun sog pos btsan 'dzul byed myong bed/'bras ljongs rgya gar du yod pa'i dbyin gzhung gi 'og tu tshud rjes phal cher phyi lo 1rngurtseX rjes tsam nas 'bras blon mi drag sa ris bdag thob can tshor ka dzi (5lnga 21)'bod pa byung / 'di ni kha che'i tha snyad kyi ka dzi'i go don dang tha dad yin/ yang rgya gar dbyin gzhung mnga' zhabs su yod skabs rgya gar dang lho 'brug sa 'brel bhag sa ḍor (25snutshipu537) sa khul dang thag nye raja sha hi'i (ṣālnga’3'im 1) sa khyal sde tshan spyi khyab kyi las byed ka rdor sgang gsum khyal gyi mi ser dkyus ma/ lhag par skad bsgyur lo tsā ba lta bu (dzu'i1061ga16rdu(3ba17lngab51mi(07(01dzu0ba bge13310bakhu‘06ṣā35smoma'i/1)151rdu10ba)'i/'ang 91

mkha' spyod 'bās mo 1snangs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/lam yig dang / phan yon lung byang sogs gsungs pa rnams 'ga' zhig dpe ma rnyed/ re zung mchis pa rnams yig skyon che bas 'phyang mor gyur pas bkod stabs ma bde/ yid rton 'pher ba ji rnyed mchis pa rnams dkyus gcig tu bsdebs pa po lha btsun 'gyur med 'jigs bral bstan 'dzin dpa' bor 'bod pas so/ spro06 /zhes gsal/ gong gsal dpal lngan 7mi dbang sa skyong stangs dpyal lhan ni 'bras ljongs rgyal thog bcu gcig pa bkra shis rnam rgyal mchog (1893—spro963) dang btsun mo sde dpon mdo mkhar kun bzang bde chen mtsho mo (1905—1987) rnam gnyis yin/ yang spar byang smon chig tu/ sbas yul gnas yig 'di bzhin 'bras ljongs lha sde spyi 'thus nas spar bsko'i yon sbyar zhu skabs lha btsun pas so/rnyaspro07 /zhes gsal/ 'di la'ang bsam gzhigs dgos te/ lha btsun sku phreng gsum pa 'jigs med dpa' bo'i sku dus su 'bras ljongs lha sde spyi 'thus dang 'bras ljongs dgon gnas las khungs shes pa'i tha snyad med pa'i phyir na lha btsun 'gyur med 'jigs bral bstan 'dzin dpa' bo zhes pa ni phreng ring rin po che rang yin par mkhyen mdzod lags/dreng ring rin po che 'gyur med 'jigs bral bstan 'dzin dpa' bo ni/spro06 sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzod zhes bya ba bzhugs so//shog ldeb ca7na2spro07 sbas yul 'dras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzod zhes bya ba bzhugs so//shog ldeb curngun194

sngon gleng /'bras ljongs chos rgyal sku rabs bdun pa gtsug phud rnam rgyal (kro785—spro863)dang / la mo'i lha lcam dang po'i zhal ta ma bya khrid gnyis gab mthun la sras bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal lam/ phyag mdzod dge slong dkar po 'khrungs/ gtsug phud rnam rgyal gshegs rjes khong gi btsun mo chos rgyal sku rabs dgu pa mthu stobs rnam rgyal gyi ma yum smon skyid lha lcam dang phyag mdzod bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal lhan du gnyen bsdebs byas par sras 'phrin las rnam rgyal lam lha sras sku zhog 1jicaca lor sku 'khrungs/ chos mdzad sku zhog gam/ dreng ring rin po che'am/ gling bu rin po che'am/ lha btsun 'gyur sped 'jigs bral bstan 'dzin dpa' bo ni gong gsal 'bās ljongs lha sras snin las rnam rgyal (sgro866—272(spro9spro9) dang / lha sdings ye shes sgrol ma (kro867—kro9spro0) zung la phyi lo 1jijicalor sku 'khrungs/smin grol gling du slob gnyer mdzad/yang gsang bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin yar 'brog zhwa de'u 'khrul zhig gu yangs he ru ka kun bzang mthong grol rdo rje (spro862—1925) mchog dang / kaḥthog si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho (1880—1925)sogs bsten/mdo sngags rig gnas sbyi dang /lhag par du gso dpyad sman la mkhas/myang stod gling bu dgon pa de snga bstan dgra sog po 'jong gar gyis dgon pa rtsa med btang yang 'o rwarngo stong la nye ba'i nang rten gtso bo yi dam dpal chen dang / gsung rten ru lu rong byon gnyis phrino las 'gro don ma bsdus par bzhugs su gsal stabs 7gang sa skyabs mgan 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen por myang stod gling bu dgon pa zhig gsos gsar 95

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/bzhengs zhu 'thus snyan gsan ji gsol bka' 'khrol don smin byung ba ltar sa rta 161rngulor dgon pa gsar du bzhengs nas gzhung dgon khongs su tshud pa gnang / gsar bzhengs nyams gso'i 'gro gron mang po zhig 'bras ljongs gzhu+ong nas kyang bstsal/108 phal cher de dus tsomo nas gling bu ri+on po che zhu b.ro mag brtsams sam snyam/ srus yul 'bras ma ljangs su dang thag 1'tsho4 la tsam la phebs sam/ sku tshe smad du gling bu dgon dang phreng reng gzhis ci rigs su sku bzhugs mdzad/phyi lo 1lnga47phyi zla gnyis par zhing brjes/109 (yang srid 1rtse71 lor lho kha gra nang lding dpon rta mabo'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ gling bu dgon par khri 'don mnga' gsol dang /slob gnyer gra phyi smin grol gling du mdzad/phal cher 100༷lor dgongs pa rdzogs sam/deng gling bu dgon par yang srid khri 'don mnga' gsol yang zhus sgrub skad ) phreng ring rin po che 'bras ljongs su bzhugs ring 'bras ljongs lha sde spyir gzigs rtogs dag ther mdzad/ lhag par du 'bras ljongs nang dmar mchod spong thabs 'bad rtsol gnang /sbas yul 'bras ljongs kyi lho mon mi rgyud nyag phrar thug skabs/ ra ga 65 sres mdzad pa'i pha ma'i drin lan bsab pa/ mdo 108 chos mdzad bstan dar gyis mdzad pa'i/ paṇa chen :tis btab pa'i myang stod gling bu dgon ngo spru+od mdor bsdus/ zhes pa/ bod ljongs zhib 'jug 1rtsertse4 'don thengs/ 2shog grangs/134—137/14cabacas la'ang gzigs 'tshal/kro09 stutsho7tshorkyo975moṇ+ḍaṃ05smonarme0smopo11tretshorkya 2snu(༷7bami/sa6(lnga1751)khu9lnga((ba khub( sa/༷smo()ḍū/khri1 15mikhrilami‘khusmo spro945 9ṣ+ṭa 41—42 tshe bakhusmokhub 20/bge3 1371batha 2)7:4mome’tsho/ 0(ṇaṇ+ḍaṃtsho8/0'ib/lo57ngalngakro sbyi0baspu0ba 1970 9ji98 100 102 17496

sngon gleng /rgyud mthun pa ban lugs kyi mtshun bcos te/ zas gtad bang so mchod pa dang don gcig go /bon po'i srid pa'i lha gsas bsdar zhes pa'ang / mtshun bcos 'di yin par snang ngo / /zhes pa sgang tog pho brang sbar ma/ dpe ring zhog ldeb 20bzhugs pa gsar du spar brko bcug/srus yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzod zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zhes pa sgang tog pho brang spar ma/ldeb 'bring shog ldeb/ caji can gsar du phyogs sgrig mdzad smo10pa bcas so/dreng ring rin po che 'gyur med 'jigs bral bstan 'dzin dpa' bos mdzad pa'i/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzod nang gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter byon bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa dang / gter ston rin chen gling pa'i gter byon/ rin chen gling pa'i gter byang / rin chen gling pa'i gter lung / rig 'dzin rgod ldem can gyi zab mo thugs kyi lde mig /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bka' lung /mnga' bdagre/ khri srong lje'u btsan gyi gsang ba'i gab lung / dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro mas lung /gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i gnas yig/gter ston rdo rje gling pa'i spyo10 phyogs mtshungs tsha rong dbyangs can sgrol dkar gyis brtsams/ mchan bu bkra shis tshe ring gis btab/ sde dpon mi drag gi sras mo gzhon nu ma zhig gis sge'u khung nas mthong ba'i bod kyi rgyal sa lha sa'i snang tshul mdor bsdus/ dha ram sa la/ a myes rma chen bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug khang / 2༷༷ca shog grangs cachu—7༷ bar la'ang gzigs 'tshal/97

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/gnas yig lung bstan/ gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyi lung byang / 'phrang mgo gter ston 'dreng po gter chen shes rab 'od zer ram 'gro 'dul gling pa (15spro8—spro584)lam yig bcas la khyangs btugs lung 'dren mdzad 'dug lags/sbas yul 'bras morto ljongs kyi gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzod ces pa'i nang / gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyi lung byang las: bod yul lo re bzhin du sdug tu 'gro: rang yul 'khor bu'i bde la ma chags par: 'bras mo gshongs sogs sbas pa'i yul rnams su:pad+mas mi bslu nges shes skyes la bros: zhes lung 'dren mdzad 'dug /gter ston gu ru ye shes khyung grags ni zur shākya 'od po dang / sa skya'i dpon chen shukya bzang po dang dus mnyam du byon/ rgya nag yongs rdzogs sog ser pos dbang bsgyar nas yon gong ma se chen khan (1215ge1296) gyi sku tshe bsring ched gtsang gi rwa5'i cha brag rdo rje tshe brtan nas bdud rtsi'am tshe chu'i khrom gter bzhes skor rnam thar 111 nang gsal/ rig 'dzin rgod kyi ljem 'phrus 13cacad13ca7lor brag ri sbrul spungs 'dra'i sted pa ste zang zang lha brag lha'i skyed tshal zer ba'i brag phug nas sbas yul bdun gyi them byang dang sbas yul 'bras mo 1sgro gur bkras zu+ol 'byung /krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe sgrun khang /1khyartseXshog grangs 2rnguji/4jik+ṣu—4rtseX myang ci la sngod smad bar gsum gyi ngo mtshar gtam gyi legs bzhad mkhas pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugre/sa so/ /bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe sgrun khang /1khuji3shog grangs 1༷2—1༷3/1༷jibacas la'ang gzigs 'tshal/()8

sngon sleng /ljongs kyi gnas yig sogs gter nas bzhes/ des na gter ston gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyi rig 'dzi+on rgod ljem las mi lo+o ji7 tsam gyi gong rol nas sbas yul 'bras ma ljangs su bras dgas skar gsung 'dug na 'bras ljongs 'khod pa'i tshig ris snga shos kyi gras su 'dug na da nas bzung 'bras mo ljongs pa rnams nas gter ston gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyi gsung la gcigs su 'dzin nas 'tsho'i/ zhib dgos gal che'o snyam lags/gter chen sangs rgyas gling par o rgyan rin chen gling pa phyi mar bzhed mkhan yang yong 'dug /'on kyang sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzod nang lung 'dren gnang tshad gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa'i bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: ma 'ongs lung bstan gsang ba'i dkar chag bkod pa zhes pa'i nang ma rnyed son ma byung / yang kai tshang bka' brgyud kyi rgyal ba yab sras khongs dpal ldan dpa' bo chos dbang lhun grub (1slo9—rwa503)kyi sku phreng dang po gter ston rin chen gling pa yin/ gter chen rin chen gling pa ni 7rgyal dbang karma pa sku phreng gsum pa rang byung rdo rje (kro284d+ngha1339) dang bod kyi sne gdong gong ma tā'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan (rwa302—kro362) gnyis dang dus mnyam du byon pa yin/ des na gong gsal gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa dang / rig 'dzin rgod ldem/ yar rje o rgyan gling pa bcas las phal cher lo grangs 37 lhag dus tshod snga bar byon pa zhig red 'dug na ma 'ongs par gter ston rin chen gling pa'i gter chos 99

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/kyang 'tshol zhib do snang dgos gal che ba zhig kyang red 'dug snyam mo/sngon gleng 'di 'bri skabs bzhugs sgar bod kyi dbe mdzod khang gi bod yig dpe mdzo+od sde tshan 'gan 'dzin dran dbang dpe mdzod shes lngan sku zhabs blo bzang shas+t+ri lags/phyag rogs dpe mdzod shes lngan bsod stobs lags dang /thub bstan phun tshogs lags/ bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi dbyin yig dpe mdzod sde tshan 'gan 'dzin dbe mdzod shes lngan tshe ring nor 'dzoms lags dang / phyag rogs dpe mdzod shes ldan bstan 'dzin chos bzang lags/ dpe mdzod shes lngan dpal mo tshe ring lags bcas nas bsun 'tsher sgyid lug med par thugs 'khur chen pos dbe khungs lung 'dren blta klog ched dbe deb ji dgos mkho 'don g.yar stsol mthun 'gyur gnang bar thugs rje che zhu/sngon gleng zer yang phyogs ston nam dkar chag tsam gyi tshul du rang mnyam 'dra la phan du re nas bzhugs sgar dha ram sa la a myes rma chen bod kyi rig gzhung zhib 'jug khang nas jo sras bkra zhis tshe ring gis 20༷khuphyi zla 7tshes 27 bzang por spyi brtol bskyed de g.yar khral tsam du bris pa dge rgyur cig/nongs pa dang nyes pa'i tshogs mtha' dag la bzod gsol zhu/skyon sangs dang dgongs 'char ji srul la/ dga' bsu zhu ba lags so/ /bde skyid bkra shis bde legs dpal gyi nyi ma zhar ba shog/ //100

༄༅༅/ /ma 'ongs lung bstan sbas yul gyi them byang bzhugs//1bco〉༅/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bsam yas mchims kyi brag phug tu: ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas: mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyis: bsam yas su spyan drangs nas: tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya rtsa mdzad pa'i tshe: spyir ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi lung bstan zhus: khyad par sngas yul gyi lam yig zhus pa: kyi slob dpon chen po lags: ma 'ongs dus lnga brgya mtha' ma'i tshe:bod kha ba can gyi sems can rnams: sprus pa'i yul du 'gro 'tshal na:phyi'i rtags nang gi rtags ji ltar du mchis: ces zhus pas:bka' stsal pa: mnga' bdag rgyal po legs par gson cig: gong du bstan pa bzhin du: dus mtha' ma'i rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'ong :khyad par sbas yul du 'gro dgos pa'i rtags 'di rnams 'byung : rgyal po nyid la sogs te: rgyal po byang chub kyi sems ldan gsum gyis bzhengs zlo josrasabakrazhis tshe ring sler gyi dpe khongs yod pa'i dpe rnying ldeb ring tsā can bris ma yig phreng tsu re yod pa'i zhog ldeb 12 can las zhal bshus bgyis pa'o/ /sbas yul spyi'i them byang bzhugs soḥ smus yul spyi dang bye brag yol mo gangs ra'i gnas yi/ga bzhugs so// 25khyisdi15smornguspu 6〉 51dzib90 smoto1kro3 20baspu‘59 205spustumibami(stu ṣā3('ilamibasku5 2003shog grangs 1—1lngabar la'ang gzigs 'tshal/spro01

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhags/༄pa'i lha khang thams cad kyi mchod pa chag: phal cher zhig ral du 'gro:mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang phyed cig: mchod pa 'bul ba rgyun chad: 'on kyang lho'i phyogs su sprul pa'i rgyal po gcig gis: da ste gdung rabs lnga nas lha khang gcig bzhengs par 'gyur:de bzhengs nas mi lo sum brgya drug cu na: zhig ral du stongs par 'gyur: de nas phyi yul gyi rtags dang sbyar te: sbas yul du 'gro ran pa'i rtags so: bod la khrims med brgya dang rtsa gsum yong :de nas mu dur nag po hor gyis 'dul:sdig sbyod hor khrims 'dzugs: hor gyi khrims lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga nas hor khrims 'ji+og: de'i dus su bod sbas pa'i yul du 'aglo dgos: zhes gsungs sa:yang zhus pa:kyi slob dpon chen po lags:sbas pa'i yul de rnams su bdag rje 'bangs rnams 'gro dgos par gsungs gda' bas:de'i dus su sbas yul rnams nges par rnyed dam mi rnyed lags: bod kyis sbas yul rnams zin nam mi zin lags:bod snying stobs zhan pas mthar spyi ru 'gyur ba lags:zhes zhus so:bka' stsal pa: mnga' bdag rgyal po gson cig: khyed bod mi khong bcol chung bas:ji ltar bstan kyang mthong rgyu med:ji ltar bzhad kyang go rgyu med: ji ltar bskul kyang 'khul dus med: spyir du bod srin po zha lings 102 kyis non pa yin: phal cher gsod par 'gyur ro: lnga brgya tha ma'i dus na

ma 'ongs lung bsnyan sbas yul gyi them byang /dang po mi mgo bran gyis byed pa lo nyi shu rtsa lnga yong : mi mgo zhan pas byed pa lo drug cu 'ong : de'i dus na 'gro ran te: srus pa'i yul du 'gro ba la:chos skyong ba'i rgyal po gcig yod na kun thar bar 'gyur te: rgyal po zhan pa nag po'i dbang gis rgyu dang : rgyal po chags sdang gi mtsho rdol nas: sbas pa'i yul du 'gro ba gcig dge byed kyis byed de: dge byed sdig can gyis 'khol: lam 'dren chos byed kyis byed de: chos byed ya gas smod: lam rgyags bzang po bya dgos te: chos byed 'byor pas 'phongs: sa 'khrul lam 'khrul te blo chung hor gyi sdig sbyod la skrag nas blo gtor: de'i dus su 'o skol yon mchod kyis bzhag pa'i ma 'ongs pa'i lung bstan rnams:gter kha mang po nas rim gyis rnyed par 'gyur:de'i dbang gis sbas pa'i yul du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed: kun kha rlonges par 'gyur ro: de nas hor khrims zhig ste: bod nang 'khrug byed pa'i dus na: srid le'u 'thor: gong du jag pa'i 'tsher byed pas: dge byed kyis lam mi shogs: bod sbas pa'i yul dran pa rnams 'jigs zhing skyi g.ya' ste: snying stobs kyis lam zhogs par mi zhus: de'i dus su dge byed re re tsam gyis sbas pa'i yul 'tshol ba'i 'dun pa drag po dang : rtsol bas bka' spyad byas pas:bod la bde skyid lo 'ga' 'byung : bod rnams bde skyid la zhen pa'i sems dang : ru nga phrag dog gi dbang gis: dge byed sbas pa'i yul 'tshol ba la smod cing ya ga sgrogs: de'i tshe dge byed rnams yi chad pa dang : dpa' zhum ste dge ba la 103

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/mthar mi thon: de'i tshe ri rab kyi rtse nas bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gis 'jig rten gyi phyogs bzhir bltas pas: spyir nag po'i bdud rgyal bas bdud kun drod pa skyes te: lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling na shākya thub pa'i bstan pa nyams pa mthong bas bdud rje dga' rab dbang phyug snying dga': rgya gar rdo rje gdan de'i dus su du ru kas 'dzin pas: bdud mtshon cha'i me tog 'thor: bod kha ba can gyi yul du bstan pa'i lhag ma dar la ma smin pa de'i dus na 'ong ste: bdud kyi rgyal po des ri rab kyi rtse nas: dug mda' bdun bod la 'phen no: de yang lo zad zla zad kyi dus 'dzam bu gling la mde'u rtse 'phangs te: phyi rtags su nam mkha' me 'od glog 'dra ba dgong kha lam lam pa 'ong : nang rtags su sde dpon dang : gtso bo dang : 'jig rten gyi las stobs che ba rnams la: gsod byed kyi dug phog pas: glo bur du zhe sdang tsha lam lam pa dang : phrag dog khrag 'khrug 'khrug pa skye: de'i rjes su gcig gis gcig gsod pa: gcig gis gcig rlag par byed pa: mkhan po dang : slob dpon dang : dge bshes dang : ston pa dang : stobs mnga' thang che ba rnams la: spyo byed kyi dug phog pas: glo bur du snying mi dga' ba dang : sting grang stong stong ba 'ong : de'i dus su chos byed la zer zhugs te:gcig gis gcig smod: chos bor nas 'jig rten gyi las la 'jug:nyams len bor nas chi'ika la ltos: gos ser gyon pas yul phyed khengs:ston pa'i bka' bzhin byed pa re re tsam las mi 'byung : 'khrug byed kyi dug 104

ma 'ongs lung bstan sbas yul gyi them byang /slob dpon dang gros byed rnams la phog pas: shes pa rtsi mun pa glo bur du skye: de'i dus su blo 'khrul dang khong che bar 'dod pas: pha rol mi 'thad pa'i gros tshur smra: tshu rol mi 'thad pa'i gros phar zlos: de'i dus su bod nang 'khrug la zings 'gro: bkren chags kyi dug dge byed la phog pas:bod kyi chos pa dang mi chos pa thams cad 'i/ kha rngam khyog la lta: 'apyo chi'/ pa cig yong : de'i dus su thams cad la zas kyi 'dod sred langs nas phu'i ri dwags rngon:mda'i nya 'dzin:rang gis bkol ba'i byol song gsod nas:sh-i dmar po za: khrag dmar po 'thung : pags pa dmar po 'dings: dus der pha sha bus za ba'i dus yong : g.yo byed kyi dug bud med la phog ste:glo bur du shes pa rtsi rum pa 'ong : de'i rjes su pha dang bu 'thab tu 'jug:yul mi nang 'thab: dpon dang g.yog 'khon: spun nang dme byed pa gcig 'ong : bsam log gi dug ngan song la phog ste: glo bur du rngam sems hab gyur skye: de'i rjes su mi sna 'bal du mgo gdungs yong :chos gos 'og tu gri 'dzugs:bud med gri ru 'chi:dbugs ma chad par 'bal dang bro dungs byed: gson snying sa la bskung ba gcig 'ong : srog gcod 'phrog gi dug dge bshes dge bsten chos pa dang : sde dpon ya rabs kyi rigs la phog ste: dge byed la snying tsha long ba 'ong : de'i dus su dge ba'i rtsa ba mthar mi thon: de lta bu'i bdud kyi dug mda' bdun bod la phog pa dang : byis phran khras gtor ba ltar bod kyi bsam pa phyogs gcig tu mi 'gril bar:sdu05

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ gcig gis gcig rtsod: gcig gis gcig rgol: gcig gis gcig 'khrug cing mi lo sum cu'i bar du sdug bsngal la sbyor: de'i dus na dge byed byang chub sems dang lngan pa: sting rus dang lus stobs che ba: 'khor dang yo byad ldan pa'i rten 'brel thabs la mkhas pa'i lam btsal: yul bzung bas sbas yul thams cad zin par 'gyur ro: bod kyi sbas yul thams cad zin na: du ru kas gsod cing rlag par mi hūṃs te: de yang bdud kyi dug mda' phog pa'i stobs kyis: bzang lan ngan gyis 'jal:dge ba sdig la snub: de'i dbang gis dge byed thams cad yi mug sgyid shal 'gro: sbas pa'i yul rnams phal cher yid la smon: lag tu mi len mthar de la sbas pa'i yul du bgrod pa'i skal ba med:sangs rgyas kyi yul dang 'dra'o:thos lo tsam las mthong bar mi 'gyur ro:hor khrims zhig nas mi lo sum cu lhag song ba dang : smad nas dmag sde chen po dgu: bdud kyi pho nya nyi shu rtsa gcig: stod nas myur ma mgyogs kyis zhan pa lan lnga:dmag sde chen po bcu gsum mi lo drug cu'i bar du rdol nas: bod srin po sha lings kyis non pa bzhin je sdug je sdug la: mthar yul khams mes 'tshig pa bzhin du rlag par 'gyur ro:rigs gsum mgon po'i byin rlabs kyis: bsam yas dang 'khrul snang gi ri la mi'i sa bon gcig lus: spyir bod thams cad glo bo spu rang mtshams nas rgya nag gi bar thams cad rlag par 'gyur ro: sems can las dbang gis kun gsod par 'gyur ro: bod 106

ma 'ongs lung bstan sbas yul gyi them byang /khams sting re rje ste: bdud kyi dbang du gyur pas nyes: phrag dog rlung nag 'tshubs pas lan: bdud kyi mtha' ma sleb pas phyang : nga'i bko' la nyan pa rnams la zhur zla zhur srung thabs yad: la bskar gsum du bzlag thabs yod: gtan du bdud dmag thar thabs yod: yod kyang chos byed yid smon tsam: log lta can rnams ngan song 'gyur: dus ngan de'i sems can rnams: snying re rje ste rang gi lan: nga la log lta byed pa dang :nyi zla rgyab kyi phyogs pa dang : sgrog thag chad pa'i sems can gsum: shing sdong me yis 'tshig pa 'dra: 'di ru dge bas mi bzlog ste: phyi ma ro bsreg ya re nga :nga'i bka' la nyan pa rnams: blo can rnams kyis sbas yul tshol: byang sems can gyis srung 'khor sgoms: dge stobs can gyis bdud dmag bzlog: de'i thabs dang mi lngan na: di ra rdza som gangs kyi phug: brag rong nag po dben pa'i phug: 'jig rten 'di la ma chags par: rtse gcig byang yu ba sgrub pa gyis: tshe 'dir dmag gis mi gsod cing : phyi ma rgyal ba'i zhing du thar: gsod gcod las la mi brtson na: bdud kyi dmag gis gsod mi 'gyur: zha khrag zas su mi za na: bdag la gzhan gyis mtshon mi 'phog:de phyir nga'i bka' la nyon:zhes gsungs so:yang zhus pa: kyi slob dpon chen po lags: lnga brgya tha ma zhar ba'i dus na: bod kha ba can la bdud kyi dug mda' bsrung ba'i thabs bstan du gsol:zhes zhus pas:107

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ bka' stsal pa: rgyal po legs par gson cig: bdud kyi dug mda' bsrung ba la: phyi'i yul gsum: nang gi rdzas gsum: gsang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsum: drag po'i sngags gsum: rtsa ba'i srung 'khor gsum dgos so: dang po phyi'i gnas gsum ni: byang chub kyi sems dang lngan pas bzhengs pa'i lha khang dang :sngon du byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgrub gnas dang :'gro 'dug gi dus na gdugs sam: zhwa'i bum par sum̐ trī kha'i sngags bris pa dang ma bral na: bdud kyi dug mda' mi 'phog go: ting nge 'dzin rang gi yi dam lha dang : byang chub kyi sems dang : mi dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum gang rung de dang ma bral na: bdud kyi dug mda' mi 'phog go: nang gi rdzas gsum ni: sgrub pa'i sman: de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel:sngon grub pa thob pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rdzas rnams bcangs pas dug mda' mi 'phog go: drag po'i sngags gsum ni: gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i sngags: rdo rje sder mo'i sngags: dgongs mo grib so nag pa nas: gza' skar bkrag ma thon gyi bar bzlas pas: bdud kyi dug mda' mi 'phog go:de dang mi ldan pa rnams la bdud kyi dug mda' 'phog go: dge byed nga'i bka' la nyan pa rnams bsrung ba'i phyir:gnam lcags thog gi gu/ra zhes bya ba: zhog ril dang po'i nang na yod pas ltos shig: de'i dus su balce da kha rgyal bas rdzun dang zog po mi thul ba 'ong : chos byed ngas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mi rnams ni: rgyud la zol zog med pas shes pa drang por 108

ma 'ongs lung bstan sbas yul gyi them byang /5ོ/da: rdzun dang g.yo rgyu med pas blo sgrom drang por yod: de'i dus na chos byed chos log sbyod pas smod: lung bstan lung log gis bsnub: bka' lung dri ma me+ed pa nyon mongs can: chags sngang gi bgegs pa 'ong : de yang bsam yas kyi mtha' gogs pa dang : bod la nang 'khrug yong : dbu rtse rigs gsum zhig ral byung ba dang : bod mtha' dmag gi khyab yong :byang dang ra nas byang sman rgyal mo'i spug phar gyis mi tshugs rma ni: thog ma la bdud dmag gi gsod do: de nas dang ra'i bar gyis byang rgyud ni: phyi dmag gis gsod do: ba stag zhang dung gi sgo mo nas: rgya nag bar gyi yul dbus kyi rgyud thams cad ni sdug zad la song ngo 'joms so: spu rang nas me+e nyag 'ga' rong yan chad:lho kha chur ni jag pa'i tshul gyis 'joms so:kyi rgyal po stod mang yul gung thang du: rgyal po nyid kyi gdung rgyud gcig gri ru 'gum pa dang : bod kyi sdug mgo 'dzugs so: gnyis gri ru 'gum pa dang bod kyi phung mgo 'dzugs so: gsum gri ru 'gum pa dang : bod kyi skyid pa zad do: sbas yul dang : lho rong la bros gcig: de'i dus su sbas pa'i yul du thar ba rnams bde skyid 'byung ngo : lho rong du thar ba rnams gzhis ngan du 'chi mi dgos so: de ma yin pas rang yul la rtag tshams che ba dang : bcol chung ti ta 'khor ba dang : blo log bka' lung la 'gre/la ba byed pa rnams: sdug bsngal ris non pa tsam:zug zer me 'obs su zhor ba tsam:cho ngas brag ral ba tsam myong zhing :kun gsod par 'gyur ro:sa 109

mkha' sbyod 'bras 31 ljongs kyi gnas yig ༷rtogs bsdebs bzhags/༄bon zes 'chig pa bzhin 'bras bu rlag ste: dmag des bsad pa rnams dmyal khang nag por las kyi dbang gis skye bar 'gyur ro: de lta bu'i dus na thams cad sdug bsngal gyis non te: nga dang sbas pa'i yul dran pa zhig 'ong ste: dran pa phyis so: nga la rtse gcig tu mos pa rnams dmag la mig ma lta bar bros zhig: hūṃb li'i yul du bros pas thar bar 'gyur ro: de'i gong du chos skyong ba'i rgyal po'i khrims zhig nas: bod khri 'ur 'thor ba'i dus 'gro ran te: kun yul la chags nas mi 'bros:de'i dus su mu thur nag po hor gyis 'dul: de'i sdig grib kyi bod non nas mi 'bros so: de nas hor khrims zhig bod khrims 'thor bas: lam bgrod pa dka' ste 'bros ran no: de'i dus su nga'i bka' la nyan pa rnams bros shig: de'i dus su bod la nga'i thugs rje dang : bdud kyis dug mda' rtsal 'gran pas: nga'i lung bstan thob pa'i gang zag la: bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mi thams cad kyis: ya ga sgro skur dang : btad rtsom pa yong ngo : ci la yang skrag pa ma byed par bros shig: de'i dus su ma bros na:'dzam bu gling na shākya thub pas lung bstan gyi mdo bdun po de: so so nas 'bros ran pa'i lung bstan gyi dus su: bdud sdig can gyi lung nag po sde dgu yod pa de'i dus na: 'dzam bu gling mtha' bzhi'i dmag gis bskor cig ces pa'i dus yong ngo : de'i dus na lung bstan rgyal po'i mdo las:110 shā ri'i bu nyon cig:nga mya ngan las 'das nas:rgyal po gdung gsob sgron

ma 'ongs lang bstan sbus yal gyi them byang /ra ra ma 'dra ba lan bdun 'byung : de'i phyi ma la lnga brgya phrag bcu'i mtha' ma sgor: de'i dus na nga'i 'khor bzhi po: ri bo star sting gi gling dang : chu bo don snying gi mgo dang : phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gling dang : bas mtha' nags kyi rong la song zhig: rgya gar dang skyurgyan dang : kha che dang : sing nga dang : sa la dang : li yul dang : sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gnas thams cad lho hūṃb rgya masnu'i do gling la song zhig: byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul du: dus mtha' ma la bstan pa dar bar gyur cig: de yang rigs gsum mgon pos lung bstan 'a/: lnga bab/ mtha' ma 'a/ bod thams cad bas mtha' 'i/ song zhig:nags ri'i rong la bros shig: ces lung ston cig shod cig: ces gsung so:thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs las:da lta nga nyid kyis lung bstan pa'o:de'i tshe de'i dus na bod kha ba can: mtha' bzhi dmag gis 'khor 'ong :nga'i lung bstan pa'i dus la ma bros na: bod thabs thug pas mi thar te:dmag mtho' bzhi nas ri gtib pa ltar yong nges pa'i phyir ro: zhes gsungs sa:yang zhus pa:kye slob dpon chen po lags:de'i tshe de'i dus na:bdud dmag de las thar nges pa du mchis: dus gsum sa le mkhyen pa pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bstan du gsol:zhes zhus pas:bka' stsal pa: rgyal po gson cig:rgyal po bod la thugs brtse ba'i phyir: lung bstan pa dang thabs mang po bton pa yin gyis: bod mtha' 111

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhags/༄'khob kyi mi 'di da lta dus bzang yin kyang : nged lo paṇa bod kyi yul la yong pa rnams la: gsod pa'i gros byed: rgyal po nyid bod kyi mgon po yin te: sku tshe ring na mi rung ba'i blo 'char: bsam yas kyi lha khang bkrag ches pas: gzhon pa mig yengs nas: las thabs gcogs pa 'dug zer: bod kyi mi rnams bsam pa ngan pas khyi dang 'dra: kha 'chal smra bas wa dang 'dra: blo sna mang bas sbre'u 'dra: gdon gyis bslad pas smyon pa 'dra: da lta bas kyang lnga brgya snyigs ma'i dus na bcu 'gyur gyis ngan du 'gro: rgyal po med pas mgo med kyi yan lag 'dra: lung phran re na rgyal phran re: rgyal phran zhan pa glang snying re: gros mgo kha 'chal g.yog pos byed: sde dgon re la mkhan slob re: mkhan slob skye bo gos ser gyon: gros mgo nye gnas sgyeg mgos byed: jag pa nye bas khyim 'tshes 'joms: gshed skur chos byed grogs la byed: log lta byang sems can la byed:spang bya dam pa'i chos la byed:de lta bu'i bsam sbyor ngan pas bod khengs nas bod phal cher phung zhing rlag par 'gyur ro: rgyal po thugs khral ma mdzad da lta'i dus na yang : ngan song gsum gyi gnas na sdug bsngal bzod glags med: de yang snying re rje ste las ma dag gi bar du thugs khral byas pas phan pa med: dus mtha' ma'i bdud dmag de yang sems can las ngan can thams cad dang : dus mtha' ma'i zhan 112 pa byed pa yin:bod 'dir bdag dang rgyal po'i smon lam gyis: byang chub

ma 'ongs lung bstan sgras yul gyi them byang /sems dpa'i rigs can bdun gyi sna drangs pa'i lho 'bras mo gshongs su sum brgya thar: bud gting du lnga brgya thar: spa spro bum thang gi mtshams su brgya rtsa gcig thar: lho brag mkhar chu'i gting du brgya thar: tsa ri dang tsa gong la bzhi brgya thar: de rnams gting nas thar ro: sbas pa'i yul du btsan sa zin pa'o: yang lho rong thag nye ba rnams su bros te: la la srog thar ba yong : la la lho mon gyi rngan byung ste gsod: la la nags rong brag rong chu mgo la 'chi: la la bod nang 'khrugs te grir 'chi: la la bdud dmag la thar te rkyen gyis 'chi: la la lho'i dug phog ste 'chi: la la ltogs ris 'chi: rgyal po de'i dus na skyid med do: dmyal ba'i gnas dang 'dra: de'i dus na sems can sdug pa'i dus yin: nags na me zhor ba'i gling na so sod dang skyid 'dug pa ngas ma mthong : rgyal po nyid rang chos nyid zab mo la longs spyod du yod pas: da lta btsan sa zung mdzod gosungs pas: rgyal po thugs yus kyis brnangs te: sbyan chab mang po zhar:de'i dus na: slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: lnga brgya mtha' ma'i sems can la zhal ta bzhag: bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya snigs ma'i mthar: 'dzam gling sems can thams cad la: bde skyid med pas btsan sar gros: sdig can bka' las mi nyan pas: dge byed bsam pa phyogs gcig dril: nags rong zas med sa gtsang la: ༷/rgyan 113

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rgyal po pad+ma ngas: lho rong btsanartsopa'i yul phran rnams: sa gzhi byin rlabs gter chen sbas: sgo bcad sgo srung bka' nyan zer ram rtag pan bskos: de phyir sprus pa'i yul kun na:sgrub gnas re dang gter chen re:bka' rgya yin pas bzhag par bya: 'dzom gling chos byed thams cad la: rgyal ba shukya thub pa yi: rgyal tshab pad+ma 'byung gnas yin: bod kyis chos byed thams cad kun: nga'i sgrub gnas byin brlabs su: pha yul bu yi 'dzin pa ltar: the tshom med par 'dzin du bzhud: skye ba 'di'i phyi ma la: nga dang 'phrad par the tshom med: bka' 'di'i dus na bod kyi las can gyis: lung bstan thams cad dkar chag yi ger btab: slob dpon la rin po che sna lnga'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas:gter du sbas so:lung byang 'di gu ru ༷/rgyan gshegs pa'i dus na: byang zang zang lha brag gi sked la sbas te: bod kyi dad pa can gsum la bka' stsal pa: nyon cig bod kyi dad pa can: nga'i zhal gdams yi ge 'di: thon pa'i dus la babs pa'i tshe: gdug pa sa bdag gnyan gyi yul: byang phyogs rdol pa'i yul khams 'dir: lo legs 'abhu bcud smin par 'gyur: gter 'di zhar thad ri bo'i shar: lung phran pad spru+ong 'dra ba'i rtsar: 'brug gam glang lo khro du'i gzugs: drag shul can gyis 'don par 'gyur: las can de yi 'di khyer nas: lho yi rong bdun sbas yul bdun: las can de yi 'byed par 'gyur:de las bod kyis srog brten cig: ma mo bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis: lung 1kro4

ma 'ongs lung bstan srus yul gyi them byang /'di las can de la gtod: ces gsungs so: ma 'ongs pa'i lung bstan sbas yul gyi them yig 'di: las can gcig dang 'phrad par zhog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: zang zang lha brag gi sked nas rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas gdan drangs pa'o2dge'o:

(bye ri 8/bye/ (bye ri tsurdo ribaco〉༅//lha sras mu tag ban pa la lha' dbang pa brgya byan gyis lung bstan sbas yul bdun gyi spyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan bzhugs so//2shātādzñācasgotrī'epetasgeh+lar+ṣasgrijoṣ+kakre7'e slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas:rak+ṣa srin po'i kha gnon mdzod du gshegs pa'i dus:g.yas ru gtsang 'phrang du dgung zhag gcig gzims pa'i tshe:lha sras btsan po'i rnal lam du khye'u dar dkar gyi la'u gon pa:rin po che'i ga'u bdun brtsegs khyer ba zhig byung nas:'di skad smras so:kye ma skyes bu lha'i sras:da lta bod na bde skyid ldan:drug cu kha ral dus ngan 'char:bde dang sdug bsngal sbel mar 'byung :tshe tshad lnga bcu sleb kha ru:bod du 'gong po spun dgu 'ong :gnam la khrag gis gru char 'bab:sa la me rlung dmar nag 'khrug:rgyal po'i gdung brgyud gri ru 'gum:gtsug lag khang la rme khang byed:chos spyod rnams la bar chad byed:de dus mtha' dmag las kyis g.yo:sangs rgyas bstan pa zhig tu cha:mi ro'i thang la brdal du cha:srog chags kha phung stong du cha:de dus ga'u 'di bdun po:bod la dgos pas kha dbye 'tshal:ma 'ongs phyi ma'i don phyir wadangosrasabakrashis tsha ring sger gyi dpe khongs yod pa 'i dpe rnying ldeb ring dbu med bris ma yig phreng 7re yod pa'i shog ldeb 1༷can las zhal bshus bgyis pa'o//

sbas yul bdun gyi sbyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan/du: lde mig slo dpon nyid la zhus: zhes ga'u bdun lha sras la gtad de bar snang la gshegs so:rnal sad pa dang thugs ma bde nas: slo dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la zhus pa: kyi slo dpon chen po lags: bdag la rmi lam 'di ltar rmis: khye'u zhin tu mdzes pa gcig: rin chen ga'u bdun thogs nas: da lta bod na bde skyid ldan:drug cu kha ral dus ngan 'char:zhes pa'i gnad tshig bcu bdun smras:bar snang mkha' la gshegs te song : de'i rgyu rkyen la nge dang : dus dang gnad kyi man ngag rnams: ma 'ongaso don du bstan du gsol: zhes mgul g.yu brtan dmar dkral nas phul la:bka' bstsal pa: gson gcig mnga' bdag lha'i sras: thugs snang dag pa'i rnal lam du: khye'u mdzes pa'i gzugs mthong ba: lha'i dbang po brgya byin lags: da lta dus bzang spyod pa bzang : rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos kun dar: de'i yon tan bde sgyid 'byung : ngan song sum brgya nyi shu na: tshe tshad drug cu kha ral 'char: bskal pa'i cha nyams 'byung bzhi g.yo: rgyal po glang gi ming can gyis: bod khams nag por gtong bar gda': res 'ga' nga'i sprul pa yis:bod khams bde ba'i rten 'brel sgrig: res 'ga' bdud kyi sprul pa yis: sems can duḥkha las la sbyor: de phyir dkar nag spel mar mchi: nga song mi lo bzhi brgya na: bod kyi rgyal khrims zhig nas kyang :sil bu rang dgar 'thor bar 'gyur: de nas mi lo bcu gsum na: shar 117

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/phyogs tsong kha hor la 'chor: de nas mi lo bcu drug na: bod khams thams cad hor gyis 'dul: de dus lha sras btsan po nyid: hor rgyal go pe la ru 'khrungs: de'i ring la khrims la gnas: bod la bde sdug spel la mchi:bod yul hor gyis dbang byas nas: mi lo brgya dang nyi shu nas: mu thur hor gyi khrims zhig ste: bod khams nang rme dar nas kyang : yul khams khri'ur rlag par mchi: lha khang bshig nas 'khrug khang rtsig: dge bshes log nas dmag dpon byed:mi mgo zhan pa nag pos byed:mtshon dang dug gi las la sbyod: nyi zla gza' dang 'phrad pa bzhin: bde skyid rim gyis zad par 'gyur:de nas 'gong po spun bdun gyis: bod du sleb nas bod khams phung : nang 'khrug khrag ltar khol ba 'ong : phyi ltar shākya'i cha lugs bzung : nang ltar mtshams med sdig sbyod pa'i:bdud kyi sprul pa gsum byung nas:bod kyi nang rme thams cad byed: de las sprul pa'i bdud kyi rigs: ngo dmar las kyi zhan pa gsum: las ngan dbang gis 'dus nas kyang : bod kyi phung mgo 'dzugs par byed: de dus ltas ngan 'di rnams 'byung : gnam la phung byed skar ma gsum: rim gyis zhar nas mi dge 'byung : mkha' la khrag gis gru char 'bab: sa la 'khrul 'khor chen po drug: zla ba'i 'phel 'grib gcig la g.yo: bdud kyi sprul pa mi gsum gyis: rgyal po'i gdung brgyud gri ru 'gum: de tshe nga'i rjes 'jug rnams: rin chen ga'u 'di bdun po: kha phye 'di phyi'i don chen sgrubs: de dus sems can las ngan gyis: las kyi phyi 118

srus yul bdun gyi spyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan/bshol byung ba na:bod du rgya'i 'gong po gsum: bdud kyi dmag sna khrid nas yong : ma dros mtho'i mtha' ma nas: yar lha zham po'i bar dag tu:bod kyi nang 'khrug dar nas kyang : sems can drug cha rlag par byed: shar nas mtha'i dmag chen drug: bod du rdol nas mi phyed gsod: de nas lo gsum 'das pa dang : zhar nas rgya'i dmag mo che: nam mkhas sa gzhi khebs pa ltar: mang yul ru thog mon kha la: thug gi bar du bod khams 'joms:bod khams gsum gnyis gri ru gsod: mi ro'i thang la brdal ba mchi:bod mkhar ri rul stong par 'gro: re khyim pa dang gnag lug dang : dud 'gro phyugs rnams phal che rlag:rims nad chang ltar bsag par mchi:stod nas bdud kyi dmag dpung gcig: gtsang gi stod 'dir rtol nas mchi: de nas mi lo bco lnga na: srin mo rlag 'bar nag mo'i bu: 'gir 'dir nag pos gtso byas pa'i: dmag mi bye ba dung phyur gsum: blo bo pu rangs kha nas rdol: gung thang stod du dmag ra 'cha': gtsang stod sems can rlag par byed: nyang ro'i yul du dmag ra 'cha': gtsang smad sems can rlag par byed: yar klungs sog khar dmag ra 'cha': dbus kyi sems can rlag par byed: de dus nga la mos pa yis: gang zag gdung bas gsol 'debs na:'gro ba mang po skyob srid de: nga la mos gus byed pa nyung : de phyir sem/sa can log ltas phung : thabs gzhan cis kyang bzlog mi 'gyur: dus der rgyal ba'i thugs rje las: phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa gcig: lcags po ri'i rtse /sdu9

mkha' spyod 'brasdo/ mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhags/༄la 'aXn: dbus su mi'i sa bon tsam: drug brgya'am stong phrag gcig tsam lus: de ma gtogasas pa'i bod khams su: mi dang dud 'gro ri dwags rnams:gcig kyang lus par mi 'gyur ro:de nas bdud kyi dmag dpyang de:khams kyi klong thang sgrol mar 'tshogs: mdo khams stod smad phyang bar byed:de nas rgya nag yul du 'tshogs: rgya dang hor gnyis rlag par 'joms: de nas sog po'i yul du 'gro: dru gu'i yul khams rlag par byed: lho phyogs 'dzam gling bstan pa 'di:bdud kyi dmag des rlag par 'gyur:de phyir rgyal po lha'i sras: snyigs dus duḥkha zad mtha' med: thugs rje'i skabs la babs pa'i tshe: ga'u 'di bdun bod la dgos: dbye ba'i thabs la nan tan mdzod:zhes gsungs so:yang zhus pa:kyi slob dpon chen po lags:rin po che'i gañtsa 'di rnams kyi brda'i ngo bo gang lags: dpe dang don ji ltar du sbyor: dbye ran pa'i rtags ji ltar du mchi: las can gyi gang zag ji lta bus dbye: de yi lde mig bstan du gsol:zhes zhus so:bka' bstsal pa: gson zhig mnga' bdag rgyal po'i sras: bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di: thugs rje chen po dang sgrol mas btul ba'i dus su: thugs rje'i khrus kyis bod khams kun du khyab par sbyangs te: 'gro ba sngar 'das pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs: sa'i sgroms dang mthil thams cad dngos 120 grub 'byung ba'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs2 ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bdud

sbas yal bdan gyi sbyi them ma 'ongs lang bstan/ra ra ra kyi sprul pas: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnub: 'gro ba duḥkha la sbyor bas:ma 'ongs thugs rje bskyab pa'i phyir: srus pa'i yul gnas mang po byin gyis brlabs te bzhag go: de yang bod kha ba can gyi yul 'di na: khyad par 'phags pa'i yul bzhi: gnas chen po drug: rong bdun: phran bu'i yul bcu gnyis:di ra dang rdza zom la sogs pa:kha 'thor gyi dmag thub pa sum cu rtsa gnyis yod de: las 'phro dang lngan pa 'ga' dang 'ga' bskyab pa'i phyir smon lam btab ste bzhag go:rat+na'i ga'u 'di bdun ni: sbas pa'i yul bdun yin te: gnas kyi ngo bo lho phyogs mon dang bod kyi mtshams: 'bog bcol gyi mi ste: mtha' 'khob dud 'gro lta bu'i yul mtshams na: rin po che'i maṇ+ḍal bkrams pa lta bu gral du sgrel nas yod do: de yang mang yul mthil nas lho hūṃb tu kha bstas pas:gangs ri dkar po rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu yod do:de'i lho phyogs na:bde ldan skyid mo lung zhes bya ba:grong khyer sum brgya shong pa:rin po che sna lnga yod pa:zhar zhub la sgo yod pa:sa sgo 'dom bdun bsrungs pas chog pa: gnas der phyin pa tsam gyis: sa dang po rab du dga' ba thob pa yod do: brag phug yang le shod kyi byang phyogs: dge bsten gling ru'i gangs mkha' la rgyal mtshan 'char ba 'dra ba'i lho phyogs na: sbas pa pad+ma'i tshal zhes bya ba:thing thog dang sa'i bcud sna tshogs skyes pa:btab na 'bru thams cad skye ba: sgo bzhi yod pa: grong khyer stong phrag bdun shong ba: gnas der sdu2spro

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig cadags bsdebs bzhags/༄sleb pa tsam gyis:sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros kyi sa man chad non pa:sa sgo 'dom bzhi bsrungs pas chog pa zhig yod do: smad shod khum bu'i gting na:rol pa ṭīki'i gling bya ba:zhing thog dang sa'i bcud la longs spyod pa:gro ma dang sa'i zhag gis lto thub pa: dbus gtsang gi bzhi cha shong ba: sgo gcig la sa sgo 'dom gsum bsrungs pas chog pa: der sleb pa tsam gyis: sa brgyad pa mi g.yo ba'i sa man chad non pa yod do: bud kyi gting na rgyal gyi mkhan pa lung bya ba: grong khyer sum brgya zhong ba: ma mos pa'i lo tog chol le yod pa: khyad par mkhan pa'i rtsa ba la bdud rtsi'i ro dang ldan pa: shing thog sna tshogs yod pa:der sleb pa tsam gyis:sa drug pa mngon du gyur pa'i sa man chad non pa: sgo gnyis yod pa: sa sgo 'dom phyed dang do bsrungs pas chog pa yod do: zar sbu sman gyi 'dabs na: lha'i pho brang sdings bya ba:grong khyer brgya dang nyi shu shong ba: me tog dang shing chol le yod pa: btab na 'bru gang yang skye ba: der phyin pa tsam gyis sa gnyis pa sdu ma med pa'i sa non pa: sgo gcig la sa sgo 'dom phyed bsrungs pas chog pa yod do: mdzod lnga stag rtse'i mdun na: bar yul la 'bras mo gzhongs zhes bya ba: 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs yod pa:dbus gtsang gi gsum gnyis zhong ba:der phyin pa tsam gyis sa bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa non pa: sgo bzhi la: sa sgo 'dom phyed dang gsum bsrungs pas chog pa yod do: spa gro'i gting na gro mo spro22 khyad bya ba: grong khyer stong phrag drug shong ba: shing thog mang pos lto thub pa:

sprus yul bdun gyi sbyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan/der phyin pa tsam gyis sa bcu pa chos kyi sgrin gyi sa non pa: sa sgo 'dom gang : sgo gnyis bsrungs pas chog pa yod do: de rnams sbas pa'i yul bdun gyi gnas tshul lo:rat+na'i ga'u la dpe dang brda ru bstan pa ni: 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad 'byung bas: rin po che sna bdun lta bu'o: sa'i mthil yangs pas ga'u yi sgrom lta bu'o:sa sgo dam pas ga'u kha sbyar ba lta bu'o:'di rnams dbye ran pa'i dus ni: bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su: rgyal khrims dang chos khrims gnyis nyams: sdig can skye bo rang dgar spyod: dbus gtsang du zhing khyim phub pa bzhi cha las mi: yul khams khri'ur 'khrug: srid le'ur 'thor:gong gsum du 'tsher 'thab byed pa'i dus na: gnam la ltas ngan me 'od 'bar: sa la phung byed mi gsum 'byung : byang sems sprul pa gri ru 'gum:gung thang stod du rme khrag 'thor: bod kyi sdug mgo tshugs pa yin: de'i dus su dge byed thams cad bsam pa phyogs gcig tu dril la: pad+ma 'byung gnas nga'i zhal chems la: the tshom dang yid gnyis ma byed pa: sbas pa'i yul du bzhugs shig:de yang srus pa'i yul bdun po 'di: sgo dbye ba'i gang zag ni: pad+ma'i sgrub gnas: gnas chen gsum la dbang ba'i skyes bu: shes rab dang snying rje che bas: theg pa thams cad la gus pa: 'gro ba la phan pa'i sems bskyed dang smon lam yod pa:khro gtum dang :rig pa'i ngar che bas:dgra bgegs 123

mkha' spyod 'bras mo 11ngas kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/gyis bar chad mi hūṃs pa:shes pa la tshul chos med pasaca khamagakyi zas 'a'igatsang btsog med pa: khyi phag lta bu rtog pa med pa gcigapa phag mo yum gyis byin gyis brlabs te 'byung ngo : de'i smon lam gdul bya'i las 'phro 'dzoms na: phyi yis gnas gsum la longs sbyod: bod khams cung zhig bde bar hūṃs so:de yang snyigs ma'i dus su: bsod nams dang ldan pa'i sems can nyung bas:thugs rje dang las 'phro ma 'dzom par:bod khams phung ba'i ltas byung na: sbas pa'i yul bdun dbye dgos te: de'i lde mig phyi nang gsang gsum du bstan gyi+os: rgyal po'i thugs la legs par dgongs 'tshal: zhes gsungs sa:e ma ho: dus ma 'ongs pa'i tshe: dge ba spyod pa'i gang zag sbas pa'i yul du 'gro bar 'dod na:phyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang mthun pas:dge ba'i sems bskyed dang lngan pa: khrus dang gtsang sbu la gnas pas: sa sgo rig pa zhib mos brtags la 'gro ste: thugs byang chub sems kyi lde mig yin: mi mthun pa'i rkyen dang bar chad kyi rtsol ba byung na: yid dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis: sems bskyed dang dam bca' ma nyams par: brtul zhugs kyi ngar dang ldan pas lam spyod: mi 'jigs pa'i stobs kyi lje mig go: lam dang sa 'khor nas: sgo srung lha 'dres mgo skor byung na: thabs khyad par can gyi 'phrul mig dgu sgyur te: bem pordo sa pa'i yul bzhigaca rdzu 'phrul thabs spro24

sbus yul bdun gyi sbyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan/kyi lde mig go: sems can gyi las dang : rgyal ba'i thugs rje ma 'dzoms par: dge ba'i bsam pa phyir log ste: lam dang sa'i gnad 'khor nas dugs pa srid na:snang srid rang gi rig par shes pas:rkyen snang lam du khyer la 'gro ste:gsang ba rmad du byung ba'i lde mig go:nga'i lde mig 'di bzhi dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis: sbas pa'i yul bcal sla'o: 'dzin pa mkhas su dgos so:zashebi 3tanaṣ+pesgyujirtse tregyertasenaphocastasna bud kyi mkhan pa lung btsal ba dka': bzung ba sla: lha'i pho brang sdings btsal ba slaca thar ba dka':'dzin pa ni chos byed re re tsam las mi 'byung ngo : lho brag mon gzhongs ni:gang zag blo stobs can min pas mi bgrod do: bzung ba dka': zin na longs spyod rgyal po'i pho brang dang mnyam: has kyi sbas yul gting ma ni:bod dang thag ring pas bgrod dka': bzung ba sla: zhar tsā ri bgrod sla:'a:dron pa pa/nga thabs/ mkhas/ na sla: sbas ༷/'a/ gzhan rnams 'i/ 'i/ btsa'/ ba dka': la la phran bu yin pas mdzod do: de ltar sbas yul mang po bstan kyang :nges par rnyed pa gsum yong : gzhan rnams ni:gnas re re la lung bstan pa'i gang zag re re yod:de dang ma 'phrad na mi rnyed do:nges par rnyed pa'i gnas gsum ni: lo tsā ba bhe ro tsa na'i sbrul pa: rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa gcig gis: shar rtswa ri gangs kyi ra ba rnyed do: r+bhe ro tsa na spyugs pa'i las 'bras kyis:rdzogs pa chen po ma yin pa'i: theg pa dman pa zhig gis 'dzin par 'gyur ro: bar yul 'bras mo gzhongs ni: bod kyi 125

mkha' spyod 'bras mo 11ngas kyi gnas yig cadags bsdebs bzhugs/mkhas pa rnam gsum gyi sprul pa: rdo rje phur pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig gis 'byed par 'gyur ro:bod kyi grub thob rnam pa gsum:bsam yas mchims phu ru: 'tshogs pa'i byin rlabs kyis dang po gang zag gcig gis mdzad2 rjes su grub thob rnam gsum so sku1ra gyes pas: 'bras mo gzhongs su mthar gsang sngags kyi sde gsum 'byung ngo : la phyi gangs kyi ra ba ni2 atsar+ya dzñā na'i sbrul pa zhig gis phyeca atsar+ya dad pa che bas: mos gus can gyis zin par 'gyur: gnas de nges par rnyed do: las can dang 'phrad nas rnyed par 'gyur ba'i gnas: ku thang gi skyid mo yul: rta mgrin la hūṃs pa thon pa zhig gis rnyed do: de yang pra thum gyi phyogs nas 'byung : yol mo gangs kyi ra ba rig 'dzin bla ma'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa zhig gis rnyed do: de yang gtsang ru lag gi zhub nas 'byung : sman zhod khum bu'i rong : che mchog ma mo'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa zhig gis rnyed do: de yang byang tho yor nag po'i yul nas 'byung ngo : bud kyi mkhan pa lung bya ba: rdo rje rnam 'joms la bsten pa 'khyol ba zhig gis rnyed par 'gyur ro: de yang ru lag rgyang gi zhub phyogs nas 'byung ngo ca sbas yul ding mo sna:'jam dpal gzhin rje la bsten pa 'khyol ba zhig gis rnyed par 'gyur ro:de yang nyang ro'i phyogs nas 'byung ngo : lho brag rgyal mkhan pa lung ni: he ru ka'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa zhig gis rnyed par 'gyur ro:de yang bsam yas kyi phyogs nas 'byung :de ltar sbas pa'i yul de rnams bod la gces pa'i phyir: sbas yul spro26

sbas yul bdun gyi sbyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan/thams cad kyi rgyal po lho 'bras mo gshongs sgo 'byed pa'i gang zag: tshe lo drug cu kha ral nas: lnga bcu'i bar du bdun rim par 'byung : tsā ri la lan gsum 'byung : la phyi gangs kyi ra ba la lan gnyis 'byung : yol mo gangs kyi ra ba la gsum 'byung : ku thang skyid kyi yul la gnyis 'byung : gzhan rnams la re re 'byung : de rnams dang 'drad na sbas yul rnyed: ma 'phrad na sgo 'gags par 'gyur ro: dus mtha' ma'i sems can bsod nams chung bas: lung dang man ngag 'dzoms pa dka': gnas phal mo che rnyed par mi —'gyur ro: bdag dang rgyal po'i smon lalogyis: gnas gsum: stod smad bar gsum gyi dge byed bskyab pa'i phyir: nges par rnyed par 'gyur gyis:zhes gsungs so:yang zhus pa: kyi slob dpon chen po legs: stod smad bar gsum la gces pa'i gnas gsum po de: 'tshol ba'i thabs bstan du gsol: ces zhus sa:bka' bstsal pa: rgyal po legs par gson zhig : tshe lo drug cu kha ral nas: lnga bcu ma sleb kyi bar la: lung bstan pa mang po yod de: gnas kyi khungs chod pa dang :phyogs mtshon pa dang :dwang ba 'dren pa las:gnas bgrod pa dang rnyed pa mi 'byung : tshe tshad lnga bcu la sleb pa dang : bod kha ba can du: ngas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gang zag: 'jig rten gyi yul yid la mi chags pa: skad mi rtag pa'i sgra ru smra ba: bya ba nges med du spyod pa zhig kro27

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo 11ngas kyi gnas yig 〈snags bsdebs bzhugs/gis: gtsang gi srus yul thams cad 'byed par 'gyur ro: gdul bya dus la babs na: gtsang tshong dus 'gur mo nas: dra thum gyis bar gyis bod dang : mon gyis mtshams na: sbas pa'i yul chen gsum:chung pa yul phran bdun yod pa phye zhig: dus mthar thug na: gar blo 'jug pa'i thad so nas song la:sbas yul gcig po'i sgo phye zhig:de'i dus na bod kyi bsod nams nyams pas: 〈snas byed 'tsho bas 'phongasaX/ bdud kha langs nas: rdzun dang zog pos mi 'dul/ ba yong :chos byed nga'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i mi rnams ni:rgyu la zog med pas:shes pa drang por yong :rdzun dang zog med pas:blo gros drang por spyod: de'i dus na: chos byed la chos log spyod pas smad do:lung bstan lung log gis bsnub: bka' lung dri ma smred pa nyon mongs pa can gyi chags sdang gis 'gegs2 dge byed yo byad kyis 'phongs te: sbas pa'i yul mthar mi phyin pa yong : de'i dus na nga'i lung bstan thob pa'i gang zag rnams: dang po bar chad 'dul ba gal che bas: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: rdo rje phur pa: khrag 'thung he ru ka: gsum gang rung gi bsnyen pa rdzogs par gyis: de nas snang srid dbang du bsdu ba dang : srid pa'i mkha' 'gro bskang ba'i phyir:rta mgrin dang :che mchog ma mo'i bsgrub pa gyis:nga'i gter kha re re na: mchog thun mong gi dngos grub tshang bar yod kyis: gang la gang dgos mchod: de nas chos byed pa gtso: 'tsho bas 'phongs na: lho 'bras mo gshongs 'amāli ba'i dus na:gtsang tshong dus mgur mo'i lho hūṃb la kro28

srus yul bdun gyi spyi them ma 'ongs lung bltan/nye ba na:co ro srad kyi yul yod:de'i sked naca o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgrub khang yod: ming ni 'khar chen brag dkar zeraca de na gser mdzo+o khal gcig yod pas thon: tsha mo rong du lha khang 'dom gru bzhi pa zhig bzhengs:dge 'dun gyi lam khang brtsigs: 'bras mo gzhongs kyi bskul byang yi ger thob la zhog:gangs mdzod lnga stag rtse'i ri rgyud la:lho bod kyi mtshams su2 lha khang brgyad brtsigs: dge 'dun gyi sde chos: 'bras gzhongs kyi lam chos: gnas kyi mthil du dbyen khang brtsigs: zhar nas mtha' dmag lan gsum dbus gtsang gi gzhung la 'grim: lho kha char la mi yong bas: de'i dus na bod la rkyen dbang gis nga dran pa gcig yong : dad pas khri bskul gcig: de'i phyi ma dbus gtsang thams cad khebs pa'i hor dmag la sogs dmag rigs dgu dus gcig la rdol bas:bod yul bor la 'bras gzhongs su bros zhig:bud dang khyam bu la 'gro ba rnams:gtsang ru lag gi lha khang yod pa'i lho zhub kyi thad so 'dom bdun phyin pa na: gser bsam yas kyi bre gang dang : g.yu bdun yod pa thon laca bu le'i gangs phran la lam khang brtsigs: bud kyi rong la dge 'dun gyi sde thob: sbas yul gyi lam 'tshol: la phyi dang yol mo gangs ra la 'gro ba rnams: zang zang lha brag gi shar na: gser phye ma gzi'i dong pa gang dang 2 thig po ra'i phyin pa tsam zhig yod kyis:de thon la rgyal thang gi gangs rong la lam khang tshugs:snya nam gyi 'gram la dge 'dun gyi sde thob: sprus pa yul gyi lam bcos so:129

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/skyid mo lung du 'gro ba rnams: dra thum gyi lha khang dbus ma'i sgo 'gram na:mu men gyi rdza ma gser bre dos gang ba yod: de thon la sku thang gi rong la gnas dang lam khang dus gcig thob:de ltar byas pas gtsang gi phyogs su:lo bskor gcig bde sgyid 'byung : mthar chos byed dang : mi nag chos la dkar ba thams cad kyi srog thar ro: yang te rtse gangs kyi lho shar na: 'dzeng rdo dkar po g.yag tsam zhig yod:de'i zhub na gser gyi thig po lag pa tsam bcu gsum yod: chos byed 'tsho bas 'phongs na thon: te rtse la lam khang tshugs: gangs ri de'i zhub phyogs kyi gangs yod med mtshams na: phyogs hūṃb byang mtshams na: gangs ri lha'i khrom 'tshogs sa 'dra ba zhig yod:der dus mtha' la thug tsa na: chos byed sum brgya thar pa'i rdzong yod: 'tsho ba'i zhing yod pas:stod kyi chos byed la lam ston cig:dbyas kyi srus yul bzung lugs ni: zhar tsā ri gangs kyi ra bar dge byed kyis bskor: nags rong phugs bzang bas bgrod sla: dwags po'i ka ma lung du dge 'dun gyi sde btab na: 'gro don gyi stobs che: chos byed 'tsho bas 'phongs na yer pa'i brag phug zhar ma'i logs la: rin po che sna lnga'i bum pa sog po'i ska rags can: gser phye bre phyed: g.yu ming can bcu gsum: g.yu phran dong pa gang yod pas thon: 'gro ba'i la/ma byang 'bras mo gzhongs dang 'dra bar gyis/ shig : bsam yas brag dmar mdun na: pha bong rgya zhogo sgril ba 'dra ba 'ig yod:de'i 'og na bse'i pa ra zhigre yod:de na rdzi drag yod pas:ra tshil gyi klod () sir+sha ra

sbas yul bdun gyi sbyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan/byug pa gyis la dbyen par zhog: de'i 'gram na rdo dkar po dre 'dra ba zhig yod: ti tsha'i bum pa bcu gcig gser bsam yas kyi khal gcig gis gang ba yod pas: mchims phu la dge 'dun gyi lam khang gyis: lho brag mkhar chu'i ngos la gnas thob: de'i rting du mtha' dmag mi yong : dus phyi ma la gter de rnams thon la: bsam yas kyi zhig gso gyis: bre gsum gyis chos byed kyi 'tsho ba gyis la rong la bros shig: bod thams cad lho rong la 'bros pa'i dus na rdzi drug gi ga'u bsam yas kyi sgo la zhog cig: de yang bsam yas kyi mtha' gogs pa dang bod la nang 'khrugs yong : dbu rtse rigs gsum la zhig ral byung ba dang : bod mtha' dmag gis khyab yong :bsam yas dbu rtse rigs gsum dang lha sa 'khrul snang la zhig ral dang dgra'i gnod pa ma byung na:bod gting nas brlag par mi 'gyur ro:de'i phyir mi spre lo pa zhig gi sna sbug tu: tsan+dan gyi lde gu blugs: ra chil gyis lus maso/ mjug med par byug: bsam yas kyi them pa'i 'og na mar rko: bse'i ga'u de'i nang du ba'ag la: kha phye te rang bros zhig: de'i bsam yas kyi phyogs su dmag ra 'cha' mi hūṃs so: lo gsum nas bdud dmag rang sar ngengs/ nas mi lo sum cu bod la bde skyid 'byung ngo :dus mthar cis kyang mi bzlorge go: bod lho rong gi gting du bros shig: gtsang jo mo kha rag gi 'dabs su lam khang tshugs:lho brag mkhar chu la gnas thob:de rnams su thar ro: spyir bod /bams rong bzhi dang : rdzong sasum la bros: dbus gtsang / 31

mkha' spyod 'bras 31 ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/gnyis sbus pa'i yul dang : lho kha char gyi yul la bros: byang mtha' rigs la yod pa rnams: sting rus che ba lho rong du bros: der ma thar ba rnams:dang ra nas 'bru'i sa bon khyer la: rta sgo gangs kyi byang thad la phar nyin la yul 'debs kyin song shig : rta sgo gangs nas mi 'bring po'i zla ba gcig phyin pa'i sa na:gangs dkar po lcags ri'i tshul du 'khor yod:de'i gangs bar la so nam la thar ro:dge byed kyis lam btsal na:gangs de'i khog pa na: byang 'bras mo khud yod: de rnyed na bod kha ba can gyi yul na: de bas dga' ba'i yul med do:ma rnyed na gangs brag la mi yong gis bros:dang ra na byang sman rgyal mo'i mugs rong yar gyi mi thog ma la bdud dmag gis gsod: te rtse nas dang ra bar gyi rgyud ni: phyis stod dmag gis gsod do:ba dag zha dung gi sgo mo man chad nas: rgya nag po'i bar gyi yul dbus kyi rgyud thams cad sdug zad la song song 'joms: pu rangs nas mi nyag 'ga'i rong yar bcad kyi:lho kha tshar ni jag pa'i tshul du 'joms:kye rgyal po: stod mang yul gung thang du: rgyal po nyid kyi gdung rgyud gcig gri ru 'gum pa dang : bod kyi sdug mgo 'dzugs: gnyis gri ru 'gum pa dang : bod kyi phung mgo 'dzugs: gsum 'gum pa dang : bod kyi sgyid gzad pas:sbas yul dang lho rong la bros zhig:de'i dus su sbas pa'i yul du thar ba rnams la bde skyid 'byung : lho rong du thar ba rnams gzhis ngan du 'chi mi dgos so: de ma yin pa rang gi yul la rtag phyis byed pa spro32

sprus yul bdun gyi spyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan/dang : bcol chung ti ta 'khor ba dang : blo log bka' lung la 'gal ba byed pa rnams:sdug bsngal ris non pa tsam:zug zer me 'obs su shor ba tsam:cho nge brag ral ba tsam myong zhing kun gsod par 'gyur ro: sa bon mes 'chig pa bzhin:gnyis bral du brlag ste:dmag des gsad pa thams cad dmyal khang nag por las kyi dbang gis skye bar 'gyur ro:de lta bu'i dus na:thams cad sdug bsngal gyi non te: nga dang sbas yul dran pa zhig yong ste:dran pa mchis so:nga la rtse gcig tu mos pa byas pa rnams:dmag la mig ma lta bar bros zhig: hūṃb li'i yul du bros pas thar bar gyur ro: de'i gong la chos skyong rgyal po'i khrims zhig nas: bod khri bur 'thor ba'i dus su:'bros ran te: kun yul la chags nas mi 'bros so: de'i rjes su mu dur nag po hor gyis 'dul: de'i tshe bod sdig sgrib kyis non nas mi 'bros so:de nas hor khrims zhig:bod srid 'thor bas lam bgrod pa dka' ste 'bros ran no: de'i dus su nga'i bka' la nyan pa rnams bros thig: gong ltar lam khang dang rong sgo'i mi dang mthun par gyis la bros shig: de'i dus na bod la nga'i thugs rje dang : bdud kyi dug mda' rtsal 'gran pas: nga'i lung bstan pa'i gang zag la: bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mi thams cad: ya ga dang sgro bkur dang : bar chad rtsom pa yong ste: ci la yang skrag par ma byed par bros thig: de'i dus na ma bros na: lho 'dzam bu'i gling na rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i lung bstan gyi mdo bdun yod do: thams cad 'bros ran pas lung 133

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/bstan gyi dus so: bdud sdig can gyis lung nag po sde dgu yod do: de'i dus na 'dzam bu gling gi mtha' bzhi dmag gis bskor cig ces pa lung gi dus so: de'i dus na lung bstan rgyal po'i mdo las: shā ri'i bu nyon cig:nga mya ngan las 'das nas: rgyal po gdung gsob sgron me 'dra ba 'a/na bdun 'byung : de'i phyi ma la lnga brgya phrag bcu'i mtha' tha ma 'char: de'i dus nga'i 'khor bzhi po: ri bo dan dig gi gling dang : chu bo dan dig gi mgo dang :phyi'i rgya mtho'i do gling dang : bas mtha' nags kyi rong la song zhig: rgya gar dang :o rgyan dang :kha che dang :sing nga dang :sa la dang :li'i yul dang :sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod sa'i gnas thams cad: lho zhub rgya masnu'i gling la song zhig: byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul du/ dus mtha' ma la bstan pa dar bar 'gyur gyis: der yang rigs gsum mgon po'i lung bstan la: lnga brgya snyigs ma la bod thams cad bas mtha' nags kyi rong la bros shig:ces lung ston cig: zhod cig: ces gsung pas: thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis: da lta nga nyid kyis lung bstan pa'o:de'i dus/ de'i tshe:'dzam bu gling dang : bod kha ba can gyi mtha' bzhi dmag gis 'khor 'ong : de'i dus lung bstan pa'i dus ma bros na: bod thabs thug pa dang mi thar te: dmag mtha' bzhi nas ri gtib pa ltar 'ong nges pa'i phyir ro:zhes gsungs so:yang zhus pa: kyi slo dpon chen po: de'i tshe de'i dus na: bdud dmag de la thar nges pa du 'byung : dus gsum sa le mkhyen pa'i pad+ma 'byung gnas 134

sbus yul bdun gyi sbyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan/kyis lung bstan du gsol:zhes zhus so:bka' bstsal pa: rgyal po gson dang : bdag gis rgyal po dang bod la brtse ba'i phyir: lung bstan dang : thabs mang po bstan pa yin gyis: bod mtha' 'khob kyi mi 'di da lta dus bzang ba yin kyang : nged lo paṇa bod kyi don la 'ong pa rnams gsod pa'i gros byed: rgyal po nyid bod kyi mgo bo yin te: sku tshe ring na mi rung ba'i blo 'char: bsam yas kyi lha khang bkrag ches pas: gzhon pa mig yengs nas las thabs bcog pa 'dug zer: bod kyi mi 'di bsam pa ngan pas khyi dang 'dra: kha 'jam smra bas wa dang 'du: blo sna mang bas spre'u dang 'dra: gdon gyis bslad pas smyon pa dang 'dra: da lta bas lnga brgya snyigs ma'i dus na:bcu 'gyur gyis ngan du 'gro:rgyal po med pas mgo me+ed kyi yan lag dang 'dra: lung phran re na rgyal phran re: rgyal phran pa glang snying re: gros mgo kha 'chal g.yog pos byed: sde dgon re la mkhan slob re: mkhan slob skya bo gos ser gon: gros mgo nye gnas sgyeg mgos byed: jag pa nye bas khyim 'tshes 'joms: bshes bkur chos byed grogs la byed:log lta byang sems can la byed:spang bya dam pa'i chos la byed:de lta bu'i bsam sbyod ngan pas: bod phal cher khengs pas phung zhing rlag par 'gyur ro: rgyal po thugs khral ma mdzad: da lta'i dus na yang : ngan song gsum gyi gnas na sdug bsngal la bzod glags med: de yang snying rje re las ma dag gi bar du:thugs khral byas pas phan pa med:dus mtha' ma'i smo35
