mkha' sbyod 'bras mo 11ngas kyi gnas yig sdu gas bsdebs bzhugs/bdud dmag de yang : sems can las ngan can thams cad dus snyigs ma la skye gnas len pas: de'i gshed ma byed pa yin: bod 'dir bdag dang rgyal po'i smon lam gyis2 byang chub sems dpa'i rigs can bdun gyis sna drangs te: lho 'bras mo gzhongs su sum brgya thar: bal bod kyi mtshams su nyis brgya thar: brin khyam bu'i rong du drug bcu thar: bud kyi gting du lnga bcu thar: spa gro bum thang gi mtshams su brgya rtsa gcig thar: lho brag mkhar chu'i gting du brgya thar:tsā ri tsā skor la bzhi brgya thar:de rnams rting thar ro: de rnams sprus pa'i yul du btsan pa zin pa'o: yang lho rong thag nye ba rnams la bros te: la la srog thar ba 'ong : la la lho mon gyis ngan byung ste gsod:la la nags rong brag rong chu la mchong :la la bod nang 'khrugs te gri ru 'chi: bdud dmag la thar te rkyen ngan gyis 'chi: la la lho'i dug phog ste 'chi: la la ltogs rir 'chi: rgyal po de'i dus kyi sems can ji ltar byas kyang skyid med: dmyal ba'i gnas dang 'dra: de'i dus na sems kun sdug pa'i dus yin pas: nags la me+e shor ba'i gling na so sod skyid 'dug pa ngas ma mthong :rgyal po nyid rang chos nyid zab mo la longs spyod du yod pa la: da lta rang btsan sa bzung mdzod: ces gsungs pas: rgyal po thugs yus kyis brnangs te:spyan chab mang po zhor ro2 de'i dus na slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: lnga brgya mtha' ma'i sems can la gdams pa bzhag pa: bcom lngan shākya thub pa yis: bstan spyo36

sbus yul bdun gyi sbyi them ma 'ongs lung bstan/pa snyigs ma lnga brgya'i mthar: 'dzam gling sems can thams cad la: bde skyid me+ed pas btsan sar bros: sdig can bka' la mi nyan pas: dge byed bsam pa phyogs zhig drilaca lung bstan sprus pa'i yul rnams kyang : nags rong btsan sa'i rogs yin pas: bde zhing yangs pa'i 'dod pa skyungs:dmu 'thoms mon gyi yul mtshams na: 'byung ba mi snyoms nad gzhi'i rgyu:rten 'brel thabs mkhas sman spyad rten: nags rong 'jigs pa'i g.yang sa la2 dred sngangs ma byed dga' ba bcos: kha char rmugs 'azibs stugs pa la2 'jigs par ma byed pho nya bcol: lo gsum sbyod pa legs par gyis:de nas yul dang lus 'phrod 'gyur: nags rong zas mod sa btsan pas:o rgyan rgyal po pad+ma ngas: lho rong btsan sa'i yul phran rnams: sa btul byin phab gter chen sngas: sgo bcad sgo srung bka' nyan bskos: de phyir sbas pa'i yul rnams na: sgrub gnas re dang gter chen re: bka' rtags yin pas bzhag par bya:'dzam gling chos byed thams cad kyis:rgyal po shākya thub pa yin: rgyal tshab pad+ma 'byung gnas yin: bod kyi chos byed thams cad kun: nga'i byin brlabs sgrub gnas su: pha shul bu yis 'dzin pa ltar: the tshom med par 'dzin du bzhud: skye ba 'di'i phyi ma la: nga dang 'phrad par the tshom med: bka' 'di 'das na bod kyi las ngan gyis: gshis ngan gri ru 'chi bas lung 'di nyon:zhes gsungs so:de'i tshe rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis: lung bstan thams cad yi ger 137

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/btab nas: slob dpon la rin po che'i sna lnga'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas gter du sbas so: lung bstan 'di gu ru o rgyan du gshegs pa'i dus na: byang zang zang lha brag gi sked la sbas te: bod kyi dad pa can gsum la bka' bstsal:nyon zhig bod kyi dad pa can: nga'i zhal gdams yi ge 'di: thob pa'i dus la babs pa'i tshe: bdug pa sa bdag gnyan gyi yul: byang phyogs gdol pa'i yul khams 'dir: lo legs 'bru bcud smin par 'gyur: gter 'di'i zhar thad ri bo'i zhar: lung phran pad sdong 'dra ba'i rtsar: 'brug gam glang gi lo la ni: drag shugs can gyis gter 'di 'don: las can de yis 'di khyer nas: lho'i rong bdun sbas yul bdun: las can de yis 'byed par 'gyur: de la bod kyi srog bstan cig: ma mo bstan ma bcu gnyis gyi:lung 'di las can de la gtod: ces gsungs so: ma 'ongs pa 'i lung bstan srus yul gyi them yig 'di las can zhig dang 'phrad par zhog: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya:byang zang zang lha brag gi sked nas:rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas spyan drangs pa'o:sarba maṅga le/ma phyi ltar zhus dag go/138

bco〉༅//sbas yal 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig le' rang rang sle spedrug pa lje mag 'khrul gya dgu skor bdog go:mjug tu chos blon brgyad kyi luḍi rta3sa bka' bgros pa rdzuphags pa zab mo'i lung bdun slepar grags ༷/rigang chur sa'ad gsang ba rmad byung ga cha lag tu gtags kyang thob yag tu chos kya sda tshan du ma 'dra 'dug gsungs/da༅༅/ /'imar+shaXzo2'phags pa ༷gas rje tram̐n rngo la phyag 'tshasdu lo:spyan ras gzags kyas bad kha ba can gya yul byan gyas brlabs pa' das ris spe spe sle ༄na: gnas dban zhang bzang ba thams cad phya ma' dan da sbas zhang gab:spe sa4 4༄chos kya sgrub gnas su byan gyas brlabs:las can gya dan du gasdu dkral:lagapacanal shaṃ sdang bzhag ༷sa:bar yul 'aḍis ma gshangs kya gnas rtsa 'di+o ༷ la' dpa moXd khang sdu 'gaspya 'khur rtsom sgrag pa dom po thub bstsan rgyal maslen gyas phyagasdu bosgrags/rnyang sdu' gsung 'bum dkar chadī/ṭ+wāṃsorapar/snaṭ+wāṃ ༷gyas pa/rjortseshog grangos ri0nang gosalo/sbas yul ḍi ma'i ༷ngas sdu+okā ṭ+wāṃspyadī ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ༷ kau nga kāṭ+wāṃ ༵ rdoṭ+wāṃ khongs ༵wa sdiṭ+wāṃ ldaṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ zlo sduṭ+wāṃ sdo ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ/ ṭ+wāṃsna 4 tram̐bye ṭ+wāṃ rdo+oṭ+wāṃ bye twe+o+o+oX / khro+o/la/dadīrdzu ṭ+wāṃ~X ༵ ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃsbyaṭ+wāṃ ༵ ོ༵// pa chen li thob yig

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/byin gyis brlabs soca de'i tshe gnas kyi snying po bzhugs sa 'phags pa'i bka' yi lung mdzad: de'i tshe mi lo brgya phrag gsum na mdzod lnga stag rtse'i steng du: lha'i dbang po brgya byin byon nas gnas kyi sgo dbye ba gsal byed lha'i lung mdzad do:de'i rjes su 'phags pa'i yul mi lnga byon:gnas kyi la lang de btag pa gdams rtsis lung mdzad: de nas mi lo stong phrag gsum dong brgya phrag gsum: lo bzhi nas u rgyan gyi rgyal po pad+ma 'byung gnas byan:e ma ho: bod kyi yul du 'phags pa'i bstan pa byon pa'i thog ma la:lha'i dbang po brgya byin mdzod lnga stag rtse'i steng du byon te: lho 'bras mo gzhongs kyi sgo dbye ba'i thabs gsal byed lha'i lung gsungs pa 'di lta ste: dga' lngan lha'i lung bstan bde skyid kyi (mkha' ) 'gro ma lung 'di la:sgo chen po bzhi: gsang phug lta bu'i sgo bzhi yod: lam yig bzhi: 'jug pa'i thabs yod de: sa gnad rtsi ba'i thabs dang : rnal 'byor pa rtogs pa can 'gro ba'i lam yig ni: byang sgo nang nas ma phye na phyi nang mi phyed par bzhad de: rtsa phran dang srog rtsa 'dres pa dbye mi shes pa'i dpe yis mi phyed pa'o: dbang po brgya byin nga'i lung 'di: dus tha ma la lha bzang skyongs zhes bya ba skye ba rgyud mtha' la: mi rigs bzang gi bya ru skyes nas lung 'di rnyed do: gnas 'di'i sgo tshol bar 'gyur ro: dang po bod kyi yul mtha' bris mtshams zhes bya ba'i ri rtse nas lho ru bltas pas2 lha'i dbang po brgya byin 140

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig le'u drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/gyi gdan: gnod sbyin gyi gnam rtum rje'i pho brang : gangs chen rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa lta bya zhig yod:de'i zhar zur na gangs kyi sgo bar dog po gcig yod pas: byang phyogs 'jug pa'i gangs thang dang : lho phyogs sgrol ba'i gangs thong la thabs snying stobs kyis sgrol cig: la sgo de'i rtsa ba nas gangs lung dog po gcig la chu 'bab pa yod pas: chu de'i rgyun ma nor ba la zhugs shig:lung pa de'i zhar na ltongs gcig yod:de la zhugs na yang phya lung du yod de lam nor ba yin no: zhukhu phyogs kyi gangs yol le ba gcig yod: de la zhugs nas go chu rong la nor sa yod do: bar gyi lung pa'i rgyud la zhugs pas: phu mdzod lnga stag rtse'i shar zur nas zhugs te:mdo nas lho zhub la phyin pas: lung pa rje yengs je yengs la 'gro: rong sgo btsan: g.yas dang g.yon du seng ge gnam du mchongs pa 'dra: de la sgo ba dpa' bo'i gyad bzhi sdig can bsrung ba la bskos yod: dregs pa'i phyi nang bzhi sdom nyams bsrung ba la bskos yod2 phra men bza' bdud lcam dral dang bcas pa rnams ma bsrung ba la bskos yod: dam chig gi ma mo bdun dam nyams bsrung ba la bskos yod pas: gnas der nyams pa rigs bzhi mi 'gro bar bya: brag de'i drung du mda' la dar sna lnga btags la gzugs:sgo srung mchod pa'i lha khang bzhengs:dam nyams pa gzugs:klu 'byal:de nas yud tsam zhig phyin pa dang : dpal 'bras mo gzhongs kyi skyid kyi gro ma lung gi dbyibs dang gnas tshul thams cad bkra lam gyis mthong ngo :41

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/dbang po brgya byin lha'i lung bstan ni: nyung ngus gsang ba'i snying gtam 'di lta ste:mdzod lnga stag rtse'i mdo nas lung pa gsum:lho ru kha bstan 'dra mon yin: g.yas pa'i ri de nga ri yin: bar ma'i ting gi nags lung rong ston yin: g.yon pa'i chu rgyun khrid la 'gro dgos te: sa rong dog pas sh-ir du nor sa yod:nor sa mon phu yang lung nang du 'ong : legs par 'gro dus mdzod lnga'i g.yon zur phyi: gangs sgo sgrol ba lha ri'i 'jug slo ste: de'i chu rgyud khrid la lung pa'i dbyibs: sgo mo'i gzhung chu zhar du 'bab pa yod:mgo bo 'jug lam byang shar mtshams su bstan: rkang pa sgo mdo lho zhub mtshams su bstan: de 'das pha rol nang so rnyed pa'i rtags: lung pa'i gzhung rgyud tshangs thig 'then pa 'dra: skal pa can gyis lung 'di ltas na tshud: tho co can gyis rtsal skyed phyin gyur kyang : sgo srung lha 'dres mig rgyur sgo 'gyegs dang : rang gi las la spang blang mi shes pas: rkyen byas mtha'i lung phran rnams su zhor: legs par tshud na lung pa de'i mdor: mtsho mun mchod pa'i tshul du bkod nas yod: sman gyi ri bzang me+e tog tshom bur bkod: gangs ri lnga dang gangs phran mang po yi: gnas chen de la skyob byed byang nas bskor: sa'i mthil nas brag dkar lha'i gdan: tsan dan sdong po bzhi yis bskor ba yod: de'i sgo la ngas yi se 'di bris nas bzhag pas:ma 'ongs pa'i tshe dpal gyi sprul pa lho zhub mtshams nas byon te: gnas 'ji/'i lung bstan rgyas par byed pas:de'i tshe nga'i lung 'di zab mo garter du 142

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig le'u drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/sbos shig: nga'i lung 'di rnyed pa dang bod kyis mi phyed kyis thar te: bod las ngan gyi rkyen bod pa gnas 'dir 'gro ru rung ba'i skabs mi rnyed pas:skyes bu snying stobs can gyis sde dpon gyis zhig: dag pa'i 'khor bdun cu khrid cig: de yang rgyas par phye na dus la bab pa'i tshe 'gro ba mi'i snying kha na: lha'i sa bon rang byung du rdol ba gcig snying stobs bskyed nas: gnas 'di tshol bar 'gyur ro: de nyid kyis slob dpon lung dang mthun pa bcu gsum:btsun pa tshangs spyod dag pa bcu gsum:skye bo khrims la gnas pa bco brgyad: bud med srid la gnas pa nyer gcig: gtso bo gros la mkhas pa mi bzhi:ded dpon bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mi bka' nyan gcig 'khrid la:dud 'gro da/kar zal gcig gis sna drangs pa'i lnga bcu: de ltar mi phyugs brgya phrag gcig dang nyer gcig thog ma'i 'khor la 'khrid: phyi lam thabs dang brda yis chod: bar lam sngags dang phyag rgyas bsrungs: nang sgo gyad dang mtshon chas bsrungs shig: de ltar ma byas na bka' nyan gyi 'khor 'du:bar du 'gong po'i lta rtog pa 'du: tha ma bar du gcod pa'i bdud gsum zhugs te: gnas der 'dzoms/ pas: thog mar lung dang mthun pa'i 'khor sgrol: bar chad byed pa'i 'khor bsrungs: tha ma bod kyi 'brel chod cig:phyi ma'i tshe lung bstan thob pa'i gegs brgya dang nyer gcig: sprul pa'i bud med sum cu rtsa gsum 'byung : de'i phyi ma sdug bsngal gyi nyams thag pa'i sems can su/ma brgya 'byung bas: de las mang ba ni 'jug par mi rung ngo :14kai

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/de'i chos sbyad pas gnas de mi yis gang yong : sems can mi yi sa bon sbas pa'i dus yin no2 zhes gsungs so: dpal 'bras mo gzhongs kyi dbus su lha'i lung bstan nas: bar snang la 'ja' gyi lam la bzhud do:lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi lung bstan leñtsa gnyis pa'o:lhagum ma te2r+ṇazo de'i tshe de'i dus na: 'phags pa'i sprul pa mi lnga gnas der byon nas:phyi ma'i dus na gnas der gang zag ji lta rū bgrod de2 bde skyid ji lta bu 'byung ca yun ji tsam gnas: zhes langs te btags pas: lha rdo dkar po bco brgyad: thun rdo khra bo lnga: 'dre rdo nag po gsum:'byung ba rigs kyi rdo bzhi babs pa las:gab pa dkrol:legs par rtsis pas: gnas 'di la thog ma 'jug pa'i dus su: zhar sgo la blun po sbre'u 'dra ba gcig byung ba sdug:lho sgo la blun po glang 'dra ba gcig sdug:zhub sgo la blun po khyi 'dra ba gcig sdug— byang sgo la blun 〈sna wa 'dra ba gcig sdugaca spyir blun po bsam pa rno ba: yang na: thibs pa: thung ba: khrug pa rmongs pa'i mi lnga sdug: shar sgo bde la ring ba stag 'dra bas phye na phyes: lho sgo la 'jam mi ring ba lha 'dra bas phye na phyes: hūṃb sgo bzang la khro gtum che ba 'brug 'dra bas phye na phyes: byang sgro dpa' bo rtsal chen seng ge lta bus phye na phyes: spyir bsam pa rgya che la brtanaca 'dun gros zhib la mkhas: gdung shugs drag la ring ba rnams nas 'dir 'jug go: de yang 'jug tu rung ba'i mi rigs bco brgyad 'byung ste: nang bsam pa dang sbyar te rtsis pas:spro44

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig leñtsa drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/rgya che ba nam mkha' lta bu: gsal byed nyi zla lta bu: brtan pa ri bo lta bu:klong chen rgya ma tsho lta bu:thabs mkhas ded dpon lta bu:gzhan don lhun grub lta bu: phyi spyod pa dang sbyar te rtsis pas: ci byed legs pa lha bzo ba lta buca ci smra legs par mnyan pa khol po lta bu: dad pa 'pho 'gyur med pa nad pas sman 'tshol ba lta bu2 gdung shugs che ba bu gcig pa'i ma lta bu2 brtson 'grus che ba sgeg mo mgo bo la be zhor ba lta bya: bsam rgyu gzhan med pa btson dong nang nas 'bros pa lta bu: phyi nang thun mong nas rtsis na:snying rje can khri mnyan sa le 5 lta bu: sdig sgrib chung ba lha lta bu: byang sems che ba rtag tu ngu lta bu: re sa gzhan na med pa thang stong gi byi phrug lta bu:chog shes pa seng ge lta bu: gzhan la mi gnod pa lug lta bu rnams 'jug tu rung bas drongs zhig: gnas der 'jug tu mi rung ba'i mi rigs dgu 'byung ste: phra ma mkhas la zhe ngan pa wa lta bu: ro gyong la dge ba med pa gcan gzan lta bu: kha sbyang che la khrel med pa 'phyon ma lta bu: bcol chung la gtad med pa sgre'u lta bu: nyon mongs hrag la bsam pa chung ba smyon pa lta bu: zhe sdang che la rgyud ngan pa khyi lta bu: khengs dregs che la spyod pa ngan pa jag pa lta bu: tshul chos che la zog che ba rkun mo lta bu: bsod la rngam la dmar dad che ba spyang khyi lta bu rnams zhugs na 'phags pa'i bstan pa bzhig pas: legs par rtogs la bsrungs shig: rung dang mi rung phyes ma'i mi lnga to kriṣaṇas/ra/ —da da wa 145

mkha' sgyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ 'byung : sdom pa nyams pa bsnyen pa brgya rtsa gcig gis sbyangs na rung :dam nyams pa sgrub pa brgya rtsa gcig gis bskangs na rung : sdig po che mchod rten rang lus dang mnyam pa brgya rtsa gcig bzhengs na rung : rme pho mo mchod rten brgya:bsnyen gnas brgya:gzungs zab mo tshar brgya:khrus kyi cho ga brgya bsgrubs na rung : 'phyon ma nal mo bsnyen gnas tshar nyer gcig byas na rung ste: phyin chad bsdoms zhus pa la bsrung ba yin no: gnas der bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa lha'i 'dod yon dang mnyam pa:rgyal po'i gdung rabs bco brgyad 'byung : mi yul phal pa dang mnyam pa'i mi lo stong phrag gnyis 'byung :de nas sprul pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung :bar skabs gsum la bdud kyi bu gsum zhugs pa 'khrid pas: mtshon cha dang drag sngags kyi gter longs spyod cig: dang po 'jug pa sems bskyed pa'i bar skabs:gnyis pa gnas pa bde zhing skyid pa'i bar skabs: gsum pa bde ba mar 'grib kyi bar skabs: bdud 'dul ba la nan tan gyis zhig: dang po'i dus su brtag cing bsrung : gnyis pa'i dus su gyad kyis bzlog: gsum par drag sngags smod pas sgrol: ces gsungs te: sbrul pa'i mi lnga: rgya gar gyi yul du gshegs so:gab pa rtsis kyi le'u gsum pa'o:e ma ho: sprul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lje btsan sku 'khrungs nas mi lo nyi shu rtsa gcig nas: u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sbyan dungs: brag dmar dbus kyi bsam yas bzhengs: bod yul chos kyis 146

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig leñtsa drug pa lje mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/gang bar byas: rgyal po dgung lo sum cu rtsa brgyad bzhes pa dang : sbas pa'i yul 'bras mo gshongs su byon te: lha srin thams cad dam la btags: phyi ma'i don du byang bu drug dang : lung bstan sum cu mdzad do:snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams zhan pas: dge ba mi sgrub sdig la spyod: lung bstan thob pa'i gang zag la: bdud kyi spyo ba 'byung : de tshe dpal 'bras mo gzhongs 'dir: nga'i bstan pa 'byung bas: de'i don la gces pa'i man ngag: kun rdzob kyi snang ba bzhig pas: yang dag pa'i don mthong ba: lha srin gyi rdzu 'phrul phrogs pas don 'grub pa: bdud kyi dpung bshi+og pas log pa'i dgra thu'a'ib 'di: ma 'ongs pa'i don du bzhag par bya':sa ma ya:rgya rgyargya:phyi ma'i dus na gnas der 'jug pa'i gang zag la bdud dang lha 'dre'i mgo skor byung na 'di ltar gyis shig: dang po 'byung ba sgyur ba'i 'phrul yig ces bya ba: 'jim pa dang rdo la gnas de chags pa'i dbyibs dang dpe brtsigs la: 'byung ba'i dgra med pa'i phyogs su bzhag ste: de nyid gnas de dngos su gsal bar bskyed: yin nges pa'i bsam pa ma skyes bar du yang yang gsal gdab bo: mdun pa yang gzhan du mi btang bar de la dungs kyis btang ngo : dbe sgyur ba'o: de nas shog zhog la gnas de bris nas: dngos su bskyed: 'jim pa la brtsigs la dngos su bskyed: 'bru phye 'am zhing thal la brtsigs la dngos su bskyed do: dug zhing la me spar la 147

mkha' spyod 'bras mo 〉(ngas kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rang lha ru gsal ba'i ngang nas sngags brgya rtsa gcig bzlas te: zhog shog la bris pa de bsregs pas gnas de'i dngos po bsregs nas stong par bsam mo2 s+t+woṃ 〈( gha dzha ti ba ra kha: yang rlung gi rkyal pa gcig la sngags 'di brgya rtsa bzlas te 'bud do— gang ba dang ca bye ma la bskyed pa de stor bas: gnas de'i dngos po gtor nas stong par bsam mo:/lha/ sno sno gha dzha dha dha bha ya: yang chu bum pa gang la sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad gtab pa thal ba la bskyed pa de la 'phyar bas: gnas de'i dngos po dag nas gtor bar bsam: sna sna sna kha tsha zha tha pha wa kha: de ni 'byung ba sbyang ba'o: rjes su sbas yul gyi ming stong nas mtha' bral gyi ngang la bzhag go: de nas 'byung ba bskyed: stong pa'i ngang la rang gi mdun du e zhes pas nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong : de'i steng du yam̐ las rlung gi dal: de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dal: de'i steng du su las gser gyi sa gzhi2 de'i steng du waṃ las rin po che'i mchog rab: de'i bum par rin po che'i gzhal yas khang las sbas pa'i yul ji lta bu bskyed pas: de gzhi bdag bka' srung thams cad de bsrung zhing las byed par bsam2 mchod pa dbul: rgyan dang spyan gzigs sna tshogs dbul: 'byung ba bsgyur ba'i rten de la dmigs pa gtod: sbas yul dngos su gsal bar byas pas: lha srin thams cad bden pa'i don la rtogs te snang ba 'gyur 'gro nges pa'o:de nas rnal 'byor brtul zhugs bskyed la/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i 48

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig leñtsa drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/ngang nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du dpal 'bras mo gshongs lung byang dang mthun par gsal bar bskyed la: de thur du sbub nas gnas pa blo mgo 'gyur bar bsam: ngh+ru lo su baṃ ram̐ yo e: zhes baji+od pas: 'byung ba lnga po steng 'og 'gyur bar bsam zhing dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gtad do: de ni 'byung ba gong 'og 'pho ba'i 'phrul yin no: de nas 'byung ba bkug ste:nyaṇanama.a.a.e.a:zhes 'byung ba nam mkha' steng na yod de:phaṭa zhes pas 'og tu 'phangs:ka tsu ṭa ta pa:i i li li phaṭa:zhes 'byung ba sa zhar na yod de zhub du 'phangs: ga dza ṭa da pha e e ri ri phaṭaca zhes 'byung ba me zhub na yod pa zhar du 'phangs: kha tsha tha tha pha o e+o phaṭa: zhes 'byung rlung byang na yod pa lho ru 'phangs: de nas 'byung ba srid pa'i 'jig rten thams cad: yom yom zhig zhig thor thor 'ur 'ur 'dug par bsam zhing : e su ram̐ ye baṃ: zhes bzlas pas srid gsum g.yo bar zhus so: 'byung ba dkrug pa'i 'khrul mig yin no:de nas 'byung ba sa chu la thim: chu me la thim: me rlung la thim2 rlung nam mkha' la thim: nam mkha' gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i ngang la bzhag pas: snang srid yul med ming dang bral: lha 'dre gnyis med 'dod pa'i rten dang bral: ci yang ma grub pa'i ngang las de dgos kyi mtha' chod: de 'byung ba stims pa'i 'khrul mig yin no:kha char smug thibs dang : gangs brag snyil ba dang : chu rgod rdol ba 149

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/dang :thog ser rlung po phug pa dang :lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul che na byas pas bar chad rang chad rang stong la 'gro ste: 'byung ba bzhi la srid pa rten yod pas de dkrugs pas gnod byed yul dang bral lo: gang rung rung byas na: lha 'dre'i yul mkhar zhig pa'i rnam par smin pa 'byung ngo : de nas rnal 'byor pa rab kyis kun rdzob kyi 'phrul pa bzhig ste: srid pa phyi nang gnyis rdzun la dzun rten yin no:dang wa ra(ga dbang chen gyi gzhal yas khang nyid dang :mkha' la rlung rten de la rim par rten: dber na sbrur pa rlung gis steg pa 'dra: nang bcud kyi sems can 'gro ba drug kyang 'dod pa'i rlung la sgyu ma'i khu khrag chags:rtsa rus sha lpags gcigre/ la gcig rten yin: dper na bar snang sgrin dang na bun 'dra: gang la rtag par 'dzin pa'i rgyu med pas: ram̐ ye khaṃ gis 'khrul snang bsregs gtor sbyangs: rgyu 'bras dbyer med stong gsal ngang la bzhag: rme+o maha shu nu ta dzña na badz+ra swa bha wa ad ma konya haṃ: zhes mtha' dbus med pa stong pa'i ngang la bzhag pas:kun rdzob 'khrul snang bzhig pa'i 'khyul mig ces bya ste: lha ma srin bden pa ma mthong ba rnams: srog snying 'bul zhing : zhing nags brag chu gang la mngon par zhen pa'i snang ba grol nas: yang dag pa'i don lhangs kyis skye bar 'gyur ro: de ltar stong pa de'i ngang la rig pa'i rtags gsal: gsal ba de la bdag 'dzin gyi mkhan po med pas: gzung 'dzi+on dngo bral bas phyi ltar dngos po ma grub: bdag dang bral bas nang ltar dngas pa ma grub: chags snang dang bral bas bar du spro50

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig le'u drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu/ skor/dngos po ma grub: de'i ngang la gnas pas 'gro drug gi g.yang sa chod:rigs drug gi sems can rnams rang snang 'khrul pa las byung ste: de rang byung gi ye shes su shar rtsa na: ngan song du lhung du dogs pa med do: de'i tshe snang srid bdag med mnyam pa'i 'khrul mig ces bya ste: de'i ting nge 'dzin dang ma bral na: phyi gangs brag chu'i gnod pa: nang lha srin gcan gzan gyi gnod pa:gsang ba mig rgyur lam log gi bar chad mi 'byung ngo :e ma ho: phyi sbas pa'i yul du 'gro ba rnams: re dogs med pa seng ge'i 'dug stangs bzhin: rtog pa gang shar 'dzin med du zhog: cho 'phrul gangs brag rong la thug gyur kyang : nyam nga bag tsha med pa hur gyis: lam la sdug na dngos 'dzin snang ba bshig: 'jig rten 'di dag ye nas stong pa yin: mi rnyed mnyam pa rtog 'dre yin: chos nyid rtogs pa'i gding dang mi ldan yang : nga'i lung la the tshom ma byed par: lho phyogs srus pa'i yul du myur du song : dge ba'i bsam pa rlabs chen mthar 'don pa: byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa nges par yin:de dus lus srog gces par ma 'dzin par: gangs brag 'jigs pa'i g.yang la thabs kyis sgrol: de tshe nga nyid gzhi bdag 'khor gyis bskor: lam gyi bar chad sgrol ba'i grogs la 'ong :las can man ngag 'di dang ma bral bar: sbasdo/ pa'i yul du song gcig sa ma ya:u rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsang gtam: mkha' 'gro ma'i snying 151

mkha' sbyod 'bras 31 ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/gtam: 'di lta ste: dpal 'bras mo gzhongs zhes bya ba 'di: bde bar gshegs pa zhi khro'i pho brang yin te:'dir 'gro ba dang 'dun pa stong ba'i yon tan spar mi zhus so: gnas 'dir sngar ma bgrod pa'i mi thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mngon sum du thob nas sangs rgyas thob ste:dang po lam du 'jug pa'i dus 'jig rten zhen pa'i yul dor rtsa btson dong nas 'bros pa lta bu dgos te:nyan thos thar pa 'dod pa'i lam du phyin:gnyis pa lam gyi gegs ci byung yang : rang nyid ci la yang mi skrag mi chags pa gcig dgos te: rang sangs rgyas kyi lam bgrod: gsum pa lus dang srog la mi lta bas dka' ba dang du blang dgos te2 byang chub sems pa'i lam bgrod:bzhi pa thab dang gzhob sbangs: 'khon dang dam sel spangs: na pa dang khrigs sbangs te2 khrus dang gtsang spyod dag pa'i lam bgrod dgos te: kri ya dang ༷/pa'i lam bgrod:lnga pa gnyen par gnas pa:snyung bar gnas pa:za gcig pa'i sdom khrims bsrung dgos te: bdag skyob byed dge ba'i lha dang sar 'gro dgos te: yo ga'i lam bgrod:drug pa bar chad 'dul ba la yi dam lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar 'gro dgos te: ma ha yo ga'i lam bgrod do: bdun pa pho mo chags pa rang rgyud pa spangs te: bcud lus la gnas pa'i shes pa dang seng ba la 'gro dgos te: rnal 'byor pa thig le bde ba dang stong pa zung 'jug bzhi la 'gro dgos te: a hūṃ yo ga'i lam bgrod2 brgyad pa rkyen ci byung lam du rdzogs pa dang : 'dod pa'i don grub 15lha

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig leñtsa drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/pa yin dang min pa'i rtog pa dang bral: skyes bu thang chad pa ngal gso bas:bde ba la bde ba'i baji+od rgyu ma rnyed: snga ma dka' ba'i bya ba rdzogs: phyi ma 'di bya'i 'dod blo ma skyes: bar du nyams snang bde ba la der 'dzin gyi rtog pa ma slad pa'i bar la: dpal rdo rje sems dpa' mngon sum du byon nas:stong gsum kun 'gro yangs pa'i 'khrul mig 'dus ma byas pa'i sgo phye ste:a ti yo ga rtsol bral gyi ngo bo dang 'phrad par 'gyur ro: khyod dang dam ma nyams pa'i 'khor thams cad thog ma la gnas bgrod nas mi lo bdun nas/ rang byung gi ye shes mthong nas: dag pa'i 'khor bdun dang bka' nyan gyi 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhi sangs rgya'o: phyi ma'i las can rnams ni 'khor ba las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro: badz+ra tsi ta a a a: rang rig ci yang ma grub pa: stong pa zang thal gnas pa 'di: chos nyid kun tu bzang po yin:rig pa rang bzhin ma 'gags pa: sa le hrig ge yer re ba: rig pa kun tu bzang po yin: stong gsal dbyer med par: wal le khyug ge bun rne ba:chos sku thig le nyag gcig yin: zhes gsungs so: 'bras mo gzhongs kyi lde mig rgya 'grol thabs slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gsungs pa'i le'u bzhi pa'o:2ternyanag sgrotheterme de tshe rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis phyi ma'i don la dgongs nas gsang ba'i gab lung gsungs pa ni— spu rgyal bod kyi rgyal po nga'i lung : bod 'bangs phyi ma rnams 'di skad zlo: bod yul kha ba can 153

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/gyi bde skyid de: 'phags pas byin rlabs slob dpon zhal gnyis dang :chos skyong rgyal po nga yi thugs rje yin: de yi bka' bzhin sgrub na rtag par bde: dus kyi tha ma bdud rigs kha slangs nas: rgyal ba'i bka' dang rgyal po nga'i lung : khyad du gsad pas bod kyi skyid pa zad: bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru ma thon slob dpon byed:tshul khrims bsnyen par ma gnas mkhan po byed:sbyi khrims dge ba med pas rgyal po byed:legs nyes rtsis rgyag mi shes blon po byed: skye bo rnams ni nyon mongs rang dgar spyod: bud med thams cad g.yem dang nal la brtson: sku gsung thugs kyi rten la mchod pa chag: nga'i dpal gyi bsam yas lha sa dang : mtha' 'dul yang 'dul lha khang brgya rtsa gcig: phal cher zhig ral mchod pa chag pa'i tshe: bod kyi bde skyid zad pas dben par bros:sdig can dmag dang 'khrug pa byed pa dang :las ngan dme pho dam nyams byas pa dang :rigs ngan zhan pa rngon pa nya bya zhor:las log mtshams med lnga la spyod pa dang : 'dod log g.yem la :stob pa med pa yi: 'phyon ma nal po grogs rgyud byed pa dang : zas ngan zha khrag dmar la dad che ba: thams cad las ngan dbang gis ded nas kyang : rang rang las la chags nas 'bros mi 'gyur: gal te bros kyang sdig pa ma byang na: bde chen sbas pa'i yul du mi thar ro: bo dhi sa tā'i rjes 'jug btsun pa ni:'dul ba'i lung ltar sbyod pa thams cad dang : pad+ma 'byung gnas rjes 'jug sngags 'chang ni: dam chig bkod pa'i rgyud ltar bsrung ba dang : chos skyong 1to4

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig le'u drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/rgyal po nga'i rjes 'jug ni: mdo sde rgyu 'bras don la lta ba rnams: the tshom ma byed sbas pa'i yul du bros: gzhan yang skye bo chos la gus pa rnams:bud med rang lus gtsang mar bsrung ba rnams: chags med zhen med dor la sbas pa'i yul du bros: dam chig sa bral sdom pa sa shor dang :sdig pa mang po spyad pa'i skye bo dang : g.yem 'byor rme med spyad pa'i bud med ni: bod kyi grib dor sgo yol bar lung du: sdig sgrib sbyongs la phyin chad sngom pa long :de dus bod kyi yul la skyid med pas: chos spyod thams cad sbas pa'i yul du bros:dpal gyi 'bras mo gshongs de nga'i yul:bod la bkos phyir rgyal po nga yis bstsal: dang po nga 'gro dus mtha' yul mtshams kyi: zhar lho gnod sbyin yol mo'i 'dabs na bzhugs: stong dpon lung nag 'das pa'i pha rol na: lung phran gangs lung kha brag dog mo yod: de yi lho na gangs lung ring mo yod: sked na nags kyi rdzing chung 'khyil ba yod: gnas der lo gsum sgrub pa'i gzhi rten tshugs: 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i lha khang bzhengs: lha ru gnod sbyin rgyal po 'khor bcas mchod: bod kyi grib chod 'bru'i so nam gyis: 'gro ba mang po gnas der 'dren dgos na: de'i phyi rol nags rong ring smon na: stod na brag ri thong lcags glang 'dra yod: de la rig 'dzin pad+ma'i lha khang bzhengs: dge byed chos pa'i gnas der de ru tshugs: bar na nags rong sum mdo yangs pa la: ya rabs bsod nams can gyi gnas rten tshugs: smad na nags ri yol ba rkyang 'dra yod: de'i sproto5

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/dbus su skye bo'i gnas rten tshugs: lho bod sa rigs rtogs la so nam gyis: lho ru ma mo bdun dang brag btsan dang : srog bdag rgyal po yul gyi lha ru mchod: phyi'i gangs lung nang gi seng ge lung : gang du gnas kyang bstan ma bcu gnyis mchod: gnas der sngags pa btsun pa rgyal po dang :blon po 'bangs dang bud med mi rigs drug: rang rang yul dang bcas te so sor bcas: 'khon dang nal rme thab gzhob sdig las sbang 2 nang du mon dang mthun pa'i 'jug pa bya:mtha'i dmag thub grong khyer brgya phrag mtsho:phyi ru bod kyi grib can bsrung bar bya: yun du mi sdod bod kyi blo ngan 'jug:'gro ba ded dpon byang chub sems dpa'i rigs: thog ma'i dus na nga'i rgyal rgyud 'jug2 dus mthar song na nga'i gdung nyams 'gro: de dus byang chub sems ldan 'gro ba'i mgon: glang ngam 'brug gi lo la skye ba len:'phags pa'i sprul pa srong btsan sgam po dang : sgrol ma'i sprul pa tshug jo thabs kyi srasaca de gyon de wa ra dza zhes bya ba'i gdung : tha mal spyod pa'i rigs lngan chos la dad: mi rabs sum cu rtsa drug brgyud pa'i mthar: byang chub sems ldan de'i gdung du skye: de nyid chos skyong rgyal po nga'i tshab: dge ba'i khrims 'dzugs dge byed cham la 'bebs: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnas der rgyas par byedaca 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs dang de'i srasaca pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs brgyud rgyal tshab 'dzin: stag spre phag sbrul bzhi la byang nas 'jugaca gdug pa'i lo bzhi dag la sgo 'byed pa2 skyes bu bshed spro56

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig leñtsa drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/bzhi lo pas sgo dbye: seng ge g.yu lung stod nas gangs kyi lha: bzhag pa dka' bas zhag gsum phangs la dgos: de nas lha ri phyag gi ri rgyud la/:sa rong dog la dka' bas zhag gsum dgos: de ltar zhag drug nyin lam bdun song tshe: blon po smug zil 'bangs su slebs par 'gyur: de nas du+o skad cig na sgo drung yod2 de nyid 'das ma thag tu gnas chen mthong : de ltar sbas pa'i yul gyi sgo phyes tshe: bod kyi grib las thar ba'i 'khor rnams drongs:lung dang 'gal ba'i mi rigs bzhug mi byaca grib ma spangs pa'i mi rigs spang bar bya: thog ma'i 'khor la dag pa'i mi rigs 'du: rjes nas 'jug pa 'gong po'i lta rtog yin: 'jug par mi rung mi rigs zhugs pa na: lo bdun 'das nas nang du 'khrug pa 'ong : nad rigs bod dang sbas pa'i yul na 'ong : de phyir mi rung ba yi mi rigs bzlog2 'jug par rung ba'i gang zag gang tshogs la: bsrung ba'i rtags bdag sbas pa'i yul du drongs:rjes kyi lam chos sgo srung gyad pa bskos:lo bdun 'das nas las kyi 'phro yod pa'i: gang zag brgya dang nyer gcig gnas der 'jug: bud med sum cu rtsa drug 'jug pas drongs: gnas der slebs nas zhag bdun song ma thag: rgyal 〉skyon khrims bca' mnga' gsol sgrub par bya: sngags pa thams cad rnal 'byor pa gcig gis: gsang sngags dam cig gcig pa'i khrims kyis bsdu:rab byung thams cad gnas brtan gcig gi 'og:'dul ba ka ri ka'i khrims kyis bsdu: skye bo thams cad rgyal po gcig gi 'og:157

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rgyal khrims nyi ma'i 'od zer khrims kyis bsdu: gnas der dge ba'i bsam pa mthar phyin 'gyur:zhes gsungs the+o/:de tshe rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis: gnas de la dbang gi byang chub sems dpa' de la gab pa'i lung drug dkrol ba: snying gtam chig gsum gsungs pa ni: rgyal po'i lung la phyi ma'i gdung 'dzin nyon: lam yig ji ltar gsungs pa'i dka' nyan la: blon po smug zil 'dabs nas phyir ma rtog: lho bod lha srin 'khrug nas bar chad mi 'cha' 'o: thog ma'i 'khor de sgrib sgyong gzungs sgrub bgyi:de'i ngang la grib can ma 'dres par: myur bar phyin na bar chad mi 'byung ngo : 'khor la grangs rtsis brtag pa sna tshogs gsungs: ji ltar gsungs kyang sting stobs can: 'khor du khrid la gzhan skyon brtag la spangs: dus tshod nam blo bshad pa'i lung mang yang : stag pa dbyar zla tha chung stod la this: 'jug pa dbyar zla tha chung smad la shis: ston zla ra ba'i tshes la phyin yang thon: phyi ma mi phyugs mang po ma 'don gcig:nyung hrag 'gro na ston zla 'og ma gnyis: gangs kyi gso dang bral na bde bar 'gyur ro: sgo srung lha 'dre zhin tu mangs gyur te: byar mdzod lnga stag rtse'i bsrungs ba la: bzhos rtsang g.yas darkya/ra zung dang me long dang : mda' bzang rgod sgro skyon lngas rgyan pas mchod: las can khyod kyi 'khor la mang po dang :gcig pu khyad par med pas lung la ltos:smon lam stobs kyis bar chad mi 'byung ngo : bka' las 'das pa'i 'khor rnams ma bsrung na: sbas spro58

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig le'u drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/pa'i yul du phyin pa don re chung : ka gcig sdig can grogs ni legs par srungs:zhes gsungs so:rgyal po gsang ba'i gab chung le'u 4lnga pa'o:rtadzorakhyamathaloṭ+wā12grortswasesmra tarnyarī+ode nas bud med khyad du 'phags pa: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma ye shes kyi mtsho rgyal dang : las can gyi ma sher bza' sgron ne+e gnyis kyi: bar yul rin chen gsh-i+ongs su bzhugs pa dang :nam smad kyi dus su bud med nag mo g.yu'i ral pa can: dung gi zor ba thogs pa gcig byung nas 'di skad smra'o:kyi rigs lngan ma gson dang : nga ni dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi pho nya lags: gnas 'dir dus phyi ma'i tshe 'gro ba mang po 'jug par 'gyur:de tshe gnas 'di mkha' 'gro ma'i pho brang yin pas: skye bo mdangs nyams pa la bar chad 'byung ngo : de bsrung ba dang rten pa'i lung kar chag yi ger thob cig zer te bar snang la song ngo : ye shes mtsho rgyal dang sher sgron gyi bu mo gang zag rab gsum: 'bring gsum: tha ma gsum dgu phrugs su phyes nas mdangs gsol ba'i lung chig 'khrid pa ni:ye shes mkha' 'gro'i pho brang gnas chen 'dir: pho mo rang rgyud chags pa can gyi rigs: 'jug par mi rung srog la bar chad 'byung : de phyir thig le bzung ba'i thabs 'di mdzad: rab mchog dang po'i gang zag khyad par can: bde ba gnas su zin nas rtog pa med: de la mkha' 'gro thams cad rang bzhin 'du: rab kyis bar pa rtsa rlung gnad du song : bud med stong la sdu59

mkha' spyod 'bras yo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/sbyad kyang yar la 'phelaca de'i bran du mkha' 'gro thams cad 'khol: rab kyi 'og ma yid bzhin ting 'dzin gsal: bde ba'i zig le gsang ba'i mchod par shes:de la mkha' 'gro thams cad mnyes par 'gyur:'bring gi dang po chags pa'i rtogs sgrangs nas: rtsang mar gnas pas mkha' 'gro'i bar chad med: 'bring gi bar pa chags pa sbangs gyur kyang : 'dod pa'i dbang gis rang bzhin 'dzag pa mang 2 de la srung ba med na bar chad 'byung :'bring gi tha ma srung cha'i don ma shesaca ma mo thams cad g.yel zhing dngos grub nyams: de la bsten par gnas pa'i cho ga dgos: tha ma'i dang bo pho mo'i 'brel ma chod:mkha' 'gro'i bka'i chad pa 'bebs par 'gyur:de la dus bzang khrims la gnas par bya: tha ma'i bar pa pho morto chags pa can:rang rgyud 'khrig sems chims pa med pa la: mkha' 'gro mang po khros nas srog la rgol: de la gnyen po bskyed la khrims bsrung dgos: tha ma'i 'og ma rme nal smad 'tshong rigs:bag med spyod pa byed na ma mo 'khrugs:yul de nad kyis 'gengs pas mtha' la skrod: gang zag phal pa thams cad rin chen lnga: mu tig mchan khyang g.yon du btags par bya: gnas der 'gro dus pho mo sde rigs dbye2 khye'u gtsang mas skye bo'i lam sna drangs: bu mo gtsang mas bud med lam sna drangs: 'di yis lam gyi bar chad zhi bar 'gyur:gnas der slebs nas dus khrims gnas khrims srungs:khyim pa'i srid kyang dus bzang bsrungs nas kyang : gab dang tshod ni mkhas na bkra 60

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig leñtsa drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/zhis 'gyur: khyad par che po'i rla ba la: pho mo thams cad phye ma khrims srungs shig: de ltar byas pas tshe 'dir bsam pa 'grub: phyi ma ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bral: zhes gsungs so: mkha' 'gro ma thig le'i lung le'u drug pa'o:shin tu legs so:lhazabe⑫chagarga2tarketa77lhade nas chos kyi rgyal po brgyad kyi lung rtags bka' bgros pas: gnas 'dir sgrib pa ma dag pa'i ye shes mi bgrod:sdig pa can la bar chad 'byung ngo : snyigs ma'i sems can mi dge ba'i gzugs can yin pas: dus la bab pa'i tshe: gnas 'dir ma thar ba la bde zhing skyid pa'i go skabs mi 'dug pas: snga ma'i sgrib pa spangs nas phyi ma'i byed pa'i dam bca' zhus pa kun la: sgrib pa yong ba'i lung bstan la:gnas 'dir 'jug pa'i thabs bstan te: skye bo thams cad dung bar bya bsam nas: dge ba thabs kyi lung 'di bzhad do:e ma bod khams phyi mar gnas 'dir 'jug pa'i tshe: chos kyi blon po rnams kyi gtam la nyon: sdig pa ma spangs bde ba'i gnas mi bgrod: gsang sngags dbang thob dam :yon gsum nyams dang : rab tu byung nas rtsa bzhi sngom nyams dang : phung byed las log mtshams med sdig spyad dang : las ngan nye drung bsad pa rme pho dang : pha ma bu dang ming sring nal spyad la: sa bon me yis 'tshig pa lta bu ste: bde chen sbas pa'i yul du mi thar ro: dam tshig ya bral nyam/sa pa'i sngags pa de: bzhags chen sbyin sreg brgya rtsa byas na thar: snom pa so sor 161

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/zhor nyams pa'i btsun pa de: bsten gnas bsrung zhing bslab bya skyar na phan:sdig can mi de bsad pas mi drong de: tsha tsha brgya btab mchod rten mi gang bzhengs: srog blu brgya ston mdo sde tshar gcig bklags: de ltar mi gsod grangs la 'gyur byang brtsi: phyin chad srog gi sdom pa blangs na thar: khyim mdzes sde rigs gcig pa'i rme pho byas: mchod rten mi rang gzugs tshad nyer gcig bzhengs: bsnyung gnas brgya rtsa bsrungs na thar bar 'gyur:bsrung ba'i bud med drug la nal spyad dang : rgyal po ya rabs smad pa'i nal byas na: rgyal po'i mdo bcu tshar stong bklags na thar: rab byung bsnyen gnas bsrungs la nal byas na: bsnyung gnas brgya rtsa man chad bsrungs na thar: ming sring bu mo la sogs 'phangs pa yis: bu mo pha spun tsha la nal spyad pas: rdo rje rnam 'joms bsgrub pa brgya rtsa'i khrus: mchod rten mi gang bzhengs na thar bar 'gyur: khyim pa bdag po can la nal byas na: gang sa chen sum cu 'dus pa'i chu slangs nas: sgrib pa sbyong ba'i gzungs dang dag byed khrus: sbel rims brgya rtsas sbyangs na thar bar 'gyur: gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten glegs bam dang : rtsa brgyad khong dang pha ma rab byung drung : chags pa'i gnas min spyad na bsnyen gnas bdun: gnas mal gcig tu bsrungs na thar bar 'gyur: bu mo gtsang ma dang ni nad ma dang :bu chung skye ka zho 'thung can la sogs: gzhan de ma dad bzhin du nal sbyad na: sku gdung khru re bzhengs nas phyag 'tshal stong : sko+or ba stong dang yi rge 162

sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig leñtsa drug pa lde mig 'khrul gyi dgu skor/drug ma stong : ma yengs dag par byas na thar bar 'gyur: dam tshig zur nyams bla ma'i gzungs ma dang : rdo rje mched la log lta skyes pa yi: yid sbyod ngan par ltas nas rlung sems sbang : dbang thob lha'i bsnyen pa rgyun bcad dang : gsang ba'i do dam bstod ra bya sems byas: de la gsang sngags dkyil 'khor bzhengs: bla ma gzungs dang mched de gdung sems kyis:dngos dang yid kyis spyan drangs bzhags par bya:longs spyod ci yod dbul zhing bskang ngo bya: bzlas pa chag na snying po brgya rtsas bskang : gsang ba'i sbyod pa rtsings pa tshogs kyis bskang : phyi ma'i dam bca' ma nyams thub na thar: 'dul khrims slad ma mi dbul zhing bskong bya: kha 'am bzhang bar pho mtshan bcug pa dang : rang gi 'chang par 'dod pa'i myangs pa dang :bud med lus la reg pas 'dod log nye: bya dang dud 'gro phal pa grog sbrur dang : ri dwags yung dwags bsad pas sro ga gcod nye: tshong dang khe bogs byas pas rku la nye:rmi lam bden par smra dang bre mo yi:rdzun gyi nyes pa yin te 'dul/ khrims dmad: de la bsten pa tshar bdun byas pas thar:bya pa nya pa rngon pa zha pa bzhi: bsten gnas brgya rtsa rnam 'joms gzungs chog bya: mdo sde tshar gcig bklag na thar bar 'gyur: jag pa rkun ma rang gi lus tshad kyi: rdo chen bcu gsum 'dom brgya'i sa nas blangs: de yi gzhi byas mchod rten chen po bzhengs: de yi/ drung du sgrib sbyong grezungs tshar brgya:phyas nga/nga skor ba stong dang sbyin gtong bya: das pa'i sems kyis sgrub na 16)

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/thar bar 'gyur: lag rme rang gi dud 'gro gsod pa rnams: rang gi theg thang sa rdo 'khur pa re: dud 'gro chung chung re la blangs bar bya: chen po rnams la bcu bcu blangs nas kyang : zam 'phrang chen po gso ba'i rgyu la bzhag: dud 'gro re la mdo sna tshar re bklags: de ltar byas na sbas pa'i yul du thar: byi pho dang ni bud med smad 'tshong ma: 'dod log drangs med spyad pa'i rigs rnams ni: mdza' bzhug de la rdo chen khur po re: 'dom bdun thad nas blangs nas gom gsum du: tho chen brtsigs zhing bsnyen gnas bdun gsum srungs: lung pa bcu gsum gzhung gi chu bcus nas:gangs chen bcu gsum mthong sar khrus nas dbyungs: de ltar byas pas sbas pa'i yul du thar:byi pho byi mo lan drangs nyung spyad kyang :yul la grib kyis phog nas bar chad stong : rdo chen thegs tshad grangs kyi rdo rtsigs la:bsten gnas khrus chog tshar gcig byas pas thar: de 'dra'i skyon gyis ma gos mi rnams kyang : sdig sbyong sgri ba sel khrus nas dag par sbyangs: phyi ma mi dge sdig byed sems kyis spangs:gnas chen de ru 'gro 'am 'dug kyang rung : chos dang mi mthun bsam sgyod thams cad spangs: de ltar byas pa'i mi rnams thabs kyis thar: bsam ngan sdig spyod byed pa'i mi rigs ni:gang du phyin kyang bsam ngan log pas 'tsho: snyigs ma'i las dang chos min spyad pas la na: chos byed thams cad sbas pa'i yul du gshegs: zhes blon po brgyad kyis yig byang byas nas: dus mtha' ma'i sems can las spro64

srus yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lam yig le'u drug pa lde mig 'khyul gyi dgu skor/ma dag pa 'dren pa'i thabs mdzad pa'o: de'i tshe bar thang rin chen gshongs su: gnas chen 'bras mo gzhongs kyi sgo dbye ba'i thabs: lung bdun ces pa'i sdom pa drug gsang ba'i mdzod gsum gab pa'i snying gi lde mig dang bcas pa dkar chag yi ger btab nas: byang sgo la byon te gam thams cad gu ru urgyan gyi gling du bshegs pa'i dus su: byang zang zang gi brag la sbas pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya:rgya:rgya: rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis ston pa'o:6shog ser yang tsha la zhal zhus so: maṅga waṃ:6 me rta 13catsu lo lug rla'i tshes bzhi'i srod la brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i sked pa ste zang zang lha brag lha'i skyed tshal zer ba'i brag phyag nas gter bzhes pa'o//sdu65

༄༅༅//bla ma dgangs pa 'das pa las2ma 'angs lang da shā dzo ri shā bstan gsang ba'i dkar chagabakod pa zhes pa las 'bras ljongs gnas yig zur phyung /7riri na35ri 'itsogra5skulhalhalis na mo ghu ra dhe wa ḍak+kini ༄༅ ri ri rihā:zag mad mtha' bral kan bzang ha ru ka:bad stang zung 'jug bzang ༄ོsa ༄ 'ima' mkha' klang las:sprul pa yang sprul rtsal snang du ma yas:gdul ḍipy-i'o 'angh+rul ༷ra mdzado la phyag 'tshal bstod:snang ba mtha' yaso thugs rjo' 'do zar gyas:nyaṭaṃ mangs snan hūṃm gsal nas thane+e lam mchagaḥm nar mngan sum lham mar snang byaX cang :baXd ༷/'a 'phrang sdus sgraX mdzad khyod la 'dad:spyan ras gzags dbang nya ma' dal rgyas zhang :ya ri ༄ོri 4zhasdu rtsal 3nga 'ad zaX du ba yas:phyags dusdu sna lus ༷na tu khyab gyuḍi pa':lha ya lha mchoX ḍi la gus tram̐g 'ardoX:dra ༷da mtsho glang pad sdong ga 6 sarawongh+ru+o hū+oṃlnge /hū+o+oṃ // do+o / ོ snye da/ rā tre+o /

'bras ljongs gnas yiga'ongs da lta lhang nger ston:bdag 'dra pad+mas dus gsum mngon par baji+od:e ma: stong khams 'jig rten phyi nang snod bcud kun: chags 'jig gnas stong 'gyur lngog dpag tu med: chu gnyer smig rgyu g.yo ba ji bzhin du: sna tshogs snang phyir baji+od pas mtha' klas kyang : gdul bya rjes 'jug mos blos khrid tshul du: gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i: zab don bka' stsal 'dir 'jug sbro bya'i phyir: ma 'ongs lung bstan gsang ba'i dkar chag bkod: oṃ ā:hūm̐ hri: rang byung pad+ma zhes byar grags pa nga :sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas thugs las rdol: thugs rje sbyan ras gzigs dbang gsung las sprul: mkha' 'gro yongs kyi ming po dpa' bo'i rgyal:dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las bdag:mnyam med kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen po: sprul pa'i skur snang thugs rje chen po lngan: gang la gang 'dul 'grwo ba'i don ched du: sems can kun gyi re 'dod yid bzhin skong :zhub phyogs o rgyan mtsho gling pad sdong las:spre'u lo spre'u zla'i tshes bcu nyi sh-ir tshe: sku bltams 'gro ba rnams kyi dpal du zhar: rgya gar phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dbus dang lngar: sbyod pa skyong zhing dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes: ma ra ti ka bal yul yang le shod: ma ga rak+ta la sogs grub gnas 'grims: sgrub pa mthar phyin tshe yi dngos grub thob:bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan dang : skye ba yang thog smon lam 'brel pa'i mthus: bod khams kha ba can gyi ljongs su 'ong : sa gzhi byin 167

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/brlabs lha 'dre dam la btags: gangs ri g.ya' ri spang ri nags khrod dang :rdza ri grog po thang chen lung pa'i sul: thams cad thebs kyis mnan nas sgrub pa bgyis: phyi rabs don phyir bod khams sa phyogs 'dir:gter kha chen po brgya dang rtsa brgyad sbas: thugs gter lnga dang gces pa'i gter chen brgyad: gsang ba'i gter kha chen po bcu gsum sbas: mnga' bdag rgyal po'i bla gter nyer gcig sbas: sngags btsun rnams kyi bla gter nyer lnga sbas: mo btsun yongs kyi bla gter bcu drug sbas: skyes pa yongs kyi bla gter bco brgyad sprus: khyad par yang gter chen po dgu ru sbas: 'dzam gling sa yi bcud gter bzhi ru sbas: bod 'bangs spyi la dgos pa'i bcud gter sbas: 'don du mi thub bcud kyi gter lnga sbas:cis kyang 'don par bsngags pa'i gter lnga sbas: de ltar spyi dang bye brag khyad par gyi:kha byang yod pa'i gter kha bye ba sbas:kha byang ma btab gter ni dung phyur sbas:bod khams kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir:lha 'dre dam btags sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs: gter rnams rgyas btab smon lam btab nas bzhag: mnga' ris bod 'dir ma 'ongs dus kyi mthar: mtha' mi dbus gtibs yul 'chug 'byung bas na: 'bros lam khung sgo sbas yul sa mig bstan: bgrod pa'i lam yig phyi nang gsang sogs dang : kha byang snying byang lde mig spar khab sogs: gang la gang dgos de la de dgos bzhag: kun kyang legs par chos la bkod pa lags: snga phyi bar gsum 168

'bras ljongs gnas yigadus tshigs gang la yang : mnga' ris bod la kho bo bka' drin che: bka' sdun dran mdzod mnga' bdag yab sras rje: phyi rabs rjes 'jug tha tshig go bar mdzod: ye shes mtsho rgyal yi ge ris su bris: smon lam phyi tshigs gsang ba'i gter du sbos:sa ma yā:rgya rgyargya:dpal bsam yas lhun gyi grub pa'i pho brang : bkra shis brag dmar gyi 'og: mkhas btsun mang pos zhabs kyis bcags pa'i sa: bod stong sde thams cad kyi 'tshogs ra: pho brang rim brtsegs rnam par rgyal ba lta bu:chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan yab sras bzhugs pa la: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dam pa'i chos mang la rgya che bar bka' sul: bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su: dam pa chos kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad cing : khyad par du bla med sting po don gyi mthar thug: dgongs pa spo+ongs rdzogs gnang ba'i tshe: slob dpon nyid kyis thog drangs pa'i bla yi mchod gnas rnams dang : mnga' bdag rjes thog drangs pa'i rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga ste: de yang rje mnga' bdag nyid dang : rlang dpal gyi seng ge dang : pa gor be ro tsa na dang : rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po dang : gahūṃbs nam mkha'i snying po dang : gnyag dzñā na ku ma ra dang : ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang : sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms dang : sba ye shes dbyangs dang : sog po dpal gyi ye shes dang :zhang sna nam ye shes dang : mkhan chen dpal gyi dbang phyug dang : 'dan ma 169

mkha' rje(da 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rtse mang dang : mchan bu ka ba dpal brtsegs dang : shud bu dpal gyi seng ge dang : 'bre rgyal ba'i blo gros dang : lo khye'u chung ba dang : dran pa nam mkha' dang : la sum rgyal ba byang chub dang : 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug dang : rma rin chen mchog dang : gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che dang : lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje dbang phyug dang : lang 'gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang : mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal dang : gzhan yang las dang skal bar ldan pa'i skyes bu pho mo mang po 'dus pa'i tshe na: sgrub gnas mchims phu dre gu dge 'ur: bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sgrub pa chen po mdzod pa'i dgyes ston gyi dus la bab pa'i tshe: slob dpon chen po ni dar chen gab tse dgu brtsegs kyi steng du bzhugs: za 'og gi smug ber sku la gsol: spyan gzigs kyi longs spyod dpag tu med pa sbyan sngar baspoms:gser skyogs rin po che phra men gyis sprus pa'i nang : 'bras chang dang rgun chang gis bkang ba'i nang du bdud rtsi chen po'i kha tshar btab nas phyag tu phul zhing drangs: dgyes pa'i zhabs 'bring du ma byas zhing : 'dus pa'i mched lcam thams cad kyis: mos gus kyi gdung ba gdeng nas bskyed de:so sos chigs su bcad pa'i bstod pa re re gsol ba btab: lha phyag gyang 'gyel ba ltar 'tshal zhing : sku drung du pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis 'khod nas: thog mar mnga' bdag nyid kyis gdung rabs la sogs pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi yig chung zhus: de nas rim pa ltar gtsug lag khang kro70

'bras ljongs gnas yigadang dben ris kyi gnas lugs zhus: khyad par du dgongs 'dus man ngag sting po gser gyi yang zhun du bkol ba: rgyud snying man ngag thams cad kyi bcud phyung ba: 'gag dril ba: gnad sdeb pa: sngon chad zhal du ma byung ba'i man ngag:thugs kyi dpal be'u nas dgongs:mgul gyi bum pa nas 'dril:ljags kyi pad+ma nas bkram:dung gi tshems bar nas bzhar:gsung gi gdangs la bskyon nas yongs su rdzogs par gnang zhing : slob dpon gyi zhal nas: yongs su 'tshogs pa'i dad lngan pho mo rnams: bskal par tshogs bsags pa dang 'phrad: las 'phro rje yi srid la 'khod: bka' gsang yang dag chos dang mjal: sgo gsum gnad kyi don dang lngan: kun kyang dge bar mchis mod kyang : 'dus byas chos rnams mi rtag chos: skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrug: las 'bras chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra: tshe 'di rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin: yun du mi rtag myur du 'jig: longs spyod rtsi thog rgyas pa 'dra:dus kyi g.yo pas gang stongs che:'du tshogs tshong 'dus mgron po bzhin: gtan du 'grogs pa'i go skabs sped: skyid sdug dar tsam yud tsam yin: rtag par gyur pa skad cig med: gzhon pa sos ka'i me tog bzhin: rim gyis 'gyur ba'i chos can yin: rgyan 'phyor bar snang 'ja' ris bzhin: legs legs 'dra zhing yal ba'i rgyu: dar ba ljon shing 'dab rgyas bzhin: blo gtad bya rgyu cung zad med: rgas pa snum zad mar spe 'dra:yun du mi gnas myur du 'chi: gnyen 'dun grogs bshes mang 'dzom spro71

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/yang : shing kha'i bya tshogs bzhin du gyes: dgra gnyen nga khyod chags sdang yang : rang gzhan ngan song 'phen pa'i rgyu: rgyal srid chab dul phung po bzhin: nam yang brtan par mi 'gyur gyi: rang re spo+on mchod 'dir 'tshogs dang :dpon slob mched grogs thams cad kyang :deng sang gnas skabs yud tsam las: rtag tu gser zhal ga la 'dzo+om: bdag gis ji ltar bsgos pa bzhin: kun kyang rang mthun chos la spyod: tshe 'dir dal 'byor thob dus su: sgo gsum don yod ma bsgrubs na: 'chi khar 'gyod tsa phyis pa yin: bar dor las kyi gshed ma yis: dge sdig so mtshams 'byed pa'i dus: nges pa'i gding chen thob pa gces: tshe 'dir btsan sa ma zin na: phyi ma gar 'gro mi shes pas: las rlung nag pos bskyod tsa na:rang dbang rang la mi che zhing : las dbang gtso che rigs drug 'khor: de bas dran bsam da dung thong : mnga' bdag la sogs 'dir 'khod rnams:gtan srid 'dun ma da res bsgrub: tshe 'dir mngon zhen ma che mdzod: smon lam dag kyang rgya cher thob: nges par snying phur gdab par 'tshal: da lta 'dir 'brel las smon gyis:yong ye bstan pa'i dus zhabs su:smon lam dag pa'i mched rnams kyang : dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor gral la 'khod:bka' gsang gces 'dzin dran par mdzod: ces gdams pa dang : mnga' bdag bzhengs te: nyid kyi bla g.yu zla 'od thod dkar phyag tu phul zhing :phyag 'tshal gus pa'i tshul gyis zhus pa:spro72

'bras ljongs gnas yiga.e ma ho: kun mkhyen ma hā gu ru rin po che: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i+o sku:ོ phyi nang sde sno+od ma lus 'dus pa'i+o gsung :ོkun bzang thugs mchag stang khams kha la bsgyur: bdag sags 'gra rnams brtse bas rjes su gzung : mnga' ris bod khams kha ba can ljongs 'dir: sngon chad dam chos ma dar mun pa'i gling : da dus dgongs pas yongs bzung sangs rgyas zhing : chos sbyod bcu sogs bstan pa dar zhing rgyas: khyad par rmad byung zab khyad thang mar brdal: don gyi bcud phur dgongs 'dus bka' gsang phyes: bka' drin 'khor med thabs mkhas thugs rje'i bdag: bdag sogs 'gro ba rmongs par gyur rnams dang : ma 'ongs rjes 'jug phyi chis don slad du: legs nyes 'byung tshul do gal gyur pa rnams: gtan la dbab pa'i mdo byang lung bstan 'tshal: khyed ni dus gsum ma bsgribs sa ler gzigs: spyi dang bye brag khyad par la sogs pa: bstan pa'i 'phel 'grib gtsug lag dar rgud dang : mnga' ris rgyal khams ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul: bzang ngan legs nyes gtan la dbab tu gsol: zhes zhu ba gsol zhing : gdung shugs phul bas:slob dpon nyid sku mi 'gyur ba ri rgyal lhun po lta bur gzengs bstod: gsung 'gag med tshangs pa'i dbyangs su gdangs bskyed: thugs skye med rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes mnyam par bzhag nas: dal cig dgongs pa la bzhugs nas gsungs pa:173

mkha' sbyod 'bras yo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/e ma ho:mnga' bdag chos rgyal byang chub sems dang ldan:yab mes mdzad srol can gyi brgyud 'dzin cing 2 mi yi lus la rgyal ba'i dgongs pa can:srid 'bangs sde skor dkar po'i chos la bkod:bstan pa'i srog shing rgya gar gsang mdzod nas: lo paṇa sbyan drangs dam chos mang po bsgyur:gtsug lag khang rten sku gsung thugs mchog bzhengs: sbyin bdag tshangs rgyal 6) ma grags mtha' yas: khyad bzhed yab sras chos srid 'bangs skor dang : slad kyi don phyir zhu don phul ba legs: bdag kyang o rgyan zhing du 'gro sems kyang : mnga' bdag yab sras sri zhu che ba dang : skye sngon las 'phro smon lam la brten nas: da dung cung zad yab sras bla mchod bgyid: zhu don bka' mchid snga phyi bar gsum gyi: rgyu mtshan dkar chag par yang btab mchis kyang : rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams kyi don ched dang : yab sras zhal ngo bstan sde'i don dam dang : dgos pa'i bslab bya dus chigs brjod par bya: 'dan ma rtse mangs mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: ye shes mtsho rgyal zin ris thim la thob: ces pas mnga' bdag nyid kyis zhus pas: bstan pa spyi'i lung byang spar khab dang : thang yig bsdus pa gsungs:sras kyis zhus pas:gang zag sgos kyi lung byang dang :bslab bya'i zhal gangams gsungs:jo mos zhus pas:sdom byang gnas skabs zin nyig gi lung bstan dang : kha byang gsungs: ga'/na yang so so rang rang gi skye rgyud 174

'bras ljongs gnas yiga'adas ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi rgyu mtshan zhus pas: thad thad du thams cad la phyi tshigs kyi lung bstan dang : bka'i rgya nan rnams rim par gsungs: mdor na gang la gang 'dul de la der gyi lung bstan sdom byang me long gsal byed dang mtshungs par gnang zhing : rtse mangs kyis bzung nas:mtsho rgyal gyis yi ger btab pa'o: sa ma yā: dhathim:8 zhes dang /phyi snod kyi 'jig rten ji ltar chags tshul/dbyin ji'i sgo+og grangs 7rngu—8 gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i (1340—spro396) bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi chos skor bzhugs so/ /pod cha/ ṣā56/15smodzisku khyismo 50ba3k+ṣe 10jithalngakau 541 63satha(0smomi spro972 ta/tha327sgu/dz+wa14〉1bapyib lngasmo55batha7'i6 //0/5ba rdu49 99 65—77'bras blon 7mi rje 'ba' nyag a thing gi dpe khongs su bzhugs pa'i 'og min mtshur phu'i dpe rnying / bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i lung bstan bka' rgya'i skor/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma/dbu med bris rnying zhog ldeb 27shaṃbazhugs pa dang /bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: ma 'ongs lung bstan gsang ba'i dkar chag bkod pa'i ༷/nga bstan bka' rgya zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 256//5stukhusku6k+ṣiṃ5'irdu7lngane6to7(5rngub ji ba1ma dzu3ba2(06 51khri k+ṣe 1983 'bras ljongs rnam rtse dgon pa'i dpe khongs bzhugs pa dbu med bris rnying ma phyir byas pa'i dbyin ji'i sgo+og grangs 74rngubazhugs pa/bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: lung bstan bka' rgya'i skor bzhugs snyo: bla ma dgongs 'dus/ sangs rgyas gling pa/ pod cha/ 'di'i ma phyi ni lho 'brug mtshams brag dgon pa'i yin/256sdi15'ingapu6tokhopyi07759311spu5'iXji16shwasmo1①rduk+ṣiṃ stuto1khu'i51(ba1ji/khu 2'ang0 2'i5(3bokro981dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 177—7rngu2bar bzhugs pa rnams la'ang zhib bsdu ra yang ba zhu lags/spro75

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/nang bcud kyi sems can rnams grub tshul/dbyin ji'i shog grangs rngo7—'khor los sgyur rgyal byon tshul/dbyin ji'i shog grangs lnga3wabade gshegs rgyal ba phyon tshul/dbyin ji'i sgo+og grangs lnga7—phyi nang theg pa gsungs tshul/dbyen ji'i shog grangs ༅cadaphyi nang theg pa gsum zhu ba po dang sdud pa po ji ltar byon pa'i rim pa/ dbyin ji'i sgo+og grangs 1༷2—bod yul du chos rgyal byon tshul/dbyin ji'i shog grangs 1༷7—lo paṇa skyes mchog byon tshul/dbyin ji'i shog grangs 114—bod du dam chos dar tshul/dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 117—dbang gi chu bo bab tshul/dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 11cadabod du bab tshul/dbyin ji'i shog grangs 117—sngags 'chang grub thob byon tshul/dbyin ji'i shog grangs 127—rgyal rgyud thugs dam bzhengs tshul/dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 12ji——rgyal rgyud gtsug lag khang brtsigs tshul/dbyin ji'i shog grangs 141—grong khyer bang so brtsigs tshul/dbyin ji'i shog grangs 143—lha khang ji ltar bzhengs tshul/dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 147—sku mkhar ji ltar brtsibs tshul/dbyin ji'i sh-i+og grangs 14cadache rtags rdo ring bslang tshul/dbyin ji'i sgo+og grangs 172—ma 'ongs nor skal sbas tshul/dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 173—176

'bras ljongs gnas yigabaka' yi nan thag bsdam pa/dbyin ji'i zhog grangs 14rngu—phyi rabs kyi sngags 'chang la man ngag rgyas gdab tshul/dbyin ji'i shog grangs 23cadam 'ongs pa'i dus su ji ltar 'byung ba rnams sa/sungs pa/dbyen ji'i shog grangs 27cad slob dbe+e3 chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas skye 'chi bgres rgud dang bral ba:ye shes mchog gi dngos grub: thun mong las kyi dngos grub: 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub: 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes shing snang srid dbang du 'dus pa: lha srin bran du 'khol ba: 'gro rnams bde la 'khod pa:sprul pa dpag med 'gyed pa: rdzu 'phrul du mar ston pa: dus gsum sa ler gzigs pa: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad 'dus pa'i gtso mchog he ru ka chen ngo/ nyid la: bdag 'dra kho mo mtsho rgyal las kyi dbang gis lus skye dam/na du sanas kyang sems g.yo sgyu brol zog dang bral bas: dad pa mos gus/ kyi sri zhu bskyed de: slob dpon la snang srid gser g.yur gyur nas: zas nor gyi mngon zhen med kyang : bdag rang bsod nams bsag pa'i slad du: rang gi lus rgyan gser ga/yu'i lan tsar bkrol te phul zhing :hrī: dus gsum/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngori+o bo nyid: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dpal: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gnas rin po che: rdo rje pad+ma 'byung gnas khu+ong phyag 'tshal: 'dzad be da dasongs pa'i klong nas rang byung ba: dus sa/sum ma bsgribs legs/ nyes sa ler gzigs: 'gro ba'i don phyir sang la gang 'dul gyi: so sor lung byang bka' nan legs par gnang :

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ma 'ongs 'gro don sbyod par smon lam btab: gsang chigo rjen par bka' yi nan thag bsdams: slad don yi ger bris zhes rjes su gnang : phyi ma'i don dgongs gter du sbed ces na: ma 'ongs dus der gnas skabs zin tig rtags: phyi nang 'byung ba'i dar rgud ji lta bu: 'gro ba rnams kyi skyid sdug legs nyes ci: ston pa'i zhal tshab skyes mchog ji ltar 'byon: bstan pa dam chos rin chen ji ltar dar: khyad par yang zab dgongs 'dus spyod pa'i tshe: sprul pa yang sprul gang zag khyad par can: 'dra min log spyod bdud sprul ji ltar 'byung : de dag dbye ba khyad par gang gis 'byed: bstan pa 'phel sdud la sogs dus rtags rnams: bzang ngan legs nyes 'byung tshul gsung du gsol: ces gnas skabs zin tig dus: rtags kyi lung byang zhus pas:gsungs pa:kye ma nyon cig dad ldan mkhar chen bza': dus rtags phyi nang 'byung ba'i dar rgyud dang : 'gro ba'i skyid sdug legs nyes la sogs pa:bstan pa 'phel sdud bzhad kyis yid la zungs: da dus bskal bzang bstan pa dar lags kyang : lan gcig ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: khyad par yang zab dgongs 'dus spyod pa'i tshe: phyi nang snod bcud g.yo 'khrug sna tshogs 'byung : 'byung ba g.yo 'khrug mi snyoms sgang gzhongs che: dus min sa 'tshub rlung dmar kun tu 'phyo:than char mi snyoms tsha grang sgang gshongs byed:lo tog smin mgyogs sog rtser sbrang bab 'dra: skye bong chung zhing 'bru bcud kro78

'bras ljongs gnas yigazhin tu ngan: btsa' sad ser sogs lo dgra du mas 'joms: sa bcud nyams rtags pha mes dur rdol zhing : 'dres dkrug gter rkun sa bcud gter rnams rdol: de sogs 'byungo ba'i g.yo 'khrug bsam mi khyab: 'gro ba rnams kyang sdug bsngal las la spyad: bza' btung mtha' stang las ngan sdig zas dar: skyems phang bdud rtsi chang gi rtus pa nyamasaca bcud med ham skyur 'gong po'i kha chu 'thung : 'abhu mchog yid bzhin zas kyi bcud nyams shing :ma rabs g.yung zas bra sran la nyung la:zas mchog snying por byed cing kun gyis spyod:'o ma yod kyang rtsi mar snum zhag me+ed:bza' btung bcud nyams rus zhag sdor du 'debs: mtha' gzhug sbang rtsir bra skogs phum ma 'gam: sa za rdo mur chu la dur 'thung byed: gos kyi mtha' stongs snga stags rnam gsum 'byung : skra yi sad bu 'phying ris lwa ba byed: bi'u lpags skam po 'phyor chas byed pa 'byung : nad kyi stobs che sman gyi zhus pa chung : mi rnams nyon mongs 'dod chags mai ltar 'bar: mi 'phel che zhing bzang ngan skyon can mang : bza' btung bcud me+ed mi gtsang chu ser mang :bkrag med ham skya lus la bag dul chags: yid du mi 'ong dad me+ed 'dre sbyod byed:tshe thung phal cher dus min 'chi bar byed:bstan pa nyams pa'i snga rtags gter chos sbyod: gter chos nyams rtags gter min gter 'dras bslu: 'gro ba phal cher log pa'i lam la 'khod: lha cha'i skad dang gos kyi tshos mdog nyams: btsun pas skya chas mtshon la rgyan cha byed: skya bos spro79

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/btsun chas jag tshong rku khram dar: bka' gdams dge bshes jo gdan hor 'drar 'babs: bstan pa'i tshul 'jig gtsug lag phyugs kyis 'gengs:ri khrod dben gnas ri dwags ling pas 'dzin: dgon stong ri sul rkun tshang wa spyang 'phyo:mchod cha bzhig bcom lho mon tshong dus 'grim:mchod cha drab bzhig mo btsun 'phyor chas byed: dkor bdag khros pas yul khams bkra mi zhis: sdig can tshe ring chos byed sku tshe thung : chos byed mi bkur zog po zog mo bkur: de sogs las ngan mi rung sna tshogs dar: bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i skyes bu rnams: 'gro don mi spyod zhing khams phyogs phyogs gshegs: chos spyod bcu yi bstan pa nyams par 'gyur: kye: rigs lngan gyi mtsho rgyal zab chos 'di dag ni: tshe lo drug cu kha ral gyi gzhug: lnga bcu kha ral gyi dang po la babs pa'i tshe: gter nas 'byin par 'gyur ro:lnga bcu kha ral gyi dus dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur te:de yang bka' ma rnams tshong dus kyi 'o ma bzhin 'chal zhing : hūṃb pa la nye ba'i dus dar bar 'gyur ba yang : gter du bzhugs pa'i bka' la lhad dang sel ma zhugs pas:sgrub thag nye: byin rlabs che: dngos grub myur ba la so/gas pa yon tan dpag tu med kyang : mthar 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams pa dang :bdud kyi dbang du song nas:gang zag la skur pa 'debs shing :chos la log par lta: bdud kyi spu+o ba bskyed cing shes pa bsgyur ba'i g.yo rgyu zol zog can mang pos bstan pa skyong bar byed de: de yang sngon bcom ldan 'das 8du

'bras ljongs gnas yigadang : bdud hūṃs pa 'gran pa'i dus su: bdud kyi sde dpyang bcas pham par byas pas: bdud rnams kyis shukya'i bstan pa'i tha ma la bab pa'i tshe:thams cad bdag cag gi dbang du 'dus nas log pa'i lam la 'khod par gyur cig: go'u ta ma'i khrims seng ge'i khog pa 'bus g.yeng pa ltar gyur cig: kho rang gi 'khor rnams kyis kho rang gi bstan pa brlags par gyur cig sogs kyi smon lam btab pa'i mthu dang :deng sang gi sdig blon rnams kyis chos la gnag che ba'i las sna tshogs byas pa'i rgyu rkyen la brten nas:ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus lnga brgya tha ma la babs pa'i tshe:bdud kyi sprul pa dang yang sprul 'gyed de: la la ni mngon gsum du 'byung zhing bstan pa la thog rdzis byed pa dang : la la ni nang pa'i tshul: mkhan po dang : slob dpon dang :bla ma dang :sgom chen dang : dge bshes dang :sngags pa dang : rnal 'byor pa dang :zhig po dang :rtogs lngan dang : gter ston dang : dge sbyong dang : dge tshul dang : rigs byed mkhan gyi tshul du sbrul: la la ni khrims bdag dang : rgyal po dang :blon po dang :mi chen dang : mi dpon dang : gtso bo dang :skyes pa dang :bud med dang :pha dang :ma dang :phya zhu dang :mdza' bshes dang :grogs po dang :slob ma dang :'khor 'bangs dang :bran khol dang :tha mal gyi tshul du sprul:la la ni zas nor longs spyod la sogs par sbrul: la la ni mo ma dang : mngon shes mkhan la sogs par sprul nas: cha lugs dang rnam 'gyur du mas bstan pa bsnub cing : 'gro ba rnams log 181

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/pa'i lam la 'khod par byed de:de rnams tha dad du slu byed kyi spyod pa:tshul zhis zhis 'dra ba:sbyod pa legs legs 'dra ba:sbyod tshul bzang bzang 'du ba2 khrims chags chags 'dra ba: bsod nams dang snyan grags che che 'dra ba: grub po thob thob 'dra ba: sku btsun btsun 'dra ba: mngon zhen chung chung 'dra ba la sags pas 'gra ba bslu ba 'byung : khyad par du bstan zhabs su gter chos dar ba la brten nas: bdud dang bdud kyi rigs kyi lha dang :bdud kyis spu+o ba bskyed pa dang : bdud kyis shes pa bsgyur ba 'ga' zhig:nga min nga 'dra'i chas su zhugs nas nga'i bstan pa brlag par byed de: de dag zhib mor dbyad pas:sngar gyi mdo rgyud dang :lung rigs mi mthun pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum skyong zhing :bka' me+ed kyi rdzun dbang bskur ba:lung med kyi rdzun lung sgrogs pa:bka' gter gyi chos rnams dkrugs nas:'dra min gyi yig sna mang po bkod pa: lus ngag gi bya sbyod dor nas: bro shon dang glu gar rol rtsed kyis nyin mtshan dus 'da' bar byed pa: rnam par smin pa la mi 'dzem zhing : bsod nams ye shes kyi tshogs sbel ba la mi brtson pa:nyon mongs chags sred stobs 'byin cing : bud med mang po bsdus nas khrims lngan gyi btsun tshugs 'dul khrims 'dor du 'jug pa:'dul khrims dbang gis 'bog pa: sngags pa rnams yi dam ye shes pa'i bsnyen sgrub yal bar 'dor du 'jug pa: bskyed rdzogs ya bral du ston pa: 'jig rten pa'i 'dre ngan dang : mi ma yin bsgrub tu bcug pas: byin rlabs kyi drod spro82

'bras ljongs gnas yigayal zhing : zhus pa ma thon pas: rdzas ngan sna tshogs bsags nas gtad khram dang phung shig sna tshogs sbyar bas: yul gyi lha 'dre 'khrugs nas bkra mi zhis pa du ma 'byung de dag dang gang 'drel gyi rgyud dkrugs nas chos min gyi spyod pa sna tshogs dar bar 'gyur zhing :bsod nams nyams pa dang :las ngan gyi rnam par smin pa rgyas pa'i mi phal cher de dag gi rjes su 'brang nas: rang dbang med par rjes su 'jug par 'gyur te: de yang thog mar de rnams la thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa skyes te: kho'i rjes su zhugs pas sngar gyi rang tshugs zhor ba: bar du the tshom zos pas sting mi dga': yi ga 'chug: kho'i rjes su 'brang sting mi 'dod: mthar log lta skyes nas bsam ngan gyi sbyor ba mang po dran nas: ngan song gsum la sogs 'og nas 'og tu bye ma'i phad bu kha bye ba ltar 'gro bar 'gyur ro:bstan pa 'dzin skyong sbel ba'i skyes bu yang dag par sprul pa dang yang sprul rnams ni: lta ba lung rigs kyi rgyab mdo rgyud dang mthun cing : chos spyod bcu'i bstan pa 'phel bar byed pa: las bzang ngan shan 'byed cing :rgyu 'bras la 'dzems pa: sems bskyed gsum dang lngan cing byin rlabs che ba: bstan pa'i sngar srol skyong ba: dam chig la gnas pa: sdom pa dang lngan pa: pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi don la spyod pa: ye shes lha'i bsnyen sgrub la 'bad pa:bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs spel ba la brtson pa:rtag tu bla ma dkon mchog mchod cing 'bral med du bsten pa: 'gro ba la byams pa rwa83

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/phyogs ris med pa: sting rje ngang dad brtson che ba: chags sdang 'dod sred chung zhing chos byed bkur ba: sems can gyi don byed pa la skyo dub med pa:g.yo sgyu dang zol zog med pa: phyi'i sbyod yul zhib pa: nang gi lta sgom ma log pa: bar du lus ngag yid gsum nyams len la 'jug pa2 gang 'brel la legs pa'i yon tan 'go ba: lam dman pa dang log pa las skyob pa:'jig rten 'di'i ched 'dzin 'khrul pa dang snang ba la mi bstun nas:bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba la sems pa: lam dmar khrid kyi nyams/ len ston pa'i gnad la mkhas shing : rnam gzhag zhib la rgyud thog tu khel pa la sogs te: mdor na legs pa'i yon tan dang lngan pa: nyes pa'i skyon shes chung ba: bslab pa gsum la gnas pa sha stag ste: de lta bu'i rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su 'jug pas: bskal pa nas bskal par tshogs bsags pa zhig 'tshal te: snyigs dus kyi sems can tshogs ma bsags pa rnams de 'dra'i rjes su mi 'brang gi steng du: de rnams la gshe skur sna tshogs 'debs thing : gsang sngags thun mong ma yin pa'i lta sgom spyod 'bras la skrag sems skye zhing : khyad par du skyes bu dam pa 'gro ba'i don spyod pa: thabs khyad par can gyi spyod tshul gang la gang 'dul du skyong ba rnams la log par lta zhing smra mchu byed pa: slu byed rnyed tshol mkhan mi gtsang ba'i rdzas kyis bkang ba'i bum pa byi dor byas pa lta bu rnams la dad pa dang bkur sti phu dud byed pa 'byung zhing : brtson 'grus log par zhor bas phod khams shin tu sdu84

'bras ljongs gnas yigache: de ltar rnam gzhag zhib mos 'dra min rnams legs par brtag 'tshal te:dus ngan stigs mar phal che ba mgo gang mtho dang :gdong gang bzang :zas nor gyi longs sbyod gang che'i phyogs su 'brang nas chos tshul bzhin spyod pa nyung zhing :sdig pa mi dge ba spyod pa zhin tu mang bar 'byung ngo :de ltar las ngan can rnams kyi don du: ston pa sangs rgyas bcom lngan 'das rnams kyi zhal tshab tu gyur ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams 'byung zhing : bstan pa dam chos dar bar mdzad de: khyad par spong zab dgongs 'dus kyi bstan pa gnas pa'i tshe yang : sprul pa dang yang sprul 'dra min dang bcas pa 'byung bas: zhib mor brtags shing spang blang gi mtshan nyid shes par bya'o: bstan pa de dag kyang 'phel sdud dar rgud res mos su 'byung zhing : mthar lnga bcu kha ral gyi mjug: bzhi bcu kha ral gyi sna zug pa'i tshe na: du ru ka rigs lnga 'byung bar 'gyur te: de yi snga rtags su mi rung pa'i ltas ngan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'byung ba ni: phyi 'byung ba'i g.yo 'khyug 'byung bar 'gyur zhing : skabs su nam mkha'i mdog dmar por gyur nas: de'i mdangs chu la phag pas: chu thams cad kyang khrag mdag tu 'bab pa dang :sa dang bar snang gi khams su 'ur sgra dang thug chom la sogs pa sgra mi snyan pa grags/ pa dang : nyi ma blo ba'i bkrags nyams pa dang : sngon chad med pa'i skar ma mi sdug pa 'char ba dang : bya dang ri dwags kyi spu mdog log cing skad 'gyur ba dang : gcan gzan rnams rab tu rgod cing mi srun gdug 185

mkha' spyod 'bras yo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rtsub che ba dang : dud 'gro gcig la gcig rigs mi mthun par skye pa dang :sngar yod pa'i gangs rnying pa 'jig cing med pa'i sar lhags pa dang : mi rnams pha mes rgan gyis mi dran pa'i bya byed sna tshogs dran pa dang : zhwa gos la sogs pa'i chas rnams 'gyur nas: chos min sna tshogs dar ba dang :mi rta khyi bong la sogs pa rnams kyi sting la 'dre rgod zhugs nas smyo ba dang :kla klo mthar byed dbus su gtibs nas 'grims pa dang : bud me+ed kyi gtso gral 'grims pa dang : gsod gcod rku khram jag 'dral dar ba dang : sku gsung thugs kyi rten mchog gnad du 'khyer zhing nyo tshong byed pa dang :pha spun nang 'khrug 'gyed cing dme sdig mna' za dug g.yos dar ba dang : dpon slob dang rje 'bangs go log pa dang : shākya'i btsun pa la tshul ma yin pa'i chos lugs mang po dar zhing sbyod pa dang : bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen du gsol ba rnams shag rogs srid sde bca' ba dang : sngags btsun rnams dam chig dang : sdom pa mi bsrung bar khrims zhor ba dang : ri brag la sogs do bo gangs btsan rnams la rdzong dang 'thab ra bca' ba ste: de ltar mi rung pa'i ltas nyer gcig rim pas 'byung ba'i rjes su: yul phyogs phyogs nas nad kyi du ru ka zhes nad kyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa:sman gzhung gi dpyad kyis mi khebs pa dar nas mi mang po 'chi ba dang : mtshon cha'i du ru ka zhes rtsod 'khrug dang 'thab rgyag dmag g.yos chen po dar nas: phan tshun gcig gis gcig gsod pa dang : mu ge'i du ru ka zhes lo tog gi skye kro86

'bras ljongs gnas yiga'abyung zhan cing : gang skyes pa yang btsa' sad ser ba la sogs pas 'joms shing : mu ge lhags nas mang po bkres te 'chi ba dang : 'byung ba rtsub 'khrug gi du ru ka zhes: 'byung ba'i chu me rlung la sogs pa rnams kyi byer sdud mi snyoms nas: sgang gshongs chen pos yul khams thams cad mi bde ba dang :nag po bdud kyi du ru ka zhes:mtha' mi rgya sogs pa dang hor 'khrugs pa'i yul 'chug chen po 'byung zhing : kla klo mthar byed bdud kyi cho 'phrul ston par byed de: bzhi bcu kha ral dang : lnga bcu kha ral gyi bar du:kla klo mthar byed lcags pho khyi la yul mgo tshol nas sna 'jug chu pho rta nas rta ltar du rgyugs par byed: me mo glang zhar nas gdug rtsub 'gyed cing :bod khams thams cad la lug khyu la 'phar spyang thebs pa ltar gtor bar byed pa la sogs du ru ka rigs lngas yul khams thams cad 'joms shing : mi'i sa bon tsam las mi lus par 'gyur zhing bstan pa yang sdud par byed do:de dag kyang bskal khug chen po ni ma yin te:de rnams mi 'byung ba dang :bablo+og pa'i thabs dang rten 'bril la brtson par bya'o:de yang snga ltas mi rung ba nyer gcig 'byung ba'i dus nas: thams cad kyi chos khrims dang :thang khrims bka'i khrims legs par bca' ste:ri rgya dang klung rgya legs par btsugs:'chi nges pa rnams kyi srog bslu:mi dge ba mtha' dag spang zhing : dge ba bcu yi bya ba spyad pa la 'bad: btsun pa rnams kyis 'dul khrims bsrung : sngags pa rnams kyis dam chig la 187

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/gnas par bya: gsung rab rnams 'don klog bsgrag: gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten zhig pa gso: tsha tsha gdab: chu gtor ba dang : sngags pa dam chig dang ldan pa rnams 'tshogs nas gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phye: zhi khro'i sgrub pa la sogs sgrub pa chen po rnams bya: ma sring ṭīkli rnams kyi thugs dam bskang zhing gnad nas bskul: snang srid kyi lha 'dre rnams la mdos kyis mchod: dge bsnyen nyer gcig la sogs bod kyi mgur lha: srid pa'i lha rabs bstan ma rnams so so'i mchod rdzas kyis mchod: gtor chen dang zor brdeg: dgra sri'i mnan pa bya: gter ston rnams 'dus nas sa gta' rnams bsdam: nor gter dang dur gter mi 'don par slar gter srung rnams kyi gsol kha bya zhing rgya bsdam: chos gter la rin po che'i gter tshab bzang po gzhug: yul phyogs thams cad du dge ba'i bskul ma bya: ri brag dang lam 'phrang thams cad yi ge drug ma la sogs pa lha'i sting po bri ba dang bkram pa la sogs bya: me tshogs las bzhi'i sgyin sreg la 'bad: chos sde grub gnas thams cad du dge 'dun mang po 'tshogs nas: nyan bshad sgom gsum gyi sde grwa btsugs: yul phyogs phyogs kyi mi chen khrims bdag gtso bo rnams 'tshogs nas sngar gyi yul khrims bzang po rnams bca':bla mchod rnams la bkur sti phu dud bya:mdor na yon mchod thams cad gros chos mthun du spyad cing : bla mchod kyis bstan pa'i bka' khrims rnams bca': yon bdag rnams kyis yul spro88

'bras ljongs gnas yigasde bzang po btsug pa la sogs thams cad 'dun ma chos ldan bsgrubs na:du ru ka la sogs pa nyes pa'i skyon thams cad mi 'byung bar: legs pa'i yon tan thams cad dar zhing rgyas par mchis te: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la babs pa'i tshe: mi rnams rang rang gi sbyod pa ngan pa sna tshogs byed cing : da dus ngan par song ngo zhes skad ngan 'byin par 'gyur te: dus ngan gyi lan rtsa rang la thug pas snying re rje bya thabs med do: 'dun ma spyi rgya'i rlabs chos srid legs par bskyangs na bde zhing skyid la chos dang mthun te: sbyir chos byed pa rnams la mi nyan par rgya gad dang sma mchu byed cing : 'phral gyi bras nor la bltas nas: yun gyi chus srid rlung la bskur bar byed de: des 'dun chus kyi jus mgo nas: bde skyid myu gu sad la bskur ba yin: dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can las ngan gyis mnar ba rnams dus rtags ngan pa ci shar yang sman pa'i spyi tshig la nyan par mi 'gyur bas:chos byed sgrub pa po rnams dang : skal lngan pho mo rnams: dus rtags ngan pa zhar ba'i tshe:sbas pa'i yul chen dang :yul phran dang :rong kha bzhi dang :lung phran dang :ri sul dang : gangs brag dang : nags 'dabs la sogs dben zhing :'tshe dogs med pa'i sa phyogs su bros la bsgrub pa tshul bzhin sbyod cib:yul khrod phal pa bas stong 'gyur gyi bogs che ba'i gnas tswa ri dang :mkhar chu dang :stag tshang dang : bāg dkar til sgro dang : zab bu lung dang :rma skung lung la sogs pa rnams su sod+ku la rtse gcig gis sgrub pa nyams su 81

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/longs zhig: tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgya bar 'gyur ro: mtsho rgyal de ltar gnas skabs kyi zin tig shes par gyis la zin ris su bris zhing : ma 'ongs don slad du gter du sbos zhig:gnas skabs phran bu'i zin tig ni brjod kyis mi lang ste: yi ge'i mtha' las 'das so: du ru ka rigs lnga'i bzlog thabs gzhan ma grub kyang : yul gyi mi chen 'byor lngan gtso bo la sogs pa dad pa can 'tshogs nas: yul phyogs kyi sa bkra bzang sar mchod rten tshad lngan bzhengs pa'i nang du: mtshon cha'i khral bsdus te: tshon skud lnga'i dra bas bcings la rtse mo mthur du bstan te gzhug:'og tu 'byung po 'dre ngan mtha' mi'i mnan pa bya:de la byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas rab gnas bya zhing : skabs su mchod gsol bgyis pas: mtshon gyi bskal pa nyams nas yul phyogs su 'khrug rtsod mi 'byung zhing : mtha' mis yul 'chug khegs par 'gyur ro: yang sman mang po bsdus te bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa bya zhing : sman gyi gong bu mchod rten du bzhugs su gsol nas: rab tu gnas pa dang lngan pas nad kyis 'tshe ba mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro: yang 'bru sna mang po bsdus te: mchod rten du bzhugs pa la sogs sngar ltar byas pas kyang mu ge las grol bar 'gyur ro: yang 'byung ba'i lha mo rnams bzhengs pa'i nang du 'byung ba so so'i 'khor lo dang sa bon: rin chen sman 'bru dang dar sna yang gzhug cing : ri 'phen bzang dpyad legs pa'i rtser gter du sbas nas: bkra shis mnga' 190

'bras ljongs gnas yigagasol rab tu gnas par byas pas kyang : 'byung ba'i g.yos ngan pa zhi nas: 'byung ba thams cad rang sa bzung nas: yul phyogs thams cad bde legs yon tan gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ro: gzhan yang yul phyogs phyogs su chos dang mthun pa'i bca' khrims gang tshugs tshugs bcas pas: de dag gang du byas pa'i yul phyogs rnams dgos skyid rang sar 'byung ba'o: zhes gsungs nas:gnas skabs zin tig gi lung byang zhal ta phyi chig bslab bya bka' yi nan thag dang bcas pa mdzad do:sa ma yā:slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la: mnga' bdag yab yum sras 'khor blon 'bangs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsol pa: kye slob dpon chen po lags: yang ma 'ongs pa'i dus lnga brgya tha ma la babs pa'i tshe: bzang po'i bka' srol rnams zhub cing : ngan pa'i bka' srol dar ba la brten nas: yul phyogs thams cad du bkra mi this pa dang :yul 'chug chen po 'byung zhing :kla klo mthar byed pa sogs pa:rgya sog hor bod thams cad 'khrugs par 'gyur bas: de'i dus su yul che chung sbas pa rnams dang : gnas che chung la sogs par bros la rtse gcig gis sgrub pa gyis: tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur: zhes pa'i bka' nan gsungs lags na: sbas pa'i yul khyad par can che chung rnams dang :gnas che chung khyad par can rnams su bgrod par byed pa'i thabs stsal du gsol:zhes zhus pas:gsungs pa:spro91

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/kye dad pa dang lngan pa'i rje 'bangs yab yum sras 'khor thams cad nyon cig: de ltar gnas khyad par can rnams bgrod par byed pa'i thabs khyad par can du brjod par bgyid do: zhes gsungs nas: ma 'ongs pa'i sems can spru+o ba bskyed pa la dgongs nas kha byang : de dag tu bgrod pa la dgongs nas lam yig: de dag tu gnas zhing rtse gcig tu sgrub pa byed pa rnams/ la dgongs nas zhal gdams bslab bya:de'i dus kyi cha rkyen yo byad la dgongs nas gang la gang dgos kyi gter kha sbas pa: so sor bka' yi nan thag dang bcas pa gnang ba las: sbro ba skyed pa'i kha byang rnams snga thog tu dgongs nas gter kha dang por bstsal zhing : 'dir lam yig bslab bya zhal gdams gter byang lde mig rnams bka' stsal pa'i thog mar sbas pa'i yul chen po: bar yul rin chen 'bras mo gar+shangs kyi lam yig la sogs pa gsungs pa ni: 'di ltar kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su phyogs bzhir sbas pa'i gnas yul chen po bzhi: mtshams ba'ir yul phran bzhi la sogs pa yod de: shar phyogs su tsā ri gangs kyi ra ba: lhor bal yul gangs kyi ra ba: zhub tu la phyi gangs kyi ra ba: byang du gnod sbyin gangs kyi ra ba:mtshams bzhir yul phran bzhi ni:shar lho rgyal gyi mkhan pa lung :lho hūṃb tu dpal gyi gra phu lung :hūṃb byang du dpal gyi 'jag ma lung :byang zhar du skyid kyi gro ma lung :gzhan yang spar phug gangs gyi ra ba:gsal rje gangs kyi ra ba: g.yu lung gangs kyi ra ba: 'brong rdza gangs kyi ra ba: bal yul gangs 192
