sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas yigayi phyogs bzhi na:thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba re re yod: bram ze skye bdun zha dang thod pa yod: drag sgrub phyar pa srid pa kun 'dul yod: phyar pa de ni gdengs pa tsam gyis ni: bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad brlags: lar brag phug de yi nang na mchod cha dang : bod du bsgyur tshad sngags dang mdo rgyud dang : 'dzam bu gling gi mi phyed sos pa'i rdzas: thams cad tshang bar gter du sbas nas yod: brag phug 'dir sleb skye bo pho mo rnams: phyag rgya chen 11 mchog gi dngos grub thob: brag phyag ming yang o rgyan bde chen phug:lar ni brag phug de yi rgyud la ni:mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i brag phug gsum:thun mong dngos grub thob pa'i brag phug gsum:sbyir na 'bras mo gzhongs kyi lung pa na:mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i brag phug bcu: thun mong dngos grub thob par byed pa yi: brag phug sprus pa bcu gcig gsal bar yod: grub pa thob pa'i brag phug nyi shu gcig:sbas yul rin chen gzhongs kyi g.yas logs su: sman gyi sdong po dri ngad lngan pa yod: de la me tog pad+ma rigs bzhi 'char: rtsa ba rigs bzhi lo 'dab rigs bzhi skye: 'bras bu rigs bzhi bro ba rigs bzhir ldan: de'i rtsa ba 'dab ma me tog 'bras bya bzhi: nya ra byas pas rlung mkhris bad kan dang : 'dus pa la sogs nad rigs bzhi brgya sel: sbas yul 'bras mo gasgo+ongs kyi phu ri la: tshad pa'i nad sel sman rnams tshang ba yod: mda' na grang ba sel ba'i sman tshang yod: brag dkar bkra shis/ lding gi nub 249

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/byang na:sman bzang lung pa zhes bya shrīng sdong 'dra:de yi nang na lung phran lnga lnga yod: de dbus grang ba yul 'byin sman chu yod: ming yang sman chu lung zhes bya ba yin: sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi lung smad na: 'bras ma btab par skye ba'i lung gsum yod: bar na nas ma btab par skye ba'i lung gsum yod: stod na bra bo ma btab skye ba'i lung bzhi spo+od: zhing thog rnams kyi rigs ni mi 'dra ba: ro mngar bcud lngan brgya dang rtsa lnga yod: star ka la sogs mar 'dra'i zhing thog yod:'o li la sogs zan 'dra'i shing thog yod:rgun 'brum la sogs chang 'dra'i shing thog yod: tring 'bring la sogs sha 'dra'i shing thog yod: se di shing thog rkyang pas lto thub yod: do ba nyung ma dang do ba ser mo dang : sna gcig ma dang ting 'dzin mtha' brten pa'i:do ba rigs mi 'dra ba sum cu rtsa bdun yod: bza' ba'i thabs ni tshod 'phrul la sogs dang :bsreg pa kho na la sogs shes pa'o:gro ma dang ni gre ma 'bol ma la sogs pa:kha zas bcud lnga ldan pa za ba yod:sgog pa'i rigs ni mi 'dra nyi shu yod: bzar btub baspru+oms na sum brgya drug cu yod: nyung ma la phug ma btab skye ba yod: co le nyo le rgyun 'brum skyes nas yod: zhing dang brag la sbrang rtsi chags nas yod: sbas lung 'bras mo gshongs kyi dgos 'dod bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gsang rgya:maṭatwasu7ji/cu lung pa yan lag gi lo rgyus 'di ltar ro: sbas yul rin chen gshongs 250

sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs kyi gnas yigakyi lho zhub na: chu dkar lung pa zhes bya che ba yod: spos dkar nags ma bu ram zhing skyes yod:de yi zhar phyogs seng ge lung zhes bya ba na:lung mda' dog cing rgya skyeg skyes pa yod: shar lho rgod lung bya ba'i lung pa na: g.yer ma'i thing ni ma btab skyes pa yod: lho phyogs bod lung lung pa bya ba na: ka ra'i shing ni ma btab skyes pa yod: zangs kyi wa mo chu 'thung 'dra ba yi: ri sna cig yod yar yar brkos pa yi: rdza 'chos pa dang zangs rdo mang du yod:byang phyogs g.ya' lung bya ba'i lung pa na: me rdo dang ni chu rdza'i yang yod: de yi mda' na ba tshwa'i mtsho chen yod: rin chen lung pa zhes bya'i zhar phyogs na: sa tshon kha dog sna lnga tshang ma yod: lha bzhengs tshon rtsi de nas blangs pas chog: gro ma lung zhes bya ba'i lung pa na: brag la spang mthing lngong ros yod: reg mo lung pa zhes bya'i lung pa na: sa zhag zos pas bcud la lto thub yod: lar ni lung pa de na rin chen sna tshogs yod: sa bon gang btab thams cad skye ba yod: zhing thog me tog rigs rnams tshang ba yod: do ba bcud ldan kha mi tsha ba yod: rin chen sna tshogs ma tshang ba yang med: sman gyi rigs su gyur tshad tshang ma yod: sngo dang sh-i mo'i rigs su gyur tshad yod: shing gi rigs su gyur pa sna tshogs skye: bya dang ri dwags sna tshogs thams can rnams: dus la bstun cing skad snyan sgrogs pa yod: 'bras mo gzhongs 'dir slebs pa'i mi rnams kun: rin chen nor bu lta bu'i gling yin pas: dbul phongs mi khom gnas brgyad bral: mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad 25spro

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rab zhi nas:tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas par 'gyur:de ru skyes pa'i mi rnams thams cad ni: shes rab chen po thogs med 'char ba dang :rig pa'i gnas la shin tu mkhas par yod: ma rig pa rnams rang sar grol bar 'gyur:bde chen lta bu'i byang chub sems dang ldan:ting 'dzin 'od gsal thugs la ngang gis 'char: 'bras mo gzhongs 'dir ma 'ongs dus mtha' la: sems can thams cad bde skyid gnas chos zhig: sa 'dir skye bar smon lam yang yang thob: ces gu rus gsungs pa dang : mnga' bdag rgyal po yab sras blon 'bangs rnams: rab tu dgyes zhing rjes su yi rangs par gyur to:'bras mo gshongs kyi kha byang gi le'u ste brgyad pa'o:sa ma ya:rgya rgya rgya: 7thornyaciyang gu ru la: pad+ma gsal gyis gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul: tshogs 'khor bzhams phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas nas zhus pa: kyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung : 'bras mo gzhongs kyi yon tan du ma lngan: phyis ma 'ongs pa'i sems can 'gro bar byed pa yi: dus dang gnas skabs ji lta bu: lam phyogs gang nas 'gro bar byed: tshul ni ji ltar byed pa yin: nang du ji tsam 'tsho bar 'gyur: nang du sdod lugs ji ltar byed:rje ma hā gu rus gsung du gsol: zhes zhus pa dang : o rgyan gyis gsungs pa: khyed rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don du zhus pas na: 'bras mo gshongs kyi lam yig ngas gsungs kyis: yab sras rnams kyi yid la zhog mdzod cig: 'bras mo 252

sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas yigagash-i+ongs la sgo chen bzhi ru yod: gsang phug lta bu'i sgo phran bzhi yang yod:shar gyi sgo ni kyin thing ha rir gtad: sgo yol rim pa bzhi ru yod: lcam dul bdud la lho yi sgo yang gtad: sgo la yonu/ ba rim pa gsum du yod:hūṃb gyi sgo ni ma mo nyid la gtad: sgo yol rim pa bzhi ru yod: byang gi sgo mo gnod sbyin pho mor gtad: sgo yol rim pa gsum du yod: lung pa spyi bsrung brtan ma bcu gnyis gtad: phu yi gzhi bdag mdzod lnga stag rtser gtad: bar gyi gzhi bdag lha btsan spun dgur gtad: mda' yi gzhi bdag bdud btsan spun bdun gtad: lung pa spyi rnams gnyan chen thang lhar gtad: dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa la yang gtad: dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma la gnyer yang gtad: 'jig rten khams kyi lha 'dre mang po la: bka' rnams bsgos nas gnyer yang gtad pa'o: lung pa zhin tu gnyan la byin rlabs che: 'bras mo gzhongs su 'gro ba'i dus tshod ni: spyir kha ba can gyi sa phyogs 'dir: mtha' mi skad rigs sna tshogs mi gcig pa: bod yul dbus su lhags pa'i dus su 'gro'o: khyad par gtsang gi gnas gzhi chus nyig dang :brag ka ba can gyi shug pa 'gyel ba dang :spu bdun rtse yi lha khang garjir 'byung : bsam yas garjir lho zhub yo: khams kyi tsā ru'i mchod rten 'gyel ba dang : ge re yang 'phrang brag logs yig drug 'byung : ra sa 'phrul snang kag ni byung ba dang : ma mo'i sdong po rang skad 'chad pa dang :yer pa'i mchod rten byang du yo: dbus kyi bde chen me la bsreg pa'i dus:253

mkha' spyod 'bras mo 1snangs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/'bras mo gzhongs kyi sgo 'byed dus rtags yin: srib ri logs la dmag dar 'phyar ba dang : zar dang 'bri mtshams tshong 'dus 'byung ba dang : mdzod lnga stag rtse'i gangs phyogs shar ma la: sngar med dmigs san rdza nag nyil ba dang : jo mo kha rag khyung mchu chag pa dang : 'bang ma'i gling stod mo pa'i gling byung dang : dge ma brag smad rta chu'i khrom byung dang : stong dpon lung nag bde ba'i snga bcad bya: g.ya' lung gre tshe kag ni byung ba dang : bla ma mkhan slob du ming btags nas: 'dul khrims rnam dag mi bsrung pa ru 'chal:gshin po'i cho ga nor la hab zha byed: dge slong dge tshul so nam khe bsog byed: gtsug lag khang la dmag gi 'thab ra 'cha': bud sped rnams kyi khrims ra bskor ba dang : mtha' yi rgya dang hor gnyis 'khrug pa 'byung :dpon la g.yog gis bslus pas thabs kyis gsod: chos pas dmag dpon khrims ra 'jug pa dang : chos pas 'dul khrims mi thub bag med byed: sngags pas dam tshig mi thub gsang sngags 'chal : skye bos khrims mi thub cing rang srog bor: bud med lus mi thub cing chu sgo gdeng : dge slong ming btags sri'u gso bar byed: mthu dang ngan sngags grong chog 'bung zhing bslu: byin rlabs can gyi rten chos mang po 'jig: dben gnas byin rlabs can rnams brlag tu bcug: bla ma slob dpon chags sdang me ltar 'bar: sgom sgrub byed bsam med cing kha pho mtho: gzhan don bor la yon bdag mnga' ris rtsod: gzhan la chos ston byed cing rang rgyud gyong : chos 254

sbas yul 'bras mo gzho5ris kyi gnas yigapa'i ming btags tsam zhig ma gtogs pa: thams cad so nam byed cing mi nag 'dra: pha mas bu gsod bu yis pha ma gsod: spun la chung ma nor phyir dme 'khrug byed:ma lan mi la nges med khrims su bcug:rten mchog byin rlabs can dang chos zab rnams: mtha' la gdan 'dren byed pa'i dus zhig 'byung : sprul sku mon byon dmag sgar bzung ba'i dus: rnam smin skyes pa'i rgyal po mched lnga zhig: dbus gtsang mtshams nas langs zhing bod rnams dkrug: de nas lo ni 'ga' zhig lcags pho khyi zhar tshe: mtha' yi dmag ni rgya nas langs shing g.yos: yar byung dmag gis dbus gtsang khengs pa srike : de dus 'bās mo gzhongs kyi yon tan dran: de'i dus su sgo ni 'byed pa'i dus: gsang sgo rdol nas thams cad bde zhing skyid: ces gsungs so:'bras mo gzhongs la don cing sgo 'byed pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o: las can gcig dang 'phrad par zhog:sa ma ya:rgya rgya rgya: masetwa༅spajucago rgyan gyis gsungs pa: kyi chos rgyal yab sras bdag la gson:'bras mo gshongs su 'gro ba'i dus bzhi ni: sh-ir sgor 'gro na ston kha 'gro bar bya: lho sgor 'gro na dgun kha 'gro bar byed: zhub sgor 'gro na dpyid kyi dus su 'gro: byang sgor 'gro na dbyar gyi dus su 'gro: rnal 'byor rtogs zhus lngan pa yod gyur na: g.ya' gong gangs mgor gnyis nas phyin pas thar: sh-ir gyi sgo nas phyin pa na: stag pa lung gi sgo nas phyin: kyin thing grengs kyi lho zhub nye bar phyin: gangs ma phrin g.yu'i mgo cog can bya na:255

mkha' sbyod 'bras smos ljongs kyi gnas yig tre(gas bsdebs bzhugs/'bu srin g.yu'i dpal zhur bya ba yod: de gnyis 'dus pa'i mdun du gsang bdag sgrub2 srid pa kha snyoms kyi mdos chog bya: de nas la chung gcig brgal nas: g.ya' lung phor mo mtsho yi lham yu mthong : lung pa de'i chu 'khris phyin pa dang :mtsho chen rgya mtsho gser gyi rna bar yod:de'i rtsa ru klu gtor brngan mdos bya: yang cig chu yi rgyud la zhugs phyin pas:g.ya' lung go yol gnyis pa'i phu ru yod: de nas lung pa'i gzhis la phyin pa yis: rtag pa lung gi sgo lung bya bar sleb: kha zhar bltas zhing stag ma skyes pa yod: de yi lho phyogs ngos la phyin pa dang : g.ya' gangs 'dres pa'i ga nyag gcig kyang yod: de nas lho nub phyogs la lding zhig yod pa la: de la phyin pas la stong gsum du yod: g.yon phyogs phyin pas sngar gyi la btsas yod: de nas zhub tu bltas nas phyin pa yi: do lung zhes bya lung pa'i nang yang mthong :de'i thad ka'i zhub ri la: brag spang 'dres pa'i gangs zhig yod: de'i lho ngos 'dzeg pas nags stong yod: de nas phar bltas brag skam pa kha ral 'dra ba mthong : de ru srid pa'i spyi mdos bya: ma mo rnamakha' 'gro rnams la tshogs 'khor bya: de nas phyin pas 'bras mo gzhongs kyi ni: lung pa chen po'i phu ru slebs par 'gyur: zhar mes tshigs bzhur nas 'jug phyin pas:shar khang chung thang chu lung nas phyin:zhar sgo'i sgo yol gsum pa na: seng ge gangs bar lung pa bya ba de: phu ni byang la mda' ni lho zhub nye: lung pa gcong rong dog pa gcig tu yod: de'i chu ni g.yas nas 256

sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas yigaphyin pa dang : g.yu mo gangs kyi ri rgyud bcad pa dang : g.ya' lung chen mo dang gnyis 'dzom pa na: rtse la rin chen thang zhes bya ba'i spang : khod snyoms lag pa'i mthil dang 'dra ba yod: de'i stod na brag ze 'dra ba zhig kyang yod: de'i steng nas phar bltas pas: mes tshig spang lding chung ba'i ri rgyud mthong : de nas lho zhub phyin pas mes chig slebs:de nas zhub bltas lam zhur gcig la phyin:nags kyi stongs kha zhig la slebs nas yong :la kha de nas bltas tsam na: rdza dang spang dang kha ba'i khrod cig yod: de la phyin pas spang lung ring mo steng du slebs: de ru mun btsan mchod cing mnyes par bya:dge bsten nyid la gsol kha btang : de nas zhub phyogs lung pa kha gsum pa: zhar gyi phyogs su bltas nas yod pa la: g.yas kyi lung pa mtha' ma'i nang la phyin: g.ya' gangs 'dres pa lag sor 'dra ba yod: nyag 'og ma nas phyin pa'i la kha na: rdo yi rtsig pa spang brtsegs 'dra ba yod: de nas steng chung gnyis rgyab phyin pas na: brag la mtshal gyi phyag rjes bzhag pa yod: de'i ltag gi nags mtshams bltas pa yi: 'bras mo gzhongs kyi lung pa kun gsal mthong : mon phug mo de la phyin pas na: sbas yul 'bras mo lung gi lung pa yod: de ltar lam rnams rig pas dpyad kyin phyin: chu dang brag dang rngam chen tsam la yang : gtad cing 'gro ba tsam yang med pa'o: gal te lam dang rtags rnams ma rnyed na: bu mo bya lo grong pa'i skyon med gcig: lag tu mda' dar dkar po gtsang ma thogs: kyin mthing 257

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ma'i dkar gtor lag g.yon khyer: khrus byas spos kyi dud pas bdug byas la: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya pra mo ta la ta li hūṃ hūṃ: mang du bgrang zhing mda' dar g.yab pas: kyin mthing ma zhugs nas lam sna byed par 'gyur: de nas 'bras mo gzhongs su slebs pa'i dus: srid pa ma mo'i spyi mdos chen mo bya: dge slong tshul dang ldan pas khrus chog bya: sngags pa dam chig ldan pas sngags chog bya: lho ru mthun byed blon po'i gling yang btab: zhub tu bran dang 'khor gyi gling yang btab: byang du bdud 'dul sngags pa'i gling yang btab:mtshams bzhi byang chub chen po'i mchod rten btab: 'bras mo gshongs de dbus gtsang mi yis bzung : rgyal po'i gdung rabs gnyis gsum song ba'i skabs: sras gsum bar ma mnga' bdag rgyal po'i sbrul: rgyal po zha bo cher grags dmag dpon byed: bod du dmag drangs mtha' dmag yul 'don no: de bzhin sprul pa'i skyes mchog bdun byon te: bar 'dir sangs rgyas bstan pa nyi shar ltar: sems can thams cad bde skyid skal ba lngan:de dus 'phags pa 'jam dpal sgrub pas 'dul: de nas lo ni brgyad cu tham pa la: lha khang khyung mgo can zhes bya ba 'byung : sprul pa ston pa'i skyes bu+o lnga 'byon no+o:rtogs hūṃso ldan pa'i rnal 'byor lnga bcu 'byon:grub thobo pho ma bdun cu dan bdun 'byan: sprul pa mkha' 'gra sum cu tham pa 'byan:yul 'dir phyin pa'i skye bo pho mo rnams: tshe 'di phyi gnyis ka'i don 'grub 'gyur: srus yul 'bras mo gzhongs kyi sgo phye nas: se rma sa can bde skyid 258

sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas yiganyi ma shar bar 'gyur: sbyir rgyal khams phyogs rigs thams cad du: lo legs char chu dus su phebs pa dang : mi nad phyugs nad thams cad rgyun chad 'gyur: mtshon dang 'khrugs pa 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal zhi: gdon dang bgegs dang mi mthun zhi gyur nas: 'bras mo gzhongs kyi sgo de bye ba'i mthus: sems can rnams kyi dpal dang mgon du 'gyur: ces gsungs so: zhar sgo nas 'gro ba'i lam yig gi le'u ste bcu pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:lho sgo nas 'gro ba 'di ltar ro:mon yul bang ma nas ni sgo phyes te:rong byang lung gi chu la zhugs nas 'gro: sdon ma chu la zhad de zhugs nas 'gro:brag them thur du 'phyang ba zhig dang thug: de'i logs la dal bus bltas pas na:brag them 'khris la lam ni kha gsal yod:de la zam pa btsugs nas phyin par bya: de la bdud btsan yod pas bya nag bzhos bus mchod:de'i hūṃb ngos brag nag gi mal zhig na: sa dkar dkar po dung dang 'dra ba yod: de'i sa dkar kha la tho brtsigs nas: sa dkar dkar po 'thor zhing 'gro bar byed: brag mda' sgro 'dra ba chu bab phyogs na yod: de nas phar phyin chu 'khris thig la yod: mi na mas 'gro 'chags ma bde hūṃb ngos thar:gal te zhub kyi phyogs su ma thar na: brag ri bong nyal 'dra ba zhig yod: de steng zam pa btsugs pas thar ba yod: de yi tha/ra phyogs srang nags 'dres ma yin: gangs/ shig 5ོ/da nga/sa de la 'dzegs nas 'gro: de nas 'bras mo/ 259

mkha' sbyod 'bras 31 ljongs kyi gnas yig cadags bsdebs bzhugs/gshongs kyi phu ri mthong : de nas chu 'gram la ni phyin pa dang : thang bde mo zhig la chu chung zhig kyang yod:chu de brgyud nas phyin pa dang :brag phug spang gsum thog tsam byas pa na: de la chu yi mtsho zhig 'khyil nas yod: der slebs pa dang srin mo btsan yang mchod: de yi zhar 'khris bskor bas thar sa yod: de'i steng du slebs pa dang : byang chub chen po'i mchod rten mi gang brtsigs:de la rab gnas bkra shis baji+od pa dang : srid pa khod snyoms kyi mdos yang bya: gzhi bdag rak+ṣa chang phud gtsang mas mchod: de nas srus yul rin chen steng du slebs:nags ma zhig ni brgal phyin pas:sbas yul rin chen gzhongs su slebs pa'o: lho'i sgo nas 'gro na brag srin mo dang :brag btsan la sogs mchod pa gal che'o: lho'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i kha byang gi le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o:sa ma ya:rgya rgya rgya:man+t+ra gu ya:hūṃb sgo la phyin na: sbrang sman lung nas kha zhar du bltas pa na: ri ni mog 'dra ba cig yod pa la: de yi rtse ru phyin nas bltas pa yi: zhar gyi phyogs na lung pa gnyis yod mthong :lung pa de gnyisdo/ phu bcad phyin pa yis: dge lung gong ma bya bar slebs nas yong : de'i zhar smad brag che ba gcig kyang yod: der slebs pa dang ma mo mkha' 'gro dang : re ma ti la khrag mdos dmar gtor btang : de nas yar la g.ya' mtshams rgyud phyin pas: sgras yul 'bras mo gshongs su slebs pa'o: lam de hūṃb gyi phyogs nas 'gro dus su: dbang phyug ma la zor mdos btang la 'gro:zhub nas 'gro ba'i kha 260

sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs kyi gnas yigabyang gi le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o:sa ma ya:rgya rgya rgya:thazacibyang gi sgo nas 'gro na: g.ya' dang mtshams la brgyud phyin pas: sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs su sleb bo: sgo ma phye par ni phyin pas na: rig tsam gyis ni thar yang phye mi 'gyur: phyogs gang nas 'gro yang blo dang shes pa bstun: dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab kyin 'gro: mkha' 'gro ma la tshogs 'khor btang zhing 'gro: gzhi bdag rnams la gsol mchod gser skyems gtong : mthun rkyen mang po khyer la 'gro bar bya: dal bus rim gyis lam rnams btsal zhing 'gro: dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis bden pa brdar: gtsug tor rnam 'joms mang du 'don pa dang : la dang 'phrang la mda' dar btsugs zhing 'gro: chu la khad kyis dal bus blta zhing 'gro: brag dang nags la rig pas dpyad kyin 'gro: mi rgod lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul ci byung yang : mi 'jigs mi skrag rig pa mi zhum 'gro: thab gzhob dang ni mi gtsang pa la 'dzem: khrus dang gtsang sbra gnas par byas la 'gro:kha char che na tshad de len gyin 'gro: cud zad che na mu zi gu gul dang : khyi lud spe la bsreg la dud pa btang : g.yer ma dang ni tshwa bsres thal ba gtor: yul lha rnams la gta' btsugs gser skyems btang : bu mo gtsang mas 'brang rgyas mchod kyin 'gro:de ru 'gro ba'i mi rnams spyi sa/tsug tu: gu ru dang ni rdor sems dbyer me+ed bsgoms: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ: sa ma ya hūṃ ā: zhes ni bgrang zhing lam kha la: a tsar ṭī dril kha ṭ+wāṃ 261

mkha' rje/da 'bras mo 11ngas kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/thogs par bsgom: mtshan mo lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul che ba na: dkar gtor dmar gtor byin gyis rlobs la byin: stag gzig dom dred cho 'phrul che ba na: nyung kar drag sngags btab cing gtor: lar 'bras mo gshongs dang lam kha na: sems can gyi rigs ni mang po yod na yang : de la 'jigs pa'i rtog pa skye mi dgos: 'bras mo gshongs su sleb pa dang : rtogs pa khyad par can ni shugs la skye: byang phyogs nas 'gro ba'i kha byang gi le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o:sa ma ya:rgya rgya rgya:maṭatwatwetha capataspe gra'itsobyulngazathāsto2 sbas yul dpal gyi 'bras mo gzhongs 'di na: gang zag las ldan rang rang dgos pa yis: yo byad ma tshang ba gang yang med pa'o: spas yul rin chen gzhongs zhes bya ba na:brag dkar bkra shis steng zhes bya ba yod:de la them skas rim pa bdun du yod:'og na 'bras mo gzhongs kyi lde mig yod:de nyid bton nas lung pa'i dbyibs 'dra dang : sgo 'byed dang ni rten 'drel byed lugs yod: zhar lung spong po gru bzhi bya ba'i dkyil: pha bong dkar po lug 'dra ba cig yod: de yi zhar ngos rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes bco lnga: zla ba shar la khad la bltas pa yis: dngul gyi g.yung drung ris shig gsal ba yod: de'i thad na phar la brkos pa yis: khro chu'i rdza ma gcig la ni: 'bru sna mi 'dra gsum gyi sa bon yod: yang cig rdza ma kha leb gcig gi nang :khre dang phra mo'i sa bon mang du yod: lcags kyi rdza ma gcig gi nang na ni: bra bo dkar sngon gnyis kyi sa bon yod: bse yi ga'u gcig gi nang na ni: nyung 262

sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs kyi gnas yigakar nag gnyis kyi sa bon yod: lar 'bru sna'i sa bon gang dgos yod:'bras bu ma btab lo thog zad pa dang : ston thog gang skye'i yul du sa bon btab: rin chen gzhongs kyi byang shur mtshams la ni: mdzod lnga stag rtse'i zhar gyi gangs 'dabs na: brag skya dpang du thag 'dom nyi shu pa: dkyus su mig mthong bdun phan yod pa la: de la tshwa yi gad pa tshwa bzang yod: dus phyis de nas blangs pas zad pa med: de ni lan tshwa'i mdzod chen yin pa'o:gangs gnyis pa gser dang g.yu yi mdzod: gangs gsum pa ni chos dang nor gyi mdzod: des na mdzod lnga stag rtse bya ba'o: gangs bzhi pa ni go cha mtshon cha'i mdzod: gangs lnga pa ni 'bru dang sman gyi mdzod: gangs phran rnams la gter kha mang du yod: rin chen gshongs kyi mda' na ri ni zhu ma 'dra: de'i steng na mchod rten gcig yang yod: zhub 'khris nas mar 'dom gang brkos pa na:rdo sgrom gcig ni sol bas gang gseb na:seng ljeng sgrom ni mig dgu pa cig yod: de'i mig gsum bka' 'gyur bzhugs nas yod: mig gsum rgyal po'i thugs nga/ma lha chos yod: mig gsum thab cha sga chas tshang ma yod:de rnams 'don na lug blo'i rla ba la:dge bsten gzhi bdag gsol mchod byas la 'don:lung pa de yi phya na ni:brag ni mda' sgro 'dra ba yod: de'i kha nas bltas pa na: zhub byang brag ni byam pa 'dra ba yod: de yi dkyil na rdo sngon gcig la ni: gu ru'i zhabs rjes byin rlabs can zhig yod: de la byin brlabs zhus pas spyo 'bog sel: sbas yul 263

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo 11ngas kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/'bras mo gzhongs kyi byang logs na: spang lung bya ba kha zhar bltas pa yod:phu na spang ljongs che zhing 'brog pa bzang : bar na rdzing ljongs che zhing gser nya 'phyo: mda' na sbang bu skye re co le byas: de'i zur la mu men mtsho ni gru bzhi yod:de'i g.yas zur brag mi rengs khrus dbang 'dra ba yod:de'i shar zur rdo ra mchin 'dra ba yod: de'i 'og tu 'dom gang brkos pa na: rdo sgrom chen po sol ba'i gseb na ni:thing gla ba'i sgrom chen zhig ni yod: shug pa'i spes bsreg rdo sgrom kha bye bas: gser g.yu 'dres pa bre khal dgu yang yod:khrab ni nyi shu gri ni sum cu yod:'thab ber go cha can yang bya ba yod:bse yi ga'u gcig gi nang na ni: sbas yul lung pa'i gzhi bdag mchod lugs dang : sgrub thabs tshang ma ma lus sbas nas yod: de rnams lung pa'i btsan ni mchog la bton: lung pa de nas lung pa gsum 'das nas:gling bu lung bya ba'i lung pa yod: de na brag rgyud gzhan las dpang mtho ba:lung pa rngam zhing 'jigs pa gcig yod de: de'i phu na brag mon pa khros pa 'dra ba'i shar: 'debs na shug pa phung po bdun yang yod: de gsum yar bzhag mar bzhag dkyil ma de: zhub 'khris phyin pas brag 'khris zhig la slebs: de nas gyen la yud tsam 'dzeg pa dang : brag gi 'dab 'khris skyer pa'i phung po yod: de 'og mar la 'dom gang brkos pa na: chu rdo'i brtsigs pa gcig yang yod: de bzhig pa dang brag phug che ba yod: de'i nang na dkyil 'khor cig yod de:de'i nang na tshe chu'i bum pa ni:bsam yas kyi bre 264

sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas yigakhal phyed 'gro ba'i: gser gyi bum pa tshe chus bkang nas yod: de'i mtha' na thun mong mchog rdzas yod: chang par thod pa dar sngon dril ba yod: de'i steng du rkang pa g.yas bzhag pas: gang 'dod pas ru skad cig sleb par 'gyur: sba lcag rtse la srin mo'i lag btags te: g.yon du bcad pas lha 'dre mi gsum gyi:mi mthong pa yi sgrib shing zab pa yod:me long gcig dar dmar dril nas yod: de la ba dmar 'o mas khrus byas nas: bltas pas gling bzhi gling phran thams cad mthong : phur pa dar dmar dril ba gcig kyang yod: pha rol dmag gdengs pa tsam gyis ni: rengs shing brgyal nas 'gro bar 'gyur ba'o: rnga ni srid gsum zil gnon bya ba yod: gzhog g.yas brdungs pas lha 'dre thams cad bros: g.yon phyogs brdungs pas mi'i dmag rnams bros: de las gzhan pa'i sgrub rdzas mang po yod: de rnams thon dus thang lha btsan dang ni: brtan ma bcu gnyis mchod la thon par bya:'bras mo gzhongs kyi byang smad bya ba na: she'u lung bya'i lung pa gzhu gzugs 'dra: phu na mtsho bzhi byas pa gcig kyang yod: lung pa de'i dkyil gyi nang dbus na: brag mchod rten gyi ni gzugs 'dra ba: the'us brkos pa 'dra ba gcig kyang yod: de'i 'khris nas mar la brkos pa na: zangs dang slang 'dres/ pa bdun cu yod: ma mo dang ni klu btsan mchod la thon: 'bras mo gshongs kyi bar smad bya ba na: dom tshang bya ba lung pa che ba yod: de na ras bal rgyu ni ma btab skye ba yod: de'i bdag po bdud la gtad yod pas:265

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/ras bal len dus bdud la gsol mchod btang : 'bras mo gzhongs su sdod pa'i mi rnams kyis: gos kyi gter kha 'di nyid yin pa ste: 'bras mo gshongs kyi lho phyogs na: thang zang lung bya ba'i lung pa gcig yod pa:mda' na phu lag sor bkram pa 'dra ba yod: de na sems can rigs mi 'dra ba sum cu yod: bya rigs rgod dang ngur pa ma gtogs pa: de min bya rigs sna tshogs tshang ma yod: 'bras mo gzhongs su sems can shi tshad rnams:phal cher de ru phyin nas 'chi:gnas der zha ni rgyun mi chad pa yod:skam po dang ni rlon pa gsar rnying dang :sha rul dang ni 'bus za srin bu med:zha 'dod rnams ni de nas blangs pas chog: zha len tsa na lung pa'i btsan mchod de: de ni sha yi gter kha yin: lung pa de'i sems can tshad las 'das so: yul de'i sems can 'di rnams thams cad la: gsod pa dang ni gnod sems ma byas na: zha ni rgyun mi chad cing ri ltar spungs: de nas zhub tu lung pa gnyis phyin na: bla lung lung pa kha shar bltas pa yod: de'i lung pa nang na 'khor lo dang : chu ti ma btab skyes pa yod pa'o: de'i dkyil mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i pho brang yod: brag phug ka ba bzhi stegs tsam zhig yod: de'i nang na maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi yod: dkyil 'khor shar phyogs 'dom gang brkos pa na: zangs kyi ga'u gcig gi nang na ni: ḍāki 'du ba'i sgrub thabs bcas pa yod: nor bu rin chen bsam 'phel dgos 'byung yod: gzhan yang ḍāki'i sgrub thabs mang du yod: de 'don dus su mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 266

sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs kyi gnas yiga'akhor bya: re ma ti la khrag mdos btang rag chen po btang : o rgyan nga la gsol ba yang yang thob: bya'i lo la thon pa'i dus yin no: brag phug de la bskor bas ci bsam 'grub: khyad par bud med rnams la srid 'phel 'gyur: 'bras mo gzhongs kyi lung pa'i hūṃb phyogs na: dza mo lung bya'i lung pa gcig kyang yod: phu la g.ya' dang gangs 'dres pa zhig yod: de'i g.yas kyi brag logs ngos bzung la: mtshal gyis rgya yig bris pa zhig kyang yod: de'i thad ka'i chu la zam pa btsug nas 'gro: de nas zhub kyi phyogs su phyin pa dang : brag phug mi che ba zhig de na yod: de'i dkyil na rdo lug tsam zhig yod: de'i 'og nas mar brkos pa dang : brag phyag stong pa rlung yod pa zhig yod: de'i phug na skye tshang gsum yang yod: de'i nang na zangs kyi rnga dang cha lang dang :rdor dril thod rnga ting zhag marnyi dang : ting dang maṇ+ḍal bla bre gdugs yol dang :de la sogs pa mchod cha tshang ma yod:de 'don dus su ma mo sman mo mchod: 'bras mo gzhongs kyi phu rnams 'brog ri yin: khyad par spang lung dang ni dang lung gnyis: 'brog ri rtsa khyim pa'i gter yin pas na: bar dang mda' rnams zas nor 'bru yi gter: khyad par sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs de ni: phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i gter kha'o: lung pa de ni nyams dga' rtogs pa 'phel: rin chen gzhongs kyi zhar 'dabs na: bsam gtan phug bya ba brag dkar wa rwarngos 'jam yod:de'i logs la gter kha thams cad kyi kha byang ni: o rgyan gyis yi ger 267

mkho' spyod 'braso mo ljo+ongs kyi gonas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/bkad nas yad pa': ma 'angs las 'phra can dang 'phrad par zhag: 'bras mo gzhongs su gter sbas pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o:sa ma ya:rgya rgyargya:sbas yul dpal gyi 'bras mo gzhongs su: stag gi 'jigs pa byung bas na: mdzod lnga stag rtse ma dga' bas: g.yag dang mar g.yag rnga tshar tsam gyis mchod:dar dkar po la gri khrag sngags 'di bri2tsog bhan dhe bhan dhe par+ṇa badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa: ces pa'i sngags ni bris byas la: dbung pa g.yas su btags pa na: stag gi 'jigs pa 'byung mi 'gyur: dug sbrul 'jigs pa byung ba na:yul bdag klu dang ma mo dang :gser mig ma ni ma dgyes pas:klu brgyad klu gtor klu chog gyis: yang na klu yi gsang sgrub bya: gla rtsi dang ni gser dngul gnyis: zhar gyi sgo yol rtse nas ni: chu dag blangs nas ba nag gis:'o ma sbyar la thum bu bya: tsos ṭ+wāṃ ga tsit+ta tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ phaṭa: sngags de bzlas nas mgul du btags: de yis dug sbrul 'jigarmi pa thub: byi ba'i gnod pa byung ba na: gnyan chen thang lha khros pa yin: lug dkar po'i gnyan mdos bya:gtor ma btang zhing bden pa brdar:lci dang rta sbang dud pa btang : mi rgod 'jigs pa zhi bar 'gyur: dom gyi gnod pa byung ba na:bdud khros pa yi cho 'phrul yin: lug nag bzhos bu nag pos mchod: dung dang 'khar rnga'i sgra mang bsgrags: so so ri yi rtse mor ru: mi rus dang ni khyi rus bsreg:dom gyis gnod pa zhi bar 'gyur: 'phar spyang 'jigs pa byung ba na: btsan khros pa yi cho 'phrul te: mda' dmar bshos bu dmar pos 268

sbas yul 'bras 31 gshongs kyi gnas yigamachod:mi dang de ni nor rnams la:byang bu mig dgu rnga ma dmar:mgo dang dpung pa gnyiso la btags: 'ophar spyang gnod pa mi 'byung ngo : char pa babs na klu khras pas: rnam 'jams khrus dang bsang mang bya: klu gtar mang du btang ba'o: de yis char pa chod par 'gyur: mi dang phyugs la rgyu 'khrug 'byung : gzhi bdag khros pa'i rtags yin pas: gsung rabs mang du 'don pa dang : srid pa ma mo'i mdos chog bya: yul bdag rnams la mchod sbyin dang :gser skyems mang du btang bar bya:'bras mo gzhongs kyi lha 'dre rnams:zhin tu gnyan zhing gdug rtsub che: spyod pa sbyi brtol mi bya'o:dkar chos dag la 'bad par bya:sdig spyod bsam ngan mi bya'o:thams cad byang chub sems lngan mdzod: lung pa'i mthil 'dzom thams cad 'du: kag ni mchod rten mang du bzhengs: pad+ma nga la gsol ba thob: ci bsam don rnams 'grub par 'gyur:'bras mo gzhongs kyi lung pa'i 'jigs pa bsrung ba'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o:sa ma ya:rgya rgya rgya: margatwazudz+ra:lam gyi 'jigs pa bsrung ba ni: 'bras mo gzhongs su 'gro ba'i dus su: lam gyi cho 'phrul byung ba na: rang gi dri chu bul tog bsres: gtor bas rmi lam 'tshub pa zhi: lam du na bun 'tshub pa na: gtor ma gser skyems0gzhi bdag mchod: de yis smug pa sel bar 'gyur: kha ba che zhing lam 'gags na: mu zi dang ni khyi lud dang : spos dkar bsres pa'i dud pa btang : gzhi bdag rnams la bden pa brdar: de yis kha ba chad par 269

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhags/༄'gyur: 'khor nas dus la ma slebs na:rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: bar do gcod pa tshar yang bcad: lam du tho brtsigs dkar rtsi byug: nang sgo lam bsrang ma rnyed na: mda' rgod sgro ma la dar sna btags: lag pa g.yas pas g.yab kyin 'gro: zhub kyi sgo nas 'gro ba na: zar gyi mun thang lha mo yi: sgrub pa blo gcig byas la 'gro: ma mo'i spyi mdos gtong bar bya:lho yi sgo nas phyin pa na: nyi ma'i ri la gshin rje yi: sgrub pa zla gcig byas la 'gro: sarba ru pa'i mdos yang btang : zhar gyi sgo nas phyin pa na: gro mo khang chung ri la ni: rin chen rigs kyi sgrub pa zla gcig bya: srid pa g.yul bzlog mdos chog bya: byang gi sgo nas phyin pa na: stong dpon lung nag ri la ni: phur pa phrin las sgrub pa bya: srid pa g.yul bzlog byas la 'gro: khang bu rdza lung nang phyin na: khang bu yi ni rdza ri la: pad+ma gsung gi bsgrub pa bya:srog bdag kyin mthing ma mo la: gsol mchod khrus dang gtsang sgra bya: khang bu rdza lung phyin pa na: la kha nas ni phar phyin pas: zhing sdong yal ga med pa ni: gral bsgrig brtsigs nas yod pa'o: zhing ni gcig nas gcig mthong ba: de la gtad nas phyin pa dang : seng ge gangs par lung bya ba: g.ya' lung chen mo gcig tu yod: ma nor shing la gtad phyin pas: skabs su tsha mar dud pa gtong :de rnams rig pas dpyad kyin 'gro:'bras mo gshongs/ su 'gro ba la: phyogs bzhi lam yig sbas pa'i gter: bsam yas na:270 phyogs bzhir mchod rten bzhi ru yod: mchod rten dkar po lu yi sa 'jig:

sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs kyi gnas yigade nas thengs shig sos pa'i rjes: lam yig de rnams thon par 'gyur:mchod rten dmar po rlung dmar 'jig: ri rab bar gyi lho nas 'don: byang phyogs zhig pa'i dus su thon: chu sngon mchod rten nag po yi: bum pa zhig pa'i nang nas 'don: lam yig de la brten phyin pas: bod kyi mi phyed thar nas 'gro: mchod rten nag po'i mgo nas ni: byung ba'i dung chen bus pa yis: gcan gzan thams cad 'bros shing 'gro: pheg de brdabs pas dug sprul zhi: zhar phyoges sgo nas 'gro ba na: khrus dang gtsang sbra gnas par bya:lho yi sgo nas 'gro ba na: spyod lam dal bus 'gro bar bya: zhub gyi sgo nas 'gro ba dang : byang sgor 'gro ba shin tu dka': shar lho gnyis nas 'gro ba gces: yul 'dir 'gro bar byed pa la: bsod nams bsags pa'i mi re ma gtogs pa: skal med rnams ni zhin tu dka': phal pa kun gyi der mi 'gro: las ngan bsags pa'i dbang gis ni: 'jig rten 'di'i nor zas dang : 'khor 'dab bu tsha khyo chung ma: gnyen 'brel kun la chagres pa dang :la la las ngan gti mug sgrib: col chung 'ga' zhig sdug la chags:bsam ngan lam mi rnyed pas lan: lan chasas can tsho 'khor bas bcing :zhing dang yu'༈ mkhar rnams la chags: bla ma slob dpon chags sngang bslus:snyig/sa ma'i sems can bsod nams chung : gnas 'dir 'gro sems 'charu mi 'gyur: bde ba can dang dbyer med gnas:bde skyid 'byor pa lngan gyur kyang : de la 'gro ba thi/na tu dko/na: dpal gyi 'bras mo gshongs de ni:

mkha' spyod 'bras mosna 11ngas kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/yon tan brgya dang lngan pas te:sems can rnams kyi smon lam thob:'bad rtsol byas la shugs kyis phyin: chags sems med par 'aglo bar byaca sems la bde skyid bsam mi khyabaca nyams dang rtogs pa rang shugs 'char: gnas 'dir sngon la sleb pa rnams: mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'o: bar du sleb pa rnams kyis ni:thun mong dngos grub thob pa'o:rting la sleb pa rnams kyis kyang :nor gyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur: gnas de tshwa de dka' bas na: tshwa'i gad pa brag brkos pas:tshwa de gang dgos len pas chog: mdzo+od lnga stag rtse thang lha mchod: de ltar byas pas 'bri mtshams nas: tshwa mtsho las ni tshwa 'byung ngo : de nas mtsho sman mchod la gsol: tshwa de dus rtag blangs pas chog: ma btab lo thog zad pa dang : so nam byas pas 'abhu sna rnams:thon phung gzhan las che ba yod: lto la yang bcag go:lam gyi 'ojigs pa bsrung zhing : gnas kyi yon tan bshad pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa':sa ma ya:rgya rgyargya:yang gu rus gsungs pa: kyi lha lcam yab sras rnams: 'bras mo gzhongs kyi gnas de ni: bde gshegs zhi khro'i pho brang du: pad+ma nga yis byin gyis brlabs: lung pa dang ni gangs ri dang : mtsho dang brag dang phug pa dang : khyad par zhing gi sdong po rnams: lha yi pho brang nyid du ni: gnas pa stong phrag drug cu yod: rang byon lha sku khri phrag yod: de lta bu yi 'bras mo gzhongs: rnam thar lan gcig thos pas kyang : skye ba dpag med bsod 272

sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas yiganams bsags: yul der 'gro ba'i blo zhar yid smon pa: las dang skal ldan gang zag yin: yul der 'gro ba'i mi rnams ni: sa bcu gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'dra: 'bras mo gshongs ni lan gcig bskor ba na:bskal stong bsags pa'i sdig sgrib 'dag: mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas par 'gyur: gnas de ni mthong ba tsam gyis kyang : ngan song gnas su 'gro mi srid: rigs drug skye ba'i sgo rnams bkag: 'bras mo gzhongs su 'gro ba la:g.ya' lung la la:rong mo'i rdza la:khang bu'i thang la:gro mo'i gtsang la: me tshigs nags la: yon po'i bdud la: bar ma'i brag la: nya ma'i steng la:g.yo phu'i bal la:zar gyi brang la:'bri 'tshams kyi rgyud la:stong dpon gyi sgang la'o: la kha de rnams phal cher nas: 'bras mo gasgo+ongs kyi lung pa mthong : la de rnams la ni zhugs phyin pas: sgo yol dang ni bar yol dang : lung pa'i mthil du yod pa'o: 'bras mo gzhongs kyi phyogs mtshams na: gnam thig sa thig bar thig chu thig dang :thig rnams tshad ni 'jal shes bya: yul der 'gro ba'i dus byung tshe:sngags pa dam tshig lngan pa dang : bud med lus ma nyams pa dang : btsun pa 'dul khrims ma nyams pa: bon po so khrig ma nyams pa: rgyal po gdung brgyud ma nyams pa: skyes pa rong gar+shad ma nyams pa: gang zag blo sems ma nyamaso pa:ོgtso bo bgras kha ma nyams pa: phud dang dam rdzas ma nyams pa: slab dpan zhus pa ma nyams pa: de ltar lngan na rgyal khams bde bar 'gyur: yul 'di sbas 273

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/pa'i lung pa yin: thab gzhob mi gtsang pa la 'dzems: 'thab rtsod 'khon la sogs pa spangs:yul der skyes pa dpa' bo dpa' mo ste:yul de'i byang sgo ma phye na: stag sprel phag sbrul lo bzhi la: 'gro bar bya bas sgo 'byed yod: g.yag lug ba glang la sogs pa: thar bar 'gyur zhing yul 'dir sleb: dus min phyin na kha bas 'gags: dus dang bsdun nas byol song khrid:yul 'dir sleb cing zho shed che:yul der bskal pa dus kyi stigs ma la: pad+ma 'byung gnas bdag gis byin brlabs pas: las dang skal par ldan rnams kyis:zhus pa dang lngan sgo phye nas:sems can bde skyid dang ldan paro bya'o: o rgyan gyis gsungs so: gnas kyi yon tan bzhad pa'i le'u ste bca brgyad pa':sa ma ya:rgya rgyargya:yang lha lcam gyis zhus pa:kyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung :sbas yul dpal gyi 'bras mo gzhongs: sgo sna nam byed dus ni ji lta bu: lo dang zla ba gang la 'gro bar byed: 'don pa'i gang zag gang gis 'byed pa yin: de'i yul ni gang phyogs ngos su yong : 'di na zhag grangs ji tsam dus la sleb:mtha' dmag bod la ji tsam dus la 'byung : gu rus bdag la gsung du gsol: ces zhus pas: o rgyan gyis gsungs pa: lha lcam yab sras bdag la gson: sbas yul 'bras mo gasgo+ongs kyi ni: shar sgor 'gro na ston kha 'gro bar bya: mon gyi ston thog bsdu ba'i dus su 'gro: glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi yi lo la 'gro: khyad par sa mo lug la 'gro na bzang : byi ba'i 274

sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs kyi gnas yigarla ba tshes gcig lam la zhugs:lam lha mchod cing ngang gis 'gro bar bya:rgyal gyi zla bar 'bras mo gzhongs su sleb: 'don pa'i gang zag bum thang mthil nas 'byung : lha lcam khyod kyi skye mtha' bum thang yong : rta lo lcags khams pa gcig 'byung ba'o: snang ba 'ur zhing 'dod blo zhig pa dang : tshig rtsub rta skad cho le smra ba yod: o rgyan nga yi thugs sprul pad+ma'i ming : skyes bu de yis sbas yul 'don par 'gyur: de nas skyes bu'i yul nas zhag bco brgyad: 'bras mo gzhongs kyi shar sgor sleb: de nas dus tshes rtsis nas lam la zhugs: bod mon mi phyed spus yul slebs nas ni: lo ni brgya phrag 'das pa dang : lcags pho khyi la mtha' dmag bod du slebs: bod 'bangs sems can ma skyid sdug la gtad: hor gyi dmag gis dbus gtsang 'dzin par 'gyur: lhag ma rnams kyang sbas yul gnas su bros:gnas kyi gzhi bdag gnyan pa'i mthu zhus kyis: la 'phrang lung 'phrang smug pa kha bas bsdams:hor gyi dmag gis sa 'dir sleb mi 'gyur:'bras mo gzhongs su gang sngod bde skyid lngan:de dus 'bras mo gshongs su chos rgyal sprul pa zhig: zhe'u cher grags rgyal po'i khrims byed nas: bod du dmag drangs mtha' dmag mtha' la bzlog: de nas rgyal khams cud zad bde bar 'gyur: dus mthar byams pa'i bstan pa byung ba'i dus2 mi'i sa bon 'di nas mched par 'gyur: 'bras mo gshongs kyi sgo rnams 'byed pa yis: gzhan yang gang zag mang du yong : lam yig de ni 275

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/mkhas pa kun la byin: brtson 'grus can gyis btsal zhing rnyed par 'gyur:yul de rnyed pa tsam gyis rgyal khams bde bar 'gyur: pad+ma nga yi smon lam 'grub par gyur cig: las can sting gi bu dang 'phrad par gyur cig:dus dang lo zla bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:gter rgya:zab rgya:sbas rgya:gtad rgya:bka' rgya:gsangs rgya:dam rgya:t+yāṭasgrosngadzica khazanablo: r+ghaṃpo 0 r+ghaṃ 'o 9snaspagyaṭam5maspeglu:

4 slebacom༅//sbas yul 'bras ma ljangs kya gnas yag dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdad rtsi'i 'od 'phro ༄zhes bya ba bzhugs so//da༅༅//bdag blo'i ma rig mun pa sel bar byin gyis rlobs/slob dpon pad+ma 'byang gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byang gnas dang /༄ ༄rgyal po khri srong lde' btsan gnyis/pre ba sngon ma'i las 'brel gyis/rgyal ra ri3pos slob dpon bod du spyan 'dren nas/bod kyi sa gzhi ma lus byin gyis ṭ+wā+oṃ/ ༵kā dī brapy-i py-i 'ardo+o k+ṣiṃ rnaṭ+wāṃ kāsdu bo lda~X sna~X py-isna snardzu~X zlotram̐ ༵nga ོ༵ nga dīX ༵/ ba 5khu01nej-i0/027sa00bab0 0 can 'a/ kha shog ta/sba)/ pa/05 'brathag mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dang rgyal rabs mdor bsdus bzhugs so༄//zhes ༵go 'tsham ༵ ༵ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ sngi+ogam bri ṭ+wāṃ ༵༵ bye ṭ+wā+oṃ/ོ ༵ ༵ ṭ+wāṃ 'a~Xṭ+wāṃ rdoṅge sdu rdong dī~Xs ༵ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ~X rnyi/sa' /ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wā+oṃṭ+wāṃ dīn ga~X gyi8 ṭ+wāṃng ༵rji+oṭā ṭ+wā+oṃdī ṭ+wāṃce/k+ṣiṃ ṭ+wā+oṃ/ zloṭ+wāṃ /paṭ+wā+oṃ ༵༵༵ rdi/7mi bshākā sdu ོ༵ bdashāḥ ra rna/5 tshan ci ra 'di red snyam mo//bu dpe zhal bshus gnang mkhan gyis brel tshubs ngang bgyis stabs sdo ོ༵ṭ+wāṃ sbya ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wā+oṃ/ba/ tshags rtsa ba nas byung mi 'dug na ma phyi gzhan zhig rnyed na zhib bsdur 277

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/brlabs/lha khang gtsug lag khang brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzhengs/gter kha brgya dang rtsa brgyad sbas/ gter phran sa ya dung phyur sbas/ thugs gter lnga sbas/yang gter brgyad sbas/dgongs gter dgu sbas/gsang gter gsum sbas/sbas pa'i yul bzhi sbas/yul 'dra min bzhi sbas/ yul phran bzhi sbas/bod kyi lha srin dam la btags nas chos la bkod do//sa ma yaḥrgya rgyargyaḥ.o rgyan rin po che gus pas 'dud/ dus de 'dra byung na snying rje gsungs/spyan nas spyan chab mang du gnang / mi rnams 'di 'du dpe srid snyam pa'i ngang nas lus 'dug pas/ gu ru'i zhal nas 'odi skad gsungs/ mtha' dmag gi lag tu shar nas ngan sang du 'khyams dgas pa 'dra byung /gu ru nga dang dkan mchog gsum la rtse gcig tu gsol ba thob/ gtsug tor stobs po che dang gra rtog gser gsum sgrog /bablo+og pa dang gsang khrus la 'bad 'bungs bgyis/de ltar byas nas sbas yul la 'gro ba'i blo rnyed do//yang rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis zhus pa/ gu ru rin po che lags/ de dus sbas yul 'di ru gang bza' gang btung /yon tan phan yon ci 'dra yod zhus pas/slob dpon rin po ches bka' stsal pa/ gang zag rnams ni/ btsan po bya phag lo pas yul gyi dbus bzung / sa gzhi byin gyis rlobs/ btsun mo bya glang sbrul lo mas sting rje skyongs/ sngags pa stag sbrul lo pa rnams kyis lha srin dam la btags/gu ru nga la mos shing blo sna zhugs pa dang /sgru cing spyod lha78

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro/la rtsub pa dang / sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa dang dus rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas thar ro/ /thog mar 'gro ba thams cad spyod pa 'di ltar bya'o//gtso bo gros la dbang ba ma nyams pas yul gyi dbus bzung / dbon po brgyud ma nyams pas lha srung mchod/ sngags pa dam chigo ma nyams pas yi dam sgrub pa byed/ gzhon pa shed ma nyams pas rgyags 'khur/ dge slong 'dul khrims ma nyams pas khrus dang gtsang sbra bya/ bud med lus ma nyams pas mda' dar me long thogs la bkram nas kyang / kha char ma chod na tshod lta zhing 'gro'o/ /lus la na tsha byung na mtho brtsegs la la brtsas pas dkar bran no/ /'chi bdag gi cho 'phrul byung na yung dkar dang gla rtsi sbyar nas dud pa gtong / gcan gzan gyi 'jigs byung na mkhar rnga dang dung cha lang rkang gling dang rol mo'i sgra sgrog go/drag dang chu la rig pas daspyad nas 'gro'o//gzhan yang 'bras mo ljongs kyi mtha' bskor na yod pa'i gnas ni sa dang po rab tu dga' ba bcu pa chos kyi sgrin non pa'i gnas yig yod de gzhan nas btsal dgos/'bras ljongs zhes bya ba ni mdzod lnga stag rtse'i mdun du 'dod pa'i yon tan sna tshogs yod pa/ dbus gtsang gnyis gzhongs ba/gnas 'dir phyin pa tsam gyis bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sa non pa yod/ sgo bzhi la 'dom phyed dang gsum bsrungs bas chog pa/ gzhan yang bod kyi nyams chung ba rnams zha bo dang / long ba dang / rgan bu rnams bros pa'i gnas ri dang rdza zom dang 279

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/lung sul lung khug la sogs pa'i bros lung gi gnas mang po byin gyis brlabs nas yod cing / de rnams kyi nang nas yangs la khrod che zhing btsan pa bkra this kyi byin chags pa/ sbas yul thams cad kyi gtso bo dpal 'bras mo ljongs su slebs pa'i phan yon ni/ thog mar slebs pa thams cad tshe lo bdun sku lus ma bor bar mkha' spyod du 'gro bar the tshom med/ gzhan yang rjes su slebs pa rnams ni bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob bo//'bras mo ljongs 'di lan cig 'khor na bskal pa dpag tu nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag go gsungs so/ /mos pas gom pa bdun yid gnyis the tshom med par phyin na lam du tshe 'phos kyang gu ru ngas bar do bsu ru 'ong ngo //sbas yul gyi ri mthong ba'i sa ru 'chi na bde ba can du skye zhing phung po 'ja' lus su 'a〈lha(//'bras mo ljongs 'di sems can thams cad rna bas thos pa tsam gyis mos zhing dad pa chen po byed pa'i mi rnams kyi brgyud pa mang po gu ru ngas rjes su bzung ngo //'dzin no//de bas dkar chag 'di 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i rna bar sgrog cig zhod cig/bris nas kun la spel cig/de ltar byas na gu ru nga'i rjes su skye'o/ /sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs 'dir phyi'i dbyibs la gru bzhi sgo bzhi gzhal yas khang du yod/ gnas kyi nang ni rnal 'byor pa'i lus lta bu'o//gsong ba'i rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yod do//de yango phu byang du bstan pa/ mad lha la bstan pa/ lung phran brgya dang lnga bcu yad da/ /mda' gcig tu bsdus pa yod/ zhar ri dar 'phan 'phyar ba 'dra/ lho ri mon pa khros 280

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro/pa 'dra/ zhub ri glang chen nyal ba 'dra/ byang ri lag sor bkram pa 'dra/ phu ru ral gri ltar du babs/mda' ru chu thams cad lha 'dre ltar babs pa/lung chu lcags sgrog ltar 'khyil ba/ phu ri gangs la shel gyi mchod rten brtsegs pa 'dra ba/ de 'og phal cher rdza ri rgya stag nags la 'gying pa 'dra ba/ de 'og phal cher spang ri gser gyi khyung gzhog rkyong pa 'dra ba/ de 'og phal cher nags spang 'dres mar/ gzi mchong spel ma'i dreng ba lta bu/ de 'og phal cher nags la dom nag ral pa dkrug pa 'dra ba/ yul mthil gser gyi gzhong pa 'dra ba/ phu ru chu dkar chu rtsa rgya shug sug dkar skye ba/ mda' ru rtsod dang g.yer tshwa skye ba/ bar du lo thog sna dgu smin pa/ lung phu thams cad na sha ba dang gna' ba dgo gnyan sbrul la sogs pa'i ngar skad mang po sgrog pa/ zhar phyogs bde chen 'o ma can gyi mtsho/ lho phyogs bde chen 'jam dpal gzhin rje'i mtsho/hūṃb phyogs bde chen pad+ma can gyi mtsho/byang phyogs bde chen ma ning sding gi mtsho/de rnams mtsho chen dgu yis bskor nas yod/de rnams mjal ba tsam gyis stod kyi mtsho pad+ma can dang ma pham g.yu mtsho dang mtsho chen bzhi po mjal ba dang mnyam mo/ /mtsho nang du dung dang nya mo chu srin dang seṅge mang po yod pa/ de'i phu na mdzod lnga stag rtse rgyal chen gdan la 'gying ba 'dra ba/de yi phu mda' la rta pa'i nyin lam bco brgyad tsam yod/ de'i dbus su brag dkar bkra shis lding zhes bya ba / cho lo ri gzham bab pa 'dra ba yod/ rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang cho lo rigs gru bzhi yod pa/ dpal dgongs 28spro

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/'dus kyi pho brang tshul du yod pa phyogs mtshams rigs lnga'i pho brang dang 'dra ste/ brag ri them pa bdun brtsegs yod pa/them pa dang po la btsun mo'i thab chas dang ka cha rnams yod/gnyis pa na bstan srung cha tshang yod/gsum pa na gter sgrom gcig gi nang du 'bru'i rigs kyi sa bon yod/ bzhi pa na go mtshon gyi gter kha yod/lnga pa na so nam gyi lag cha'i gter kha yod/drug pa na bal 'khor byed kyi gter kha yod/ de rnams gu ru'i bzhugs khri'i 'gram na yod/ kyong nas 'bur du thon pa brag dkar bkra shis lding de nyid rtsa ba bltas na maṇ+ḍal gyi phyal 'dra ba/sked pa rab byung chos gos bsnam pa 'dra ba/rtse mo rdo rje 'gyel ba 'dra ba/de'i phyogs la gu ru'i khri re re yod/chos kyi sgra sgrog pa'i chos dung dang glang chen gyi mche ba rang 'byon/ de'i zhar phyogs phug pa'i nang bdud rtsi rang 'byon/ le'u bdun ma dang / bsam lhun bton na gu ru'i khrus kyi bdud rtsi rgyun babs pa yod/ zhar lho mtshams su mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lam ka'i 'og na dur khrod bsil ba dang mnyam pa gcig la gcan gzan sna tshogs kyi rkang rjes bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang de yi 'og na ngan song sgo mo yod/ de'i steng na gu ru'i bzhugs khri rdo rje phag mo'i pho brang yod/ phyag 'tshal sgang na drag po'i gtor ma rang 'byon yod/ de'i gong na khro bo me 'bar gcig bzhugs/ bzhugs khri'i dbus na rdo tshal gyi g.yung drung ris dang / de'i 'gram na phyi rgya mtsho ri chu skad dang bya ngang pa'i skad dus tshes bzang por las can gyi nyan na chos sgra thos pa yod/de'i 'gram na gu ru'i kha 282

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro/ṭ+wāṃ ka btsugs nas tsan dan gyi sdong po rtse lnga pa zhig yod/ de la mkha' 'gro sde lnga mngon sum du bzhugs yod gsungs/ phyogs bzhi la mi 'gyur ba'i gzer chen bzhi yod/ de la tsan dan gyi sdong po bzhi 'khrungs yod de/ de nas pho 'dom gsum tsam gyi rtsa ba na gu ru'i bdud rtsi rang 'byon yod pas 'di skal lta bha das rak+ta 'byor/ sku mdog smug nag gcig bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal bskang bshags rgya cher byas nas smon lam btab na hūṃb phyogs o rgyan gling du skye'o/ /rta mgrin dang gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje yab yum/ de'i g.yon du gu ru drag po zil non/ 7rje lha btsun chen po mkhan sku gzhogs kyi gdung rten ring bsrel bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs/ de'i steng na rdo rje gdan nas spyan drangs pa'i klu sgrub kyi sku gdung lnga/ gser rnams dang ston pa'i sku gdung bya mo'i sgo nga tsam gsum bzhugs/ na ro paṇa chen gyi sku gdung gcig dang rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i li dmar las grub pa'i sku gdung nyer lnga tsam bzhugs/ dur khrod du rdo rje phag mo bcu gcig zhal rta mgrin rigs gsum mgon po rnams yod/ der 'chi ba dang / ro 'khyer ba dang bskor ba tsam gyis ngan song du mi 'gro'o/ /mjal ba tsam gyis phung po 'ja' lus su 'gro/ phyi ma ngan song lhung na na ra kan/ las can rnams kyi dur khrod me 'bar ba mthong / tshes bzang dus bzang rnams la lce sbyang dang mkha' 'gro'i sku mjal ba dang rol mo'i sgra thos so/ /las 'phro can gyis bu rnams kyi mkha' 'gro ma mngon sum du mjal lo//'dir gcod gtong ba dang phung po 283

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/zan du bskyur zhus na sangs rgyas so/ /gzhan yang ston pa shāka thub kyi 'phel gdung dang bsam yas mchod rten dkar po nas 'phel ba'i shā ri'i bu'i tshems/ chos 'phags kyi tshems dang / gter ston gling pa brgya dang /dri med lnga/ mchog sprul rnam pa gsum de dag gi gter nas byon pa'i bram ze'i sku sha de dag 'phel ba'i ring bsrel gsum/khyad par mthong grol btags grol gyi+o 'khor lo dang rang byon snying gter nas byon pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang ba med da//gnas yig chen po las/ o rgyan dang ni rgyal po bzhugs pa'i gnas/brag dkar bkra shis lding zhes brag ri ni/ dpangs su 'dom ni tha brgya tham pa yod/de'i steng gi brag dkyil mjal ba dang /skyes pa dar ma'i mda' rgyang bzhi'i tshad/ phyogs bzhi tsan dan sdong po bzhi yod do/ /brag ri de'i rtse mor bltas pa na/ 'bras mo gshongs kyi phu mda' bar gsum dang / phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad ma lus gsal por mthong / de'i me long ngos ltar 'jam pa la/ brag ri rdo rje rgya gram 'dra ba'o/ /maṇ+ḍal spungs dang g.yung drung 'khyil ba 'dra/ yang na nor bu'i g.yung drung 'dra/ de'i dbus na mkhan slob mchod yon rdo sku rang byon yod/ gnas der ni rnam rgyal khang bzang dang /rdo rje gdan/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ ri bo po tā la/ lcang lo can/ bde ba can/ o rgyan gling /zangs mdog dpal ri/pad+ma 'od dang mnyam mo//gnas yig chen po las/ gnas 'dir sgrub sde lha khang bzhengs na/ bod 284

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 3ོda 'phro/yul lo brgya'i bar du bde bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs/ de lta bu'i gnas ni 'bru btab kyang mi 'khrungs pa gcig kyang med/ zhing thog gi rigs me tog gi rtags 'bru bcud kyi rigs mastun gyi rtags/ rin po che dang rdo rje yi rtags/ sman ngad dang shing sna'i rigs/ chos dang bya rigs kyi rtags su gyur pa thams cad la sogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling na nor bu rin po che lta bu'i 'bras mo gzhongs der slebs pa'i mi rnams ni 'di phyi gnyis kyi don grub bo gsungs so/ /gsol 'debs dang smon lam log par btab na/ min bud med gsum gyi kha non/ rgya bod mon gsum gyi 'dren thabs/ dad can 'byor lngan can gyi zhing sa/ las can sgrib gnyis bstan la 'di dgos te/ lung bstan kun sel sgron med las/ gnas sbas yul rigs la gyur pa'i rtags//sku'i rtags su pad+ma'i sgrub phug re/ /gsung gi rtags su dam chos gter kha re/ /thugs rje'i rtags su gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtog zad/ /yon tan rtags su gu ru'i phyag rjes bzhag /re re yod pas gnas chen byin gyis rlobs/ /phrin las rtags su rang ngo shes byas nas/ /bod 'bangs chos byed sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan tshugs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang ma btab pa'i lo thog drug cu re bzhi skye'o/ /'abhu'i sa bon gter nas ston la/ skyes shul du btab pas/gnas de ni 'bras mo byung thang shin tu che ste/ bre gang gi sa bon la snyon khal nyi shu re skye'o/ /star kha mar dang mnyam pa'i rigs nyi shu yod/ mngar khag rigs mi 'dra ba sno thub pa nyer lnga yod/'dzam bya gling gi zhing thog ma tshang ba 285

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/med/phu'i ri thams cad la tshad pa sel ba'i sman dang /mda'i ri thams cad la grang ba sel ba'i sman bcas yod do/ /sbal yul rin chen gasgo+ongs kyi g.yas logs na/ 'tsho byed sman gyi sdong bu dri ngad dpal ldan pa gcig la 'bru'i rigs mi 'du ba bdun yod pas/ de'i lo ma dang 'bras bu la sogs pa rtog nas gnyer logs par byas pas rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa thams cad la phan na//dgongs 'dus bka' rgya ma las/ brag dkar bkra shis lding nas yar bltas pas/ /ri gdong phag nyal 'dra ba gcig yod do/ /zhes pas/ de la gzigs nas phyin pas brag 'gram gcig tu slebs yod/ de'i 'khris la cung phyin pas brag ka ba bco brgyad kyis bteg pa'i tshad tsam gcig yod/de na rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bkrag ma nyams pa yod/ de mthong ba tsam gyis phung po lhag med du sangs rgyas so/ /de'i dbus na 'jig rten steng na rin po che bum pa ma gha dha'i bre gcig zhong ba'i tshad tsam gcig gi nang na yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel lnga brgyas bskor ba yod/ 'dzam bu gling gi bde skyid thams cad 'di las byung ba yin no//zhar na 'chi bed tshe yi bum pa tshe chus bkang ba yod/ de chu thig re 'thung na tshe yi rig 'dzin thob/ zhar lho na dar sngon pos 'asdul ba'i nang rkang mgyogs kyi rdzas yod/ lho na gu ru'i phur pa srid pa kun 'dus yod/ de ston pa tsam gyis srid gsum dbang du 'dus shing / gdeng pa tsam gyis pha rol gnod byed rengs par gyur/ lho hūṃb 286

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro/na sba lcag la srin po'i lag pa zhig yod/ de lag pa g.yon du thogs na lha 'dre mi gsum gyis mi mthong / zhub na be long dar dmar pos 'dril ba yod/de ba dmar po'i 'o mas khrus byas na srid gsum thams cad mthong / hūṃb byang na thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i rdzas yod do/ /byang na rnga srid gsum kun 'dus yod/de bdung na lha 'dre mi gsum gyi dmag bros so//byang zhar na gu ru'i gter rdzas dang sgrub rdzas yod/ de'i ming la sbas yul rdo rje me long zer ro/ /de'i zhub la phyin pas shing skyer pa'i sdong po bdun yod do/ /de bar thad logs nas bltas pas chu rdo sngon po gcig yod/ de bshig na brag phyag chen po gcig yod/de nang rgyal ba'i gsung rab rgya gar rgya nag kha che za hor gser gling zangs gling o rgyan gling li yul la sogs pa rnams nas spyan drangs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten ma tshang ba med do/ /rol mo'i sgra dang mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod/ lho phyogs su brag phag pa 'dra ba rdo rje ka ba bzhi'i bteg pa'i nang maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa yod/maṇ+ḍal de'i zhar 'khris 'og nang mda' gang brkos pa zangs kyi ga'u gcig nang mkha' 'gro ma dngos grub 'dus pa'i rgyu dang sgrub rdzas yod/nor bu bsam 'phel bya ngang pa'i sgong tshad tsam yod/ de bskor bas don bsgrub bud me+ed srid 'phel/ gzhan yang phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod/glang phug ces pas/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs zhes bya/ lho bod gnyis kyi mtshams na yod/ rgya gar gyi chu sgo bod kyi ri chen bzhi zhes bya ba/ brag 287

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/spang du mda' rgyang drug tsam zheng du 'dom bdun yod/ de'i dkyil smad na brag phug kha lho zhub tu blta ba dpangs su khyim gsum thog dang mnyam pa ka ba bcu gnyis kyis bteg pa tsam yod/de'i dbus na rig 'dzin tshe'i dkyil 'khor yod/ nor bu bsam 'phel bum rdzas kyi bkang ba de mthong ba lus la reg na mchog thun mong dngos grub thob/ phyogs bzhir bdud rtsis thod pa bkang ba bzhi/ bram ze skye bdun gyi zha rimyo/ skye bdun gyi thod pa gcig yod/ gzhan yang brag phyag de nang las phur dang mchod chas lha rten sogs bod du sgyur tshad kyi rnam pa dang 'dzom gling phyed tsam sos pa'i nor rdzas yod/ brag phug 'di ni o rgyan bde chen phug ces bya'o/ /'dir slebs pa tsam gyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob bo/ /slar yang brag phug 'di la mchog thob pa'i brag phug gnyis/ thun mong thob pa'i brag phug gsum/ spyir sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs kyi lung pa la mchog thob pa'i brag phug bcu gsum/thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i brag phug phran bu yod gsungs so/ /gzhan spong byang lung lam rkus mang po gzhan nas btsal dgos zhus/mdzod lnga stag rtse zhes pa ni/ gangs ri dang po chos kyi mdzod/ /gangs ri gnyis pa gser g.yu'i mdzod/ /gangs ri gsum pa nor gyi mdzod/ /gangs ri bzhi pa mtshon gyi mdzod/ /gangs ri lnga pa 'bru dang sman gyi mdzo+od/ gangs phran rnams longs spyod kyi gter mang po yod do/ /sh-ir bsam gtan phug na kha byang gi gter kha yod par gsungs so// 288

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro/brag dalo/ra bkra shis lding gi lho hūṃb na/ pha bong sbal pa 'dra ba gcig yod/ de nang go cha'i gter khrab stong dang brgyad brgya/ phub stong phrag gnyis dmag dang brgyad brgya/ gri dang mtshon cha de'i bdun bsgyur tsam yod/ shar na rin po che thang bya ba brag dkar po gcig yod/ de nang khro stong phrag gsum dang rdza ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod/ de nas mda' rgyang gang na/ rdo ra mgo 'dra ba gcig yod/ de'i 'og na sgrom gcig nang lung chags tshul rgyas pa yod/ gzhi bdag gi ngo 'dzin mchod 'phrin sgrub thabs bcas gsal por yod/de'i zhar na tshon rtsi lha khang logs bris mon ras bcas yod/ de'i lhor ri dwags sna tshogs mi 'dra ba mang po yod/ sh-i'i gter yin pas srog gcod mi bya/sman chu lnga dang chu tshan rigs lnga yod/nad rlung mkhris bad kan tsha grang thams cad la phan no/ /hūṃb na re wa mo chu 'thung 'dra ba gcig yod/ rdza dang dkar yol gyi gter yod/ byang na me tog rgya tshos dmar tshos bu ram ka ra sogs ma btab par skye'o/ /sprus yul 'bras mo ljongs 'di ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'o//phyogs zhes gsungs so//lha ri snying phug ces pa'i brag ri ni/ shar la kha bstan nas brag phug gsum yod pa'i/ lho'i nang na chos sku yum chen la/ phyogs bcu'i sras kyis bskor ba rang byon yod/ brag la rang byon gser gyis bris pa 'dra/ 'dir phyin mchod dang smon lam btab gyur na/ bod yul bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'drel 'grigs/ khyad par sa cha de zhes bya ba ru/ bzhad sgrub bstan pa dar rgyas 289

mkha' sbyod 'bras po ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas yi ge bris nas bstan gyur na/ gang bris sar bstan pa dar bar 'gyur/ dbus ma'i nang na tshe dpag med mgon tshe lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba bstan 'gyur na/ byang ma'i nang na rdo rje gzhon zhu la khro bcu khra thab bskor ba bstan 'gyur na/ lho'i nang drag po bzhi rgyud yod/ zhar ma'i nang na rgyal chen rnam sras la/ nor lha rta brgyad kyis bskor ba yod/'dir phyin bod kyi dge sgre sde dpon gyi/ mnga' thang phrin las rgyas pa'i rten 'brel sgrig /de'i zhub na rdo rje phag mo la mkha' 'gro sde lngas bskor ba rang byon yod/ der phyin bod kyi grub thob pho mo rnams/ nyams rtogs rgyas dang khyim pa srid med na/ bu bdun skye ba'i rten 'drel sgrig par byed/ de'i zhub na lha mo rdor rgyun ma/ btab pa'i lo thog skye ba'i lha gsum yod/ de'i zhub tu 'chi bdag gzhin rje dang / srog bdud 'chi bdag pho nya'i tshogs bcas dang /de'i 'og tu hom khung gru gsum yod/ bod du gnas tshab can sbas yul sogs/ bdud rigs dpung yin ming bris 'gyur na/ lo yi phangs su 'chi bdag gnas su 'gro/ de'i 'khris la rdo'i ga'u gsum yod/ khro bcu sdam pa'i nang du sgog dril bdun/ yod pa'i snga dgra phyi dgra yin/ srog gcod len dang mnga' thang longs spyod rnams/ 'dzoms pa'i drag sngags then gsum 'brang 'gyur na/ zhag bdun bar du mi 'gyang rtags mtshan byung /de'i zhib cha sgo nang tshud ma thag/brag ri bong bu 'du ba gcig yod de/de'i logs mtshon gyi rdo rje rgya gram yod/ de 'og 'dom gang brkos na ga'u yod/ gnas sgo 290

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro/'byed lugs gter gyi kha byang yod/ nga la gsol btab tshogs gtor bya/dus ngan mthar thug de dus su/ pad+ma'i thugs rje lhag par myur/ sbas yul 'tsho yi gang zagre/ la/nga dang 'du bral med par the tshom spang /de'i rgyu rkyen rten 'brel ni/o rgyan rgyal po in+d+ra bho dhi'i yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel/sprul pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam po lha yi dbang po brgya byin longs spyod gter bum/ sprul sku dga' rab rdo rje'i dbu thod nas mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya rdo rje gdan du sgrub pa'i tshe bum phyag na rdo rje 'gro ba'i don phyir rdo rje char 'beb kha mdog lnga lngan/ o rgyan dang rdo rje phag mo gnyis su med pa sde bzhi/ hūṃ ka ras kha dbyings dag pa'i yul la tshe sgrub pa'i sman thod pa gang / bī ma mi tra'i ljags las pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ nam mkha'i snying po'i tshe yi ril bu/ mkha' 'gro ye r+shas mtsho rgyal gyis zhal gzigs pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' las byon pa sangs rgyas stong gi sku rang byon/'das pa'i sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi ring bsrel/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis phul ba'i sangs rgyas stong sku/ slob dpon sgo ta'i phyag 'khar las rigs gsum mgon po rang 'byon/ de rnams kyi thog drangs pa'i gter kha chen po brgya dang bdun yod// de'i nang na mthong pas nyon mongs dang bral ba/ rig pas sangs rgyas/ thos pas tshe nyi rla ltar mnyam pa/ phun sum tshos/sa pa'i gter kha lnga yo da pa/ lung pa'i gangs mtsho thang shing gi snong po rnam/sa la lha'i pho brang stong phrag drug gnas so/ /sku khri phrag gcig yod/ de'i 291

mkha' spyod 'bras po ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/phyir 'bras mo gzhongs zhes bya ba de ni rna bas thos pa yang tshe rabs thogs med nas bsod nams bsags pa yin no/ /yul 'dir 'dun pa gtong ba ni skal ba dang lngan pa yin no//zhes gsungs so//pad+ma saṃ bha was gsung ba'i zhal gdams lung bstan las/ 'dzam gling 'di ni byin rlabs che ba yin/ /sku dang ring bsrel chos dang man ngag dang /khyad par can gyi rdzas bdun yid bzhin gyi/ /nor bu bdun dang skye bdun zha//tshe chu chos gos yo byad yod/ /ma tshang med pa thams cad gter du sbas//rang byon lha sku khri dang drug stong yod/ /gnas 'dir bde ba can gyi sa bon yin/ /de las 'bad rtsol byed pa'i mi rnams ni/ /lus kyi shig kyang bde ba can du skyes/ /nang du slebs na mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /de phyir gnas nang gom pa bdun brgyab na/ /phyi ma ngan song lhung ba mi srid do/ /mos shing yo byad phul ba'i mi rnams ni/ /tshe 'dir bkra shis mi nor mnga' thang rgyas/ /phyi ma spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing du skyes/ /de la dre gang tsam zhig 'brel na yang //'di phyi dbul 'phongs sdug bsngal zhi bar gyur/ /dge ba 'bum 'gyur thob pa gdon mi za//gnas 'dir phyi nang gang du 'dug pa yang //tshogs bzhams dge ba'i smon lam gang btab 'grub/ /'dzam gling gnas ni de 'dra yod mi srid/ /pad+ma ngas kyang mthong zhing rna bas thos/ /gzhan na yod zer ba ma thos//de mi bden na gu ru ngas/ gsungs pa'i chos thams cad rtsa ba nas mi bden no/ khyad par gnas 'di bcol ba ni/ byang mdzod lnga stag rtse la bcol rmi92

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro/lo/ /shar gnyan chen thang lha la gtad/ /lho bdud btsan spun gsum la gtad//zhub ma mo la gtad/ /lung pa spyi'i gzhi bdag gnyan chen thang lha la gtad/gzhan yang rdo rje legs pa/ bstan ma bcu gnyis la gtad do zhes so/ /dus ngan mtha' ma'i tshe na dgos pa'i phyir/ sbyan ras gzigs kyi byin gyis rlobs/ de nas sgrol ma khro gnyer can dang ni/ lha dbang brgya byin srong btsan sgam po yi/ sprul pa'i mi bdun mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs mdzad/ tha ma pad+ma bdag dang bho dhi yis/ chos skyong rgyal po sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro/ chos blon brgyad dang yi dam chos srung dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro byang sems sogs/ma lus tshogs nas gnas 'dir byin gyis brlabs/sa 'dul byin phebs tho thogs stong btab/ gter sbas gnyer bkod smon lam brgya tshar btab/ ces rgya cher gsungs/ nor bu rin chen lta bu'i 'bras mo gzhongs 'dir slebs pa rnams ni/ dbul zhing 'phongs pa bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal mi khom gnas brgyad nyon mongs pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral lo/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas so/ /sbas yul 'bras mo gshongs 'dir lan cig 'khor na yang bskal pa stong gi sdig pa dag par gsungs so// mkha' 'gro gsang phug ces pa'i gnas yig ni/ 'di rin chen spungs nas phar bltas pas zhar phyogs na ri snom nag rgyugs pa 'dra ba gcig yod/ de'i rtsa ba me+e 'bar phug ces bya ba dbyibs ni zhing sgam rang byon la sgo yod/de na pha bong chen po gcig zhal ma ri'i sdong rngu+o yod/g.yon na dpal rdo 293

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/rje gzhon hūṃ dang /de'i g.yas na mkha' 'gro sde lnga brag la rang byon yod/de na brag phug gi thog bdud mo'i glo snying na tshe chu bab pa yod/ de'i 'og tshe bum dang gtor ma bdun tsam yod/ de rnams bya rgyud sbyod rgyud rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sogs pa rgyud sde bzhi'i gtor ma yin no/ /de 'og na bdud mo'i ro mgo lag dang bcas pa tshang ma yod/ de'i g.yas na sbrul la sogs pa yod/ de nas pho 'dom gcig tsam mar me bteg nas phyin na 'gag dog po bcu sacig yod/zhib par bltas na ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi bha ga dang /de'i 'og na gu ru'i zhabs rjes rang byon yod/ de nas 'gag gcig brgal song bas/ gu ru'i tshogs khang dang sku rjes dbu'i pad zhwa sku gre/zugs yongs rdzogs phyag gnyis rjes rnams gsal bar bzhugs yod cing / lho phyogs mon kha'i brag la sku rjes bzhag ces so/ /de'i g.yas na ye shes ma/tsho rgyal dang sku rgyab na rdo ka ma ru pa las grub pa'i tshe ril dang seṅge rang lcon yod/der mkha' 'asgru'i gsang gter bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod do//gsungs so//nge/ nas yar tsam song ba dang /mkha' 'gro sbas pa'i gsang lam yod/de rna bar thos nga/ tsam gyis byang chub sems bsam pa la 'gyur nas skye ba gsum brgyud nas mi lus thob par gsungs so/ /zhal mjal ba dang bskor ba tsam gyis tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob par the tshom med do gsungs/phug pa'i sgo nas pho 'dom drug tsam song tsa na/ bdud mo'i ro rtsar mjal rgyu yod/ de nas mda' rgyang gcig tsam yar song ba dang / lha lug gi rtags 294

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro/ tshul dang zhabs rjes yod/ de nas phar tsam song ba dang pha bong la/ gu ru'i sku rjes gsal por yod/ de nas phar tsam song ba dang / gu rus bdud mo btul nas gzugs dang pags pa gsal por yod/ gu ru dang chibs pa'i zhabs rjes la sogs pad+ma rang byon mang po yod/ de rnams mjal ba thams cad kyang / tshe rabs bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag /phyi ma o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du skye'o/ /gsungs so/ /zhes mkha' 'gro gsang phug gi gnas yig rgyas pa gzhan na yod kyang zur tsam bris pa'o//khrag 'thung rong na/ rol mo dang rnga dang mkha' 'gro'i zhabs phyag rjes ṭī ma ru rdo rje dril bu sogs dang /gzhan yang mon pa klong gi zhabs rjes dang ro phung yod/ de 'og sa/shin rje'i dwa gdong chos kyi rgyal po dang bskal mtsho na gser nya g.yu nya rnams chu mo hū+oṃ sgra ldir ba'i nang na yod/ces gsungs/de yi phug nang phag mo rong zhes bya ba ni/ phag mo'i bha ga las khrus chu grong lnga brgya 'dom pa yod/ de'i 'og na 'jam dpal bla mtsho dang khrag 'thung rta mgrin sgro+ol ma phag mo gathin rje tho/gas kyi khrus chen po mtsho dgu yod gsungs sa//yug sam thang zhes bya ba ni/ 'bras ljongs kyi sa phud rdo phud las bzhengs pa'i mchod rten bkra zhis 'od 'bar la sangs rgyas gser thub dang 'od bsrung shākya thub pa sogs kyi gdung dang dbu skra na bza' mo'u 'gal gyi 'khar bsil dang lhung bzed shu ri'i bu'i chos gos tshems/ gu ru'i pad+ma'i za lha95

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/hor gyi ber dang zhabs lham g.yas pa yod/mtsho rgyal gyi dbya skra dang /gzhan yang 'dzam gling bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi sku gdung ring bsrel 'dir ma tshang ba gcig kyang med do/ /gzhan yang gnas yig rgyas pa yod tshod 'dug ste mdor bsdus tsam bkod pa'o//mchod rten 'di'i brtsigs pa bang rim bzhi'i steng na thogs tshad lnga tsam yod/smon lam 'debs lugs ni/zhar na tshe dang lho na 'bru ste/hūṃb na gser dngul dang / byang na chos gos so/ /zur bzhi bu'i dngos grub thob/ smon lam gcig las med pa mi yong ste/ gcig pu de bya rung kha zhor las lhag pa yin gsungs/ smon lam log na gang yang mi 'grub bo/ /bka' 'gyur tshar bzhi gser gyi bris pa dang / bstan 'gyur tshar bzhi dngul gyi bris pa yod/ gser dngul g.yu dang bye ru'i do zhal sogs/bre tshad bdun tsam yod ces gsungs so/ /dgon pa dmar po dung dang sil snyan dang / mtsho ni pad+ma pho mo gnyis la sogs/ gzhan yang dbyangs gsung mang po yod stubi 'dug kyang / mdor bsdus tsam bkod pa'o//shar phyogs sbas phug ces pa'i gnas yig mdor bsdus tsam bris pa ni/sgor phyogs zhi ba kha gdong dkar mo'i gnas/ rang byon bye ba phrag khri 'bum stong yod/ lho phyogs mngon par dga' ba bkod rdzogs zhing / rdo rje sems pa'i sku ru sangs rgyas sgo+og /phug pa'i sgo na mkha' 'gro'i brda yig yod/de'i g.yas na bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur bzhugs/ de nas sgo ma'i nang du 296

'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag gsal ba'i me long bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro/'asbyol ba dang / lag pa'i g.yas na zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis/ de'i g.yon na khrag 'thung drug cu tham pa bzhugs/ them sgo 'thon nas gu ru'i bzhugs khri yod/de 'og bdud rtsi 'o ma'i chu rgyun yod/chu sgra rol mo'i rgyun chad med par yod/de nas pho 'dom dgu tsam song tsa na/o rgyan gu ru pad+ma'i 'bras mdzod yod/de nas pho 'dom bzhi tsam song tsa na/bdud mo'i snying nas tshe ring bzhin babs/de nas 'dom pa bdun tsam song tsa na/mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang gang de rdo rje sems dpa'i tshogs/tshogs khang yod de rdo rje sems pa dang /mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab bzhugs so/ /shar na rdo rje sems pa'i tshogs khang dang / lho na rin chen 'byung lngan tshogs khang yod/ de nas pho 'dom lnga tsam song tsa na/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas dkyil 'khor dang / ṭīkli ma sogs bsam gyis mi khyab bzhugs/de'i byang na don yod grub pa yi/tshogs khang de dbus rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs/ de rnams lan cig tsam zhig mjal gyur na/'chi ba'i dus su rgyal ba rigs lnga yi/lam sna 'dren pa the tshom med do gsungs/ phug pa'i g.yas na bya khyung rang 'byon bzhugs/ sa bdag klu gnyan mthong pas rang sar grol/ de'i gong na pad+ma saṃ bha bzhugs/ mjal ba tsam gyis bsam don ma lus 'grub/ de 'og phyag rdor bzhugs zhing khams gsum kun/ dbang du 'dus shing gzhan rnams zil gyis non/ khyad par mdze nad can rnams mthong pa yi/ mjal ba tsam gyis mi grol na ra kan/ zhes gsungs so/ /rgyal khams phyogs mtshams thams cad du lo legs char chu 297

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/'be+ebs/mi nad phyugs nad rgyun chad do//dus 'khrugs kyi bskal pa zhi nas nad dang gnod pa sogs mi mthun pa'i gnod pa thams cad bral bar gyur cig /'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig 'di gar gnas gar 'dzin gang gi ma thos pas/bri klog sus byas pa thams cad kyang ngan song gi sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur ro/ /mchog gi dngos grub thob/ sprul sku ngang gi sems can gyi dpal du gyur pa'o//sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/zab rgya/gter rgya/sbas rgya/i hṝ/lho brag gi sked nas rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gter nas sbyan drangs pa'o/ /sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig dkar chag byin rlabs can rdzogs so//bkra zhis// //

bco〉༅//sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs 'og min rnam dag pad+ma dru ba can gyi gnas yig lung bstan gsol 'debs smon lam gter srung gsol mchod bcas bzhugs/12lha:t+panāgathuthepithāgiglusgrukhuspukhumartswasgapikhyigi/ 6 〈 ca' ji nasngu.e ma ho:sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi dpal che ba'i mchog: lha srin tshar gcod skal lngan rjes 'dzin mdzad:dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas o rgyan rje: bka' drin 'gran bral rigs kyi bdag por 'dud: 'di na 'og min rnam dag stug po bkod: sgrib byed skyon gyi chu 'dzin rang sangs te: mchog dman rnams kyi mig gi bdud rtsir snang :gu ru rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags pa ni:nga nyid lho zhub srin po 'dul du 'gro: bkod pa mdzes lngan zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser: rang snang sku gsum ston pa'i tshul du bzhugs: las can dag pa'i 'khor gyis rtag tu mjal: dad can tha mal skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyang : pad+ma dran na rtag tu sbas gnas 'grim: khyad par ljonges gsum nang nas 'bras mo ljongs: rnga yab gling dang tha dad yod re kan: rgyal ba nga nyid rtag tu der bzhugs shing :skal ba tsan la byin rlabs dbang bskur byed: zhes gsungs rgya cher ༵2 sgangatogadaben can dgon du bzhugs pa'i spar thung shog ldeb 1/ can las zhal bshus bgyis pa'o//299

mkha' spyod 'bras mo cadangs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/bsngags pa'i gnas 'di ru: yar ngo'i ches bcur o rgyan chen po dang /rig 'dzin rje 'bangs thams cad dngos su phebs:las 'bro lngan pas dngos su mjal yang srid:gnas 'dir nyams len sgrub la brtson byas na: gzhan du lo gcig bsgrub las 'di nyid du: zhag gcig bsgrub pa'i bogs skyed che bar 'byung : sa rdo ri brag ljon shing tshogs rnams kyang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bzhugs pa'i rten gnas byas: dad gus bskyed na byin rlabs lhag par 'phel: khyad par zhar phyogs zhi ba sku yi gnas: yin phyir sdig sgrib sbyang la 'bad byas na:nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad zhi bar 'gyur:lho phyogs rgyas pa yon tan gnas yin pas: tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod bsgrub byas na: 'dod pa'i don rnams myur du 'phel bar 'gyur: zhub phyogs dbang bsdud gsung gi gnas yin pas: mchog dman skye 'gro zas nor longs spyod dang : mchog thun dngos grub 'gugs pa'i las brtsam na: myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba the tshom med: byang phyogs phrin las drag po'i gnas yin pas: zhing bcu tshar gcod 'gugs sgrol las brtsam na: mngon spyod bstan pa bsrung ba'i las kun 'grub: dbus phyogs lhun gyi grub pa'i gnas yin pas:phrin las gang brtsam thog pa med par 'grub:gnas 'di gsang sngags bstan pa'i 'byung gnas yin: rdzogs chen kun bzang thugs kyi bstan pa dar: nyan bzhad bsgom bsgrub nan tan byed zhus na: phung po lhag med 'od skur smin par nges: cis kyang bsgom bsgrub gnad du ma smin 300

'bras ljongs 'og min rnam dag pad+ma dru ba can gyi gnas yigakyang : 'chi kha dag pa'i zhing du dbugs dbyung thob2 de yang dge sdig gnyis po 'gyur stobs che— dge ba gang byas rgyal bas byin rlabs mthus:bye ba dung phyur grangs med 'phel stobs che2 sdig pa bsags na de yang mang du 'phel: de phyir gnas 'dir sdig la 'dzem gal che: srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i bya ba kun: gnas 'dir byas na mi 'dod rkyen ngan 'byung :gnas 'dir 'dug pa'i dad can pho mo rnams: nyin mo byung res o rgyan sbyi bor sgoms: gsol 'debs sning po badz+ra gu ru sgrongs: tshe 'di'i bar chad thams cad sel ba dang : phyi ma o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing mchog tu: skye nas phyir mi lngog pa'i sangs rgyas thob: mtshan mo byung res thugs rje chen po sgoms: gsung mchog yi ge drug pa bzlas brjod mdzod: tshe 'di'i phun tshogs zhor la 'byung ba dang : rigs drug 'khor ba'i skye sgo chod pa dang :don gnyis lhun grub 'bras bu smin par 'gyur:sa ma ya:gnas mchog lho gling rin chen gshongs 'di na: gter gyi bdag po gnyan chen thang lha gnas: gnyan 'khor bye ba dung phyur mang po yod: ko long dam zhing 'khu lngog gdug rtsub che: rtag tu mchod phyir 'bras dkar g.yag gis brngan:gter gyi bdag po mdzod lnga stag rtse ni:gangs ljongs sum cha tsam gyi gter la dbang : gnod spyin rnam thos sras kyi sprul pa ste: nam mkha' mdzod mnga' dbul ba'i gdung ba sel: rtag tu mchod na gnas 'dir bde skyid dar: g.yag lug bya ra'i gzugs 'gros ru mtshon dang :30spro

mkha' rjodad 'bras mo 11ngas kyi gnas yig tre(gas bsdebs bzhugs/gter bum sna tshogs go khrab gos kyis mchod: sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i dgos pa yod2 bcu phrag mda' yi grangs 'das 'khyud 'khor 'o'i:dus kyi rnam 'gyur ngom pa'i gar mkhan mas:sa 'dzin dben par skyong tshe ra ba yis: bgrod dka'i gnas thob ming dang don mthun pa'i: gnas kyi khyad chos rnam par snang bar 'gyur:lag na zho 'thung rus bus rdo rje can:mdzod ldan rka la sha ri'i phrag par lding: risas lngan rgyal ba stobs ldan drag mchog gi: zhabs stegs su wa r+ṇa yi khri yang bkod: rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs mchog tu rgyas: snga 'gyur rgyud lung man ngag chos kyi mdzo+od: gter du gtams pa'i sgo yang de dus 'byed: gnas skabs bod chen ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi:bstan pa rgya cher dar ba'i gnas yin pas:de yi sa gnad rin chen gzhongs 'dir yod: phug chen bzhi dang brag dkar bkra shis sdings: lnga po de ru dam sri mnan pa dang : de steng bdud 'dul mchod rten bzhengs byas na: sa gnad me btsa' yin pas bstan la phan: bstan don lhag bsam yar zla tshes 'dra ba'i: bya ba byed mkhan yod na bstan 'dzin yin:mthun rkyen sgrub mkhan yod na las can yin:sa ma ya:bdag ni gu yang blo bde'i rnal 'byor pa: rdo rje bde chen gling pa zhes su grags: gu ru'i bka' bzhin rin chen gshongs 'dir sleb: be+e ro'i sprul pa badz+ra bho ṭa yi: sgyub gnas balha zhod kyi sgrub khang du: lhag bsam rab dkar bstan 'gro'i don sgrub ched: bsten sgrub gnad smin dgongs pa'i don ldan 302

'bras ljongs 'og min rnam dag pad+ma dru ba can gyi gnas yigapas: slob dpon sgegs pa'i rdo rje dngos dang mjal: gnas kyang yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor te: badz+ra cit+ta ko ṭi zhes bya ba: drag rtsal gzi byin lngan pa nyid du mthong : sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i rgyud kyi mchog: nye rgyud smin grol gdams ngag rgya cher thob:'jam dpal tshe bdag gdong drug 'jigs byed dang : ki kang dug ri nyi bzhi 'char ka dang : khro chu dug sdong ṭ+wāṃ ga rak+ṣa sogs2 drag sngags gzhin rje rol pa'i zab gter rnyed:blo bde don 'grub rang nyid ngal ba'ang : 'bras med ma yin bsam pa tshims par byung : yul phyogs 'ji/ ni lho mon spyi zlum ste: brda' 'phrod dka' zhing chos kyi gnad mi shes: rgyu 'bras go log spang blang mgo rmongs gyur: o rgyan bka' bzhin don 'bras 'di byung zhes: gzhan rgyud grol ba'i 'gro don cang med sems:'on kyang yid bzhin nor bu rigs bdag nyid: rjes dran thugs rgyud bskul ba'i byin rlabs mthus: nam yang dgos 'bras don ldan yin nam snyam:dogs pa za ba'i the tshom bdag la med: yul spyi rgyal po blon po 'bangs 'khor bcas:bde zhing rtag tu bsam pa 'grub pa'i ched:thugs rje chen po ma ṇi bum sgrub dang : rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa gnyis po de: lo re bzhin du/ chad med bsgrub zhus na: dgos don khyad par rgyal po'i mnga' thang rgyas:chab srid 'jam zhing rtag tu ngabu rmog btsan: rgol ba kun bral yongs la dbang zhing phyug: sde 'bangs dar zhing rgyal po'i bka' lung nyan:chos bzhin spyod cing sdig pa'i srol ngan zhub: ya rabs bskal pa bzang por rjes su 303

mkha' spyod 'bras mo cadangs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/snegs: de dag gu ru yid bzhin nor bu yi: thugs rje 'byung phyir dad mos rim gro la: 'bad par byed las gzhan la blo ma gtod: bslu ba me+ed do pad+ma'i lung bstan yinaca sa ma yaca lha: gnas 'dir rnam dkar legs par bsgrub pa ni: yar ngo'i tshes bcu dpa' bo'i dga' ston la: o rgyan rjes dran tshogs mchod 'bul ba dang : mar ngo'i nyer lnga dpa' mo'i dga' ston la: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mchod spyin sreg dag la 'bad: phyag 'tshal bskor ba grangs me+ed maṇ+ḍal dang : sdig bzhags yig brgya yig drug tshe thar gtong : ma ṇi sirnyi gdugs dkar sgrol ma dang : bsam lhun ltung bsgogs yig brgya dar cog 'dzug: dad gus dag snang phyogs bed sbyang byas na: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams rol par 'char: sdig pa cung zad tsam la'ang brnyas mi bya: dge sdig khyad gsod phyi rol mu stegs pa'i:'dod tshul phyogs dang nye ba rgyun tu spang : de ltar spang blang legs par ma byas na: khyad 'phags gnas la brten te sdig bsags pas: rtag tu thar med ngan 'gro'i rgyu ru 'gyur: de phyir spang blang zhib pa gal che'o:sa ma ya: lha: gnas mchog dpal gyi 'bras mo ljongs 'di ru: bar chad gnod 'tshe'i rkyen gtong gdug pa can: kha dar na ni bka' lung 'di bzhin bya: phyi rol gling gzhan dag nas kha 'khyal ba'i: rgyal gshed dam sri phung 'dre gdug rtsub canaca chos la mi dga' mi dge'i sdig spyod kyi: rgyab brten byed 304

'bras ljongs 'og min rnam dag pad+ma drwa ba can gyi gnas yigacing yul lha'i mdzod du gab: mi bde rkyen gtong mi nor srog la rngam: mi yi snying zhugs srog gcod sdig pa'i las: sha khrag dmar mchod byas na phan zer ba'i: rdzun tshig smra zhing sdig pa'i sna 'dren byed: de dag yul 'di'i 'dre srin 'byug 'dren yin: rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal ma mthong : theg mcho ga dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i gral mi gnas: zab mo rgyu 'bras bden pa'i dam mi gnas: dmyal ba'i sa 'dzin dam nyams ru tra yin: de dag 'dul phyir rim gnyis rnal 'byor gyis: gdengs chen ldan pas drag po'i gtor bzlog brtsam:las la sbyor bas de dag thul nas 'gro:de nas thog ser nad dang god kha chod: gdug pa 'dul ba'i 'byung bzhi'i 'khor lo brtsam: gnad dang lngan na nag phyogs pham nas 'gro: phye ma leb kyi mkha' lding rtsal mi 'gran: de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu la 'gran zla bral: 'gran med ngo mthon stobs kyi las sbyor bya:sa ma ya:lha: o rgyan lung bstan sbas gnas 'bras ljongs 'dir: yul lha gzhi bdag 'khrugs pa'i rtags byung na: de dag zhi bar byed pa'i thabs la brtson: de ma brtson na yul 'di'i legs nyes kyi: rten 'brel go log 'char bas mi bde bskyed: nyes sel phan pa'i las thabs mi shes par:dran med glang ltar sngod na chos pa min: de yi 'khrugs rkyen mtha' mi sna tshogs kyis:gnas 'dir sa brko zhing bcad brag bshig dang :mtsho dkrug ri dwags gcan gzan bsad pa yis: yul gyi gzhi bdag khros pa'i ltas )05
