mkha' spyod 'bras yo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/mchog gi dngos grub thob: de phyir gnas nang gom pa bdun brgyab na: phyi ma ngan song gsum du lhung mi srid: mos shing yo byad phul ba'i mi rnams ni:tshe 'dir bkra zhis mi nor mnga' thang rgyas: phyi ma spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing du skye:'di la bre gang tsam zhig 'brel na yang :'di phyi'i dbyal phongs sdug bsngal zhi bar gyur: dge ba 'bum 'gyur thob pa gdon mi za: gnas chen 'di yi phyi nang gang du yang : tshogs bzham dge ba'i smon lam gang btab 'grub:ces dang : khyad par gnas chen kun gyi mchog gyur pa: 'phags pa'i zhing khams dpal gyi 'bras mo gshongs: dus ngan mtha' ma'i tshe na dgos pa'i phyir:dang por spyan ras gzigs kyi byin gyis brlab: de nas sgrol ma khro gnyer can dang ni: lha dbang brgya byin srong btsan sgam po dang : sprul pa'i mi bdun mkha' 'gros byin brlab mdzad: mtha' ma pad+ma bdag dang bho dhi dang : chos skyong rgyal po sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro bdun: chos blon brgyad dang yi dam chos srung dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lha srin byang sems dang : ma lus tshogs nas gnas 'di byin gyis brlab: sa 'dul byin phab lo thog sna tshogs btab:gter sbas gnyer bkod smon lam brgya rtsa btab:ces dang :mtha' dmag g.yo ba'i rtags brgyad yod: phyi rtags bzhi ni: sa g.yos nas yul khams 'khol bur 'jig: chu 'khyams bsdol nas yul zhing 'jig:me 'khyams 'bar nas gtsug lag khang rnams bsregs:dus 362

'bras ljongs gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzod/rtags ma yin pa'i rlung ldang ngo : nang rtags bzhi ni: sde 'khrug dar: spun dme byed: chos kyi pho brang shig nas bkol sbyod 'jol nyog tu spyod: btsun pas tshul khrims mi bsrung : de'i dus bsten sgrub la brtson pa dang : mtha' dmag brlog pa dang : sems can gyi srog mgo gdon pa la brtson par bgyis shig: de'i bsod nams ni brjod kyis mi lang ngo : 'gro ba'i don dpag tu me+ed pa byas pa yin no:phyi ma dga' ldan gyi gnas su skye ba the tshom me+ed do:mtha' dmag bablo+og pa la mos pa dang :rjes su yi rang bar byed pa rnams kyang sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnas su skye'o:zhes dang /'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs kyi bka' lung las: de dus nga yi lung bstan dran pa rnams: sbas mtha' mtsho gling nags ri rong du bros: mon ri lho mon nags kyi rong du bros: bsod nams bskal pa rab tu gyur pa rnams: 'phags pa'i sprul pa gcig gis sna drangs te: 'phags pa'i zhing khams 'bras mo gasgo+ongs la bros: yul de bde ba can gyi sa bon yin:gnas der bgrod pa'i skye bo thams cad kun: phyi ma 'od dpag bed kyi zhing du 'gro:ces dang /gnas de bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa lha'i 'dod yon dang mnyam pa:rgyal po'i gdung rabs bco brgyad 'byung : dpal 'bras mo sa/zhongs zhes bya ba 'di: bde gshegs mkha' 'gro zhi khro'i pho brang yin te: der 'gro ba dang 'dun pa gtod pa'i yon tan brjod par mi hūṃs so:zhes dang /363

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/mnga' bdag khri srong lje'u btsan gyi gsang ba'i gab lung las: de dus bod kyi yul na skyid med pas2chos byed thams cad sbas pa'i yul du bros:dpal gyi 'bras mo gzhongs de lha'i yul: bod la dgongs phyir rgyal po nga yis stsal:zhes dang /dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro mas lung mdzad pa las2 gnas der sleb nas dus khrims gtan khrims srungs:khyim pa srid skyong dus bzang bsten gnas srung : gzhi bdag thams cad bsangs brngan mdos kyis mchod: mu stegs bon lugs dmar mchod byed mi nyan: o rgyan bka' 'das bar chad mang po shingang : khyad par cho 'phrul chen po'i blo ba la: pho mo thams cad dbye bas khrims srungs shig:de ltar byas pas thams cad bsam pa 'grub:phyi ma ngan song gsum gyi duḥkha bral:zhes dang /gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i gnas yig las: dpal ldan 'bras mo gsh-i+ongs de ni: yon tan brgya dang lngan pa ste: sems can rnams kyi smon lam btab: 'bad rtsol byas la shugs kyi phyin: chags sems med pa 'gro bar bya:zhes dang /rin chen gling pa'i gter byang las: lho rong lho bod sbas mtha' brten gnas 'tshol: sgo bod sa rigs rtags la so nam gyis: 'gro la phan thog chos sbyod sgrub pa byed: bod du lo bdun dag tu sgoms pa bas: gnas 'dir zhag bdun bsgom pa bsod nams che: yul 'khor gnyen dang bu slob 364

'bras ljongs gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzo+od/zas nor dang :yon bdag sde rigs 'khor la ma chags zhig:zhes dang /gter ston rdo rje gling pa'i gnas yig lung bstan las:nor bu rin po che lta bu'i 'bras mo gshongs su slebs pa'i mi rnams ni: dbul zhing 'phong pa'i 'jigs pa dang bral lo: bkra zhis nying skom pa'i 'jigs pa dang bral lo: mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral lo: nyon mongs pa'i gnas brgyad dang bral lo: mi mthun gnas brgyad dang bral lo: tshe dang bsod nams blo ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du rgyas so: der skyes pa'i mi rnams ni yi dam lha yi byin gyis brlabs: rig pa'i gnas lnga ni phal cher shugs las 'char ro:byang chub kyi sems ni phal cher shugs las 'char ro: 'od gsal ni rang shugs las 'char ro: ma rig pa rang sar dag: bde ba can lta bu'i 'bras mo gzhongs de ru: ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyi gnas dang rten bcos thig: ces gu rus gsungs pas: bai ro nyid kyis gtso byas 'khor rnams rab tu dga' te sbro ba skyes nas rjes su yi rang ngo :zhes dang /gu ru ye shes khyung grags kyi lung byang las: bod yul lo re bzhin du sdug tu 'gro: rang yul 'khor bu'i bde la ma chags par: 'bras mo gzhongs sogs srus pa'i yul rnams su:pad+mas mi bslu nges shes skyes la bros:zhes dang /'phrang mgo gter ston lam yig las: de nas 'bras mo gshongs zhes bya ba 'di ni: rna bar thos pa yang skye ba dpag tu med pa nas bsod nams 365

mkha' spyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bsag dgos: yul der 'dun pa gtong ba yang las dang skal bar lngan pa yin no: der bgrod pa rnams sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa yin no: sbas yul 'bras mo gzhongs 'di lan gcig bskor na yang bskal pa stong du bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag ga2 zhes sogs phan yon rgya cher gsungs so/ /de ltar gnas yig khungs lngan zhig dgos gal che lugs dpal lngan 7mi dbang sa skyong stangs dbyal lhan nas yang yang bka' phebs pa dang / ljongs 'di'i ser skya mchog dman 'ga' zhig nas kyang bskul ma byung ba don dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gter rnying du mar gnas kyi lam yig dang / phan yon lung byang sogs gsungs pa rnams 'ga' zhig dpe ma rnyed/ re zung mchis pa rnams yig skyon che bas 'phyang mor gyur pas bkod stabs ma bde/ yid rton 'pher ba ji snyed mchis pa rnams dkyus gcig tu bsdebs pa po lha btsun 'gyur med 'jigs bral bstan 'dzin dpa' bor 'bod pas so//dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa'i gzi byin dang //bka' gter gnas srung dam can rgya mtsho yi//zhus pa'i stobs dang 'dir 'bad rnam dkar mthus//'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen chos bzhin 'byor//'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par gangs can ljongs//366

'bras ljongs gnas yig phan yon dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gter mdzod/nad mug 'khrugs rtsod dus kyi rgyud pa zhi//chos srid mnga' thang longs spyod cher 'phel nas//rdzogs lngan gsar pa'i dga' ston bzhad par zhog/tshul gnas thos bsam sgom pa'i bshes gnyen dang //dge bcu'i lam bzang ston pa'i rgyal blon rnams//sku tshe brtan cing 'phrin las mkha' khyab 'bar//sbas yul 'gro la bde skyid 'phel bar zhog/srid zhi'i bde skyid lang tsho'i stobs 'bar zhing //phyan tshogs mnga' dbang 'dod rgu dpal du 'khyil//zag bcas 'od skur smin pa'i rdo rje'i sku//yongs khyab chos dbyings grol ba'i bkra shis zhog/ces srus yul gnas yig 'di bzhin 'bras ljongs lha sde spyi 'thus nas dpar brko'i yon sgyar zhus skabs lha btsun pas so//sarba dza ga tam// //

mkha' sbyod 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdebs bzhugs/sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas yig phyogs bsdus/bsdu rub phyogs bsdebs dang zhu sgrig pa/ jo sras bkra zhis tshe ring /spar rtsa zhu dag pa/ brag g.yab grags pa tshe ring /chab ngoms bstan pa nyi ma/deb kyi jus 'god pa/ rgya motsho/kam pu ṭar nang bcug mkhan/ bsado namaso lha ma/pad+ma chas sgran/
rte ramipaṃ musmodzed+kulirdza/
